chapters.title: Chapter 151 - A Terrifying Battle Prowess
paragraphs: “Why would I bully you?” Hearing Lin Zixuan’s words, Hong Dali felt strange and asked, “I just wanted to ask you where you are going next. You don’t have any money with you, are you going to sleep on the streets at night?”
Upon hearing Hong Dali’s words, Lin Zixuan’s lips flattened and sobbed again. “Then, then what can I do? I, I can only do that now.”
“Oh, have no fear.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Reward, 1,000.”
The male lackey standing behind him took out the money and was going to start counting, but Tang Muxin immediately stopped him. “Dali, are you silly, why are giving her so much in one shot!?”
“Is 1,000 a lot? You see how pitiful she is, she doesn’t even have a place to stay.” Hong Dali strangely asked. “I don’t lack this bit of money, anyway.”

“I know that you don’t lack money.” Tang Muxin said, “But the problem is, look at how young she is! That’s 1,000 yuan! Maybe to you, it’s just pocket money. But to ordinary people, this isn’t a small sum. It isn’t a problem for you to give it to her, but what if some hooligan discovered about it. If they want to snatch her money, that will become a big problem!”

“That’s true, Xinxin, you are indeed more meticulous.” Hong Dali touched his chin. “Then, Zixuan, why did you run away from home? Can you tell me? If you tell me, I will send you home—your reason for coming here through delivery is really hard to believe...”
“I, I...” Lin Zixuan cried again. “Why don’t you believe me?”
“Er...” Hong Dali was at a loss of what to say.

In the end, Tang Muxin, who was also a female, was able to interact better with her. She held Lin Zixuan’s hand and softly said, “Zixuan, don’t be afraid. Look at him, even tigers like him, this shows that he is a person of high moral quality, right? What was the actual reason that you ran away from home? Tell me, I will help you!”

She proved the saying that beautiful women tended to gain the trust of others easily. After all, Lin Zixuan was still young. She looked at Tang Muxin with her teary, big eyes and finally admitted, “Actually, I secretly escaped from there, sob, sob!”
“Escaped?!” Hong Dali was horrified. “You ran away from home, right?! You’re only 13 to 14 years old, right? Only so young, and you already dared to run away from home?”

“It’s my parent’s fault for not letting me play games.” Mentioning this, Lin Zixuan expressed great grievances. Her tears rolled down non-stop. “All they do every day is ask me to study hard and study hard, study from morning to night. I couldn’t stand it anymore, so I secretly ran out, sob, sob...”
Wow!
Hearing that, Hong Dali stared in bewilderment.

Were children nowadays all so savage? They ran away from home just because they couldn’t play games? Luckily, this lass seemed quite quick-witted. Otherwise, she might have already been sold off by kidnappers to god knows where.
“Do you really like playing games so much?” Hong Dali stared in bewilderment. “You away from home just because your parents don’t let you play games?”
Lin Zixuan fiercely nodded. “Yup! I love playing games! Love playing games!”
This was the first time he heard a small lass saying that she loved to play games. Normally, it was the little boys who would be saying that...

But Hong Dali was free and had nothing better to do, so he fiercely slapped his thigh and said, “Then, let’s go! There’s an Internet cafe not far from here. It belongs to my family. Speaking of which, I haven’t gone there even once. I shall bring you there to play games! After you’re satisfied with playing, I shall send you home. How does that sound?”
Who knew that this small lass wasn’t silly at all. “Playing games is OK, but not going home!”
“My god!” Hong Dali went frantic. “You would rather not go home just to play games?”

“I’m not going home, I’m just not going home!” Lin Zixuan’s small face cried until it looked like someone doodled on it. She struggled to get up. “I better leave, sob, sob. If I go back home, I will have to study from day to night again...”

“OK, OK...” Hong Dali was really helpless. “Then, let’s not send you home first—I’m just bored from having nothing better to do. Let’s go, I’m bringing you to play games. You’re referring to computer games, right?”
“Real... really?” Lin Zixuan immediately stopped crying. “You must keep your promise, let’s cross our little fingers!”
This fellow was definitely the reincarnation of a leading actress that won the Golden Horse Award. Hong Dali was 100% sure of that.
The two of them crossed fingers, and the matter was basically decided.

After exiting the eatery and walking for less than 20 meters, they reached the Internet cafe that Hong Anbao previously sold to Hong Dali. They walked in with heads held high and chests protruding out, causing the network administrator to wonder who they were at first. But soon after, he recognized Hong Dali as his new boss and instantly came up to greet them.

The Internet cafe wasn’t small, there were about 200 plus computers inside that were all equipped with 27-inch monitors. The computers were all new, and it was pretty obvious that the business here was quite good.

Hong Dali didn’t care that Lin Zixuan’s whole body was covered in dirt and directly asked her to seat at an empty slot. Then, he carried Quentin while Tang Muxin carried Corn, and the two of them just stood behind her, watching her play.
Speaking of which, regarding playing games, Lin Zixuan indeed didn’t lie.
She turned on the computer as if she were very familiar with it and then opened a game called “The Draconic Continent Language.” After entering her username and password, she entered the game.

“The Draconic Continent Language” was about the same as a game that he played in his previous life, “Disconnected City and Weak Warrior,” a side-scrolling 2D online game. The graphics were barely acceptable. Hong Dali didn’t feel strange at all—the people in this world were more interested in sports, there wasn’t a lot of people who played online games normally. At least, compared to his previous life, there were much fewer passionate professional gamers in this world.

The commotion here had attracted the attention of quite a lot of gamers. But when there saw their bearing, especially the tiger in Hong Dali’s arms, they immediately shrunk back—someone one who could bring a tiger out on the streets was definitely someone they couldn’t afford to offend. If they dared to walk up to Hong Dali and his group, they would definitely be pulled out of the cafe and beaten to death.
As for Lin Zixuan, when she entered the game, she didn’t go to the wilderness to hunt for equipment but instead directly entered the PVP area.
Hong Dali was surprised. “Zixuan, this place that you entered is a PVP area, right? Is your equipment enough?”

“No problem!” Lin Zixuan sniffled and said, “Normally, all of them can’t defeat me. But I haven’t played for many days, my skills are a bit rusty.” As she spoke, she quickly found a challenger. Thus, under Hong Dali and Tang Muxin’s bewildered gaze, after some quick movement, her opponent died when she had only dropped 1/5 of her HP...
“Yes! I won!” Lin Zixuan cheered. “He didn’t even reduce 1/5 of my HP!”
Hong Dali’s and Tang Muxin’s faces were full of sweat—she was definitely a rising star in the gaming world, it was an understatement to say that her hand speed was flying about the keyboard.
Then, something dramatical happened.

“What the heck! What situation is this!” From behind Hong Dali came a man’s howling voice. “This fellow is equipped with only rubbish, but why is he so fearsome. Damnit! My equipment is so impressive, but I only managed to tear away a bit of her blood! Not even 1/5...”

As that voice spoke to this point, the person suddenly realized something. Then, Hong Dali and Tang Muxin were also dazed. The few of them gradually turned around, and Hong Dali saw the guy who was abused stood there for an entire five seconds as if he had seen a ghost. Then, he rolled and crawled over and shouted, “God! Where is God? Quick, let me see if it’s you!”

This dude was obviously a bit too anxious, he didn’t even notice the tiger cub in Hong Dali’s arms. He directly ran over and snatched Lin Zixuan’s mouse. “Big Sister, let me see if it’s you!” He looked at Lin Zixuan’s avatar’s name and equipment, then he kneeled. “Big Sister, let me follow you from now on! Would you like something to drink? I shall pay for your gaming fee! I will pay for it!”
Lin Zixuan wasn’t happy. “Who’s your Big Sister! I’m only 14, OK!”

“Four... fourteen years old!” That man’s nose mucus almost flowed out. “Only 14, and your skills are already so good?! If it weren’t because your equipment was too lousy, I wouldn’t even be able to catch your shadow, right!?”
At this moment, Hong Dali finally had a chance to interrupt. “Hey, you. Bro, is the influence of the equipment in the game very big?”
“You don’t even know about gaming?!” Then, the guy noticed Quentin. “What the heck, is this a tiger? I don’t have much knowledge, don’t try to bluff me... it won’t bite me, right?”
“Ah, no, it doesn’t bite.” Hong Dali hurriedly changed the topic. “Can you introduce this game to me? I noticed that most of the people here are playing this game?”

“You don’t even know about ‘The Draconic Continent Language’?” This guy was obviously a fan of gaming. Once he started to talk about gaming, he couldn’t stop. “This is the current most popular online game in the entire world. The balance between all of the professionals are almost perfect, and the most important factor that affects whether you win or lose is your gaming skills, only after that is the equipment. Good equipment doesn’t make you formidable in the game, but good skills will definitely make you formidable. This little sister’s equipment is...” He sighed and continued, “It can be said to be the worst. What a pity, if her equipment was better, she could definitely wipe out everyone!”
Just as he spoke up to this point, Lin Zixuan suddenly said with resentment, “Damn it, my equipment is too lousy. Otherwise, I would have won!”
“There is no need to feat, just continue fighting!” Hong Dali comforted Lin Zixuan and suddenly asked the man, “Then, can the equipment in the game be bought?”
“It’s possible, but it’s too expensive.” The man slightly calculated and said, “If you want a full set of the best quality equipment, it will cost at least 10,000 or more. That isn’t a small amount.”
“10,000?” Hong Dali calmly looked at the lackey standing at the side. “Ask the network administrator to come over here. Just say that I want to buy some equipment.”
“OK!” The lackey jogged away and came back with the network administrator moments later. “Young Master, you asked for me?”

“Buy her a full set of the best quality equipment. I’m talking about the best there is in the game.” Hong Dali pointed at Lin Zixuan who was seated on the chair and overwhelming her opponent. “I will pay for the expenses.”
Now, the commotion here had already alarmed all of the people in the Internet cafe. All of them gathered around them and softly commented:
“Buying a full set of the best equipment? That will need about 10 to 20 thousand, isn’t it!?”
“Yup, he’s a nouveau riche! That isn’t a small sum of money!”
“The problem is, who is he buying it for? The little beggar who’s playing now? You don’t say, her skills are really impressive!”
“Quick, look! Isn’t that a tiger that the nouveau riche is carrying!?”
“It really is! What the heck, this isn’t just a nouveau riche. He’s a God-level nouveau riche, isn’t he!?”

Speaking of which, it was very normal for these people who normally spent time in the Internet cafe or at home not to recognize Hong Dali. If it were other people from the outside, Hong Dali would be recognized the moment he showed his face.

The network administrator was buying the equipment for Lin Zixuan. Order, trade, transfer the money. Half an hour later, Lin Zixuan had changed to a set of the best equipment in the whole game. Then, everyone had an eye-opener...

A legit wipeout! There wasn’t a single opponent who could stand against her in the entire PK arena. At the start, her PK level was only mid-level. But after an hour of overwhelming other players, her level directly climbed to high-level. By now, she had alarmed all of the players in the server. Numerous players came to watch her performance, and her opponents also became more and more strong—but even with the lousiest equipment she could still overwhelm her opponents, there was no need to mention how she was doing now when she had the best equipment in the game.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - E-Sports
paragraphs: At this time, Lin Zixuan was unstoppable, defeating all those that challenged her.

The crowd’s emotions went through the process of astonishment, to admiration, then lastly to numbness. There wasn’t anyone in the entire server who could even manage to hit her avatar—she won all of them with full health. The only top player that was acknowledged by the whole server only managed to hit away 1/4 of her HP after trying with all his might...
After abusing the players in the whole server for an entire two hours, Lin Zixuan was finally satisfied.
The small lass stretched her waist, accidentally revealing her upper limb where the skin was white as snow and smooth as silk. She said, “Ah, I have finally satisfied my craving for gaming, hehe.”
The crowd’s eyes almost dropped to the floor.

Tang Muxin didn’t have the energy to lament Hong Dali for buying this small lass that he just met an entire 20,000 plus worth of equipment anymore. She only felt that Hong Dali was really amazing for being able to constantly meet with talents like this...

Whatever the case, regardless of how amazing this girl who practically dropped from the sky and how mysterious her identity was, it was fine as long as she wasn’t an enemy. As for the eye-catching skin complexion that she hid under her shirt and dirt, Hong Dali wasn’t concerned about that. He pretended not to see it and asked, “Hey, Zixuan, are you satisfied now? Let’s go?”

Although Lin Zixuan wasn’t so willing, she knew that she couldn’t stay any longer. As she stood up, she mumbled, “Sigh, if only I could play like this every day. If there is a competition for this game in the future, I will definitely join it! This will stop my dad from saying that I’m wasting my time.
Huh? There isn’t the term E-Sports in this world?

Hong Dali instantly felt that he was in luck today. Not only did he meet this super-awesome lolita, through her, he also realized that E-Sports didn’t yet exist in this world—wasn’t it a good thing that it didn’t exist yet? He had money, he could host his own E-Sports competition!
Hong Dali laughed loudly and said, “I have decided! I shall host a competition! A competition on PKing in ‘The Draconic Continent Language’!”

“You want to host a competition?” Tang Muxin thought for a while and actually didn’t object. “I think this will work. With Zixuan here, there will definitely be many fierce battles in this competition. I believe that a lot of people will join!”
“Yup, let’s go now.” Hong Dali led the way out. “As for the details, we can discuss that after we have settled the more serious stuff!”

The group of them exited the Internet cafe. Hong Dali pulled on Lin Zixuan’s elbow and asked, “Hey, Zixuan, your body is so dirty, why not ask some sisters to bring you to a bath? It won’t do for you to be so unhygienic, you will grow louse on your body if you carry on like this.”

“No, there’s no need.” Hearing Hong Dali say that he wanted to ask people to bring her to a bath, Lin Zixuan was instantly frightened. Her small body subconsciously leaned back and said, “There’s no need for that. Big Brother, I’m already very satisfied and happy for your treat in both food and gaming, there really is no need for that.”

“Oh...” If it were someone else, they would definitely behave like some weird uncle trying to lure the lolita and trying to appease her. However, Hong Dali had never thought of that. He very straightforwardly snapped his fingers and commanded, “Take her away, find a public bath, and wash her up!”
Thus, regardless of how this lolita struggled, how could she resist against three muscular male lackeys?
She was immediately captured. She shouted for help the whole way, but Hong Dali was quite well-known around this district. Which passerby would dare to step in?

Tang Muxin was very meticulous, she soon discovered the white skin that was occasionally revealed. She secretly thought to herself, This Lin Zixuan, she said that she ran away from home because they didn’t allow her to play games. But, looking at her skin condition, she is obviously not someone from an ordinary family.

After stuffing the lolita into the car, Hong Dali and Tang Muxin also went in. The lolita’s tears flowed down continuously. “You guys are villains, big villains. I thought you guys were good people, but in the end, you guys still want to bring me back, sob...”

“Yes, we’re bringing you back.” Hong Dali strangely asked, “The question is, what are you crying for? It’s not like I’m cutting you up and feeding you to the tigers.” Saying so, he even raised Quentin into the air. “Quentin, give this little sister a smile!”
Thus, Quentin obediently bared her teeth at Lin Zixuan...

“What kind of nonsense are you saying!” Tang Muxin angrily kicked Hong Dali, causing him to bare his teeth in pain. Tang Muxin softly consoled Lin Zixuan, “Zixuan, don’t listen to his nonsense, he is just scaring you. Actually, we just want you to take a bath and dress you up prettily. We will not bully you, don’t worry.” She finally met a small lass that was younger than herself, Tang Muxin instantly an awareness of being a big sister. She was quite satisfied with this.
After all, Tang Muxin still looked very reliable. The lolita stopped crying and asked, “Really? You will not bully me?”
“Yup...” Tang Muxin thought for a while and decisively used her ultimate weapon. “Of course, it’s true. I’m his fiancée, you know? How would I let him mess around?”

Indeed, these few words were more useful than a thousand words. Very quickly, the lolita stopped being afraid. After all, she was not a fool. She believed that with his fiancée at his side, this Young Master definitely wouldn’t take advantage of her. Having thought of this, she felt much better and lightly nodded.

After arriving at the most prestigious public bath in the west fourth loop, the group of them majestically walked in. Hong Dali arranged for two female lackeys to bring Lin Zixuan in for a bath and sat down on the sofa with the others. Hong Dali softly asked Tang Muxin, “Xinxin, what do you think about this small lass? I have the impression that she isn’t from an ordinary family.”

Tang Muxin softly said, “I discovered that too. I noticed her skin condition just now—it’s obvious that she is the type that didn’t have to worry about food and living, and probably has someone send her to school and back. Her skin is very white and delicate, this can only happen due to a period of using top-grade cosmetics. Of course, I think that it’s more likely that she used milk for bathing, and does that frequently.”

“What the heck, you can even discover this?” Hong Dali put on an expression that said women were really scary. He said in fright, “Don’t tell me you were a private detective in your previous lifetime, that’s so scary!”
“Only people like you who don’t have a heart will not pay attention!” Tang Muxin angrily said, “What do you plan to do with this small lass?”

Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “Honestly speaking, I almost can’t bear to let her go home. Otherwise, I will not be able to host the E-Sports competition. But the problem is as you say, her family background should be quite prestigious. She will probably be discovered the moment she shows her face, and her parents will come for her. By that time, I will be in a difficult position.”

“Yup...” Tang Muxin knew what he said was very logical. She thought for a while and said, “I have not heard of another aristocratic Lin family in Tianjing City other than Lin Chuyin’s. By rights, with her current age, she shouldn’t be someone who ran here from another city. Nowadays, you can’t get anywhere far without an identity card. And her appearance is like that of a beggar, and her clothes are also tattered.”
Speaking up to this point, Tang Muxin thought again and said, “Could it be that she is from a Lin family in this city that is not as prestigious? That might be possible.”

“Forget it.” Hong Dali was too lazy to trouble himself and directly instructed Ling Xiaoyi, “Ask someone to go and find out if there is any Lin family in the city that has filed a mission report with the Police. If there is, inform me immediately.”
“Noted.”

Tang Muxin was speechless. Speaking of which, sometimes, ideas were more useful the more stupid they were—since Lin Zixuan had run away from home, her family must have reported it to the Police. So, they would be able to find out once they checked with the Police...
After settling Lin Zixuan’s identity problem, next was the issue of the E-Sports competition that Hong Dali talked about.
Tang Muxin asked, “Dali, the E-Sports that you talked about, do you have any plans for it? I think that this may work out quite well if we do it properly.”
“Of course, I have. It’s simple.” Hong Dali sniffled and said, “Just spend money, that’s all. I’m a professional at squandering.”
“I know you are good at squandering, OK!?” Tang Muxin angrily said, “I’m asking you where to spend the money, not if you know how to spend money!”

“Is there a significant difference between where to spend money and how to spend money?” Hong Dali counted on his fingers. “They are both about spending money...” He quickly felt a death aura coming from beside him and decisively surrendered. “OK, OK, I will say it, I will say it. Yup, spending money is a skill. The first floor of our Chenhui Building is being used to raise the stray dogs now, and the second floor for the stray cats. Currently, there are professional people in charge of this.

“Then, on the eighth floor is the Zhong Dian headquarters, ninth is Caiwei Entertainment, 10th is that one, and there are still so many others. So, let’s do this. We shall use the third floor. The current Chenhui Building still had a lot of empty floors, there wasn’t any problem using one for this purpose.

“Five hundred computers, coupled with some other small stuff—three million should be enough.” Just as he was prepared to start on this project, Hong Dali suddenly remembered that his second Side Mission had not been completed yet and immediately changed his words. “Yup, let’s start with 50 computers and see the effect. Ask them to practice for a month or two, then see the results. There’s no rush for this.”

“Huh, how come you aren’t squandering this time?” To be honest, seeing Hong Dali suddenly not squandering as much as usual, Tang Muxin actually felt a bit weird. “Such a small scale doesn’t seem to be your style.”

Hong Dali’s head was full of sweat. “Ah, it’s nothing much. The main reason is that this isn’t something that can be done in a day or two, we have to take it slowly. Think about it, we have to start with advertising, right? Then, we have to recruit people, right? The computers also have to be tested after they are installed, right? I have to plan in advance for a much bigger scale of squandering in the future, right? But I have already thought of how this competition shall be done. We shall put up six gigantic monitors at the west fourth loop sports stadium. The competitors will be competing down there, and the audience will be watching on top. It will definitely be a hit!”
Tang Muxin: “...”

paragraphs: Tianjing City south second loop, Nanjing Building seventh floor, Mingxin Network.

“Brother, you have to help me this time!” A dejected Liu Mingcheng sat on the sofa, dejectedly saying, “My Turkey Bookstore’s site traffic has dropped by more than half in just a month or so, and it’s still dropping. Can you help me tell Dad to give me some more resources? Otherwise, Turkey Bookstore will be done for!”

Liu Mingcheng’s Turkey Bookstore originally had daily site traffic of 1.2 million, and it was practically the tycoon of the online literature industry. But who could have expected that its site traffic would drop to such an extent in just a month?
Actually, speaking of this, it was because Hong Dali’s lucky was really good.

If it were in his previous life, the online literature industry had already stabilized. Even if there were changes to it, it wouldn’t be as much as in this world. Here, the online literature industry had yet to form an industry chain, and the main source of income was from the readers’ orders. The other copyrights weren’t being utilized to the fullest yet.

Therefore, the high payout in Zhong Dian website easily attracted a lot of authors. Coupled with the new and interesting story formats of the five Great Gods and the 20 plus God-level nouveau riche who threw a lot of money to the authors, numerous authors were attracted there.
Therefore, Turkey Bookstore ended up in a tragedy.

Actually, no one could blame Liu Mingcheng. It was just unfortunate that he was facing up against history’s greatest prodigal, Hong Dali. If it weren’t Hong Dali but someone else, they wouldn’t have such a pure mind as his, to just squander for the sake of squandering.

“So be it.” Liu Mingxin plainly said. “You opponent is a superprodigal, he never expected to earn money in the first place. If you had increased the authors’ payout from the beginning, things might be different. But now that they have already succeeded, it’s too late to try to win them. In other words.” Liu Mingxin slowly shook his head. “Unless you can squander like him and purely squander to lose money, only then will you have a chance of winning.”
“Purely to lose money?” Liu Mingcheng went frantic. “Then, I might as well just close my online bookstore!”

“That’s why I said that.” Liu Mingxin was also helpless. In reality, whoever had to face such an opponent as Hong Dali would also be depressed. “You can’t view Hong Dali as a normal competitor. He never considers the consequences when he squanders, but only squanders as long as he is happy. You have seen for yourself the result.” Liu Mingxin helplessly shrugged. “The fool has the fool’s luck. His luck is so good, what can I do?” - You’re reading on B oxnovel.c om .Tks!

“Then, then what should I do?!” Hearing his brother’s words, Liu Mingcheng frantically said, “Then, I have to see my Turkey Bookstore close down because of him and do nothing? If that happens, I’m not the only one who will lose face, but the entire Liu family!”
“I know that.” Liu Mingxin sighed. “There will definitely be a battle between his family and ours. During this special period, I think that there is a method that will benefit you.”
“What method?!” Hearing his always brilliant brother say that he had a plan to help him, Liu Mingcheng instantly felt a sense of hope.

After all, although they were biological brothers, his talent in entrepreneurship was incomparable to his brother’s. Although Liu Mingcheng’s own talent was limited, he had quite a lot of faith in his brother.
“The best method is for you to do nothing and just let Turkey Bookstore collapse.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said.
“Brother, are you serious? Do you mean that Turkey Bookstore closing down is the best method? I don’t understand!” Liu Mingcheng asked.

“Of course, you don’t understand.” Liu Mingxin explained. “The most important aspect of Turkey Bookstore is that it belongs to our Liu Family. So, if Turkey Bookstore collapses, what do you think the Hong Family will think?”

“Hong Family?” Liu Mingcheng murmured. “What they will think? Wouldn’t they just think that we lost to Hong Dali... Ah, wait, brother, what you mean is that we shall purposely let our opponent think that we are weak?”

“Hehe, it looks like you are actually quite smart. You understood with just a hint.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said, “I heard that Dad will be making a few moves soon. If you bluff them into thinking we are weak and become less cautious, once Dad succeeds, you will have credit too. Whatever the case, you wouldn’t miss out on the rewards.”

“Ah, I see.” Hearing this, Liu Mingcheng was finally happier. “If this is the case, fine. I shall not care about Turkey Bookstore anymore and leave it to fend for itself. But brother, once Turkey Bookstore collapses, I won’t have any pocket money...”

Liu Mingxin knew from the start that his brother came here to ask for money. He gave a slight smile and said, “We’re brothers, how could I not know what you are thinking.” Saying so, he picked a card and passed it to him. “There’s five million inside, remember to spend it sparingly. My current capital flow is quite tight, too. Remember, don’t cause any trouble for Dad. He is very busy lately.”

“I got it, I got it!” Getting five million so easily caused Liu Mingcheng’s mood to turn for the better. He put the card in his pocket, smiled and said, “Then, I shall be going back first. I shall not disturb you anymore, hehe.”
“OK, be careful on the road.”

After Liu Mingcheng had left, Liu Mingxin slight shook his head and murmured, “Dad drew away 200 million from my side’s capital, it looks like his big move will be in one or two months time. Hopefully, everything goes well.”

Thinking up to this point, he suddenly thought about Hong Dali’s cheeky face and helplessly said, “This...” He thought for a while. “The most depressing think about him is that he seems to want to put a foot in every industry, yet he doesn’t fully commit to any of them. Because of this, even if someone wants to set a trap for him, they have no way of doing it. HehE, facing such an opponent is quite interesting, though.”
Actually, when Hong Dali started with his Zhong Dian website, Liu Mingxin had already known about it.

The problem was that, at that time, Hong Dali really wasn’t doing it to fight against Liu Mingcheng, he did it just because he wanted to squander. Then, the most frustrating thing about this fellow was that he actually defeated Liu Mingcheng in such a short time. It was so fast that no one was able to react to it.

“This is really not easy.” Liu Mingxin sighed. “If we leave him alone, I’m afraid he will become a big problem for us in the future. But even if we want to do something to stop him, there’s no way of doing it because no one can guess what he will be doing next. This is really causing us a headache.”
Actually, not only was Liu Mingxin depressed over Hong Dali, Tang Muxin expressed that she was depressed too.
Although she followed Hong Dali around every day, she could never have expected that he would actually do something like an E-Sports competitions.

In this world, sports were the real source of entertainment that people sought for. As for music and movies, that was something people would do in their free time. But as for gaming, that was totally under the category of wasting time. Those people who normally spent their time in Internet cafes were all disliked by others. They were practically a grade below other people. If not, a gaming talent like Lin Zixuan wouldn’t have been forced to the extent of running away from home just to play games.
Under this kind of environment, doing this E-Sports competition... would it actually work?
While Tang Muxin’s thoughts were flying around randomly, Hong Dali was so tired that he hugged Quentin and lay on her thighs.

This instantly caused Tang Muxin’s whole face to turn red. She wanted to push him away but was also unwilling to do it. But if she didn’t push him away... The thighs were quite a sensitive location. Now that Hong Dali was using them as a pillow, Tang Muxin’s heart fluttered madly, and her whole body seemed to sweat.

Just as she was in a dilemma, the door to the women’s bath was suddenly lightly pushed open. Tang Muxin’s eyes lit-up. She saw a beautiful young lady walk out. The lady seemed to be a bit timid, but that couldn’t conceal her beautiful face. Her long black hair hung to her shoulders, and she wore a white dress that came from God knows where. A golden hairband was tied simply at the top of her head, reflecting off the white dress, causing her whole being to seemingly emit light.
Tang Muxin was dazed upon seeing this fairylike girl who seemed to have descended from the Heavens.

When the girl slowly got closer, Tang Muxin saw that she was only about 13 to 14 years old, and her skin was snow-white and delicate as a flower. She looked so beautiful that one almost couldn’t bear to look at her.
Tang Muxin was a beauty herself, but upon seeing this girl, she actually felt like she was in a dream. Tang Muxin immediately rubbed her eyes vigorously.
When she saw the two female lackeys following behind her, Tang Muxin was finally sure that this fairylike girl was actually Lin Zixuan.
Tang Muxin violently shook Hong Dali awake. “Dali, Dali, quick, wake up to see the fairy!”

Unexpectedly, Hong Dali flipped over to the other side in discontent and continued to sleep. His saliva almost dropped out from the corner of his mouth as he mumbled, “How would there be a fairy in broad daylight. It’s much more probable for me to see one in my dreams. Don’t mess around, let me sleep some more...”

“Hurry up and wake up!” Seeing that Hong Dali was going to continue sleeping, Tang Muxin grabbed his face and pinched it. “The fairy is already in front of you, and you still don’t want to wake up. If you miss this chance to see her, you will definitely regret it!”
“AH!!!” Hong Dali sat up, his face full of unwillingness. He rubbed his eyes and said, “What fairy are you talking about...”
Then, he saw Lin Zixuan already standing in front of him and blushing from shyness.
“What...” Hong Dali wiped away the saliva that drooled out and asked. “Who are you?”

A laugh escaped from her mouth as Lin Zixuan said, “Big Brother, you don’t recognize me anymore?” Upon hearing her voice and seeing Lin Zixuan’s faint features in her, he almost couldn’t believe his eyes. After all, no one could imagine that a beggar with tattered clothes and full of dirt would transform into a fairylike girl. He thought for a while and said something that almost made everyone around collapse. “Are you the reinforcement sent here by the Jade Emperor?”

“I’m really going to die of anger because of you!” Tang Muxin was so angry that she stepped on Hong Dali’s foot, causing him to bare his teeth in pain. Tang Muxin said, “This is Lin Zixuan, the little beggar you picked up beside the road!”

“Oh, so it’s Zixuan...” Hong Dali wanted to go back to sleep after saying this, but he immediately came into his senses. “You’re Lin Zixuan?!” He scanned her up and down, then decisively shook his head. “My Lin Zixuan couldn’t possibly be so pretty! Monster, show yourself!”
Everyone: “...”
Tang Muxin hated how she couldn’t throw him out of the window. She angrily stood up, grabbed Lin Zixuan and left. “Sister Zixuan, let’s ignore this big idiot! Let him continue to dream there!”
“She really is Lin Zixuan?” Hong Dali violently pinched his thigh and sucked in a deep breath of cold air from the pain. “Painful! This isn’t a dream!”

If it weren’t Hong Dali but someone else, they wouldn’t have such a pure mind as his, to just squander for the sake of squandering.
“So be it.” Liu Mingxin plainly said.
“You opponent is a superprodigal, he never expected to earn money in the first place.
If you had increased the authors’ payout from the beginning, things might be different.
But now that they have already succeeded, it’s too late to try to win them.
In other words.” Liu Mingxin slowly shook his head.
“Unless you can squander like him and purely squander to lose money, only then will you have a chance of winning.”
“Purely to lose money?” Liu Mingcheng went frantic.
“Then, I might as well just close my online bookstore!”
“That’s why I said that.” Liu Mingxin was also helpless.
In reality, whoever had to face such an opponent as Hong Dali would also be depressed.
“You can’t view Hong Dali as a normal competitor.
He never considers the consequences when he squanders, but only squanders as long as he is happy.
You have seen for yourself the result.” Liu Mingxin helplessly shrugged.

“Then, then what should I do?!” Hearing his brother’s words, Liu Mingcheng frantically said, “Then, I have to see my Turkey Bookstore close down because of him and do nothing?
If that happens, I’m not the only one who will lose face, but the entire Liu family!”
“I know that.” Liu Mingxin sighed.
“There will definitely be a battle between his family and ours.
During this special period, I think that there is a method that will benefit you.”
“What method?!” Hearing his always brilliant brother say that he had a plan to help him, Liu Mingcheng instantly felt a sense of hope.
After all, although they were biological brothers, his talent in entrepreneurship was incomparable to his brother’s.
Although Liu Mingcheng’s own talent was limited, he had quite a lot of faith in his brother.
“The best method is for you to do nothing and just let Turkey Bookstore collapse.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said.
“Brother, are you serious?
Do you mean that Turkey Bookstore closing down is the best method?
I don’t understand!” Liu Mingcheng asked.
“Of course, you don’t understand.” Liu Mingxin explained.
“The most important aspect of Turkey Bookstore is that it belongs to our Liu Family.
So, if Turkey Bookstore collapses, what do you think the Hong Family will think?”
“Hong Family?” Liu Mingcheng murmured.
“What they will think?
Wouldn’t they just think that we lost to Hong Dali...
Ah, wait, brother, what you mean is that we shall purposely let our opponent think that we are weak?”
“Hehe, it looks like you are actually quite smart.
You understood with just a hint.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said, “I heard that Dad will be making a few moves soon.
If you bluff them into thinking we are weak and become less cautious, once Dad succeeds, you will have credit too.
Whatever the case, you wouldn’t miss out on the rewards.”
“Ah, I see.” Hearing this, Liu Mingcheng was finally happier.
“If this is the case, fine.
I shall not care about Turkey Bookstore anymore and leave it to fend for itself.
But brother, once Turkey Bookstore collapses, I won’t have any pocket money...”
Liu Mingxin knew from the start that his brother came here to ask for money.
He gave a slight smile and said, “We’re brothers, how could I not know what you are thinking.” Saying so, he picked a card and passed it to him.
“There’s five million inside, remember to spend it sparingly.
My current capital flow is quite tight, too.
Remember, don’t cause any trouble for Dad.
He is very busy lately.”
“I got it, I got it!” Getting five million so easily caused Liu Mingcheng’s mood to turn for the better.
He put the card in his pocket, smiled and said, “Then, I shall be going back first.
I shall not disturb you anymore, hehe.”
“OK, be careful on the road.”
After Liu Mingcheng had left, Liu Mingxin slight shook his head and murmured, “Dad drew away 200 million from my side’s capital, it looks like his big move will be in one or two months time.
Hopefully, everything goes well.”
Thinking up to this point, he suddenly thought about Hong Dali’s cheeky face and helplessly said, “This...” He thought for a while.
“The most depressing think about him is that he seems to want to put a foot in every industry, yet he doesn’t fully commit to any of them.
Because of this, even if someone wants to set a trap for him, they have no way of doing it.
HehE, facing such an opponent is quite interesting, though.”
Actually, when Hong Dali started with his Zhong Dian website, Liu Mingxin had already known about it.
The problem was that, at that time, Hong Dali really wasn’t doing it to fight against Liu Mingcheng, he did it just because he wanted to squander.
Then, the most frustrating thing about this fellow was that he actually defeated Liu Mingcheng in such a short time.
It was so fast that no one was able to react to it.
“This is really not easy.” Liu Mingxin sighed.
“If we leave him alone, I’m afraid he will become a big problem for us in the future.
But even if we want to do something to stop him, there’s no way of doing it because no one can guess what he will be doing next.
This is really causing us a headache.”
Actually, not only was Liu Mingxin depressed over Hong Dali, Tang Muxin expressed that she was depressed too.
Although she followed Hong Dali around every day, she could never have expected that he would actually do something like an E-Sports competitions.
In this world, sports were the real source of entertainment that people sought for.
As for music and movies, that was something people would do in their free time.
But as for gaming, that was totally under the category of wasting time.
Those people who normally spent their time in Internet cafes were all disliked by others.
They were practically a grade below other people.
If not, a gaming talent like Lin Zixuan wouldn’t have been forced to the extent of running away from home just to play games.
Under this kind of environment, doing this E-Sports competition... would it actually work?
While Tang Muxin’s thoughts were flying around randomly, Hong Dali was so tired that he hugged Quentin and lay on her thighs.
This instantly caused Tang Muxin’s whole face to turn red.
She wanted to push him away but was also unwilling to do it.
But if she didn’t push him away...
The thighs were quite a sensitive location.
Now that Hong Dali was using them as a pillow, Tang Muxin’s heart fluttered madly, and her whole body seemed to sweat.
Just as she was in a dilemma, the door to the women’s bath was suddenly lightly pushed open.
Tang Muxin’s eyes lit-up.
She saw a beautiful young lady walk out.
The lady seemed to be a bit timid, but that couldn’t conceal her beautiful face.
Her long black hair hung to her shoulders, and she wore a white dress that came from God knows where.
A golden hairband was tied simply at the top of her head, reflecting off the white dress, causing her whole being to seemingly emit light.
Tang Muxin was dazed upon seeing this fairylike girl who seemed to have descended from the Heavens.
When the girl slowly got closer, Tang Muxin saw that she was only about 13 to 14 years old, and her skin was snow-white and delicate as a flower.
She looked so beautiful that one almost couldn’t bear to look at her.
Tang Muxin was a beauty herself, but upon seeing this girl, she actually felt like she was in a dream.
Tang Muxin immediately rubbed her eyes vigorously.
When she saw the two female lackeys following behind her, Tang Muxin was finally sure that this fairylike girl was actually Lin Zixuan.
Tang Muxin violently shook Hong Dali awake.
“Dali, Dali, quick, wake up to see the fairy!”
Unexpectedly, Hong Dali flipped over to the other side in discontent and continued to sleep.
His saliva almost dropped out from the corner of his mouth as he mumbled, “How would there be a fairy in broad daylight.
It’s much more probable for me to see one in my dreams.
Don’t mess around, let me sleep some more...”
“Hurry up and wake up!” Seeing that Hong Dali was going to continue sleeping, Tang Muxin grabbed his face and pinched it.
“The fairy is already in front of you, and you still don’t want to wake up.
If you miss this chance to see her, you will definitely regret it!”
“AH!!!” Hong Dali sat up, his face full of unwillingness.
He rubbed his eyes and said, “What fairy are you talking about...”
Then, he saw Lin Zixuan already standing in front of him and blushing from shyness.
“What...” Hong Dali wiped away the saliva that drooled out and asked.
“Who are you?”

A laugh escaped from her mouth as Lin Zixuan said, “Big Brother, you don’t recognize me anymore?” Upon hearing her voice and seeing Lin Zixuan’s faint features in her, he almost couldn’t believe his eyes.
After all, no one could imagine that a beggar with tattered clothes and full of dirt would transform into a fairylike girl.
He thought for a while and said something that almost made everyone around collapse.
“Are you the reinforcement sent here by the Jade Emperor?”
“I’m really going to die of anger because of you!” Tang Muxin was so angry that she stepped on Hong Dali’s foot, causing him to bare his teeth in pain.
Tang Muxin said, “This is Lin Zixuan, the little beggar you picked up beside the road!”
“Oh, so it’s Zixuan...” Hong Dali wanted to go back to sleep after saying this, but he immediately came into his senses.
“You’re Lin Zixuan?!” He scanned her up and down, then decisively shook his head.
“My Lin Zixuan couldn’t possibly be so pretty!
Monster, show yourself!”
Everyone: “...”
Tang Muxin hated how she couldn’t throw him out of the window.
She angrily stood up, grabbed Lin Zixuan and left.
“Sister Zixuan, let’s ignore this big idiot!
Let him continue to dream there!”
“She really is Lin Zixuan?” Hong Dali violently pinched his thigh and sucked in a deep breath of cold air from the pain.
“Painful!
This isn’t a dream!”

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - Picked up from the Roadside
paragraphs: It was no wonder that Hong Dali didn’t dare to believe.
Who would have thought that a little beggar that he picked up at the roadside was not only a gaming expert but also a fairylike character? Was his luck with the ladies really so incredible?
But regardless of all that, now that he had already taken her in, it wasn’t easy to make him return her.
Hong Dali sniffled and said, “OK, frankly speaking, this small lass is really quite pretty. She’s at least about the same standard as my Xinxin and Sister Nianwei. Yup, that’s right.”

Hong Dali walked out and boarded the car. Previously, because Lin Zixuan was too dirty, Quentin was unwilling to get close to her. But now, Quentin actually struggled to get close to her. Hong Dali was so angry that he jumped and said, “You little rascal, you chose looks over friendship!”
Tang Muxin humphed and said, “What are you talking about, Quentin is a female. Wasn’t you the one who told me that...”

Now that everything had been settled, and Hong Dali had also played for quite a while, seeing that the sky was getting dark, he immediately sent Tang Muxin home. Then, the car turned around and returned to Hongwu Villa.

After Tang Muxin left, Lin Zixuan obviously felt a bit awkward and subconsciously moved further away from Hong Dali. But being a young girl of only 14 years old, she couldn’t contain her curiosity and looked all over the Soaring Angel on the way home. Her face was red from holding in her questions, obviously showing that she had a lot of queries but couldn’t bring herself to ask them.

Seeing her like this, Hong Dali secretly thought, Looks like her family background isn’t as good as I thought it was. At the most, it can only be considered an average wealthy family, but not yet to the standard of an aristocratic family.

Actually, this was because his level was too high. After all, in Tianjing City, there were only a few families on par with the Hong Family—one could count them with one hand. As for the other wealthy families, they were obviously not up to the standard of the Hong Family.

“Big Brother, you, are you bringing me back to your house?” The atmosphere in the car was quite cold now. Lin Zixuan thought for a while, gathered her courage and asked, “Then, where is it at?” After half a day spent together, Hong Dali didn’t show any signs that he was a pervert, so the small lass was more at ease than before. Another thing was that someone who could afford to sit in such a luxury car and also let his lackeys sit in luxury cars wasn’t someone that she could fight back at, even if Hong Dali really wanted to do something to her. Therefore, she could only resign to her fate and try to warm up the atmosphere between them. At the very least, he treated her quite well today—the small lass had a natural liking towards all those that supported her gaming.

“Where else could we be going if not home?” Towards Lin Zixuan’s beauty, other than the initial surprise, Hong Dali actually didn’t feel anything special—anyone who spent his days with beauties such as Tang Muxin and Li Nianwei would naturally have a super high resistance to beauties. Therefore, in his eyes, this small lass who was a genius in gaming was even less interesting than Quentin, who he was hugging. “I couldn’t just let you sleep on the streets, right? Don’t worry, my house is very big, it isn’t a problem finding a place for you to sleep.”

“OK...” Seeing that Hong Dali wasn’t like those other young masters who stared at her face intensely, Lin Zixuan finally felt relieved. Therefore, she had an even better impression of Hong Dali now. Of course, she also felt a higher sense of security. She could see that Hong Dali wasn’t a big pervert. Therefore, the small lass’ words gradually increased. “Then, where is your house at, Big Brother?”

Hong Dali looked outside the window and casually said, “Do you see that small mountain over there? Follow this road all the way, and we will arrive at a place that seems to be a forest. That’s my home.”

“That mountain?” Lin Zixuan slightly pondered and very quickly realized where this place was. At the same time, she finally knew who the person in front of her was. “Hongwu Mountain? Hongwu Villa? You are that legendary superprodigal, Hong Dali!?”

For the first time, this gaming genius showed her astonished expression in front of Hong Dali. A rare type of sensation flowed in her—it was like a believer on a pilgrimage, devout, and a bit of sincere respect and nervousness.

The Hongwu Villa’s Hong Weigo, that was the idol of the upper-class people in Tianjing City. He was a legend in the business industry. All those who had a bit of fame would all point their thumbs up when they heard people mention the Hong Family.
The small lass background wasn’t bad. Therefore, she naturally understood how influential the Hong Family was.

“I remember that my Dad came home one day and behaved as if he had won a million yuan. When I asked him the reason, he said it was because he saw a few of Sangle Enterprise’s high executives. Those people are already considered legends.” Lin Zixuan smiled and said, at the same feeling quite proud of herself.

To think that a small lass like her could actually sit in the car of Hong Dali, the only Young Master of the Hong Family. She could only be surprised at how amazing destiny was. After all, she was just a 14-year-old girl, she had a bit of vanity too.
“Maybe.” Hong Dali sniffled and continued to tease the cub in his arms. “I see them most of the time, anyway. So, my impression might not be that large. Maybe to you that will be a difficult chance.”

“That’s true.” Lin Zixuan agreed. “If you see them every day, naturally you wouldn’t feel surprised.” As she spoke, she looked out of the window. By now, the Soaring Angel had already driven into the path where both sides were planted with ginkgoes. The deeper they went in, the more unusual Lin Zixuan felt about the place.
She wasn’t someone who had never seem what the upper-class was like. After all, her family conditions were not bad too.

But this was the first time she saw a family occupying a few mountains. In ancient times, these kinds of people were all nobilities. Everyone lived on the same planet. She originally thought that her family conditions were still not bad, but once she compared Hong Dali’s family and her own, she felt that her pride was a bit hurt.
When she saw the two three-meter tall red jade lion statues at the foot of the mountain, Lin Zixuan could only openly express her admiration.
In the end, Lin Zixuan could only mumble one sentence.
“Our Heavenly State really have mighty people hiding everywhere.”

By rights, if it were some other girl that could connect with some young fellow like Hong Dali who was practically a mountain of gold, what they would be thinking about was probably how to get married to him and such. But as the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together. The current Lin Zixuan was thinking that with Hong Dali as her backing, her parents wouldn’t dare to force her to study the whole day and not let her play online games anymore...

The awesome person living in the villa ahead could be considered to be her father’s boss’ boss’ boss—if she really counted to the end, there would probably be ten plus layers of relationships in between.

She said to herself that, this time, if anyone still dared to look down on her for playing online games, she could stick out her still very flat chest and proudly say that it was Brother Dali who supported her gaming, an ordinary person wouldn’t even have the chance to have the same treatment!
Just as she thought of this, the gate that the two red jade lion statues were guarding gradually opened, and the four cars drove in.
When they really entered the Hong Family’s villa, Lin Zixuan then realized how low her level of vision was in the past.

A group of people stood outside the main mansion, respectfully standing in two rows. There were both men and women, young and old, totaling 40 plus. The one standing in front was an old grandfather wearing a black Chinese tunic suit. He wasn’t very tall, his body shape was slim—the most healthy type for his age—and he stood with his back straight like a pole. One look at him and people would be able to tell that he came from Heavenly State’s best family of butlers. Just the butler alone would cost at least 0.3 to 0.5 million a year.

The convoy gradually slowed down to a stop, and Hong Dali brought Lin Zixuan down with him. The butler hurriedly walked up, and his originally eerie face finally smiled. He half bowed towards Hong Dali and said, “Young Master Dali, you have finally returned. Master and Madam were already getting anxious from waiting for you. They have some matters to tell you.”

“My Dad and Mum want to talk to me?” Hong Dali sniffled, grabbed Lin Zixuan’s small hand and ran. When he reached the entrance, he didn’t care that the high-quality wooden door cost several hundred thousands and kicked it. Then, he yelled, “Dad, Mum, I’m back!”

“Oh my, my house’s little prodigal has finally returned.” Lan Ruoxi hurriedly walked out from the room. Once she saw Hong Dali, she immediately walked up and grabbed his hand. “Look at you, you played until your hands have gone cold. These two nights the weather is getting cold, and you didn’t put on a few more clothes.”
After she grabbed and pressed Hong Dali into the sofa, she then looked at Lin Zixuan who was standing at the side. “This child is...”

“A small beggar I picked up from the roadside.” Hong Dali naturally didn’t care if she were fairylike or not, the first impression was all that mattered. He directly picked up a can of beverage and took a long mouthful before saying, “Her name is Lin Zixuan. I think that it would be not bad for her to be my Sister, so I brought her back.”

“Tsk tsk tsk.” Lan Ruoxi was overjoyed. She walked round Lan Ruoxi and looked from up to down and front to back. Lin Zixuan was very beautiful in the first place, not losing to Tang Muxin at all. Now that she was a bit afraid, her tiny face looked really pitiful, her fingers intertwined, her face red and lowered—she looked just like a frightened rabbit. The more Lan Ruoxi looked at her, the Lan Ruoxi liked her. After a while of looking, she shouted, “Husband! Quick, come out! Look what Dali brought home for us!”

“I’m coming, I’m coming. What is it that you are putting up a fuss for.” Hong Weiguo held a tobacco pipe and slowly walked out from a room. Upon seeing Lin Zixuan standing there, his eyes also lit-up and asked in surprise, “Yo, what a beautiful little lady. Dali brought her home?”

“That’s right.” Lan Ruoxi’s laughed until her wrinkles showed. “Our little prodigal’s eyesight and luck are really amazing. Look at this little lady, see how beautiful she is. This skin—yup, white and delicate. This small nose and mouth and not small eyes, and she even have double eyelids. Her hair is also black and shiny, this is really good, haha.”
Her long-windedness caused Lin Zixuan to become even shyer.

And this wasn’t the end, Hong Weiguo also praised her. “Yup, she is a piece of good material. Our Dali’s eyesight is really excellent.” Saying so, he turned and looked at Hong Dali. “Dali, where did you find this small lass?”

“I picked her up from the roadside.” Hong Dali held up the cub in his arms, shocking Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi. Lan Ruoxi anxiously said, “Oh my little ancestor, you really dare to touch anything. I was wondering where you got this tiger-like cat, but I see now that this is a real tiger, isn’t it? Quick, pass it to me, aren’t you afraid that it will bite you.”
“It would never bite me.” Hong Dali said towards Quentin. “Come, Quentin, kiss me!”
Quentin instantly stretched out her tongue and licked Hong Dali.

Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi were shocked again. Lan Ruoxi said in surprise, “Looks like this little fellow also has the potential to be a prodigal, haha. Just nice, Dali and this tiger cub can form a pair! I shall ask the butler to prepare some high-quality Australia beef to feed it later!”

“Look at you, you played until your hands have gone cold.
These two nights the weather is getting cold, and you didn’t put on a few more clothes.”
After she grabbed and pressed Hong Dali into the sofa, she then looked at Lin Zixuan who was standing at the side.
“This child is...”
“A small beggar I picked up from the roadside.” Hong Dali naturally didn’t care if she were fairylike or not, the first impression was all that mattered.
He directly picked up a can of beverage and took a long mouthful before saying, “Her name is Lin Zixuan.
I think that it would be not bad for her to be my Sister, so I brought her back.”
“Tsk tsk tsk.” Lan Ruoxi was overjoyed.
She walked round Lan Ruoxi and looked from up to down and front to back.
Lin Zixuan was very beautiful in the first place, not losing to Tang Muxin at all.
Now that she was a bit afraid, her tiny face looked really pitiful, her fingers intertwined, her face red and lowered—she looked just like a frightened rabbit.
The more Lan Ruoxi looked at her, the Lan Ruoxi liked her.
After a while of looking, she shouted, “Husband!
Quick, come out!
Look what Dali brought home for us!”
“I’m coming, I’m coming.
What is it that you are putting up a fuss for.” Hong Weiguo held a tobacco pipe and slowly walked out from a room.
Upon seeing Lin Zixuan standing there, his eyes also lit-up and asked in surprise, “Yo, what a beautiful little lady.
Dali brought her home?”
“That’s right.” Lan Ruoxi’s laughed until her wrinkles showed.
“Our little prodigal’s eyesight and luck are really amazing.
Look at this little lady, see how beautiful she is.
This skin—yup, white and delicate.
This small nose and mouth and not small eyes, and she even have double eyelids.
Her hair is also black and shiny, this is really good, haha.”
Her long-windedness caused Lin Zixuan to become even shyer.
And this wasn’t the end, Hong Weiguo also praised her.
“Yup, she is a piece of good material.
Our Dali’s eyesight is really excellent.” Saying so, he turned and looked at Hong Dali.
“Dali, where did you find this small lass?”
“I picked her up from the roadside.” Hong Dali held up the cub in his arms, shocking Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi.
Lan Ruoxi anxiously said, “Oh my little ancestor, you really dare to touch anything.
I was wondering where you got this tiger-like cat, but I see now that this is a real tiger, isn’t it?
Quick, pass it to me, aren’t you afraid that it will bite you.”
“It would never bite me.” Hong Dali said towards Quentin.
“Come, Quentin, kiss me!”
Quentin instantly stretched out her tongue and licked Hong Dali.
Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi were shocked again.
Lan Ruoxi said in surprise, “Looks like this little fellow also has the potential to be a prodigal, haha.
Just nice, Dali and this tiger cub can form a pair!
I shall ask the butler to prepare some high-quality Australia beef to feed it later!”

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - Old Rogue
paragraphs: High-quality Australia beef! Look at that, anything that was related to Brother Dali had such good treatment!
Hong Dali grinned and said, “OK. Actually, I still have another cat called Corn. Xinxin liked it, so I asked her to take it.”
“Yup, that’s not an issue.” Lan Ruoxi asked, “First, tell us. How did you find this little lady?”

“At first, I was walking the tiger on the road. Then, a little child wanted to take a look at it.” Hong Dali sniffled. “I reckon that since I had nothing to do anyway, I let her see. As a result, more and more people came. I was bored and noticed Zixuan, dressed as a small beggar, was hiding in a corner and didn’t dare to come over but only peeked at us. I was curious since it didn’t matter if one more person came to look at Quentin or not, so I asked a lackey to bring her over. After we chatted, not bad, we got along quite well. Sister Zixuan is really good at gaming!”

“You mean to say, she was a small beggar, and because she wanted to look at Quentin but didn’t dare to go over, so you brought her over to you?” Lan Ruoxi was shocked. “So simple? Today is the first day you guys met?”
“Yeah.” Hong Dali strangely said, “She wasn’t willing to go back home, so I brought her home with me.”

“Then, after she bathed and turned so beautiful, you weren’t surprised?” Lan Ruoxi was a little anxious now. Could it be that her son had something wrong with his sexual preferences? This small lass was so pretty, yet he didn’t even mention anything about that?
“I was surprised!” Hong Dali nodded. “But I couldn’t be surprised forever, right? Anyway, I see beauties frequently, so I didn’t feel anything special.”
That was true, the girls around Hong Dali were each one more pretty than the last. It wasn’t strange for him to be almost immune to prettiness.

Lan Ruoxi thought for a while and suddenly smiled, saying, “Husband, see, didn’t Dali always wanted us to give him a sister when he was small, but we never succeed. I think this small lass is not bad, why not we...”

“Yup.” Hong Weiguo puffed out his smoke. “This is practically Heaven sending Dali a sister by dropping her from the sky, not bad. OK, it’s settled then. I will try to contact her family and let her become our goddaughter.

Even someone as formidable as Hong Weiguo also had to concede defeat to Hong Dali’s luck—a random girl that he picked from the streets was beautiful like a fairy... No one would believe them even if they told this to others.
Since this was the case, as long as there wasn’t a problem with her identity, it didn’t matter if they had an extra pair of chopsticks in the family.
Lin Zixuan had never thought that in just such a short moment, she actually became Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi’s goddaughter.

The small lass was slightly at a loss of what to do. Luckily, Lan Ruoxi was more experienced. She held Lin Zixuan’s hand and gently said, “You name is Lin Zixuan, right? Zixuan, from now on, you can just stay here. If you need anything, just let the butler know. We will help you inform your family, I think they won’t disapprove. Do you think this is OK?”

After all, they were not very familiar yet. Lin Zixuan face showed some excitement and some nervousness. In the end, she still generously nodded and said, “Then... then I shall thank you first... thank you, Godmother.”

“Yo, husband, look at how sweet this small lass’ mouth is.” Lan Ruoxi helped Lin Zixuan tidy her slightly messy hair and said, “It’s getting late, I shall ask the butler to bring you to rest now. Is that OK?”
“OK.” It shouldn’t be bad letting herself cool down first. Lin Zixuan decisively nodded. “Then, I shall go and rest now. Godmother and Godfather, goodnight.”
“Goodnight.”
After Lin Zixuan left, Lan Ruoxi looked at Hong Weiguo. “Husband, what do you think...”
“Yup, this small lass is not bad.” Hong Weiguo touched his chin and asked Hong Dali, “Dali, did she run away from her family?”
“Yup. Supposedly, it has already been half a month.” Hong Dali nodded and said, “I have asked the lackeys to check around. This what most of the neighborhood people said.”

“Run away from home, then that should be easy.” Hong Weiguo instantly took out his phone and dialed a number. He laughed and said, “Old Ji, it’s me, Hong Weiguo. Yup, I would like to ask of you to help me check if there’s anyone who made a police report about a missing girl this period in Tianjing City? Yup, that’s right, a 14-year-old little girl. OK, let’s meet up for gathering when you are free, you definitely must come. Hehe, alright.”
After hanging up, Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Let’s wait a while, they have started checking.”

Very quickly, his phone ringed. He picked it up and asked, “Yup, how is it? Oh, there really is, right? Which family is it? Lin Yingyi? Yup, I seem to have some impression of him. Yup, OK, wait for me to record it down.”
Hong Weiguo took up a pen and recorded down Lin Yingyi’s phone number. Then, he smiled and said, “Yup, OK, I have recorded it. Hehe, see you another day.”
“How is it?” Seeing that he had gotten the information, Lan Ruoxi anxiously asked.
“Lin Yingyi, according to Old Ji, is the director of quite a big company in the east district.” Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Let me ask.”
He dialed the phone number that he recorded down. Very quickly, a slightly anxious voice sounded from the other side. “Hello, you are...”
Hong Weiguo said, “Is this Mr. Lin Yingyi? Is your daughter Lin Zixuan? With very white and delicate skin, and a small red mole on her neck?”

“It’s Lin Zixuan, it’s her!” Lin Yingyi was obviously agitated. He anxiously asked, “Mister, did you see my daughter? Where is she? I wish to see her immediately. Please be assured, I won’t let you waste your time for nothing! You can make any request you want!” He thought for a while and anxiously said, “I only beg of you to not hurt her, please!”
“Hehe, Mr. Lin, you’re too polite.” Hong Weiguo said, “How long have your daughter left home?”

“Sigh, it’s my fault for forcing her too much, she has already left home for half a month. She only called once a week ago to report her safety.” He was so worried that he didn’t even wait for Hong Weiguo to ask. Lin Yingyi said everything, “Mister, please don’t hurt her, I only have this one precious daughter. As long as you can send her back, you can have as much money as you want! A million, how does a million sound to you!?”
Huh, looks like he thought that Hong Weiguo was a kidnapper. He thought for a while, suddenly smiled and said, “Mr. Lin, don’t you think that this price is a bit too low?”
“This...” Lin Yingyi got anxious. “Three million! I offer you three million! As long as you don’t hurt her, I’m willing to pay three million!”
“Looks like you still have some sincerity.” Hong Weiguo plainly said, “Five million, a dollar less and I will take a finger from her instead.”
“NO!” The person on the other side was obviously terrified. He anxiously said, “I agree! I agree! But...”
“But what?” Hong Weiguo asked.

“I can’t raise so much money in such a short time. Can you give me two days? Just two days!” Lin Yingyi anxiously said, “Just two days! I promise not to call the police! I won’t mention this to anyone, either! Mister, you should know that five million isn’t a small sum. I really can’t fork it out immediately!”

“All right, you do have some sincerity.” Hong Weiguo said, “Tomorrow morning at 7:00 AM, go to the entrance to Ye Lai Xiang at the west fourth loop. I will ask someone to bring you over to see your daughter. If I discover even one police officer, your daughter will suffer for it.”
“OK, OK, OK! I understand! I will be there punctually.” Lin Yingyi anxiously said.
“Then, that’s all. See you tomorrow.”
After hanging up, Lan Ruoxi burst out in laughter and said, “You can really make a spoof, you old rogue.”
Hong Dali, who was at the side, stared in bewilderment. His father really knew how to scare someone!
“Hehe, he’s my goddaughter’s father, I have to check on his moral quality.” Hong Weiguo touched his chin and suddenly shouted, “Old Wang!”
Very quickly, Hong Dali’s driver, Wang Mingyu, suddenly appeared in front of Hong Weiguo like a ghost. “Master.”
“Ask someone to check on all the information on this Lin Yingyi from the east district—the more detail there is, the better.” Hong Weiguo said in a deep voice. “Go now.”
“Yes, Master.”

After settling everything, Hong Weiguo then sat down on the soda, smiled and said, “To be our goddaughter, anything else is not important, but she must come from a clean background. I don’t wish for our backyard to be on fire one day.” When he finished, he said, “Dali, let me take a look at this small tiger.”
“OK.” Hong Dali placed Quentin in Hong Weiguo’s lap. “Quentin, kiss daddy!”
Quentin instantly stretched out its tongue and licked Hong Weiguo’s face, immediately causing them to laugh in joy.

Hong Weiguo said, “This is really a healthy and silly-looking tiger. Speaking of which, Dali, it looks like you really have an affinity with small animals. Previously, you raised quite a lot of dogs. Why, raising dogs is not interesting anymore, so you are changing to raising tigers instead?”

He couldn’t tell them about the stuff related to the System, so Hong Dali sniffled and ambiguously said, “Oh, it was because I was too bored and heard that a private zoo was changing its business. I saw that those animals were quite pitiful, so I bought them all.”

“Yup, as long as you like it.” Hong Weiguo placed Quentin in Lan Ruoxi’s embrace and said towards Hong Dali, “Dali, speaking of which, there’s only one week left before your 18th birthday on May 28th. This is your coming of age ceremony, where do you want to hold it at?”
Coming of age ceremony? This world actually still does this?

He had to admit. Because he wasn’t born in this world, he wasn’t familiar at all with this coming of age ceremony. But this didn’t stop him from answering. “Yup, anywhere is fine. I don’t have any objections.”

“This can’t do.” Lan Ruoxi, who was carrying Quentin, gently said, “Our little prodigal has grown up now, you’re going to become an adult. This is a big matter—as big as the sky. If you disregard it, you will be looked down upon. Don’t worry, this time, your Dad and I have prepared 10 million for your celebration expenses. After your coming of age ceremony, you will have to...” Speaking up to this point, she looked at Hong Weiguo, softly sighed, and didn’t continue.

Hong Weiguo hurriedly continued the topic. “Once your 18th birthday is over, you will become one of the core members of the Hong Family. By that time, during the family meeting, they will inspect you. But I believe that it isn’t a problem for you. You current achievements are more than enough to pass the inspection, so you don’t have to worry.”

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - Have Boldness! Have Foresight! Have Magnanimity!
paragraphs: Oh, so this was what it was about. Simply put, after my 18th birthday, I will become a core member of the family, so I have to start doing business and earning money. But I always squander, no wonder Dad and Mum are a bit worried for me.

Luckily, my luck is not bad most of the time. All those things that I spend money in have earned quite a bit of money—there’s no need to fear then, I shall just carry on like usual and ignore how others think about me. It’s not like I’m spending other people’s money, anyway.
“Ten million?” Hong Dali thought for a while. “That’s quite a bit of money. Do you have any suggestion for me, Dad?”

“Hehe, I suggest that you make it grand! As grand as possible!” Hong Weiguo proudly said, “I want the whole world to know that my Dali is a grown man now! You’re independent now! Not the child that you used to be! Therefore, this time, it must be grand and astonishing. And it’s best if they will never be able to forget it!”

OK, this is indeed my own father, he couldn’t hate to let the entire world know that I’m an adult now. Looks like I’m going to promote from a little prodigal to a big prodigal! This is not bad at all!

But carefully thinking about it, there are benefits in making the ceremony into a grand event. It will at least let others know how important I am to Hong Weiguo. This is probably his real intention—for me, he isn’t concerned about how much he needs to spend, this will cause other’s to reconsider before they think about touching me.
The coming of age ceremony isn’t the aim, the aim is to show Hong Weiguo’s attitude towards me!

Thinking of this, Hong Dali smiled. He might not be good at other stuff, but that didn’t include squandering. This was his specialty! He instantly said, “Dad, I just thought of a plan. I guarantee that it will be astonishing!”
Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Oh? Let me hear about it.”
Hong Dali’s eyes glittered like stars. “Dad, do we have a cruise ship in our family?”

“You mean you want to host the ceremony on a cruise ship?” Hong Weiguo touched his chin. “We do have one that’s not bad. I remember that it was about 80,000 to 95,000 tons. The price was 88 million, or was it 96 million? I can’t really remember.”
“Er...” Hong Dali was a bit depressed. “That’s a bit too large...”
“Is that very large?” Hong Weiguo strangely asked. “It will, of course, be better for your ceremony to be as grand as possible. I was still thinking that this one was a bit too small.”
“Er, I think I didn’t explain clearly.” Hong Dali sniffled, grinned and said, “I was thinking about moving the cruise ship to Fengyuan Lake and host my coming of age ceremony there...”
Hong Weiguo: “...”
Lan Ruoxi: “...”

The two of them were dazed for a while before Hong Weiguo laughed loudly. He excitedly patted on Hong Dali’s shoulder and said, “You’re indeed my son, you have the boldness! The foresight! The magnanimity! Then, it’s decided!”

He excitedly stood up and paced around in the living room. “Yup, putting a cruise ship in Fengyuan Lake is a brilliant idea, it will definitely shock them! It’s decided! But our cruise ship is too big. And it’s not easy finding a small one...”
Lan Ruoxi smiled and said, “Speaking of which, I remember that I saw some news somewhere about this.”

She placed Quentin on the ground, went into the study room, and searched through the documents. A short while later, she told out a piece of newspaper. “A few days ago, I happened to see news about this second batch of the Golden Long River series, represented by ‘Golden Long River One.’ They have finished testing in the waters and were strictly designed according to the ocean cruise ship’s standards. Each of them cost 30 million or so. The ship is 130-meters long, 24-meters wide, and 6 floors tall. There are a total of 200 plus rooms, including standard rooms, executive rooms, luxury suites, and also presidential suites. The maximum number of passengers it can hold is 570. It’s truly a fifth-generation large-sized luxury cruise ship.”
After introducing the ship to them, Lan Ruoxi showed Hong Weiguo the photo on the newspaper. “What do you think of this one?”
“Not bad, not bad at all!” Hong Weiguo’s eyes were instantly lit-up. “Dali shall use this for his coming of age ceremony! I shall call them now to buy one.”

After discussing a few more details, Wang Mingyu came back. He respectfully said, “Master, I have done a simple check on him.”
Hong Weiguo: “OK, tell me.”
