However, most of them are fixed assets such as the restaurants and so on. Thus, his liquid assets are only about three million or so. According to our intelligence, his moral quality is not bad, and he is an honest, upright person. He has never done any dirty at other’s back before, even though his business has already expanded to such a scale. Overall, he can be considered to be a good person.”

“Yup, it’s fine as long as his background is clean.” With this information, Hong Weiguo finally eased his mind. He smiled and said, “Looks like our Dali has some ladies luck. He can find such an outstanding girl just by randomly picking her up from the streets.”
Lan Ruoxi grinned and poked Hong Dali’s head. “Little rascal, I see that this Lin Zixuan is not bad too, let’s raise her as your child bride. What do you think?”
Hong Dali sniffled. “Mum, isn’t she going to be my Sister, aren’t you thinking too far ahead?”

“It’s not like you are connected by blood, what are you afraid of.” Lan Ruoxi smiled and said, “I’m waiting for you to bear me a grandson, a granddaughter is also fine. Your Dad and I already thought of names for them. If it’s a boy, he will be called Hong Dalong. If it’s a girl, she will be called Hong Xiaofeng...”
Seeing his mother thinking so far ahead, Hong Dali decisively surrendered. “I’m going back to sleep now. If we go on any further, you’re probably even going to talk about my grandson...”

“Yo, is our little prodigal shy? Hehe.” Even Lan Ruoxi’s eyes were smiling too. “It will be wonderful if four generations of our family can live together. Speaking of which, you little rascal have to buck up!”

Hong Weiguo laughed loudly and said, “Look at you, aren’t you scaring Dali away? OK, don’t chat anymore, have an early rest. I really have to go and see this Lin Yingyi tomorrow morning.” As he said so, he softly instructed Wang Mingyu, “Mingyu, send someone to keep guard over Lin Yingyi’s house and spy on him. See if Lin Zixuan really ran away from home or was purposely sent here. See if he is really anxious, then come back and report to me.”
“Yes, Master.” Wang Mingyu instantly replied.
Tianjing City East district, Lin Yingyi’s house.

Lin Zixuan’s father, Lin Yingyi, was about 40 years of age. He was usually refined in manner, but now, his face was malevolent and roared, “Damn bastard! Dog! He actually dared to kidnap my Xuanxuan! I’m going to kill him! Kill him!” Then, he trashed everything in sight and was frightening to look at.

Lin Zixuan’s mother was slightly plump, her skin was very white, and she would have looked quite pretty. But now, her face was full of anxiety, and her eyes were red. She sat there with her head lowered, occasionally sniffing from crying. She cried, “Old Lin, stop throwing things. You have smashed almost everything in the house in just this short while. Hurry up and think of something.”
She cried sadly. Obviously, this matter had caused the family to be worried sick.
Five million wasn’t a small sum to them—they were people who barely made it into the ranks of the upper-class society.

Lin Yingyi shouted, “Think of something? I have thought of everything, but I’m still lacking one million not matter how I tried. What can I do? What am I supposed to do? If anything happens to Xuanxuan, how am I supposed to live on!”

Lin Zixuan’s mother cried again and said, “If there’s really no, no other methods, then just sell this house. It should be enough. No matter what, it’s more important to rescue Xuanxuan. After all, she’s your biological daughter.”

“Sell the house?” Lin Yingyi’s voice trembled. “Where should we stay if we sell the house? Also, even if we want to sell the house, there is not enough time.” As he said this, he slapped himself hard. “It’s all my fault! It’s my f*cking fault! Why did I have to force her to study from day to night!”

“What’s the point of saying all these now.” Lin Zixuan’s mother cried and said, “Even if we have no money, we can still earn it. Xuanxuan is so good looking... If those kidnappers... we must rescue her first no matter what!”
“I know.” Lin Yingyi sat on the sofa and violently rubbed his hair. “Wait for me to see Xuanxuan tomorrow first, sigh.”
As Lin Yingyi and his wife were worrying, there was a shadow outside their door. The person recorded everything and slowly walked back, then turned around and left.
They couldn’t sleep that night.

Early morning on the second day, Lin Yingyi got out of bed and dressed neatly. He sucked in a deep breath and took a look at his wife who only just managed to fall asleep before leaving the house. He murmured, “Sigh, hopefully, Heaven will bless us. Even if I have to sacrifice my life, I will rescue Xuanxuan.”
As he said so, he lightly closed the door.
Two rows of tears rolled down from the corner of his wife’s eyes as she quietly cried.

After leaving the house, Lin Yingyi took the car and directly went towards Tianjing City’s west fourth loop. Recently, the popularity of this area was huge. The location of Ye Lai Xiang was very obviously marked on the car’s navigator. Coupled with the fact that there wasn’t a lot of cars on the road yet this early, Lin Yingyi reached the entrance of Ye Lai Xiang in just half an hour.

Ye Lai Xiang had not yet opened at this time, but there was already a Soaring Angel parked at the door. Although Lin Yingyi could be considered to be quite wealthy, buying such a car which cost as much as four to five million was something that he didn’t even dare to imagine. Therefore, he couldn’t help but keep looking at it.
Unexpectedly, just as he was looking at the car, two people alighted from the Soaring Angel and actually walked towards him.
“It isn’t against the law just look at a car, right?” Just as Lin Yingyi was thinking about this, one of them knocked on his car window. “Are you Mr. Lin Yingyi?”
“Yes, I am. You guys are...” Lin Yingyi was a bit frightened, not sure what their objective was.
“Our boss wants to see you. It’s regarding your daughter, Lin Zixuan.” The two guys didn’t say anything extra and walked back after they finished saying that.

Lin Yingyi felt that things were getting quite weird today. He totally couldn’t guess what was going on. But considering the other person’s background and that it had something to do with his daughter, even if he were going into the dragon’s den, he still had to go up their car.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 800 Stainless Steel Beds
paragraphs: The Soaring Angel gradually started and moved towards Hongwu Villa.
Lin Yingyi sat at the backseat, his heart furiously beating. He didn’t have to the mood to look at the scenery outside and carefully asked, “May I know where you are taking me?”
“You will know once we reach there.” Their tone was quite polite, one of them said, “We will reach there very quickly. Mr. Lin, please be patient.”
“OK...” At the current state, Lin Yingyi could only take one step at a time. Whatever the case, he couldn’t resist them, anyway.
Very quickly, they arrived at Hongwu Villa. Once they alighted, Lin Yingyi was stunned. “This... this is...”
Hong Weiguo was holding a tobacco pipe and already waiting there. He walked forth, smiled and said, “You must be Mr. Lin? Quick, come in. Please enter.”
“You... you are...” Lin Yingyi felt that there was too much information to take in suddenly. “This must be Hongwu Mountain? You are Hong Weiguo, Director Hong!?”

“Hehe, we are family, there’s no need to be so courteous. Just call me Old Hong or Weiguo.” Hong Weiguo brought Lin Yingyi to the living room and asked him to sit on the sofa. He waved his hand and said, “Bring some tea for Mr. Lin.”

“No need, no need. I don’t deserve such courtesy.” Towards Hong Weiguo’s politeness, Lin Yingyi instinctively felt that this might be a show. But he was unsure of what this show was about and what his objective might be.
“Let’s put it this way. You precious daughter is here at my place.” Hong Weiguo took a puff from the tobacco pipe and gradually said, “I was the one who called you yesterday.”
“You.. you mean to say...” Lin Yingyi was totally stunned. “You mean to say that my Xuanxuan was not kidnapped in the first place?”
“I wanted to inform you at that time, but you thought yourself astray.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly and said, “I was just following along the meaning in your words.”

Seeing that Lin Zixuan was so anxious, Hong Weiguo patted him on the shoulder. “Mr. Lin, don’t worry. I myself feel that this matter is amazing too.” Hong Weiguo then told him about Hong Dali’s encounter with Lin Zixuan, how he brought her home, and how Hong Weiguo took her as his Goddaughter. Lin Yingyi’s head was full of sweat as he listened. After Hong Weiguo was done, he almost couldn’t believe what he had heard.

“You mean to say, my Xuanxuan is now your... Goddaughter?” Lin Yingyi violently swallowed his saliva. “Not only was she not kidnapped, but she even became you Goddaughter, and you plan to let her stay here?”
“Yup, this is my plan. What does Mr. Lin think about this...” Hong Weiguo nodded.
“Then, then can you let me see Xuanxuan first?” After saying so much, Lin Yingyi still couldn’t believe this was true before physically seeing his daughter first.
“No problem.” Hong Weiguo shouted towards the upper floor. “Xuanxuan, come down now, your Dad is here.”

Once Hong Weiguo finished shouting, a small head popped out from the staircase. Once she saw Lin Yingyi sitting there, she immediately cried. “Dad...” The small lass cried as she ran down and violently threw herself into Lin Yingyi’s arms. “Dad, I missed you, wu wu wu...”

“As long as you are all right, as long as you are all right!” Lin Yingyi teared up too. “From now on, I won’t force you to study anymore, OK? You can play as much as you want. Sigh, compared to your grades, you are much more important to me!”

As the two of them were cried out in both happiness and sorrow, Hong Dali slowly walked out from the room. He didn’t greet Lin Yingyi when he saw him and just carried Quentin in his arms, mumbling, “Dad, I’m going to school...”
Hong Weiguo immediately stopped him. “Little rascal, are you going to carry the tiger to school?”

“Oh, that doesn’t seem to be very nice...” Hong Dali was still dazed from just walking up. “Then, I will leave it here... Never mind, I better just bring it with me.” He had the halo of ‘Animals’ Best Friend,’ so Quentin was fine as long as she was around him. If she were left at home, the items in the house might suffer. Quentin might not bite people yet at her age, but she definitely wouldn’t mind biting other stuff. Hong Dali didn’t want to come back to a house full of chicken feathers.
As he was dressing up, Lin Zixuan saw him and softly asked, “Brother Dali, are you going to school now?”
“Ah, of course.” Hong Dali said, “Play is play, school is school. Oh right, Zixuan, aren’t you going to school? If you are, you better leave now. It’s already 7:30 AM now.”

Thinking about school, Lin Zixuan’s face turned a bit gloomy. Then, Lin Yingyi hurriedly said, “If you really don’t like school, then let’s stop your studies for a year and take a good break. After that, I will find another school for you that’s not as stressful.”
“Actually, it might not be a bad idea to let her study in the same school as Dali.” Hong Weiguo thought for a while. “Why don’t I help her to transfer schools?”

Hong Dali thought for a while. “Attending school? It would be a pity if Zixuan just goes to a normal school. I think that it will be better if we build our own school. Yup, let’s just name it ‘New Lanxiang Institute of Science and Technology,’ focusing on computers, animes, and gaming. Hehe, Zixuan is a genius in gaming, this is a good idea.”
“New Lanxiang Institute of Science and Technology?” Hong Weiguo touched his chin. “This name is quite good.”

Hong Weiguo wasn’t clear what New Lanxiang represented, but Hong Dali was very familiar with it, and the slogan came to him immediately. “For gaming, come to New Lanxiang. We have 800 stainless steel beds and 300 female students with good skills!”
The original sad atmosphere was immediately broken, and Lin Zixuan laughed till she collapsed.
Hong Weiguo didn’t know whether to laugh or cry and said, “Little rascal, where do you get these phrases from.”
“Don’t bother about that, I’m going to school now.” Hong Dali took his schoolbag and left the house.

“This little rascal.” Hong Weiguo laughed and shook his head. He looks at Lin Yingyi and said, “Come, since Mr. Lin has graced my house with your presence, you might as well have a meal here. Take it as a means to appease your alarmed spirit. Also, let’s discuss this school that Dali talked about.”
“Huh?” Lin Yingyi was a bit confused. “Are you really going to build a school for my Xuanxuan? That, that’s too troublesome!”

Hong Weiguo proudly said, “It’s fine. Don’t see that Dali is a prodigal, his foresight is really good. If he said that he wants to open a school, I feel that there must be good future prospects in doing this. This little rascal’s luck has always been pretty good.”

Lin Yingyi felt that the information from his words was a bit too much—just a casual word from Hong Dali, and he was really going to open a school? The world of the rich was really something that he couldn’t really understand...
Over the next few days, the entertainment industry erupted again.

The 50,000 tickets for the second episode of “I Am a Singer” was immediately sold out directly after being released. A lot of people even started queuing two days before the ticket counter opened. It must also be mentioned that the name of Young Master was revered as a God of Fortune by the scalpers—they earned a large sum of money just by reselling the tickets for “I Am a Singer.” The originally 50 yuan tickets for the furthest seats were sold for over 200 yuan on the black market!

So Cool Video-sharing website, Ku Ge Music, and Tianjin Satellite TV—these three parties placed advertisements all over the place. Momentarily, the worth of the eight singers who joined the show increased sharply. As for Hong Dali’s side, he almost effortlessly signed a 10-year contract with five of them. The remaining three singers were still bound to their current contract and could only watch in pain as the others signed contracts with Hong Dali’s company.
Chenghui Building level nine, Caiwei Entertainment.

Zhang Cai was making her report to Hong Dali who was teasing Quentin. “Young Master, the result for the second stage of ‘I Am a Singer’ is out. Xia Yuyao who was placed third in the first stage performed greatly and got the first in the overall points of the two stages. From second to last is, respectively: Jiang Ruoyu, Liu Yuqiong, Panda, Chu Zhongqin, Yang Jun, and Fei Chang. The previous last in place Panda made a comeback, and Li Xiao who was placed seventh in the first stage was eliminated.”
“Oh? This Xia Yuyao seems to be quite formidable, not bad at all.” Hong Dali praised.

Zhang Cai said, “Yup, he is indeed worthy of being one of the most popular male celebrities currently. His skills are top-notch. Also, Jiang Ruoyu’s performances for the last two stages are also very impressive. She’s not bad too.”
Hong Dali smiled and said, “That’s quite good, I really didn’t expect that. At the start, we only invited her to meet the headcount. And she only cost us 50,000...”

Zhang Cai smiled and said, “Young Master, you added another 50,000 after that, so it’s 100,000 now. Actually, I’m surprised as well. After all, her name was too unfamiliar to the audiences. Her image was still not bad, but not top-notch. She was practically useless for increasing the viewership rating.”

“But gold will shine no matter what happens. Those with the capability will definitely shine if they have the space to showcase themselves. It’s only two stages, and she’s already showing her nature as a strong competitor. Even those as strong as Yang Jun, Fei Chang, and even Chu Zhongqin also had to back away from her.”

“Now, Jiang Ruoyu’s popularity is already the highest in ‘I Am a Singer,’ and there are quite some companies that wish for her to endorse their products. Their offer has already gone up to more than 200,000. She can be considered to be a money tree that we unconsciously nurtured.”
Hong Dali touched his chin. “Yup, but this isn’t good.”

Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Zhang Cai strangely asked, “Oh? Why isn’t this a good thing? Jiang Ruoyu only spent two weeks to increase the attraction of our show greatly—this has already caused us a great surprise. According to my original plan, I intended to groom her and push her up to fame. Coupled with her original experience of being a small artist, she is most suitable to be an encouraging figure.”
Hong Dali said, “I know that. The problem is that, if she is going to dominate the rest of the stages, then it won’t be fun anymore.”

Speaking of which, Zhang Cai was indeed an intelligent person. Once she heard Hong Dali say this, she immediately understood. “What Young Master means is that we shouldn’t let her become dominant, because if there isn’t any suspense anymore, the attraction of the show will definitely drop. Is that right?”

Hong Dali grinned and said, “Correct. Think about it, if she gets first place every time, then will the audiences still look at the other singers? Also, I noticed that the audiences don’t seem to like Chu Zhongqin’s performance very much. If he gets eliminated, not only will he lose face, but it won’t look good on us too.”

Therefore, Hong Dali smiled and said, “The most important thing now is one: Let Chu Zhongqin find a reason to leave the stage honorably. Two: Find someone who can fight against Jiang Ruoyu, so that the competition will be filled with suspense.
“Hehe, I think that Chu Zhongqin will definitely be extremely thankful for my idea!”

“You will know once we reach there.” Their tone was quite polite, one of them said, “We will reach there very quickly.
Mr.
Lin, please be patient.”
“OK...” At the current state, Lin Yingyi could only take one step at a time.
Whatever the case, he couldn’t resist them, anyway.
Very quickly, they arrived at Hongwu Villa.
Once they alighted, Lin Yingyi was stunned.
“This... this is...”
Hong Weiguo was holding a tobacco pipe and already waiting there.
He walked forth, smiled and said, “You must be Mr.
Lin?
Quick, come in.
Please enter.”
“You... you are...” Lin Yingyi felt that there was too much information to take in suddenly.
“This must be Hongwu Mountain?
You are Hong Weiguo, Director Hong!?”
“Hehe, we are family, there’s no need to be so courteous.
Just call me Old Hong or Weiguo.” Hong Weiguo brought Lin Yingyi to the living room and asked him to sit on the sofa.
He waved his hand and said, “Bring some tea for Mr.
Lin.”
“No need, no need.
I don’t deserve such courtesy.” Towards Hong Weiguo’s politeness, Lin Yingyi instinctively felt that this might be a show.
But he was unsure of what this show was about and what his objective might be.
“Let’s put it this way.
You precious daughter is here at my place.” Hong Weiguo took a puff from the tobacco pipe and gradually said, “I was the one who called you yesterday.”
“You.. you mean to say...” Lin Yingyi was totally stunned.
“You mean to say that my Xuanxuan was not kidnapped in the first place?”
“I wanted to inform you at that time, but you thought yourself astray.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly and said, “I was just following along the meaning in your words.”
Seeing that Lin Zixuan was so anxious, Hong Weiguo patted him on the shoulder.
“Mr.
Lin, don’t worry.
I myself feel that this matter is amazing too.” Hong Weiguo then told him about Hong Dali’s encounter with Lin Zixuan, how he brought her home, and how Hong Weiguo took her as his Goddaughter.
Lin Yingyi’s head was full of sweat as he listened.
After Hong Weiguo was done, he almost couldn’t believe what he had heard.
“You mean to say, my Xuanxuan is now your...
Goddaughter?” Lin Yingyi violently swallowed his saliva.
“Not only was she not kidnapped, but she even became you Goddaughter, and you plan to let her stay here?”
“Yup, this is my plan.
What does Mr.
Lin think about this...” Hong Weiguo nodded.
“Then, then can you let me see Xuanxuan first?” After saying so much, Lin Yingyi still couldn’t believe this was true before physically seeing his daughter first.
“No problem.” Hong Weiguo shouted towards the upper floor.
“Xuanxuan, come down now, your Dad is here.”
Once Hong Weiguo finished shouting, a small head popped out from the staircase.
Once she saw Lin Yingyi sitting there, she immediately cried.
“Dad...” The small lass cried as she ran down and violently threw herself into Lin Yingyi’s arms.
“Dad, I missed you, wu wu wu...”
“As long as you are all right, as long as you are all right!” Lin Yingyi teared up too.
“From now on, I won’t force you to study anymore, OK?
You can play as much as you want.
Sigh, compared to your grades, you are much more important to me!”
As the two of them were cried out in both happiness and sorrow, Hong Dali slowly walked out from the room.
He didn’t greet Lin Yingyi when he saw him and just carried Quentin in his arms, mumbling, “Dad, I’m going to school...”
Hong Weiguo immediately stopped him.
“Little rascal, are you going to carry the tiger to school?”
“Oh, that doesn’t seem to be very nice...” Hong Dali was still dazed from just walking up.
“Then, I will leave it here...
Never mind, I better just bring it with me.” He had the halo of ‘Animals’ Best Friend,’ so Quentin was fine as long as she was around him.
If she were left at home, the items in the house might suffer.
Quentin might not bite people yet at her age, but she definitely wouldn’t mind biting other stuff.
Hong Dali didn’t want to come back to a house full of chicken feathers.
As he was dressing up, Lin Zixuan saw him and softly asked, “Brother Dali, are you going to school now?”
“Ah, of course.” Hong Dali said, “Play is play, school is school.
Oh right, Zixuan, aren’t you going to school?
If you are, you better leave now.
It’s already 7:30 AM now.”
Thinking about school, Lin Zixuan’s face turned a bit gloomy.
Then, Lin Yingyi hurriedly said, “If you really don’t like school, then let’s stop your studies for a year and take a good break.
After that, I will find another school for you that’s not as stressful.”
“Actually, it might not be a bad idea to let her study in the same school as Dali.” Hong Weiguo thought for a while.
“Why don’t I help her to transfer schools?”
Hong Dali thought for a while.
“Attending school?
It would be a pity if Zixuan just goes to a normal school.
I think that it will be better if we build our own school.
Yup, let’s just name it ‘New Lanxiang Institute of Science and Technology,’ focusing on computers, animes, and gaming.
Hehe, Zixuan is a genius in gaming, this is a good idea.”
“New Lanxiang Institute of Science and Technology?” Hong Weiguo touched his chin.
“This name is quite good.”
Hong Weiguo wasn’t clear what New Lanxiang represented, but Hong Dali was very familiar with it, and the slogan came to him immediately.
“For gaming, come to New Lanxiang.
We have 800 stainless steel beds and 300 female students with good skills!”
The original sad atmosphere was immediately broken, and Lin Zixuan laughed till she collapsed.
Hong Weiguo didn’t know whether to laugh or cry and said, “Little rascal, where do you get these phrases from.”
“Don’t bother about that, I’m going to school now.” Hong Dali took his schoolbag and left the house.
“This little rascal.” Hong Weiguo laughed and shook his head.
He looks at Lin Yingyi and said, “Come, since Mr.
Lin has graced my house with your presence, you might as well have a meal here.
Take it as a means to appease your alarmed spirit.
Also, let’s discuss this school that Dali talked about.”
“Huh?” Lin Yingyi was a bit confused.
“Are you really going to build a school for my Xuanxuan?
That, that’s too troublesome!”
Hong Weiguo proudly said, “It’s fine.
Don’t see that Dali is a prodigal, his foresight is really good.
If he said that he wants to open a school, I feel that there must be good future prospects in doing this.
This little rascal’s luck has always been pretty good.”
Lin Yingyi felt that the information from his words was a bit too much—just a casual word from Hong Dali, and he was really going to open a school?
The world of the rich was really something that he couldn’t really understand...
Over the next few days, the entertainment industry erupted again.
The 50,000 tickets for the second episode of “I Am a Singer” was immediately sold out directly after being released.
A lot of people even started queuing two days before the ticket counter opened.

It must also be mentioned that the name of Young Master was revered as a God of Fortune by the scalpers—they earned a large sum of money just by reselling the tickets for “I Am a Singer.” The originally 50 yuan tickets for the furthest seats were sold for over 200 yuan on the black market!
So Cool Video-sharing website, Ku Ge Music, and Tianjin Satellite TV—these three parties placed advertisements all over the place.
Momentarily, the worth of the eight singers who joined the show increased sharply.
As for Hong Dali’s side, he almost effortlessly signed a 10-year contract with five of them.
The remaining three singers were still bound to their current contract and could only watch in pain as the others signed contracts with Hong Dali’s company.
Chenghui Building level nine, Caiwei Entertainment.
Zhang Cai was making her report to Hong Dali who was teasing Quentin.
“Young Master, the result for the second stage of ‘I Am a Singer’ is out.
Xia Yuyao who was placed third in the first stage performed greatly and got the first in the overall points of the two stages.
From second to last is, respectively: Jiang Ruoyu, Liu Yuqiong, Panda, Chu Zhongqin, Yang Jun, and Fei Chang.
The previous last in place Panda made a comeback, and Li Xiao who was placed seventh in the first stage was eliminated.”
“Oh?
This Xia Yuyao seems to be quite formidable, not bad at all.” Hong Dali praised.
Zhang Cai said, “Yup, he is indeed worthy of being one of the most popular male celebrities currently.
His skills are top-notch.
Also, Jiang Ruoyu’s performances for the last two stages are also very impressive.
She’s not bad too.”
Hong Dali smiled and said, “That’s quite good, I really didn’t expect that.
At the start, we only invited her to meet the headcount.
And she only cost us 50,000...”
Zhang Cai smiled and said, “Young Master, you added another 50,000 after that, so it’s 100,000 now.
Actually, I’m surprised as well.
After all, her name was too unfamiliar to the audiences.
Her image was still not bad, but not top-notch.
She was practically useless for increasing the viewership rating.”
“But gold will shine no matter what happens.
Those with the capability will definitely shine if they have the space to showcase themselves.
It’s only two stages, and she’s already showing her nature as a strong competitor.
Even those as strong as Yang Jun, Fei Chang, and even Chu Zhongqin also had to back away from her.”
“Now, Jiang Ruoyu’s popularity is already the highest in ‘I Am a Singer,’ and there are quite some companies that wish for her to endorse their products.
Their offer has already gone up to more than 200,000.
She can be considered to be a money tree that we unconsciously nurtured.”
Hong Dali touched his chin.
“Yup, but this isn’t good.”
Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Zhang Cai strangely asked, “Oh?
Why isn’t this a good thing?
Jiang Ruoyu only spent two weeks to increase the attraction of our show greatly—this has already caused us a great surprise.
According to my original plan, I intended to groom her and push her up to fame.
Coupled with her original experience of being a small artist, she is most suitable to be an encouraging figure.”
Hong Dali said, “I know that.
The problem is that, if she is going to dominate the rest of the stages, then it won’t be fun anymore.”
Speaking of which, Zhang Cai was indeed an intelligent person.
Once she heard Hong Dali say this, she immediately understood.
“What Young Master means is that we shouldn’t let her become dominant, because if there isn’t any suspense anymore, the attraction of the show will definitely drop.
Is that right?”
Hong Dali grinned and said, “Correct.
Think about it, if she gets first place every time, then will the audiences still look at the other singers?
Also, I noticed that the audiences don’t seem to like Chu Zhongqin’s performance very much.
If he gets eliminated, not only will he lose face, but it won’t look good on us too.”
Therefore, Hong Dali smiled and said, “The most important thing now is one: Let Chu Zhongqin find a reason to leave the stage honorably.
Two: Find someone who can fight against Jiang Ruoyu, so that the competition will be filled with suspense.
“Hehe, I think that Chu Zhongqin will definitely be extremely thankful for my idea!”

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - Zhang Gongyan
paragraphs: At the same time, Chu Zhongqin was facing an interview from a group of reporters.
A reporter asked, “Mr. Chu, do you have anything to say regarding getting only fifth place for this stage of ‘I Am a Singer’? Do you feel a lot of pressure?”

Chu Zhongqin: “I’m still OK. Everyone who joined this competition is very skilled. Sometimes, if you performed slightly worse, you will get a lower positioning. Therefore, I must put in even more effort in producing music and adjusting my myself.”
Another reporter asked, “Then, Mr. Chu, do you think that in the upcoming stages you will be able to get first place again?”
Chu Zhongqin: “I’m confident of this. After all, I have been doing music for a very long time, my foundation is still there. Naturally, I can’t just let the younger generation shine alone.”

He spoke very confidently on the surface, but once the interview ended, Chu Zhongqin hurriedly ran over to Hong Dali and cried out, “Young Master, save me! The competitors in ‘I Am a Singer’ are too fearsome, I have already dropped to the fifth place! Young Master, I don’t hope to get first place, but at least not eliminated! Otherwise, my entire face will be gone!”

It was no wonder Chu Zhongqin was so anxious. If it were someone else, they might not be as anxious as him, but some of the competitors joined as a sign of respect to him. If he were eliminated in just a few stages, it would be extremely embarrassing for him.

“Ya, I already knew that long ago.” Hong Dali sniffled. “You believe I don’t know what you are thinking? Let me say this first—I will not be doing any dirty tricks. If you’re thinking of asking me to control the audiences like the first stage, that’s impossible—there isn’t any meaning in that. I only ask you this, during the third stage, can you get... yup, can you get at least fourth place?”

“At least fourth place?” Chu Zhongqin thought for a while and affirmed. “If I use my most confident song, properly recompose it, and practice a few days, it should not be a problem! But even it’s not a problem, I’m afraid that the audiences won’t like it!”
Hong Dali grinned and said, “Don’t worry about that, just don’t get the last place. That shouldn’t be a problem, right?”
“Of course, that’s for sure.” But Chu Zhongqin still had some queries. “But what about the fourth stage and the remaining ones...”

Hong Dali confidently said, “I promise that you will not suffer any loss. Oh right, we are lacking one person now, do you have any good suggestions? I need someone who is at least as good as Jiang Ruoyu.”

Chu Zhongqin was obviously shocked. “You still want more capable singers!? Young Master, if you still find someone capable, would that work? Didn’t Jiang Ruoyu already sign a contract with you? Why not use this opportunity to properly groom her?” Speaking of which, he was on the same boat as Hong Dali now and really thought for him. Of course, he also had his own reason—who was willing to find himself a powerful opponent?
“A contract is a contract, a competition is a competition.” Hong Dali humphed. “What point is there in a competition without any suspense? Hurry up and think of one!”
“Then, let me think a bit.” Chu Zhongqin thought for a long while. Suddenly, his eyes lit up and said, “Zhang Gongyan, Zhang Gongyan is not bad! Young Master, you can look for him!”
“Zhang Gongyan?” Hong Dali naturally had not heard of him. He directly asked Zhang Cai, “Sister Cai, what kind of person is this Zhang Gongyan?”

Zhang Cai was quite well-informed about the entertainment industry and answered without thinking, “I was about to recommend him to you too, Young Master. Zhang Gongyan debuted quite early, but his personality is a bit stubborn and doesn’t like to be constrained by entertainment companies. Therefore, there is currently no one willing to groom him, so he’s not very popular and well-known now. But in terms of singing skills, he’s definitely top-notch—at least as good as Jiang Ruoyu. Also, his image isn’t bad.”

“Oh, I see. This one is good.” Hong Dali directly decided. “Then, it’s him! Go and contact him, then put the news online that we found a strong competitor to join the competition. Remember to keep it a secret.”

“OK.” Zhang Cai thought for a while and asked, “But, Young Master, the popularity of our ‘I Am a Singer’ is very high now, quite a lot of famed and popular singers wish to join—some even for free. Do you think...”

Hong Dali humphed. “Ask them to wait. Those too popular are likely to have a high temper and are not easy to serve. Also, they are too tightly bound to their entertainment companies, there isn’t much point for us even if they came. It’s not like we are lacking their popularity. I don’t want them.”
Zhang Cai and Chu Zhongqin both sighed in unison.
This Young Master’s magnanimity and foresight wasn’t something that an ordinary person could accept.

If this were some other show and so many popular celebrities were willing to join for free, wouldn’t they be delighted over themselves and couldn’t wait to welcome them with eight large carriages1? As for Young Master, he didn’t even care to look before directly rejecting them.
But then again, with Young Master’s capability and strength, he would only spend money on the best effect in doing something or rather not do it at all.

If “I Am a Singer” were produced by some other company, it would at most be considered popular. But in Young Master’s hands, he actually threw in a lot of money to create a talent search show with a viewership rating to of over 5%.
It was indeed true that one’s foresight was limited only by their capability and strength.
Over the next few days, the Internet went frantic again!

Li Xiao, whose strongest ability was singing, was actually eliminated from “I Am a Singer”— of course, Li Xiao’s net worth did increase by quite a bit, and more importantly, Li Xiao was contracted to Caiwei Entertainment too!

What did this show? This showed that “I Am a Singer” was a true competition that relied on one’s own skills, and there weren’t dirty tricks behind it! Even their own contracted singer was eliminated, what dirty tricks could there be? Also, the audiences weren’t fools. Li Xiao did indeed perform badly due to immense stress. Therefore, he ended in last place.

Therefore, now that the audiences had a favorable impression of the fairness of “I Am a Singer” produced by Caiwei Entertainment, even the discussions of who would become the overall champion also became quite popular online.
Just at this time, Caiwei Entertainment threw another heavy bomb into the already close to boiling water!
A strong competitor would be joining the competition for the third stage!
The name was kept a secret! The age was kept a secret! Other than knowing that this was a male singer, everything else was kept a secret!

Therefore, in just two days, the popularity of topics discussing this mysterious person skyrocketed. Even on Xinhai Weibo, there was also hot debates regarding this. A topic that analyzed on who the mysterious person might be was supported for 100,000 plus times, more than the second-placed topic by an entire three times.

That was not all. Tianjing Satellite TV’s viewership rating continued to exceed past results, already achieving an astonishing 5.4%—comparatively, the drama produced by Huawei Entertainment was sadly last in place. The audiences soon formed a habit of watching “I Am a Singer” before going to sleep...

The site traffic of So Cool Video-sharing website was also constantly on the rise. The first episode ofUnexpectedly! had exceeded 30 million views, and the total views of the first and second stage of “I Am a Singer” had exceeded 40 million views. As for Li Nianwei’s concert, it had already created a record-breaking viewing count of 60 million...
Hong Dali naturally wasn’t concerned about what was going on online. Currently, he was looking around in the first level of Chenhui Building.

When he just carried Quentin in, the entire first floor was filled with the sounds of dogs barking. Luckily, because of the super effective halo of “Animals’ Best Friend,” once Hong Dali entered the lounge, the entire first floor went quiet. This scared the animal groomers who were hired to look after them.

Although people were still used to calling Hong Dali the “Superprodigal from the Hong family” out of habit, their tone wasn’t filled with despise like before. After all, it wasn’t easy to squander in such artistic ways. Therefore, when the leader of the groomers saw Hong Dali carrying a tiger and entering along with Tang Muxin, Lin Zixuan, and his nine lackeys, he respectfully walked up to them and greeted. “Greetings, Young... Young Master!”
Hong Dali looked around. “Yup, good. You guys did well. Oh my, look at these cuties, they are quite well groomed, haha! Reward, everyone 3,000 each!”

“Thank you, Young Master!” The leader was very grateful. This was indeed the legendary superprodigal who was bold and had considerable magnanimity, he directly rewarded them as much as 3,000 each! There were at least 40 plus groomers on this floor. Thus, he spent hundreds of thousands just like that.

But although this was what the leader of the groomers thought in his mind, he didn’t think that Hong Dali was an idiot. Being able to become the leader of the groomers, he was someone who really liked small animals. Therefore, he didn’t forget to add in his mind, May the Heavens protect this God of Fortune so that he can live up to a hundred years of age so that more and more small animals will be able to get help from him in the future...

Hong Dali naturally wasn’t concerned with what the leader was thinking in his mind. What he was really concerned about was the future of these animals. “Hey, leader, these small things are really cute, but we can’t raise them forever. Do you have any good suggestion?” As he spoke, he touched the head of a small white Pekingese and praised. “Oh my, this little rascal, he wants to lick me, haha.”

At his side, Tang Muxin and Lin Zixuan were already excited to the point that they almost couldn’t contain themselves. They touched one dog here and touched another dog there since they weren’t dirty because all of them were already vaccinated and washed. Naturally, they could touch these dogs as much as they liked.

The leader was considering this for the past few days too. “Yup. Young Master, my suggestion is to wait until they are all groomed till they are pretty, then directly give them away to animal lovers. Actually, these fellows are really easy to raise—you just have to feed them, that’s all. They’re all stray dogs and cats, so they are not finicky. They will be happy just eating leftovers.”

“I think this is a reasonable plan, it’s decided then.” Hong Dali thought for a while, nodded and said, “Raise them here first, mainly checking if they have illnesses and such. Oh right, shave away all of their hair and burn them. I’m afraid that they might not have been washed clean and have louse in them. Also, make sure they are vaccinated with all the possible vaccines, then train them properly so that they will not bite people when they go out.”

“Greetings, Young...
Young Master!”
Hong Dali looked around.
“Yup, good.
You guys did well.
Oh my, look at these cuties, they are quite well groomed, haha!
Reward, everyone 3,000 each!”
“Thank you, Young Master!” The leader was very grateful.
This was indeed the legendary superprodigal who was bold and had considerable magnanimity, he directly rewarded them as much as 3,000 each!
There were at least 40 plus groomers on this floor.
Thus, he spent hundreds of thousands just like that.
But although this was what the leader of the groomers thought in his mind, he didn’t think that Hong Dali was an idiot.
Being able to become the leader of the groomers, he was someone who really liked small animals.

Therefore, he didn’t forget to add in his mind, May the Heavens protect this God of Fortune so that he can live up to a hundred years of age so that more and more small animals will be able to get help from him in the future...
Hong Dali naturally wasn’t concerned with what the leader was thinking in his mind.
What he was really concerned about was the future of these animals.
“Hey, leader, these small things are really cute, but we can’t raise them forever.
Do you have any good suggestion?” As he spoke, he touched the head of a small white Pekingese and praised.
“Oh my, this little rascal, he wants to lick me, haha.”
At his side, Tang Muxin and Lin Zixuan were already excited to the point that they almost couldn’t contain themselves.
They touched one dog here and touched another dog there since they weren’t dirty because all of them were already vaccinated and washed.
Naturally, they could touch these dogs as much as they liked.
The leader was considering this for the past few days too.
“Yup.
Young Master, my suggestion is to wait until they are all groomed till they are pretty, then directly give them away to animal lovers.
Actually, these fellows are really easy to raise—you just have to feed them, that’s all.
They’re all stray dogs and cats, so they are not finicky.
They will be happy just eating leftovers.”
“I think this is a reasonable plan, it’s decided then.” Hong Dali thought for a while, nodded and said, “Raise them here first, mainly checking if they have illnesses and such.
Oh right, shave away all of their hair and burn them.
I’m afraid that they might not have been washed clean and have louse in them.
Also, make sure they are vaccinated with all the possible vaccines, then train them properly so that they will not bite people when they go out.”

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - Kidnap the Director of a Gaming Company
paragraphs: There were about 2,000 plus stray cats and dogs in total, it would be a big project shaving off all of their hair. But what Hong Dali said made sense, it was better to shave everything away and let them grow them back. Also, they would be able to observe if they had any skin disease or something. The leader instantly agreed and said, “OK, I will follow your orders.”

Hong Dali laughed and said, “You guys will be busy and tired for some time. After this batch is settled, I will see if there’s any more of them out there. Do this first, I will definitely reward you guys later.”
“It’s our honor to be able to serve the Young Master.” The leader hurriedly thanked him.

“Yup. OK, let’s go.” Having settled the things here, Hong Dali acted like a leader who was inspecting his territory, being followed by a large group of people in a very imposing manner. They then directly went to the third floor.
This was allocated to become a gaming studio by Hong Dali, Lin Zixuan knew that.

Now that she had come to her own territory, the small lass was quite happy. “Brother Dali, this place is really big!” As she said so, she ran inside and touched all the new computers that were just installed. “Wow, these are all top-level configuration computers, right? The monitor is so big, it must be at least 30-inches! This mouse and keyboard! Hahaha! This is my world! Mine! I’m the queen of this place in the future!”
Seeing her so happy, Hong Dali and Tang Muxin shared a look. Tang Muxin smiled and said, “Sister Zixuan, I’m afraid that you can’t be a queen, but being a princess is no problem, hehe.”

“Princess is fine too!” How could she still endure after seeing these computers? Lin Zixuan ran back to Hong Dali and shook his elbow. “Brother Dali, let me play here for a while, please? Just a while!”
What was there to reject? Hong Dali didn’t even consider and decided. “Sure, you can play here for as long as you want. Oh right, since there’s nothing to do anyway, let’s all play together!”
Turn on the computer, start the game—Hong Dali played for a while and was dissatisfied. “It’s so troublesome training from the start. Let me see... one, two, three, four...”
Then, he told one of the lackeys, “Go buy 11 max-leveled accounts and the best equipment, one set per person! We shall go and fight the large dungeons!”

“OK!” The lackey whose profession was a lackey, and his interest was also to be a lackey, Li Yang, ran off like the wind. He came back in just a short while. “I... I, Young Master, I just went and asked. There are quite a lot of max-leveled accounts but very little equipment on sale. There isn’t enough to make 11 full sets. I spent a lot of effort to get just two full sets of the best equipment for Young Master and Young Madam, the rest are all at least two standards lower.”

Being a quick-witted lackey, Li Yang naturally understood that his own equipment should be at least two notches lower than his master’s. Otherwise, wouldn’t he be snatching his master’s glory? But it was true that the highest quality equipment in this game was really hard to get. Sports were prevalent in this world, the people of people who played online games were much less than that from his previous life. Therefore, the highest quality equipment was quite rare too.
“Damn! What country bumpkins are they!?” Hong Dali was unhappy. “This is depressing. If there’s really no other way, then let’s just go with this for now.”

Therefore, Li Yang ran out like the wind again. Very quickly, a group of people wearing luxurious equipment that could cause others to go blind from their shininess went to the dungeon. After fighting the dungeon for a while, Hong Dali got restless and said, “This stupid game’s design is really boring. We’re just running here and there, and there aren’t any equipment drops...”

Tang Muxin said at the side, “It’s natural for the drop rate to be low. The dungeons are mainly for casual play, the main thing to do is to PvP. Many players stop doing dungeons once their equipment is roughly enough for use.” She was quite enthusiastic about playing. “If it were too easy to get good equipment, then there wouldn’t be much point in playing, right?”

“The problem is, we can’t fight the difficult dungeon with just 10 plus people. That dungeon will definitely drop better items!” Hong Dali humphed. “Sigh, if we want to fight, then we should be fighting the hardest boss there is...”
Tang Muxin said, “Well, those types of bosses will need at least 40 people to fight. You want to fight it with just the 10 of us?”

“That’s true...” He threw away the mouse and went over to see Lin Zixuan playing PvP and owning the other players. He smiled happily and said, “Our Sister Zixuan is really awesome, look at her dominating her opponents. This is much better, this is the effect that a game should have, fightings dungeons are too boring—sigh, Xiaoyi, about the E-Sports, how is the advertising?”

Mentioning this, the expression of Ling Xiaoyi, who just killed a monster, instantly turned quite interesting. “Well... Young Master, I didn’t dare to tell you about this matter. We were going to start the advertisements for it earlier on, but after that, I asked around and didn’t do it...”
“Hm? What’s the reason?” This wasn’t right, this didn’t seem to be Ling Xiaoyi’s style. Hong Dali strangely asked, “Because of what?”

Ling Xiaoyi said with difficulty, “This... this game, ‘The Draconic Continent Language,’ was developed by the Liu Family’s Liu Mingxin’s Mingxin Network. Once I thought about the relationship between Young Master and Liu Mingxin...”
Hong Dali immediately felt invigorated. “This game belongs to that fellow? Xiaoyi, do you have his number? I’m going to ask for a GM account from him!”
Hong Dali’s words shocked everyone. Tang Muxin shouted, “Are you crazy! You guys are not friends, and you are going to ask for a GM account from him?”
Hong Dali took out his phone. “What’s wrong with that? Xiaoyi, what’s his number?”

“Er, let me check.” Ling Xiaoyi looked for his number and found it very quickly. Hong Dali dialed the number without another word. It connected, and soon after, a low, pleasant sounding voice came from the other side. “Hello, you are...”
Hong Dali grinned and said, “Is this Old Liu? I’m Hong Dali! What are you doing now? Have you gone to any matchmaking lately? Do you have a girlfriend now?”
“Er...” Liu Mingxin was dazed for a while. He then bitterly laughed and said, “May I know the reason for your call? It wasn’t just because you wanted to chit-chat with me, right?”
Hong Dali grinned and threw out a trap. “Of course, it wasn’t because of that. Are you free now? Come to Chenhui Building and let me kidnap you for fun?”
Once these words came out, everyone around him collapsed in shock. Tang Muxin’s heart beat furiously and thought to herself, Dali can’t be serious about kidnapping him, right?

The problem was, Hong Dali had already said this. If Liu Mingxin found a reason not to come, that would mark him as a coward. He laughed and said, “Since Young Master Dali has already asked, I naturally can’t reject you. Then, please wait for me for a while, I will get there in 10 minutes.”
Hong Dali said, “Remember, it’s on the third floor, don’t go to the wrong place! Be careful on the road, don’t speed.”
“Hehe, I know. At this hour, I can’t speed even if I wanted to. Still, I thank you for your concern, Young Master Dali.”
After hanging up, Hong Dali proudly placed one leg over the other. “Oh my, what should I do when Old Liu arrives later? Steam him in the broth? Simmer? Sweet and sour? Or should I just slice him?”
Tang Muxin rolled her eyes. “I can’t be bothered to pay attention to you.”
Ten minutes later.

The super handsome Young Master Liu Mingxin was still in that tranquil and leisure demeanor of his, and his face carried a smile that could charm all women as he gradually walked in. As he walked, he said, “Young Master Dali summoned me, I really dare not reject. But I wonder what orders Young Master Dali have for me?”

Seeing Liu Mingxin appear, Tang Muxin was used to seeing him, while this was the first time Lin Zixuan saw him. She exclaimed in surprise, “What a handsome big brother!” Then, she continued to play her game...

Ever since he came of age, Liu Mingxin had never received such cold treatment, causing him to be momentarily embarrassed. He pointed at Lin Zixuan and asked, “Er... Young Master Dali, this beautiful young lady is...”
Hong Dali didn’t reply and instead snapped his fingers. “Seize him!”

Three lackeys jumped forth and hugged his hands and legs. Liu Mingxin was instantly pressed onto the soda. He gave a bitter smile and said, “Young Master Dali, don’t tell me that you really want to kidnap me?”
Hong Dali grinned and said, “Of course! It’s so rare for you to be here, I definitely must extort something from you! Help me honestly, is ‘The Draconic Continent Language’ your asset?”
“Well...” Liu Mingxin helplessly said, “I think so.”
Hong Dali stretched out a hand. “Don’t think, be straightforward. Do you have a GM account? Lend me to play.”
“For... for real?” The always composed Liu Mingxin was totally stunned. “You specifically called me here just to ask for a GM account!?”

Hong Dali sniffled and said, “What else? You know that I’m not interested in doing business, my interest is to squander. Speaking of this, these few days I noticed quite a lot of people playing this game from your company. It seemed quite interesting, so I could only look for you—give me a max-leveled account with a set of god-level equipment. And also, that stuff such as jewels, potions and such—give me the best there is in the game! Hm, one set isn’t enough. There’s so many of us here, give each one of us a set!”
“...” Liu Mingxin was totally speechless.

This was probably the first time in the history of online gaming that someone kidnapped the Director of the game company for the purpose of getting some equipment—Hong Dali was the only one who would actually do such a thing! The problem was that Liu Mingxin couldn’t reject him—no one was willing to have this superprodigal as their opponent. Liu Mingxin was certain that if dared to say no, Hong Dali would definitely make his own online game!
Heaven knows what would happen if this lucky fellow really did that. Liu Mingxin still hadn’t forgotten how his brother’s Turkey Bookstore collapsed. This kind of thing might happen to him too.

Now, Liu Mingxin could only resign to fate. “OK, since I’m already here, then I might as well squander with you today.” This dude was definitely someone who knew when to let go. Since he was already here, he might as well magnanimously squander with Hong Dali—that might actually let his mood turn for the better.

“Brouhaha!” Hong Dali excitedly laid his elbow on Liu Mingxin’s shoulder, laughed and said, “You do indeed respect me. Fine, I shall squander wholeheartedly today. Then, after that, let’s discuss a bit of business. Hehe, what do you think?”

The always tranquil Liu Mingxin showed disbelief. “You want to cooperate with me!? Young Master Dali, you are aware of the relationship between our families, right? I can mess around with you once, but do you really plan on cooperating with me?”
“I know that.” Hong Dali strangely said, “What has their stuff got to do with us. I quite like you, so I thought I might as well not let the benefits go to someone I am not familiar with...”

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - Actually, I Am Very Pure and Innocent
paragraphs: Liu Mingxin was even more baffled by what Hong Dali said.

But he was indeed not an ordinary person. Knowing that it would be pointless to ponder on it, Liu Mingxin decided to satisfy Hong Dali’s request first. He instantly said, “OK, which server are you guys in? I will find a GM account for you. I have nothing on today anyway, I might as well accompany Young Master and play to our heart’s content.”
Hong Dali was delighted. “That’s more like it. Which server are we in again?”
“It’s the Flaming Might of the Dragon server.” Tang Muxin answered him while fighting the creeps. “Hurry up and help out, I can’t defeat this monster.”

“Flaming Might of the Dragon? OK.” Liu Mingxin instantly made a call and, at the same time, said, “Delete the account after you are done playing. If not, it will be bad for the company’s reputation if other players know about it.”

The consequences of giving out a GM account might be quite severe if others learned of it. Naturally, Hong Dali would not reject him. “OK, I’m only seeking some fun anyway. After we are done, you can take back the account. I have no use for it, anyway.”
Very quickly, Liu Mingxin got the GM account and logged in. Then, Hong Dali and his lackeys logged in too.

It was indeed a different experience being assisted by a GM. Once they logged in, they were immediately teleported to the dungeon. A character that could blind one’s eye was standing there—it was a dwarf that only wore underwear. Hong Dali was astonished. “Speaking of which, Old Liu, as a GM, you really look like a country bumpkin...”
“Hehe, it’s fine as long as it’s powerful enough. Here, take this.” Liu Mingxin sent trade request and put something on the trade interface. Hong Dali was immediately amused upon seeing it.

“[GM’s Small Underwear]: Attack Power+99999, Defense+99999, Agility+99999, Wisdom+99999, Critical Rate+100%, Dodge+100%.There was also a footnote at the end: There seems to be a weird stench on it...”
Therefore, very quickly, everyone equipped the “GM’s Small Underwear.” Hong Dali shouted, “Let’s move out!”

It was indeed a different experience having a GM on their side. Hong Dali and his group practically breezed through the dungeon, easily slaughtering anything that stood in their way. It was so easy that Hong Dali felt it wasn’t very satisfying. Therefore, the bosses in the dungeons suffered as a result of that—after they died, Hong Dali would pick the loot, and then Liu Mingxin would revive them, and then they continued killing it again. The final boss in the dungeon died 16 times in just under an hour...
This time, Hong Dali was finally satisfied. Speaking of which, how could one play a game without any sort of hack?
With the GM as their backing, they played the game in whatever ways they wished to. Hong Dali was satisfied and subconsciously said, “This is really enjoyable. Reward, 5,000!”
Thus, out of habit, the male lackey naturally put out a stack of cash, counted the amount, and directly stuffed it in Liu Mingxin’s hand. “This is a reward from our Young Master, keep it!”
Liu Mingxin: “...”

Speaking of which, he didn’t know whether to laugh or cry now. Being around Hong Dali, one could hardly feel down or depressed. But he was, after all, a Young Master from an aristocratic family and had a net worth of a few hundred million. And now, he actually received a 5,000 yuan tip from another person. This feeling, he didn’t even know how to describe it...

It was just like how a playboy brought a girl to a hotel room. After they were done, the playboy was pondering on how to tell her not to contact him anymore, but the girl threw him a 1,000 yuan and said, “Your skills are not bad, this is your tip.”
This was exactly how Liu Mingxin was feeling right now...

Luckily, Hong Dali didn’t really mean to embarrass him. Although they were on opposing sides, Liu Mingxin trusted in Hong Dali’s moral quality. Therefore, he immodestly kept the money, smiled and said, “Are you happy with the game, Young Master Dali?”

“Yup, it’s not bad.” Hong Dali nodded and returned the [GM’s Small Underwear] to Liu Mingxin. Then, he logged out and directly deleted the character. “I had fun today. Let’s talk about proper business now. Speaking of which, I have something that needs your support.”
Seeing Hong Dali’s sensitivity through his action of deleting the character, Liu Mingxin praised him in his heart and said, “Tell me.”

“I was considering.” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “This game of yours is quite balanced overall and is quite interesting to play, so why not do a competition for it—the professional kind. What do you think?”

“A professional PvP competition?” Liu Mingxin was indeed a smart person. “We hosted it before, but the results were average, so we never hosted it again. Could it be that you have some good ideas on this?”

Hong Dali wasn’t capable of other things, but he was definitely a professional in squandering. Liu Mingxin wasn’t good at this kind of activity that needed to spend a lot of money, but he trusted Hong Dali’s foresight. Therefore, he directly asked Hong Dali his plan.

“I definitely have good ideas!” Hong Dali pointed at the entire third-floor area. “Do you see this? I plan to create a professional training place for gaming. I have even found the coach, which is my sister, Zixuan. There definitely won’t be any problem!”
“Zixuan? Her?” Lin Zixuan pointed at Lin Zixuan who was still excitedly playing at the side. “This little girl!?”
“Of course! My sister Zixuan is a genius!” Hong Dali laughed.

“Are you sure this will work...” Liu Mingxin took a casual look at her playing and was soon shocked. “Is this for real? KO’ed the opponent with full health left!? I have heard of her opponent before, their skills are not low! Your sister... is she cheating!?”
“How could my sister be cheating.” Hong Dali scorned and said, “Wouldn’t you be able to tell if you just watch a while more?”

Speaking up to this point, Liu Mingxin really didn’t pay much attention to her at first. Now that he looked carefully, he was really shocked. “She’s really impressive! Her moves are flawless. I have watched a few PvP videos before, but this is the first time I saw someone linking the skills and movements so smoothly and flawlessly.” Speaking up to this point, Liu Mingxin was convinced of her skills. “Young Master Dali, what should I say? This sister Zixuan of yours, she isn’t your real sister, right? I have never heard of her before.”

“I picked her up from the roadside. How is it? Ain’t I impressive?” Hong Dali grinned. “She was running away from home when I met her. She was a small beggar at that time, the type that couldn’t even fill her stomach.”
“She ran away from home till she went hungry and still refused to return?” Liu Mingxin strangely said, “It is really rare to find such a young girl with such determination nowadays.”

“That’s for sure.” Hong Dali said, “Her family didn’t let her play games, so she ran out. But as for why she didn’t return home even when she reached that state, I didn’t really ask her about it...” As he spoke of this, he directly asked, “Zixuan, at that time, you were already going hungry, right? Why didn’t you return home? What if no one cared about you and you really died of hunger?”

“That wouldn’t make me happy.” Lin Zixuan answered matter-of-factly. “I had to pretend to be a beggar to prevent people from having ideas on me. Actually, I still had a few hundred yuan in my shoe at that time, how could I possibly die from hunger?” Then, she continued playing her game.
Hong Dali: “...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
Liu Mingxin: “...”
This little lass was definitely very brilliant for her age!
“Since this is the case, then allow me some time to consider.”

Regardless of other things, since the situation was clear now, Liu Mingxin sat on the sofa, touched his chin, and thought for half a day. But even with his intelligence, he still couldn’t fathom what Hong Dali was trying to achieve through this.

What is his motive behind this? To go into online gaming? But that doesn’t seem to be the case. To cooperate with me? With our family’s condition, there isn’t any possibility of that. He has nothing to gain through this while I will have a lot to gain. But, he doesn’t seem to be such a foolish person.

Could it be that he just purely want to squander? Or to help that Lin Zixuan rise to fame? But that’s not right too. Even though her skills and image are both excellent, the problem is that online gaming isn’t very favored in this world. There’s not much point in pushing her to fame. Then, what could he really be after?
Could it be that it really is purely for fun?

No matter how he much thought, Liu Mingxin still couldn’t understand Hong Dali’s reason for doing this. In the end, he helplessly conceded. “OK, I really can’t imagine what your motive is. But currently speaking, I seem to be the one who’s taking advantage.”

“This has nothing to do about advantage or whatnot.” Hong Dali grinned. “Actually, you don’t have to think so much. It’s just that this new sister of mine likes to play games, and I also have nothing much better to do. So, I just wanted her to play more happily. Since she has the skills, she might as well play as much as she wants. It won’t cost a lot either.” Speaking up to this point, Hong Dali said, “Speaking of which. Old Liu, later, can you announce this in your game? It shouldn’t be a problem to put an advertisement about this on the game’s official webpage, right? The venue is already ready, the West Fourth Loop Sports Stadium. How is it?”

“Since Young Master Dali has ordered, I shall naturally abide.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said, “But I keep having the feeling that you aren’t the kind of person who would do something that benefits your rival, right?”
“You want to hear the truth?” Hong Dali asked.
“Of course.” Liu Mingxin replied.
“Actually, the reason is very simple.” Hong Dali answered very naturally. “I just wanted to try something new, and online gaming is something that I haven’t tried yet.”

“Just because of this?” Liu Mingxin felt even more strongly that Hong Dali’s smile seemed strangely sinister. “But why am I feeling weird all over, I keep having the feeling that your smile seems to be that of a devil that crawled out from hell.”
Hearing his interesting words, Tang Muxin couldn’t endure and laughed.

This Liu Mingxin was claimed to be the number one business genius amongst the younger generation in Tianjing City. A normal boss of a small company would shiver in fear in his presence, but no one would expect that he would say such a thing to Hong Dali. No one would believe them even if they told others about this.
“But this is really what I am thinking.” Hong Dali helplessly shrugged. “Actually, I am very pure and innocent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - COSPLAY
paragraphs: Liu Mingxin thought to himself.I’d be a fool to believe you! I still remember how Mingcheng’s Turkey Bookstore closed down.This thought ran through his mind, but he couldn’t say it out loud. All Liu Mingxin could do was remind himself to be very, very careful. But no matter how careful he was, there was no way for him to guess what Hong Dali had planned. He could only try his best to go along. “I will post messages in the game to advertise. What does Young Master Dali intend to do?”

Hong Dali said, “It’s simple. All you have to do is mention that we have a dedicated training center and to make sure that you set up a dedicated game server. Hmm... the kind that allows many people to gather and watch. You’re the genius, surely you can figure it out yourself?”

Liu Mingxin was indeed smart, he quickly expanded on the idea. “En, that’s not a bad idea. We will get a high-end professional game server and sell tickets for people to observe the game. That will earn us some profit. We can also hype it up and raise the popularity of the event. I will announce monetary rewards for the battles, that should draw quite a bit of attention.”

Hong Dali gave him a thumbs-up. “It’s such a breeze speaking to intelligent people! We will have team battles and solo battles. The strongest player in the solo battles in each server will get 50,000. The second and third will get 30,000. The fourth to sixth will get 20,000. Seventh to tenth 10,000. 1,000 for the first fifty, and 500 for the first hundredth. Team battles will be formed with five players, and the prize money will double. I will sponsor the event.”
Liu Mingxin sucked in a breath of cold air, his feeling of uneasiness growing. “Well... Young Master Dali, that’s not good? I get all the advantage, yet you sponsor the event. I will feel bad.”

Hong Dali decisively hit the table. “Fifty-fifty then. These are small things, no problem. The battles shall be held at West Fourth Loop Sports Stadium. I will arrange for the installation of a few big screens, and the ticketing proceeds will go to me. Deal?”

Hearing that Hong Dali was willing to lay claim to some earnings, Liu Mingxin felt much better. “Ok.” He did some calculations. If the tickets cost ten yuan each, the West Fourth Loop Sports Stadium could easily accommodate fifty thousand people—that will be five hundred thousand in ticket sales. It seemed that Hong Dali would not be able to collect much. In any case, with his current appeal, it would not be a problem to fill the stadium. Advertising should be very effective. Hence, this deal could be considered a win-win situation.

Although he was still unsure of Hong Dali’s real motive, it finally made a little sense. If they charged a little more for the tickets, they could make more profit. After all, Hong Dali didn’t have to come up with much capital.

This was as far as he got before he heard Hong Dali mumble to himself. “This location seems a little small. I should make some commercials and advertise them on Tianjing Satellite TV. Otherwise, we will not be able to live up to the slogan ‘Dali’s productions must be the best.’ Xinxin,” Hong Dali called out to Tang Muxin. “Do you have any more ideas? The battles seem rather bland on their own.”
Tang Muxin: “You’re the talented squanderer. I don’t have any good ideas.”

“En, let me think. It’s no good if the event is too small-scaled.” Hong Dali looked around and suddenly saw the cover of the game disc. His eyes lit up. “Wahahahahahaha! I got it! I’m indeed good at squandering!”
If Hong Dali said he had a good idea, it was definitely a good idea. “What is it, what is it?” Tang Muxin was curious. “Tell us about it quickly!”
Hong Dali teased, “Xinxin, do you want to experience something magical? It’s amazing!”
Tang Muxin pondered for a while, and then suddenly saw the cover of the game disc. “Magical? What do you mean? Dali, do you mean you want me to dress up as one of the characters in the game?”

“Cosplay?!” Liu Mingxin instantly understood. He thought about it and agreed that Hong Dali had indeed come up with a great idea. “Young Master Dali, I’m impressed. You certainly have a lot of ideas, even thinking of this.”
Hong Dali proudly said, “That goes without saying. Let us have a spectacular cosplay event!”
That was how the first online battle was settled in a joking manner.
Liu Mingxin was practically floating as he left.
In cold sweat.

The truth was, from the moment Hong Dali brought up the matter of working with him, he had wondered what Hong Dali’s true intentions were. He had thought about it for almost half a day but couldn’t come up with any possibilities. He was almost going crazy. As he got into the driver’s seat of the car, he was still mulling over Hong Dali’s motives.
But he couldn’t think of anything.
Humans were like that sometimes. The more one was unable to figure something out, the more worried one would be. The more worried one was, the more unsettled one would be.

So, for this, Liu Mingxin’s hair almost turned white from thinking. No matter how hard he thought, things were to his advantage. Hong Dali came up with the idea and the money, all he had to do was to make use of a little popularity and there would be a little increase in turnover. At their level, an increase of a few percentages would mean millions to tens of millions of income.
Hong Dali had no reason to do him such a big favor.
Hence, Liu Mingxin pondered in his office, at home, while he was eating, and even dreamed about it while sleeping...
It took him three days. His hair almost turned white from all the pondering. He finally came to a conclusion that shocked him. Was Hong Dali doing this solely to squander?

The truth was, after Liu Mingxin left that day, Tang Muxin asked Hong Dali the same question. Hong Dali looked at her as if she were a fool. “We have been playing together for such a long time, do you still not understand? I just want to squander.”
As a result, Hong Dali got his face violently pinched again.
Sangle Building, level 16, CEO’s office.

Hong Weiguo held his pipe while looking down at the people milling around. “How is the construction of the school building coming along? Have we got all the approval documents? Also, have you found the first batch of lecturers?”

His secretary respectfully responded while clutching her files, “CEO Hong, the submitted documentation have all been approved, and the first batch of lecturers for knowledge on foundation has been found. But Young Master Dali didn’t specify what kind of school he wants this to be. Hence, I didn’t look for too many people.”

Hong Weiguo thoughtfully said, “Right. That would be my slip-up. Dali said it’s to be called New Lanxiang Vocational School. I think he is leaning towards technological research, emphasizing on web developing. You can put the focus there. By the way, please follow-up on all other aspects of the project as you deem necessary. We will leave the rest for Dali to decide.”
“Okay, CEO Hong.” The secretary asked again, “The address is at the outer loop of Tianjing Mountain?

Hong Weiguo chuckled. “Of course. That seems to be the most suitable location so far. This little rascal seems like such a wastrel most of the time. It’s true some of the things he buys are completely useless. However, the piece of land at the outer circle of Tianjing Mountain is scenic, and the surrounding land is big enough to build a school. When the time comes, we will have Lin Chuyin’s research laboratory working with us. It’s really not a bad idea at all to get into scientific-technological research.”

His secretary sighed, expressing his shock. “That’s right. Young Master Dali sure has some spectacular and unexpected ways to squander. Once the construction of Marshes of Mount Liang is complete at Fengyuan Lake, it will be a perfect place for a relaxing vacation. I think we should build smaller houses rather than mansions.”

Hong Weiguo was a man with a sharp nose for business. “Haha, that’s right. If we take a closer look at the little rascal’s ideas, some of them are actually not bad.” Hong Dali had jokingly made a comment about Marshes of Mount Liang, and he had instinctively sensed that it was an interesting idea. “Not only should we build more houses, once Dali’s age ceremony is over, let’s excavate the area around the hill near Fengyuan Lake and let the lake flood the bottom of the hill. Clear up the rubbish from the lake and find some historical-looking wooden boats. Doesn’t that sound good?”

His secretary could not deny that it was a rather good idea. “Yes. At that time, we could sell it as a nature resort. Visitors can experience gathering on Marshes of Mount Liang. They can get there by boat, wear period costumes, and have a hearty meal of wine and meat with friends. We could raise a huge flag and let visitors go around the lake with some leisure boats. It would definitely be popular among tourists.”

Hong Weiguo laughed heartily. “Hahaha. That sounds rather ideal. Yes, go acquire the land within and surrounding Tianjing Mountain. I have a feeling that our Dali will be able to think of other purposes for it. Although I have no idea what that might be, I’m sure it will be something spectacular.”
His secretary hurriedly replied, “Yes.”
Hong Weiguo suddenly asked, “Oh yes, how has Geezer Wang, the hairdresser, been lately?”

His secretary didn’t know whether to laugh or cry when he mentioned the eccentric Geezer Wang. “Geezer Wang... Geezer Wang is doing well at the production team. He is a very professional martial arts coach. There have been numerous offers from other production teams offering one thousand a day to entice him to direct their action scenes. But he rejected all of them giving the reason that Young Master Dali has not given his approval. He has real skills. I’m sure that when he was young, he was probably one of those tough men who didn’t even bat an eyelid when surrounded by tens of attackers.”

Hong Weiguo didn’t know whether to cry or laugh. “Hehe. We have a man who is paid five thousand a month but refuses to leave for a thousand yuan a day. Even I’m not sure what this wastrel son of mine is up to these days.”
The secretary then said, “Right, CEO Hong. This technology school that Dali wants to open, what do we do with the intake? Do we look for students or...”

Hong Weiguo slowly said, “Regarding the student intake, I have thought about it. Dali had no intention of profiting from this school from the start. I don’t pin much hope on profiting from it, either. We’ll contribute to society and recruit students from poor rural areas. This can wait till the school is built. Oh, do we have the cost estimates for the construction?”
