Otherwise, we will not be able to live up to the slogan ‘Dali’s productions must be the best.’ Xinxin,” Hong Dali called out to Tang Muxin.
“Do you have any more ideas?
The battles seem rather bland on their own.”
Tang Muxin: “You’re the talented squanderer.
I don’t have any good ideas.”
“En, let me think.
It’s no good if the event is too small-scaled.” Hong Dali looked around and suddenly saw the cover of the game disc.
His eyes lit up.
“Wahahahahahaha!
I got it!
I’m indeed good at squandering!”
If Hong Dali said he had a good idea, it was definitely a good idea.
“What is it, what is it?” Tang Muxin was curious.
“Tell us about it quickly!”
Hong Dali teased, “Xinxin, do you want to experience something magical?
It’s amazing!”
Tang Muxin pondered for a while, and then suddenly saw the cover of the game disc.
“Magical?
What do you mean?
Dali, do you mean you want me to dress up as one of the characters in the game?”
“Cosplay?!” Liu Mingxin instantly understood.
He thought about it and agreed that Hong Dali had indeed come up with a great idea.
“Young Master Dali, I’m impressed.
You certainly have a lot of ideas, even thinking of this.”
Hong Dali proudly said, “That goes without saying.
Let us have a spectacular cosplay event!”
That was how the first online battle was settled in a joking manner.
Liu Mingxin was practically floating as he left.
In cold sweat.
The truth was, from the moment Hong Dali brought up the matter of working with him, he had wondered what Hong Dali’s true intentions were.
He had thought about it for almost half a day but couldn’t come up with any possibilities.
He was almost going crazy.
As he got into the driver’s seat of the car, he was still mulling over Hong Dali’s motives.
But he couldn’t think of anything.
Humans were like that sometimes.
The more one was unable to figure something out, the more worried one would be.
The more worried one was, the more unsettled one would be.
So, for this, Liu Mingxin’s hair almost turned white from thinking.
No matter how hard he thought, things were to his advantage.
Hong Dali came up with the idea and the money, all he had to do was to make use of a little popularity and there would be a little increase in turnover.
At their level, an increase of a few percentages would mean millions to tens of millions of income.
Hong Dali had no reason to do him such a big favor.
Hence, Liu Mingxin pondered in his office, at home, while he was eating, and even dreamed about it while sleeping...
It took him three days.
His hair almost turned white from all the pondering.
He finally came to a conclusion that shocked him.
Was Hong Dali doing this solely to squander?
The truth was, after Liu Mingxin left that day, Tang Muxin asked Hong Dali the same question.
Hong Dali looked at her as if she were a fool.
“We have been playing together for such a long time, do you still not understand?
I just want to squander.”
As a result, Hong Dali got his face violently pinched again.
Sangle Building, level 16, CEO’s office.
Hong Weiguo held his pipe while looking down at the people milling around.
“How is the construction of the school building coming along?
Have we got all the approval documents?
Also, have you found the first batch of lecturers?”

His secretary respectfully responded while clutching her files, “CEO Hong, the submitted documentation have all been approved, and the first batch of lecturers for knowledge on foundation has been found.
But Young Master Dali didn’t specify what kind of school he wants this to be.
Hence, I didn’t look for too many people.”
Hong Weiguo thoughtfully said, “Right.
That would be my slip-up.
Dali said it’s to be called New Lanxiang Vocational School.
I think he is leaning towards technological research, emphasizing on web developing.
You can put the focus there.
By the way, please follow-up on all other aspects of the project as you deem necessary.
We will leave the rest for Dali to decide.”
“Okay, CEO Hong.” The secretary asked again, “The address is at the outer loop of Tianjing Mountain?
Hong Weiguo chuckled.
“Of course.
That seems to be the most suitable location so far.
This little rascal seems like such a wastrel most of the time.
It’s true some of the things he buys are completely useless.
However, the piece of land at the outer circle of Tianjing Mountain is scenic, and the surrounding land is big enough to build a school.
When the time comes, we will have Lin Chuyin’s research laboratory working with us.
It’s really not a bad idea at all to get into scientific-technological research.”
His secretary sighed, expressing his shock.
“That’s right.
Young Master Dali sure has some spectacular and unexpected ways to squander.
Once the construction of Marshes of Mount Liang is complete at Fengyuan Lake, it will be a perfect place for a relaxing vacation.
I think we should build smaller houses rather than mansions.”
Hong Weiguo was a man with a sharp nose for business.
“Haha, that’s right.

If we take a closer look at the little rascal’s ideas, some of them are actually not bad.” Hong Dali had jokingly made a comment about Marshes of Mount Liang, and he had instinctively sensed that it was an interesting idea.
“Not only should we build more houses, once Dali’s age ceremony is over, let’s excavate the area around the hill near Fengyuan Lake and let the lake flood the bottom of the hill.
Clear up the rubbish from the lake and find some historical-looking wooden boats.
Doesn’t that sound good?”
His secretary could not deny that it was a rather good idea.
“Yes.
At that time, we could sell it as a nature resort.
Visitors can experience gathering on Marshes of Mount Liang.
They can get there by boat, wear period costumes, and have a hearty meal of wine and meat with friends.
We could raise a huge flag and let visitors go around the lake with some leisure boats.
It would definitely be popular among tourists.”
Hong Weiguo laughed heartily.
“Hahaha.
That sounds rather ideal.
Yes, go acquire the land within and surrounding Tianjing Mountain.
I have a feeling that our Dali will be able to think of other purposes for it.
Although I have no idea what that might be, I’m sure it will be something spectacular.”
His secretary hurriedly replied, “Yes.”
Hong Weiguo suddenly asked, “Oh yes, how has Geezer Wang, the hairdresser, been lately?”
His secretary didn’t know whether to laugh or cry when he mentioned the eccentric Geezer Wang.
“Geezer Wang...
Geezer Wang is doing well at the production team.
He is a very professional martial arts coach.
There have been numerous offers from other production teams offering one thousand a day to entice him to direct their action scenes.
But he rejected all of them giving the reason that Young Master Dali has not given his approval.
He has real skills.
I’m sure that when he was young, he was probably one of those tough men who didn’t even bat an eyelid when surrounded by tens of attackers.”
Hong Weiguo didn’t know whether to cry or laugh.
“Hehe.
We have a man who is paid five thousand a month but refuses to leave for a thousand yuan a day.
Even I’m not sure what this wastrel son of mine is up to these days.”
The secretary then said, “Right, CEO Hong.
This technology school that Dali wants to open, what do we do with the intake?
Do we look for students or...”
Hong Weiguo slowly said, “Regarding the student intake, I have thought about it.
Dali had no intention of profiting from this school from the start.
I don’t pin much hope on profiting from it, either.
We’ll contribute to society and recruit students from poor rural areas.
This can wait till the school is built.
Oh, do we have the cost estimates for the construction?”

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - Xiaoyi’s Troubles
paragraphs: The secretary said, “It’s almost ready. The land is already suitably formed. Hence, there is almost no cost for that. As for the construction, if we were to build it based on the highest industry standards, that would cost about five million. All the best furnishings and equipment will add up to about one million. If we add in all the other miscellaneous spendings, the accounts department estimates that the total cost should not exceed twenty million. This amount of investment is comparable to prestigious high schools within the city. The thing is, we are still not sure what levels our school will cater to. If it’s catered for junior high to university, the projected cost will be higher.”

Hong Weiguo said without hesitation, “Let it be higher, then. Let’s work on an estimate of thirty million first. Make it from primary school to university. Wait!” Hong Weiguo’s eyes suddenly lit up. “This little rascal unwittingly paved a road for me!”
The secretary was momentarily shocked. “Ah?”

Hong Weiguo laughed. “In the future, when our company requires a certain kind of talent, we will simply start a faculty of such a subject in the school! Internet programmer, animator, web developer, data center... anything we need! The effect might not be immediate, but in the long run, this school has the potential to be one of the core facilities of Sangle!”
The secretary gaped. “I will never try to outsmart Young Master Dali again.”
Within Tianjing City.
A man who looked like a boss asked his butler, “The superprodigal son of the Hong Family is holding a coming of age ceremony?”
The butler respectfully handed the invitation over. “Yes, Old Master. They have already sent the invitation card.”

“Yes, let me take a look. May 28th, in the evening, on the Changjiang Gold cruise ship? Isn’t this ship a bit small? Whatever. Anyway, I have to go to Beijing shore. I will just take it as a two days holiday. The location is...” The boss took a quick glance at the invite and was confused. After taking a closer look, his eyes widened in surprise. “The location is at Fengyuan Lake?! The Fengyuan Lake at Tianjing City West Fourth Loop?!”

“Did you hear about it? The Hongs have really outdone themselves this time. They actually transported the entire cruise ship to Fengyuan Lake for their superprodigal son Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony. That ship weighs tens of thousands of tonnes. I wonder how he did it!”

“How would I not know such big news. I heard that the transportation fees alone cost tens of millions. And that’s only because Fengyuan Lake is linked to one of the big rivers used for transportation in Tianjing City. Otherwise, it would cost more.”
“This prodigal son Hong Dali, Hong Weiguo is actually playing along with him. Sigh, there’s no way to compare!”

“You can stop thinking about it. There is really no way to compare. The way I see it, Hong Weiguo is being so generous this time because he wants to send everyone a message. He means to say that if anyone dares to even touch Hong Dali, he will protect Hong Dali by all means necessary.”

“That goes without saying. Spending ten million just for transportation fees for a coming of age ceremony—any fool could tell how much Hong Weiguo dotes on Hong Dali. Sigh, Hard work can’t win getting born into a good family!”
“There’s no point for us being envious and jealous. We are of different levels.”
Fengyuan Lake surroundings.
“Mummy, see, why is there such a huge ship there?”
“Don’t be silly. Fengyuan Lake is not big enough for a huge ship... there’s really a huge ship!!”
“Mummy, are aliens invading Earth? How did such a big ship get here?”
“I don’t know, either. Maybe someone transported it over. Sigh, it’s impossible for us to understand the rich...”
“Mummy, can we go up and take a look?”
“Of course not. Can’t you see the people crowding around the side of the lake? No one dares to get on.”
“Oh... Okay then...”
At the intersection of Tianjing City, West Fourth Loop and North Second Loop, Lin Chuyin’s laboratory.
Lin Chuyin’s voice was calm as usual as she spoke to a levitating phone in the middle of her laboratory, “Ok. Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony? Yes, I know. I will be there.”
When Lin Chuyin agreed to attend Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony, her father on the other end of the phone was shocked. “Chuyin, you are really going? You don’t usually attend such events?”
Lin Chuyin flatly replied before turning off the phone and continuing her research. “Hong Dali is my friend. So I will go.”
Tianjing City, Villa by Hong Lake in the Southwest, Villa no. 16.

Hong Anbao leaned angrily on the sofa and kept yelling, “Dammit. Hong Dali is one impossibly lucky guy. His coming of age ceremony is such a large scale event. The whole Tianjing City knows that my fifth uncle spent more than ten million transporting the cruise ship to Fengyuan Lake. I wonder how they did it. I heard they mobilized ninety heavy trucks and twenty helicopters to move it. What a squanderer. He had too much money and nowhere to spend!”

Hong Anbao’s father, Hong Jianye, held a glass of red wine and sat with his legs crossed. “Why do you bother thinking about it? My bigger concern is, Weiguo did this on purpose to show off to us. Hehe. Such a huge coming of age ceremony. He is telling us anyone who has any bad intentions towards Hong Dali to think twice. The family meeting is coming to him, and he is giving us a warning.”

Hong Anbao disdainfully said, “Isn’t it so that Hong Dali will not be at too much of an disadvantage during the family meeting? By doing that, even if Hong Dali is completely useless, no one would dare to lay a finger on him. Furthermore, either Hong Dali is really having a lucky streak or he has some real talent. Every project he dabbled in so far has earned quite a fair sum of money. It’s really hard to deal with him.”

Hong Jianye chuckled. “Kek, we will take appropriate measures when the situation calls for it. Even if he manages to get past this family meeting, he will just take the opportunity to squander more in the future. The sales of your Fierce Bull beverage has recovered quite a bit these two days. Although it’s still unable to meet our expectations, it’s likely enough to get you a position among the top three of the younger generation. I heard that those old fogies have a plan to increase the number to five during the family meeting. It seems that there are another two amongst the younger generation that proved their potential. No matter what, you just have to keep our position within the five and go for third place.”

Hong Anabo nodded. “Yes, I understand. Once we get the funds from the family and expand our business, our sales figure will definitely improve further. But father, don’t you think we should do something about Hong Dali? It’s not a good idea to let him expand his business without interference. He has such good ideas, he will be trouble for us in the future.”

Hong Jianye sipped on his wine and said, “Haha. Don’t worry. I have already thought of something and made plans. We might not do anything to Hong Dali, but we have no qualms about the people around him.”
The next few days were calm, and it was soon Hong Dali’s birthday, May 28th.
When the dismissal bell rang, Hong Dali stretched lazily and sprung up from his seat clutching on to Quentin. “Wahahahaha! School has finally ended! It’s too boring. Let’s go play!”
Ling Yi called out to him from behind. “Big Bro Dali, it’s your coming of age ceremony tonight. We will all be there, hehe.”
Hong Dali held on to steel bullet and ran out. “Ah, everyone is gone. Haha. I’ll see you tonight, then!”

His classmates were all envious of him. “Aye, they actually transported such a huge cruise ship for his coming of age ceremony. There’s no comparing.” “Yes, yes, I just had my eighteenth birthday, and all we did was reserve one floor of a restaurant. Big Bro Dali transported an entire cruise ship, the difference is huge. Sigh.” “Stop sighing, comparing with him would be the death of you. Hurry home and get ready!”

And so, the group of classmates packed up and made their way home to get ready for Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony that night. All those that were invited were not from simple backgrounds. If one was not from an affluent family, it would be hard to even see what was going on inside.

Tang Muxin was smiling and waiting for Hong Dali as he stepped out of the classroom. She went up to him and smiled as she said, “Dali, tonight is your coming of age ceremony. Do you have anything to say about it?”
Hong Dali raised his hands up high and laughed as he shouted, “Of course! Finally, I’ve been promoted from a small prodigal son to a big prodigal son. Yeah!”
Tang Muxin regretfully said, “I shouldn’t have asked, people around are giving us weird looks now...”
Both of them stepped out of the school gates together and boarded the Soaring Angel. Hong Dali asked Xiaoyi out of habit, “Xiaoyi, are there any good news recently?”
Usually, when he asked this question, Ling Xiaoyi would promptly give him a rundown of the day’s happenings. But there was no response from her today.

Just as Hong Dali was wondering what happened, driver Wang Mingyu turned around and reported to him, “Young Master Dali, it seems there was an emergency in Miss Xiaoyi’s family, and she rushed off. I wanted to ask her about it, but then thought the better of it and decided to wait and see your decision.”
Hong Dali frowned. “Something happened in Xiaoyi’s family? What is so urgent?”
Tang Muxin said, “Sister Xiaoyi is usually so calm and collected. It must be something serious if it made her leave in such a hurry. Dali, quickly ask her about it!”

With Ling Xiaoyi handling matters for him regularly, Hong Dali had little to worry about. Now that Ling Xiaoyi’s family was in trouble, as her young master, he should naturally be concerned. Hong Dali whipped out his phone decisively, located her number and dialed. “Xiaoyi, what happened? I heard something happened in your home?”

Unlike her usual demeanor, Ling Xiaoyi was clearly crying. “Young Master, help my younger brother. Please help my younger brother!” She must have encountered something bothersome. Otherwise, from her current status and relationship with Hong Dali, she would not be so flustered.
Tang Muxin pressed her ear against the phone and heard Ling Xiaoyi’s cry. It made her anxious. “Sister Xiaoyi must be in some kind of trouble!”
Hong Dali quickly consoled her. “Don’t cry, don’t cry. Your Young Master is here. What happened?” He wanted to probe for more details but instead asked, “Where are you? I better go to you.”
Ling Xiaoyi thought about it, but gritted her teeth and said, “I... I am... Young Master, I can’t tell you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - The Rabbit Dies and the Fox is Depressed
paragraphs: Hearing what Ling Xiaoyi said, Hong Dali suddenly felt gloomy. “Damn! What place is it? What can’t you say?”

Ling Xiaoyi quickly responded from the other side of the phone, “No, no. Today is Young Master’s coming of age ceremony. Old Master has already sent out all the invitations. I... There’s nothing here. It’s just for one night. I will seek Young Master’s help tomorrow.” She promptly hung up after saying that!
Hong Dali: “...”

Damn, it shouldn’t be like that. Hong Dali furiously stomped his feet and shouted, “She’s underestimating me as the prodigal’s son?! Am I so unreliable?! Something has happened but she’s not saying. This is embarrassing!”

Tang Muxin nodded her head vigorously. “Yes, yes. It’s ok to fool around usually, but one would be a failed prodigal’s son if we don’t do anything when the lackey is in trouble. Others will look down on us!”
Hong Dali instructed driver Wang Mingyu, “Uncle Wang, find out the location of Xiaoyi’s phone. Something must have happened. Xiaoyi’s tone didn’t sound right!”
“Yes, Young Master.” Wang Mingyu quickly fished out his phone and started dialing a number. The call got through promptly. Wang Mingyu smiled as he said, “Deputy Chief Zhang, how have you been?”

Deputy Chief Zhang laughed as he replied, “So-so. What could have happened for driver Wang to think of calling me today? Is there anything you need help with? I will definitely help you if it’s within my control.”
Wang Mingyu laughed and said, “Deputy Chief Zhang, I’m not the one looking for you. It’s my Young Master Dali.” He passed the phone to Hong Dali promptly.
Police Department’s Deputy Chief Zhang Haiyang muttered a sigh, “Young Master Dali?” He suddenly exclaimed, “Young Master Dali, the Young Master Dali you mentioned, is he...”
Hong Dali laughed and said, “Is this Uncle Zhang? I’m Hong Dali.”

When Zhang Haiyang heard Hong Dali’s voice, he replied quickly and carefully, “Nothing, it’s nothing! Young Master Dali, I didn’t think you would look for me. How can I help you?” The Hong Family that Hong Dali was from was influential through the business and political world. They were, after all, the descendants of the founding father. They may not have control over everything, but it was sufficient to ask for a favor from the Police Department’s Deputy Chief.

Hong Dali thought about it and slowly said, “It’s like this, Uncle Zhang. I have a competent staff, named Ling Xiaoyi. Something happened in her family, but she refused to tell me what was going on. Uncle Zhang, could you help me check the location of her mobile phone?”
It was not a big matter. Just checking the location of a phone number. Zhang Haiyang naturally couldn’t refuse the request. “Sure, no problem. Let me make some arrangements. Ten minutes!”
“Thank you, Uncle Zhang, hehe.” Hong Dali chuckled as he hung up the phone.
At this moment, driver Wang Mingyu asked, “Young Master, it’s only three more hours till your coming of age ceremony. Shall we return home to get ready first?”

Hong Dali sniffed. “No hurry, I have no mood for it if I don’t know what’s going on with Xiaoyi. She has followed me for quite a while, after all, and she’s a good person. I can’t sit back and do nothing.”
Hong Dali’s kindheartedness and justice warmed Wang Mingyu’s heart. “That’s true.”
No one would wish for the person that they were serving to be a heartless person blinded to humanity.

Very soon, his phone started to ring. Hong Dali picked up, and Zhang Haiyang voice came through the other end. “Young Master Dali, I found her. The last location of Ms. Ling Xiaoyi’s phone is... is...”
Hong Dali said, “Where is it? Just say it. Don’t beat around the bush.”

Zhang Haiyang paused before saying, “It’s at Tianjing West City Prison. Ms. Ling Xiaoyi actually went there. I was curious too. Hence, I asked a few of my men to find out more. It turns out her brother is in prison.”
Ling Xiaoyi’s brother was in prison?!

Hong Dali curiously asked, “It can’t be! I’ve heard her speak about her brother. He is nineteen this year and is studying at Tianjing Shifan University’s affiliated high school. Year three, class fourteen. His grades are not bad. How did he end up in prison? Did he fight with someone? Hit someone?! This doesn’t make sense!”

Zhang Haiyang was curious too, “No... No... If it were just a small matter like fighting, I could get him out of there easily. The problem is that he is there for other matters, I can’t make that decision so simply.”
“He couldn’t have killed someone?!” Hong Dali was speechless. “A matter of life or death?!” He immediately shouted through the phone, “Uncle Zhang, quickly say something, I’m anxious to death!”

“Okay, I’ll say it. But I’ll say this first, don’t get too worked up, Young Master Dali.” Zhang Haiyang gulped. “Ms. Ling Xiaoyi’s brother is Ling Mufeng. The reason he’s in prison is that... he took ‘Blue Fantasy’ and was caught.”
“Blue Fantasy?” Hong Dali curiously asked, “What is that? Don’t tell me it’s those magical little pills?”
Zhang Haiyang said, “That’s exactly it. And the aftereffects are too strong. Hence... I don’t dare to let him out easily. If he can’t bear the consequences, it will be a disaster.”

Hong Dali threw the phone on the floor in a fit. “Darn! Is that Ling Mufeng crazy to eat something like that?! Uncle Wang, let’s go to Tianjing West City Prison. I want to find out for myself why such an outstanding person would do something like that!” It was a good thing that the quality of this limited edition mobile worth 125,000 was quite good. Zhang Haiyang’s voice could still be clearly heard. “Young Master Dali, don’t get too worked up. Young Master Dali...”
Tang Muxin heard everything and was furious as well. “Sister Xiaoyi is such a nice person, why would her brother do such a thing!”
Fortunately, Wang Mingyu was experienced and spoke as he started the car, “Young Master, this is not as simple as it seems.”
Hong Dali nodded. “I know, an outstanding student might occasionally get into trouble for fights. But taking drugs? This doesn’t make sense. Xinxin, what do you think?”
Tang Muxin said, “There must be something behind it. Dali, can you sense it? The timing of this matter is too much of a coincidence.”

Hong Dali nodded. “Yes, it coincided with my coming of age ceremony. To get caught for taking drugs... Usually, when people are caught, they would have taken it a couple of times. It can’t be that he got caught for just taking it once. He must have been framed or caught due to some special reasons.”

“Yes, that’s what I suspect too.” As long as it had nothing to do with squandering, Tang Muxin was bright as usual. “Dali, think about it. If Sister Xiaoyi’s brother Ling Mufeng was tempted for some reason, and took some Blue Fantasy and got caught, it can’t be so coincidental for it to happen today, right?”

Hong Dali rubbed his chin. “Yes, yes, that’s right. Speaking of which, someone must have reported him on purpose today. And the reason was for Xiaoyi to delay me. But I’m curious,” Dali asked curiously, “It’s just a coming of age ceremony. It’s nothing important. Is there a need to do something like that?”

Tang Muxin thought about it and said, “Maybe, that’s not it. Uncle Hong has done so much for the ceremony, even transported the cruise ship. If you don’t appear at the ceremony, it will certainly not look good for him. If the guests start getting rowdy, Uncle Hong can easily have some slip-ups. You’re the star today. If you don’t appear, others can easily imply that you have no respect for others. This could become a big matter.”

“Yes, that’s true. The problem is, who would take so much effort to do this?” Hong Dali was curious. “What could be their problem? All I want to do is squander happily and lead my life happily. I don’t want to create trouble for anyone, and I don’t want to make any enemies...”
Hong Dali was indeed aggrieved.

One could say that he did nothing every day, read comics and slept in class, walked Quentin with his lackeys after class, ate when he felt like it, slept when he felt like it, and tipped when he was happy. Who would plot against such a prodigal son? What reason could there be? Why couldn’t they just let him be?
Tang Muxin assertively said, “I think someone is afraid. And he wants to give you a lesson.”
“Afraid? Me?” Hong Dali pointed at himself. “Who would be afraid of a prodigal son? It can’t be. I’m so low profile.”
Tang Muxin poked him furiously. “Low profile? You?!” He grimaced in pain and could only hear Tang Muxin say, “Who would have thought that the things you squander on could be so profitable?”
Hong Dali felt helpless and hurt. “I didn’t know, either. Let’s not talk about this. Xinxin, who do you think would do something like this? Is it someone from our family or is it an outsider?”
It was no use talking about it now. The important thing was to find out who did it.

Tang Muxin was equally curious. “Aye, there are many capable of doing this. From the start, the property you bought at the West Fourth Loop could have offended some property company. Making movies, you could have offended film companies. There are many in your family who can’t wait to see you fail. Liu Mingcheng could be a suspect too—what happened to Turkey Bookstore was partly because of you as well. And the last time when you cheated the Merikans and Koreans. It could be them too...”
Hong Dali aggressively rubbed his head. “Did I offend so many people...”

“What do you think?” Tang Muxin was worried too. “The business world is like a battlefield. For you to do as you wish, you may have caused many problems. Turkey Bookstore is a very good example. You can easily find out. There’s a saying that ‘The Rabbit Dies and the Fox is Depressed.’ Would they be next since Turkey Bookstore closed down? You’re involved in too many types of businesses. Properties, movies, novels, websites, etc. You even own a few hotels. How could they let their guard down?”

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - Xiaoyi’s Brother
paragraphs: The truth was that what Tang Muxin said was not just unfounded fears.

Although Hong Dali was publicly known as a prodigal son, he had impossibly good luck. Anyone with sense could feel the pressure. Just take for example his foray into the movie and entertainment industry. The other companies were already crying foul.
Hong Dali dejectedly said, “What should I do, then? I can’t possibly spend all my time at home eating and sleeping?! That’s the life of a pig, not mine.”

“Not necessarily.” Tang Muxin said, fully in her role as the inept advisor. “For this matter, I think you should make it obvious, as obvious as you can! Isn’t that person targeting Sister Xiaoyi? Be ruthless! Do whatever you feel like doing. Make them understand!”

Hong Dali laughed out loud. “Understood! Are they treating the tiger as Hello Kitty because it didn’t show its might? How can one be a superprodigal son if you don’t know how to be a pretentious prick and put others down? Well, let’s be ruthless this time! Let them know, whoever dares to go against me will have me to contend with.”

Tang Muxin smilingly said, “Your morale seems quite high. We’ll try to find the mastermind behind it. Even if we can’t find out who it is, we can get rid of the nest of lackeys in one sweep. This way, next time, if anyone dares to target you, they will have to consider if anyone would be willing to take on the job.”
Hong Dali sniffled. “Let’s just do that! Come on, let’s fight to our heart’s content today!”
Tianjing City West Prison.
Three days had passed since Ling Mufeng arrived.

He remembered having dinner with his new friends, followed by karaoke at Tiancheng Music Lounge. He could still recall that when the policemen from the anti-narcotics squad rushed in, his two new friends happened to have gone to the washroom. He, in a drug-induced stupor from eating the little pill called “Blue Fantasy,” was brought to the Drug Rehabilitation Center and then to prison.
It was a coincidence, or was it?

He was an excellent student. He had gotten third place in his year during that particular exam and was in a good mood. It happened to be a weekend, and he had gone to an internet cafe. There, he started chatting with two men who were playing the same game as him. After a while, they became friends.

After that, they had asked him out for lunch and even said they would recommend a girlfriend to him. Although he didn’t accept the invitation, they got along pretty well. It happened that he got off school early that day, so they went to the bar together. They had some drinks and sang. Then, he started feeling odd. He was extremely excited. He later found out that they had secretly given him that thing called “Blue Fantasy.”
He had no idea how much one of those costs.

He had thought it was something like Ecstasy and would not have any lasting effect. Who knew he would get addicted after just one pill and needed more pills every day after that. The weird thing was, they gave him the pills without charging him anything!
It was only after he got rid of his addiction that he realized that one pill, just the cost of one Blue Fantasy was enough to render one speechless.
Five hundred! Five hundred yuan was how much one little Blue Fantasy pill costs! The price was astronomical!

No matter how he looked at it, the “brothers” that he befriended didn’t look rich. What made them give him such an expensive thing? They just liked the way he looked? No one would believe that. He had no money, no power, and was just a poor student. The only thing he was proud of was his sister. He heard that his sister was working under Young Master Hong Dali. She seemed to be doing well and would send money home regularly.

Could it be their target was actually his sister? No, that was impossible. If their target were his sister, they would not have put in so much effort. Could their target be... Young Master Hong Dali from the Hong Family?
It was just a fleeting thought, but it was enough to make Ling Mufeng break out in cold sweat.
That must be it. It must be so!
These people had gone through a lot of trouble to entrap him.
Ling Mufeng didn’t dare to call anyone. If his sister had found out about this matter, the outcome would be... Moreover, if it affected Young Master Hong Dali...
A cold voice from the cell interrupted his thoughts. “Hey you, the new kid, go get some water for me to wash my feed. Go quickly, don’t irk me, or I will peel your skin!”
As Ling Mufeng heard the voice, he sighed and stood up slowly.

Before he could react, he felt a strong, forceful kick on his back. Ling Mufeng fell to the ground as a bearded prisoner growled. “Brat, quit dilly-dallying. Brother Ying instructed you to fetch water to wash his feet. Do you want to die? Go quickly!”
Ling Mufeng gritted his teeth and picked himself off the ground. He bore the pain on his back and picked up the container to go fetch water.
He got the water and was ready to sneak a rest when the prison guard called out, “Who is Ling Mufeng? Come quickly, you have a visitor.”
Ling Mufeng’s hand trembled. “I have a visitor? Could it be...”

“Young Master Dali, we are here. Please alight.” Driver Wang Mingyu parked the car, and Hong Dali alighted the car with Tang Muxin. Hong Dali looked at the exterior walls of the prison. It was almost four meters high topped with barbed wire. He sniffed and said, “Tianjing West City Prison. These people have some guts to imprison my man here. They are digging their own graves. Furthermore, Xiaoyi has been a fantastic butler.”
Tang Muxin huffed. “That’s right. Dali, I fully support you this time. Show them what you’re capable of! We are not afraid to make this into a big matter!”
“That goes without saying, let’s go!” Hong Dali snapped his fingers, and Tang Muxin followed him along with the eight lackeys.
The way in was clear without any obstructions.
Tang Muxin came from quite an influential family herself, and Hong Dali’s background was even more impressive. Although they were both young, they had quite a bit of clout.

The prison police were all quick-witted. Although they didn’t know Hong Dali and Tang Muxin, they could tell from their fancy car that they couldn’t afford to offend them. From the moment they alighted the car, one of the guards had already called out, “Are you here to visit someone... Or should I give the Prison Warden a call?”
“We’ll make our way in ourselves. Tip them!” Hong Dali waved them away. “Two thousand each.”
The lackey standing behind Hong Dali took out a stack of cash, and a female lackey took out the cash counting machine.Swish swish swishand everyone soon got their two thousand yuan...

There was disbelief on the faces of most of the prison guards. “Quick, hit me. I need to know if I’m dreaming. Two thousand yuan! That’s almost two month’s worth of salary!” “Yes, yes. That must be the God of Fortune!” “Quickly, serve them well!”

It was a fact that money made the world go around. Tipping anyone they met, regardless of who they were, cleared the path for all future dealings. The group of prison guards was servile and respectful, as though they were meeting the head of the country. “Aiyo, this Young Master is so generous. Are you looking for our Prison Warden? Let me bring you to him. This way please, this way!”

With a whole group of prison guards leading the way, Hong Dali and his entourage arrived at the foot of the building where the Prison Warden was. On their way there, anyone who had worked there for more than a while would greet the group from afar. Hong Dali said the same thing whenever they met anyone. “Tip them, two thousand!” The male lackeys would then approach them with the money.

Just like that, by rewarding everyone along the way, Hong Dali had gained a group of loyal fans. There were even a few that shouted: “Chuichui, I love you.” It was obvious they were fans ofUnexpectedly!.

Tang Muxin chuckled. “You’re like the child spreading the wealth. You seem popular no matter where you go.” The little lass’ vanity was fully contented. The way she looked at Hong Dali was much friendlier.
Hong Dali was obviously in a good mood. Laughing, he said, “Of course. I’m the super prodigal son. We must look good no matter where we go!”

They soon arrived at the Prison Warden’s office. They had agreed that he would act like a pretentious snob. In order to play the part well, Hong Dali didn’t even bother knocking on the door. He kicked the door opened, smiling as he walked in.

It was almost noon, and the Prison Warden was ready to take a nap. “Which brat doesn’t know how to knock...” He was shocked by the commotion and accidentally blurted out “brat.” When he came to his senses, he had cold sweat on his head and face. He quickly jumped up from the sofa and smiled as he moved forward. “It’s Young Master Dali and Miss Tang Muxin. Aiya, why didn’t you call in advance so I could welcome you personally.” The warden’s words made Hong Dali sure that the warden was aware of something. He just didn’t expect Hong Dali to be here so soon.
If someone who knew the Prison Warden personally was present, they would be so shocked their jaw would drop.

The West City Prison Prison Warden was an influential man. He might not be a section chief or anything, but he was known to be a tough man to handle. Any prisoner that was sent to this prison would be completely oppressed by him. From simple hooligans to powerful mafia bosses, they all had to obey him.

However. at this moment, Prison Warden Cao Jianrong, whom everyone viewed as an impassable man, was acting completely submissive in front of Hong Dali, speaking extremely carefully. No one would believe if the news got out.

It was understandable, though. As descendants of a founding father of the country, the Hong Family had the power to command the wind and the rain in Tianjing City. The fact that Hong Weiguo doted on his son, Hong Dali, was known to everyone in Tianjing City. Hong Weiguo even spent a huge sum of money to transport a cruise ship to a mountain. No matter how much influence Cao Jianrong had, it was limited to the prison and couldn’t be compared to Hong Dali.

They were giving their all today, so Hong Dali didn’t hold back either. He sat on Prison Warden Cao Jianrong’s leather chair, made a few turns, and laughed as he said, “This is quite comfortable. I say, Prison Warden Cao, there is someone whom I wonder if he’s here?”

I can’t possibly spend all my time at home eating and sleeping?!
That’s the life of a pig, not mine.”
“Not necessarily.” Tang Muxin said, fully in her role as the inept advisor.
“For this matter, I think you should make it obvious, as obvious as you can!
Isn’t that person targeting Sister Xiaoyi?
Be ruthless!
Do whatever you feel like doing.
Make them understand!”
Hong Dali laughed out loud.
“Understood!
Are they treating the tiger as Hello Kitty because it didn’t show its might?
How can one be a superprodigal son if you don’t know how to be a pretentious prick and put others down?
Well, let’s be ruthless this time!
Let them know, whoever dares to go against me will have me to contend with.”
Tang Muxin smilingly said, “Your morale seems quite high.
We’ll try to find the mastermind behind it.
Even if we can’t find out who it is, we can get rid of the nest of lackeys in one sweep.
This way, next time, if anyone dares to target you, they will have to consider if anyone would be willing to take on the job.”
Hong Dali sniffled.
“Let’s just do that!
Come on, let’s fight to our heart’s content today!”
Tianjing City West Prison.
Three days had passed since Ling Mufeng arrived.
He remembered having dinner with his new friends, followed by karaoke at Tiancheng Music Lounge.
He could still recall that when the policemen from the anti-narcotics squad rushed in, his two new friends happened to have gone to the washroom.
He, in a drug-induced stupor from eating the little pill called “Blue Fantasy,” was brought to the Drug Rehabilitation Center and then to prison.
It was a coincidence, or was it?
He was an excellent student.
He had gotten third place in his year during that particular exam and was in a good mood.
It happened to be a weekend, and he had gone to an internet cafe.
There, he started chatting with two men who were playing the same game as him.
After a while, they became friends.
After that, they had asked him out for lunch and even said they would recommend a girlfriend to him.
Although he didn’t accept the invitation, they got along pretty well.
It happened that he got off school early that day, so they went to the bar together.
They had some drinks and sang.
Then, he started feeling odd.
He was extremely excited.
He later found out that they had secretly given him that thing called “Blue Fantasy.”
He had no idea how much one of those costs.
He had thought it was something like Ecstasy and would not have any lasting effect.
Who knew he would get addicted after just one pill and needed more pills every day after that.
The weird thing was, they gave him the pills without charging him anything!
It was only after he got rid of his addiction that he realized that one pill, just the cost of one Blue Fantasy was enough to render one speechless.
Five hundred!
Five hundred yuan was how much one little Blue Fantasy pill costs!
The price was astronomical!
No matter how he looked at it, the “brothers” that he befriended didn’t look rich.
What made them give him such an expensive thing?
They just liked the way he looked?
No one would believe that.
He had no money, no power, and was just a poor student.
The only thing he was proud of was his sister.
He heard that his sister was working under Young Master Hong Dali.
She seemed to be doing well and would send money home regularly.
Could it be their target was actually his sister?
No, that was impossible.
If their target were his sister, they would not have put in so much effort.
Could their target be...
Young Master Hong Dali from the Hong Family?
It was just a fleeting thought, but it was enough to make Ling Mufeng break out in cold sweat.
That must be it.
It must be so!
These people had gone through a lot of trouble to entrap him.
Ling Mufeng didn’t dare to call anyone.
If his sister had found out about this matter, the outcome would be...
Moreover, if it affected Young Master Hong Dali...
A cold voice from the cell interrupted his thoughts.
“Hey you, the new kid, go get some water for me to wash my feed.
Go quickly, don’t irk me, or I will peel your skin!”
As Ling Mufeng heard the voice, he sighed and stood up slowly.
Before he could react, he felt a strong, forceful kick on his back.
Ling Mufeng fell to the ground as a bearded prisoner growled.
“Brat, quit dilly-dallying.
Brother Ying instructed you to fetch water to wash his feet.
Do you want to die?
Go quickly!”
Ling Mufeng gritted his teeth and picked himself off the ground.
He bore the pain on his back and picked up the container to go fetch water.
He got the water and was ready to sneak a rest when the prison guard called out, “Who is Ling Mufeng?
Come quickly, you have a visitor.”
Ling Mufeng’s hand trembled.
“I have a visitor?
Could it be...”
“Young Master Dali, we are here.
Please alight.” Driver Wang Mingyu parked the car, and Hong Dali alighted the car with Tang Muxin.
Hong Dali looked at the exterior walls of the prison.
It was almost four meters high topped with barbed wire.
He sniffed and said, “Tianjing West City Prison.
These people have some guts to imprison my man here.
They are digging their own graves.
Furthermore, Xiaoyi has been a fantastic butler.”
Tang Muxin huffed.
“That’s right.
Dali, I fully support you this time.
Show them what you’re capable of!
We are not afraid to make this into a big matter!”
“That goes without saying, let’s go!” Hong Dali snapped his fingers, and Tang Muxin followed him along with the eight lackeys.
The way in was clear without any obstructions.
Tang Muxin came from quite an influential family herself, and Hong Dali’s background was even more impressive.
Although they were both young, they had quite a bit of clout.
The prison police were all quick-witted.
Although they didn’t know Hong Dali and Tang Muxin, they could tell from their fancy car that they couldn’t afford to offend them.
From the moment they alighted the car, one of the guards had already called out, “Are you here to visit someone...
Or should I give the Prison Warden a call?”
“We’ll make our way in ourselves.
Tip them!” Hong Dali waved them away.
“Two thousand each.”
The lackey standing behind Hong Dali took out a stack of cash, and a female lackey took out the cash counting machine.Swish swish swishand everyone soon got their two thousand yuan...
There was disbelief on the faces of most of the prison guards.
“Quick, hit me.
I need to know if I’m dreaming.
Two thousand yuan!
That’s almost two month’s worth of salary!” “Yes, yes.
That must be the God of Fortune!” “Quickly, serve them well!”
It was a fact that money made the world go around.
Tipping anyone they met, regardless of who they were, cleared the path for all future dealings.
The group of prison guards was servile and respectful, as though they were meeting the head of the country.
“Aiyo, this Young Master is so generous.
Are you looking for our Prison Warden?
Let me bring you to him.
This way please, this way!”
With a whole group of prison guards leading the way, Hong Dali and his entourage arrived at the foot of the building where the Prison Warden was.
On their way there, anyone who had worked there for more than a while would greet the group from afar.
Hong Dali said the same thing whenever they met anyone.
“Tip them, two thousand!” The male lackeys would then approach them with the money.
Just like that, by rewarding everyone along the way, Hong Dali had gained a group of loyal fans.
There were even a few that shouted: “Chuichui, I love you.” It was obvious they were fans ofUnexpectedly!.
Tang Muxin chuckled.
“You’re like the child spreading the wealth.
You seem popular no matter where you go.” The little lass’ vanity was fully contented.
The way she looked at Hong Dali was much friendlier.
Hong Dali was obviously in a good mood.
Laughing, he said, “Of course.
I’m the super prodigal son.
We must look good no matter where we go!”
They soon arrived at the Prison Warden’s office.
They had agreed that he would act like a pretentious snob.
In order to play the part well, Hong Dali didn’t even bother knocking on the door.
He kicked the door opened, smiling as he walked in.
It was almost noon, and the Prison Warden was ready to take a nap.
“Which brat doesn’t know how to knock...” He was shocked by the commotion and accidentally blurted out “brat.” When he came to his senses, he had cold sweat on his head and face.
He quickly jumped up from the sofa and smiled as he moved forward.
“It’s Young Master Dali and Miss Tang Muxin.
Aiya, why didn’t you call in advance so I could welcome you personally.” The warden’s words made Hong Dali sure that the warden was aware of something.
He just didn’t expect Hong Dali to be here so soon.
If someone who knew the Prison Warden personally was present, they would be so shocked their jaw would drop.
The West City Prison Prison Warden was an influential man.
He might not be a section chief or anything, but he was known to be a tough man to handle.
Any prisoner that was sent to this prison would be completely oppressed by him.
From simple hooligans to powerful mafia bosses, they all had to obey him.
However. at this moment, Prison Warden Cao Jianrong, whom everyone viewed as an impassable man, was acting completely submissive in front of Hong Dali, speaking extremely carefully.
No one would believe if the news got out.
It was understandable, though.
As descendants of a founding father of the country, the Hong Family had the power to command the wind and the rain in Tianjing City.
The fact that Hong Weiguo doted on his son, Hong Dali, was known to everyone in Tianjing City.
Hong Weiguo even spent a huge sum of money to transport a cruise ship to a mountain.
No matter how much influence Cao Jianrong had, it was limited to the prison and couldn’t be compared to Hong Dali.
They were giving their all today, so Hong Dali didn’t hold back either.
He sat on Prison Warden Cao Jianrong’s leather chair, made a few turns, and laughed as he said, “This is quite comfortable.
I say, Prison Warden Cao, there is someone whom I wonder if he’s here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - How to Become a Prodigal
paragraphs: Prison Warden Cao Jianrong greeted Hong Dali politely and said with a smile, “Young Master Dali, may I know the name of the person you are looking for? I will ask him to come over.”
“En, the inmate is called Ling Mofeng. The one visiting is called Ling Xiaoyi. Help me check it out.” Hong Dali said.
Cao Jianrong nodded his head politely and took out a can of Longjing Tea from under his desk. He said, “Young Master Dali, please have some tea first while I check things out.”
Hong Dali waved his hand and said, “Tip him, 5000.” The male lackey immediately whipped out a stack of money and counted it carefully.

“Ling Mufeng?” Cao Jianrong muttered the name under his breath, wondering, “I have not heard of such a person coming into prison the past few days. Young Master Dali, please wait a while as I go and ask around.”
After saying that, Cao Jianrong jogged outside the room and dialed a number.

“Oh, oh, ah, ah, what, bastard!” After scolding the person on the other side of the call, he ran back quickly and reported to Hong Dali with his forehead full of cold sweat, “Young... Young Master Dali, there is indeed such a person. I didn’t know of such a situation before. Someone took him to Cell 205 without informing me...”
After saying his piece, Cao Jianrong felt that he didn’t have enough energy left in him to even stand.
If it were someone else, he could have lied his way through it.

However, Ling Mufeng was actually a person Hong Dali wanted to see. This had evolved into a big problem. At this time, Cao Jianrong had silently condemned the bastard who had hidden such news from him to a death sentence. After Young Master Dali left, he would immediately fire the person. Otherwise, everyone in the prison might suffer!
That was Cell 205, a room where only prisoners sentenced for more than 20 years were kept. Which retard actually dared to send him there?!

Although Hong Dali was not aware of this prison’s happenings, he could feel the unusual atmosphere. He said, “Which bastard actually dared to do such a thing. Cell 205... Hehe, this cell is definitely not simple, right? Call that person to see me within five minutes. Otherwise, you know what will happen.”
Tang Muxin also said, “Fortunately, we came in time. Otherwise, Sister Xiaoyi would definitely be sad!”

Listening to Hong Dali’s tone, he knew that Hong Dali was very angry now, and the consequences were very serious! Cao Jianrong ran out desperately as if his life depended on it. After a while, a roar could be heard along the corridor. “Liu Yu, you bastard, come see me right now! Within five minutes!”
Five minutes seemed neither too long nor too short.
However, it was obvious that no one dared to wait for their punishments just like that.

So, in less than three minutes, a frightened and pale-faced Liu Yu was brought into the prison office. The Prison Warden, Cao Jianrong, who was supposed to be sitting on the leather swivel chair, stood like a student waiting to get scolded by his teacher at the side, instead.

Hong Dali looked at the scared Liu Yu in front of him and said, “I will give you three minutes, you better explain everything that happened to me. Otherwise, tell your family to prepare for your funeral. Don’t think that I’m merely scaring you. I dare to do what I say.”
Since he decided to play big today, Hong Dali naturally didn’t bother to be polite.
Being a good person was difficult, but being an evil person was easy.

After listening to Hong Dali’s words, Liu Yu kneeled down with a loudpu tongsound. He said with his face full of tears, “Young Master Dali, Young Master Dali, please spare me! I really didn’t know that he was your friend, Young Master Dali! I’m still young. I don’t want to die!” When he came, he already knew that he was about to face Hong Dali, the only son of Hong Family’s Hong Weiguo. He was definitely a character that he couldn’t afford to offend!
Hong Dali narrowed his eyes and said, “Don’t bother talking about useless nonsense. You know very well what I want to know.”

Liu Yu’s whole body seemed to soften and fell on the ground, and he said while crying, “I will speak! I will speak! Four days ago, when I just got off work, I received a call from Bighead from Cabinet Society. He told me to take care of a person named Ling Mufeng. He didn’t say anything about the specific reasons, and neither did I dare to ask. Just after the call was over, I received a 10,000 yuan gift. I’m lying, really! I’m an insignificant person. The Cabinet Society’s Bighead is the kind of person I can’t afford to offend. So, I secretly arranged Ling Mufeng into Cell 205. I swear I didn’t do anything other than that Young Master Dali!”
“Cabinet Society... Bighead...” Hong Dali whipped out his phone. “Uncle Wang, help me get information on the Cabinet Society!”
Driver Wang Mingyu said, “Okay, please wait a while, Young Master.”

Soon, Wang Mingyu called back. “The Cabinet Society is a medium sized gang located at the inner road of Tianjing City. Their influence and power is average and does not come into conflict with us normally.”
Hong Dali then asked, “Who are they close to? These people would not cause trouble for Xiaoyi’s younger brother for no reason, right?”
“That’s indeed true,” Wang Mingyu thought for a while and said, “You can settle the things there first Young Master, I will get someone to find out more about this.”
“Alright.”
Hanging up the phone, Hong Dali smiled and said, “It seems that this time, we are gonna kick up a huge fuss...”
Liu Yu was scared to death, while the other people were scared stiff.

With such a thing happening under their supervision, let alone Liu Yu, the others would definitely not meet with a good end. Cao Jianrong had long cursed the Liu Yu and his ancestors over and over again in his heart for 18 times. If it weren’t for Hong Dali still being there, he even wanted to rush forward to kick him.

Standing up, Hong Dali walked toward to Liu Yu and looked at the young man who was soft on the ground. He took two hundred dollars from his lackey’s wallet and threw it to the ground. “Your medical expenses.”
“Medical expenses?” Liu Yu was obviously dumbfounded.
“En.” Hong Dali twitched his nose. “Take him out and break his legs.”

Soon after, three male lackeys stepped forward, smirked, and stuffed the money into Liu Yu’s clothes. Then, they grabbed his arm and dragged him out. Soon after, a deafening cry could be heard outside.

Speaking of which, if one wanted to be a qualified prodigal, one would need to be decisive to kill. Otherwise, if one were to let his lackeys experience trouble ever so often, then how can one squander to his heart’s content?
Therefore, Hong Dali felt that his decision was really necessary today. Today’s operational code of action was called “How to become a prodigal?”

Now that things had already been roughly settled, Hong Dali looked towards Cao Jianrong, who was standing at the side and waiting for his scolding. He said, “Alright, don’t put on a face as if you have been struck by thunder. What has happened today was not your fault. Let’s go, take me to see him. I wonder how he is doing now.”
Upon hearing this, Cao Jianrong’s body started to tremble.
Liu Yu, this bastard, actually arranged Ling Mufeng into Cell 205 and put him together with a bunch of heavy offenders.

The current Cao Jianrong could only seek help from the gods in heaven, hoping that Ling Mufeng was not mistreated too badly. Otherwise, he didn’t know what Young Master Dali would do to them. If the worst were to happen, no one could protect him anymore.
Thinking of this, Cao Jianrong quickly asked, “Young Master Dali, the environment in the cell is not that good. Why not let me ask someone to invite him out?”
Hong Dali waved his hand. “No need for that. I’m curious about the situation in Cell 205.”
Seeing that Hong Dali was adamant on going, Cao Jianrong didn’t dare to object.
Hong Dali was the master, it was better if they followed whatever he said. Otherwise, their ends would be miserable.

Not even two steps out of the prison office, a shadow rushed towards Hong Dali. It was Ling Xiaoyi. When Ling Xiaoyi saw Hong Dali, she suddenly burst into tears. She said while crying, “Young Master, I, my brother, he... wu wu wu...”
“It’s okay, you see, aren’t I here for this matter?” Hong Dali took Ling Xiaoyi by her hand and comforted her. “Don’t worry, there is me here. Everything will be fine.”
Tang Muxin also smiled at the side. “Sister Xiaoyi, it will be alright. Hong Dali is very powerful!”
“But Young Master’s coming of age ceremony...” Ling Xiaoyi was still a little worried. “The time is reaching soon. What do we do about it?”
“We will need to solve this quickly.” Hong Dali waved his hands. “Let’s go!”
They quickly entered the building where the inmates were kept.

The first floor was still relatively normal as a whole. The prisoners here were generally not too evil, so the atmosphere was relatively better. Of course, this was only relative to the floors above. The floorplan for this building had the rooms on each side of the passageway. Therefore, the light from the corridor was obviously insufficient and had to be turned on during the day. The quality of the lights was not bad, at least the environment didn’t look too gloomy.
However, on the second floor, it was completely different.

The lights were flashing, and the voltage was not so stable. The electric lights flickered from time to time, just like how candlelight behaved when blown by the wind. It was like a lantern on the road to the netherworld, causing those walking by to feel scared.
The second floor was the floor where the heavy criminals were held. Most of them were mobs, those that often injured or killed others.
At least, Liu Yu didn’t go too far. If Ling Mufeng was sent to the third floor of the prison for imprisonment, then his end would not be as simple as breaking two legs.
Every five meters on either side of the walkway was an ice-cold iron gate. The iron gate was equipped with a grille hole for the prison guard to check the situation inside the cell.
The group of people walked through the alley.

From time to time, some inmates squatting near the iron gate grille saw the Prison Warden Cao Jianrong. They would suddenly laugh and say with hoarse voices, “Hello Warden Cao, when can you let us out?”

Cao Jianrong was in a very bad mood. This time, he was about to explode in anger. But then, he looked at Hong Dali, who was walking in front of him, endured and said, “We will talk about it next time.”

The prisoner was surprised. “What happened to Warden Cao today? Why is he so easy to talk with today?” Another said, “Hey, look quickly, that Young Master is so powerful, he has so many beautiful girls following him!” The third person was filled with envy. “Seriously, life is so unfair. Don’t look at them. The more you look, the more troubled you become, and the more you can’t sleep.”
Some people even shouted, “Warden Cao, can you help bring in a cigarette? When my family comes, I promise to ask them to pay you back ten times!”
Who knew that after Hong Dali heard this, he suddenly stopped. After he thought about it, he quickly ordered his lackeys. “Buy ten cigarettes, it will be useful later.”

The quality of the lights was not bad, at least the environment didn’t look too gloomy.
However, on the second floor, it was completely different.
The lights were flashing, and the voltage was not so stable.
The electric lights flickered from time to time, just like how candlelight behaved when blown by the wind.
It was like a lantern on the road to the netherworld, causing those walking by to feel scared.
The second floor was the floor where the heavy criminals were held.
Most of them were mobs, those that often injured or killed others.
At least, Liu Yu didn’t go too far.
If Ling Mufeng was sent to the third floor of the prison for imprisonment, then his end would not be as simple as breaking two legs.
Every five meters on either side of the walkway was an ice-cold iron gate.
The iron gate was equipped with a grille hole for the prison guard to check the situation inside the cell.
The group of people walked through the alley.
From time to time, some inmates squatting near the iron gate grille saw the Prison Warden Cao Jianrong.
They would suddenly laugh and say with hoarse voices, “Hello Warden Cao, when can you let us out?”
Cao Jianrong was in a very bad mood.
This time, he was about to explode in anger.
But then, he looked at Hong Dali, who was walking in front of him, endured and said, “We will talk about it next time.”
The prisoner was surprised.
“What happened to Warden Cao today?
Why is he so easy to talk with today?” Another said, “Hey, look quickly, that Young Master is so powerful, he has so many beautiful girls following him!” The third person was filled with envy.
“Seriously, life is so unfair.
Don’t look at them.
The more you look, the more troubled you become, and the more you can’t sleep.”
Some people even shouted, “Warden Cao, can you help bring in a cigarette?
When my family comes, I promise to ask them to pay you back ten times!”
Who knew that after Hong Dali heard this, he suddenly stopped.
After he thought about it, he quickly ordered his lackeys.
“Buy ten cigarettes, it will be useful later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - I Didn’t See Anything
paragraphs: Hearing Hong Dali’s instructions, the male lackey ran out like a gust of wind. In just a few minutes, he carried a big black plastic bag with at least 20 cartons of cigarettes inside and ran back. Just a quick look at the packaging and one would know that it was all genuine goods.

“Not bad,” Hong Dali said with a dazzling smile. “Keen senses and fast in acting.” Then he said, “Take all the boxes out from the carton.” Then a group of people started to remove the cigarettes in front of the prisoners.
After a carton was emptied, Hong Dali picked up a box of cigarettes and threw them out. He smiled and said, “Take it, I will need you to do something for me later.”

The prisoner suddenly had his eyes straight and held the cigarette tightly in his hands like a professional pitcher holding a baseball. He felt as if he had won a five million lottery, and his eyes filled with indescribable ecstasy and satisfaction.

With such an example in front of them, the prisoners in the other cells started making earth-shattering noises, squeezing each other to get near the door. It seemed as if they desperately wanted to get out and kill their most hated enemy.
Hong Dali laughed and began to throw boxes of cigarettes away. After throwing more than half of them out, he then said, “Help me do something later.”
After hearing the God of Fortune issue an order, the prisoners directly kneeled down and said, “If Young Master needs help in anything, please tell us. We will do it no matter what!”
Cells deeper into the passageway were empty. Thus, there was no much disturbance in their journey. Hong Dali and his party soon came to cell 205.
This was a single cell located at the end of the passageway.
As the Prison Warden of this prison, Cao Jianrong naturally understood what a place cell 205 was.

It could be said that this was the cell with the most savage and cruel prisoners on the second floor. They all followed the law of the jungle. Only the fiercest and most cruel person could become the boss of cell 205, and even the boss of the second floor. Everyone had to obey what the boss said.

Standing at the entrance of cell 205, Prison Warden Cao carefully said, “Young Master, allow me to call people to go in and ask Ling Mufeng to come out. I don’t want to dampen your mood.” After reaching here, Cao Jianrong felt as if he had reached the gate of hell. However, he could only muster up his courage and open the gate, as if making his last desperate stand.
Hong Dali didn’t care about Cao Jianrong’s words. He pulled him to the side and said, “Since we are already here, how could we not go in and explore?”
Cold sweat started to form on Cao Jianrong’s forehead. He desperately retreated to a corner, with his body trembling in fear, afraid to voice out anything anymore.
In fact, it couldn’t be blamed on Cao Jianrong for being so timid.
Cell 205 was different from normal cells. Only the fiercest and most cruel prisoners were held inside, partly due to the prison’s rules.

The first floor generally held thieves who did not make such big offenses and were usually released after around ten days. Thus, the first floor was the closest to the exit, making it more convenient for the prisoners to be sent in and released.

The second floor was completely different. It mainly kept inmates that were imprisoned for a period between one to ten years. To have been sentenced to such a long period, which one of them did not have blood in their hands? Fighting was thus a daily affair for those kept on the second floor.
Those in cell 205 were the ones sentenced the longest in the entire second floor. Every single one of them inside was dangerous and had a part in bloody crimes at least once in their life.
For Ling Mufeng to be sent into such a cell, one could imagine his fate.

As for those on the third floor, most of them were prisoners sentenced for more than ten years. Even the time of release was different from the prisoners below. If they were lucky, they could survive and walk out of prison. However, most of them did not live to see the daylight outside of prison. On the third floor, it was a common practice for them to fight until death. It was a place where only the fittest survived.
However, what Hong Dali was most worried about was not whether or not Ling Mufeng was bullied in the cell.
After entering cell 205, getting bullied was a small matter that didn’t even need to be mentioned.
What Hong Dali was most worried about was the thirst and desire of the inmates to release themselves after being kept inside for so long.

Not to say the presence of a woman, even if it were the picture of a woman, the prisoners in the cell would not mind killing a person for it. He was scared that if Ling Mufeng looked girly, he would be a target for violation and release. If that were to happen, it would certainly leave a scar in his heart.
Hong Dali took in a deep breath and said, “Alright, open the door.”
“O... Okay...” Cao Jianrong opened the door unwillingly and led the way with his few guards.
Hong Dali brought along Tang Muxin and his lackeys and headed in.

Compared with other cells, cell 205 was nearly double in size. The room was ten meters long, eight meters wide, and four meters high. The ambiance was relatively dark. Of course, part of this was due to the prisoners. A prison had to have such an environment.

There were a total of 16 iron bunk beds in the room, all of which were welded to the wall. It was difficult for even a muscular hunk to move the bed. This was to avoid the escalation of a fight into a murder case.

The central area of the cell could be considered quite spacious. An air vent was located in the ceiling with iron bars welded on the inside. A bathroom was located in the corner. Although the toilet had a flush, it still smelled bad.

But it was also due to this that the bathroom became one of the root causes of frequent turmoil here. It was no exaggeration to say that if one did not mix well here, going to the toilet was going to be a big problem.
One could imagine someone kicking in the bathroom while another was doing his big business. What a scene it would be.
At this time, there were more than 20 prisoners in the cell sitting in the middle of the open space. Among them, four of them were playing poker, and about fifteen prisoners were applauding around.

The youngest person outside was busy cleaning up the cell. His height was about 1.78m. He had beautiful eyebrows, looked handsome, and his skin could be said to be flawlessly white. Without thinking, he should be Xiaoyi’s little brother, Ling Mufeng.

However, the relatively handsome young man was currently wearing a prison uniform. His exposed skin was covered with purple-black bruises. His nose was red and swollen, eyes black and blue, and the corners of his mouth were already torn, with dried blood stains near his mouth. As for his hair, it had already been shaved, leaving about five millimeters of baby hair.
Hong Dali nodded his head. At least, he still seemed pretty good and masculine and would not be regarded as a sissy by the inmates. His purity should have been kept.
Seeing his brother again, Ling Xiaoyi couldn’t help but start crying.
Hong Dali shook his head silently. No wonder she had cried like this. Fortunately, they had come early. Otherwise, Ling Mufeng would have suffered much more than this.
With such a sudden influx of people in cell 205, everyone instantly turned their attention to Hong Dali, guessing what his intentions were.
When Ling Mufeng saw such a scene, especially that the Prison Warden and his sister were there, he decisively ran towards them. The male lackeys then surrounded him in an effort to protect him.

At this time, a muscular man in the crowd who had an eagle tattoo on his arm stood up and looked at Hong Dali. He smiled and said, “Hey, younger brother, what are you here for? Are you here to visit your relatives?”
“En, I’m indeed here to visit my relative.” Hong Dali smilingly said, “How may I address this big brother?”

“Easy, calling me Old Eagle is fine.” Although he said this, he was thinking otherwise in his heart. This is cell 205.Someone without a good background would not be able to enter so easily, much less have the Prison Warden escorting him. Who is this guy? Does he have some relation to the young man called Ling Mufeng?
Hong Dali didn’t bother to reply to him but turned towards Ling Mufeng and asked: “Is your virginity still there?”
Ling Mufeng suddenly jerked up and unconsciously touched his butt before nodding his head hurriedly.

Old Eagle and the others suddenly quietened down before bursting out into laughter. Old Eagle held his belly and loudly laughed. “Hahahaha, did you hear him? This kid actually asked if his virginity was still there, hahaha! It turns out you are actually visiting him, but still, is it me or is it that the world has changed too fast, hahaha!”
Everyone laughed extremely arrogantly. Cao Jianrong was preparing to give them a warning to teach them a lesson, but Hong Dali immediately turned around and left. “Hey, let’s go out and talk.”
“Young Master Dali, that’s it?” Cao Jianrong asked.
“Of course not.” After exiting cell 205, Hong Dali turned towards Ling Mufeng. “Do you still remember who beat you up inside?”
“All of them did.” Ling Mufeng gritted his teeth and said, “Even when I went the toilet, I didn’t have any peace.”
“That’s simple.” Hong Dali went back and shouted, “Brothers, come out to help me!”
All the prisoners outside replied loudly: “Young Master, please instruct us!”

Hong Dali twitched his nose before smiling. “Do you see that cell? I will let everyone go in later. Help me beat them up! Don’t let anyone go off unhurt! Everyone who acts will get a thousand. It’s up to you to decide how you want to spend the money!”

To release the prisoners privately when it was not the official time to do so would land them in punishment. However, at this moment, Hong Dali didn’t even hesitate to ask his lackeys to release the prisoners. Anyway, the situation had already escalated to such a point. Even if anything were to happen, Hong Dali would cover for him. What was there to hesitate about?

After the door of the first cell was opened, a muscular man with a height of nearly 1.9 meters, bald head, a “loyal” word on the neck, thick eyebrows, and thick lips appeared. He should be the leader of all of the people here.
Hong Dali was satisfied with his body build and thus asked, “How may I address this big brother here?”
The muscular man replied, “I’m called Cheng Quandao. Young Master can just call me Xiao Dao.”
“En, not bad,” Hong Dali stepped forward and touched his muscles, “Not bad, your muscles are firm enough. Tip him, 2000!”

Three male lackeys immediately stepped forward and counted 2000 before passing it to Xiao Dao. The rest of the prisoners all had 1000. The prisoners were all unprecedentedly obedient. They all queued to receive the money before standing at the side quietly awaiting further orders. After everyone had their share of the money, Hong Dali twitched his nose and shouted, “Brothers, let’s do it!”
A thousand, this was an astronomical sum in the prison. The prisoners were all hyped up and thrilled, to the point where their faces even turned red in excitement.
“Open the door.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers and ordered, “Just don’t beat them to death.”
Cao Jianrong let loose a sigh of relief and once again opened the door to cell 205.
Then, the group of prisoners screamed and rushed in. Cao Jianrong’s timid little heart almost jumped out of his chest.Oh, heavens, I didn’t see anything. I didn’t see anything.
