chapters.title: Chapter 167 - Follow Me and You Will Not Be Mistreated
paragraphs: At the same time, outside of the prison, driver Wang Mingyu received a call from Hong Weiguo.

“Mingyu, what are you doing? Why haven’t you come back? It’s already eight o’clock.” Hong Weiguo’s voice on the phone was a little anxious. “It’s extremely disrespectful to the guests if the coming of age ceremony is delayed. Anything happened to Dali?”

Hong Weiguo doted on Hong Dali and was thus reluctant to talk directly with him. Thus, he had to pass the message through Wang Mingyu, the driver. This caused Wang Mingyu to be rather gloomy. He could only listen to Hong Weiguo’s scolding and even plead for Hong Dali. “Master, it’s like this. Ling Xiaoyi’s younger brother, Ling Mufeng, was tricked by others. He was secretly fed ‘Blue Fantasy’ and is now in the Tianjing West City Prison. The Young Master has already gone in to solve it. I couldn’t stop him from doing so.”

“Someone wants to deal with Hong Dali’s lackeys?” Hong Weiguo was a clever person. Within a few seconds, he had already figured out the sequence of events. “It looks like someone purposely did so to make Dali arrive late for the ceremony. It’s certainly a good plan.”

“Yes, Master.” Wang Mingyu also expressed his anger. “If Young Master did not bother to help his lackey, it would inevitably lead to his lackeys feeling betrayed. But if he did go help, like what he is doing now, he would definitely be late. It’s hard to deal with the matter either ways. But Master,” Wang Mingyu said. “I, however, am more inclined to Dali helping Xiaoyi. And he has to deal with it in the most beautiful manner. Otherwise, such things will happen ever so often from now on, and it will be very troublesome for him.”

“En, it looks like he will be late. Let’s do it like this,” Hong Weiguo said. “I will settle the guests down first. On your side, do not delay and settle the matter as quickly as possible. Once Dali is done, contact me immediately. It’s best if this matter is settled beautifully once and for all. At least, no one will dare to touch Dali’s lackeys after this. As to how Dali wants to settle this, we will leave it up to him. Hehe, a tiger father will not beget a dog son. Since they dared to underestimate my son, I will certainly not let them go easily!”
Inside Tianjing West City Prison, in an empty cell.
“What’s your name again?” Hong Dali sat in a simple chair and looked at Ling Mufeng in front of him. “I heard about you before from Xiaoyi, but I don’t really remember your name.”

“I’m called Ling Mufeng.” Now that he finally saw hope, Ling Mufeng gradually regained his original composure. “You’re Young Master Dali, right? My sister has told me about you, but I have never had the chance to see you.” ”
“En, aren’t you seeing me now?” Hong Dali said with a grin. “Let me ask you, Mufeng. How did you end up getting into contact with Blue Fantasy? That’s the name, right?”

When Dali mentioned this matter, Ling Mufeng gnashed his teeth and said, “Originally, I was just studying by myself, and my results were not bad after the exams. After that, some people somehow wanted to get close to me. They were also very kind to me and always asked me to eat with them, saying that they would like to introduce a girlfriend to me. I didn’t think too much at that time, and thought it was just another girl who requested them to help ask me out...”

After he said this, Hong Dali understood. “En, you’re indeed quite handsome. You have a lot of girls chasing after you in school, right? You treated them as third parties requested by a girl to ask you out as she was embarrassed to do so, right?”

“En, that’s what I thought then.” Ling Mufeng then said fiercely, “At that time, they actually did ask about my opinion of a certain girl in my school. Since they were nice and friendly to me, I felt that it would not be nice if I just ignored them. After a while of hanging out together, we got familiar with each other. Then came Friday, where they asked me to go out to play with them after school. And you know the rest of the story. It was that day that I was tricked into taking in such a drug.”
To put it simply, all this happened because Ling Mufeng was still new to how society worked.

Ling Mufeng continued, “In the beginning, I thought it was just a small pill worth ten dollars or so and didn’t take it seriously. However, after a while, I found that I couldn’t stop taking it. So I went to find them twice and ended up getting caught. It was only after I reached here that I realized what had happened.”

Ling Mufeng didn’t need to continue the story for Hong Dali to know what had happened. It was just a case where Ling Mufeng was deceived into starting drugs and then caught by the police after getting tipped off by someone. This would then cause Dali to be diverted away during his coming of age ceremony.
It seemed that the real mastermind had set up a huge web targeting himself.

Ling Mufeng was just a small prawn in the plan, but he had Ling Xiaoyi behind him. As Ling Xiaoyi was one of his most capable assistants, Hong Dali would definitely help Ling Xiaoyi. In this aspect, the opposition had obviously done their research.
But the main question was: Who was the mastermind? It was too hard to guess as the field was too wide.

As Hong Dali thought up to here, Ling Mufeng’s body started to tremble uncontrollably. At first, there were only faint symptoms, but it didn’t take long before his whole body became unstable. He started to take in deep breaths of air, and his lips trembled soon after. Even his eyes turned dull.
It was “Blue Fantasy’s” effects. It was starting to kick in again.
“Dali, what should we do?!” After seeing this, Tang Muxin also guessed that it was due to drug addiction. She said in a hurry, “Dali, quickly think about what to do!”
Ling Xiaoyi had long cried till her clothes were full of tears. She felt that her heart was torn when she saw her brother end up in such a state.

Hong Dali narrowed his eyes and stood in front of Ling Mufeng. He carefully observed his reaction before saying, “You guys take a look at how this thing looks like. Make sure that I do not find any of you taking in such things. If I were to catch anyone doing drugs, don’t blame me for not being polite.”
When everyone saw how the usually happy-go-lucky Hong Dali became so stern, the atmosphere in the room immediately became oppressive.

Looking at the current Ling Mufeng, Hong Dali’s heart also felt awkward. When he was on Earth, he had a close friend in college. However, that friend of his became addicted to a drug called “Ice” and, in less than a year, became as thin as a bamboo. Even his appearance became ghost-like. After Hong Dali thought about it, he started to shiver. Thus, he hated such a thing to his bones.
“It’s... it’s so uncomfortable...” Ling Mufeng squatted down, with drops of sweat dripping down from his forehead. His mouth kept muttering a few messy words that no one could understand.

In the beginning, he was able to restrain himself. But soon, Ling Mufeng began to twitch and tremble, and even his eyeballs started to flip around. As if he were experiencing a nightmare, he started muttering, “Pill... give me the pill...”

At this time, Ling Mufeng was starting to lose consciousness. He started to behave like a blind fly in the room. He would grab and throw anything he saw. He felt dizzy, hot, and had difficulty breathing. He felt as if he were a living ghost.
Ling Xiaoyi covered her mouth with her hands and crying uncontrollably.
The others couldn’t even bear to look straight at him.

At this time, Ling Mufeng had almost lost his mind. He grabbed Hong Dali’s clothes and shouted, “Give me the pill! Give me the pill!” Seeing him attack Hong Dali, the three male lackeys immediately rushed forward and pulled him away.
Hong Dali suddenly stepped forward and grabbed Ling Mufeng’s collar. He shook him twice and asked, “Do you still remember your name?”
“Ling... Ling Mufeng...”

Hong vigorously snorted and said loudly, “Do you want to change back to a normal person in the future, or do you want to live on this thing for the rest of your life? Answer me! Ling Mufeng, answer me!”
Ling Mufeng’s face was full of tears and said, crying, “I want to be a normal person, I want to be a normal person.”

Hong Dali laughed. “Good! Hahahaha! Yes, good!” He said while releasing Ling Mufeng’s collar. He then probed his pocket and quickly found a bank card which he threw on the table. He then said, “I will give you two choices now! This is 500,000! If you take this card now, I will never ask you to return this money, and you can buy as many pills as you want with it! But in the future, you will never be able to change back to a normal person. The other way is for you to hang on as if your life depends on it and live a normal life in the future, but you will not get this 500,000.”
While speaking, Hong Dali slammed the table ferociously and shouted, “Ling Mufeng, choose now!”
Ling Mufeng stared at the card on the table, feeling hesitant.
If he took this card, a card with a full 500,000 yuan, it would be enough for him to buy a lot of pills. However, he would never be able to experience the life of a normal person ever again.
If he didn’t take it, he might be able to live the life of a normal person, but he would have to live in pain for a long while.
How should he choose?
To the current Ling Mufeng, who was experiencing the effects of drug addiction, this was a very difficult choice.
The angel and devil in his head started a tough fight.

With trembling hands, Ling Mufeng couldn’t help himself but stretch a hand for the card on the table. However, halfway there, he gritted his teeth and gave a heartbreaking scream, then fiercely punched himself hard, forcing himself to take two steps back, with his forehead full of sweat.
Hong Dali looked at Ling Mufeng’s current appearance and gave him a boost. “Come on! If you are to make it through this time, there is hope for recovery!”

Ling Mufeng’s body started squirming around on the ground. His face filled with cold sweat, and his lips had turned white. He stared at Hong Dali’s eyes and weakly said, “Young... Young Master Dali... please help me... I am afraid... I can’t stand it... Young Master Dali...”

Hong Dali used his eyes to instruct a male lackey. The male lackey immediately understood what Hong Dali wanted and thus slapped the back of Ling Mufeng’s head hard. This slap caused white foam to flow out of Ling Mufeng’s mouth, but he quickly fainted and lost consciousness.
This was the only method that could help Ling Mufeng restrain the drug addiction and, at the same time, not cause too much harm to his body.
After waiting for a while, Ling Mufeng woke up and wiped the blood off his mouth before slowly standing up.

“Young Master Dali... Thank you... Thank you...” Ling Mufeng’s eyes became brighter than ever. Although he was still weak, he tried his best to smile to Hong Dali and said, “I feel... from when I was born... till now... I had never once been... like today, so manly...”
Hong Dali laughed and hugged Ling Mufeng, saying, “Good! Have you chosen?”
Ling Mufeng firmly nodded. “I have chosen! Even if I have to suffer the greatest hardship, I want to be a normal person! A normal person who can live well! For my sister, for my parents!”
Hong Dali patted Ling Mufeng’s back and said, “Rest assured. Follow me, and you will not be mistreated.”
Witnessing this scene, Ling Xiaoyi, Tang Muxin, and the five female lackeys started crying uncontrollably.
It was the greatest choice to have followed Young Master in this life!

“En, you’re indeed quite handsome.

You treated them as third parties requested by a girl to ask you out as she was embarrassed to do so, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - Young Masters Wrath
paragraphs: After the two sat down properly, Ling Mufeng asked, “Young Master Dali, when will I get out? I have to go back to class as I don’t want my parents to worry about me. I haven’t called them for several days.”

Seeing that he finally returned to normal, Hong Dali nodded with satisfaction and smiled. “Okay! I will get you out in a few days. You should prepare for it, I will give you seven days. Remember to withstand your drug addiction. If you can’t pass this hurdle and continue to take in such things when you get out, even the gods can’t save you at that time. Do you understand?”
Ling Mufeng replied, “I understand! Even if I were to lose my life, I will never touch that thing again!”

“En, that’s the right mentality.” Hong Dali directly threw the card to Ling Mufeng. “Keep this card, go back to school and study hard. Remember, temptation always exists, but everything you choose is up to yourself. If you are sand, even if I were a brick, you would still be unable to build a house. Do you understand?”
Ling Mufeng’s eyes brightened and said, “I understand, Young Master Dali!”

Hong Dali patted the back of the chair and said, “The first thing you should do is rest and raise your spirits. I will go out and arrange things. Remember, if you touch that thing again, your life will be ruined forever.”
“I understand. Thank you, Young Master Dali.”
“Xiaoyi, stay here for two days to look after him.” Hong Dali arranged. “There is nothing much to do for now. You can come back after you have settled things here.”
“Alright. Thank you, Young Master.” Ling Xiaoyi wiped away her tears and said, “I will go back after everything here is settled.”
“Don’t worry.” Hong Dali stood up and said, “Let’s go!” He said with a stern face, “To dare lay their hands on those around me! Do they really think I am so easy to bully?”

After exiting Tianjing West City Prison’s gate, Tang Muxin pulled Hong Dali’s hand and smilingly said, “Dali, I didn’t think much of you in the past, but I didn’t expect you to be so reliable at such a crucial time, hehe.”

“Isn’t that a must?” Hong Dali said with a smile. “As a prodigal, if one can’t keep his lackeys safe, then he should just scram off!” As he spoke, he gently held Tang Muxin hands. Tang Muxin’s face turned red and lowered her head, but she didn’t shake Dali’s hands off.
Tang Muxin’s face was fully red, and her heart beat quickly.
Actually, Hong Dali is not as bad as I had thought him to be. He is actually quite manly at times.Tang Muxin thought.

At this time, the lackeys that had been following Hong Dali also expressed their opinions. “Young Master really treats us so... Ai, I will not say anything more. Otherwise, I’m going to cry!””I agree. Which Young Master would help his lackey when the lackey is in trouble?” “I think that for us to have become Young Master Dali’s lackeys, it was due to blessings that have been passed down for several generations. Not anyone is qualified to be Young Master’s lackey!”
“Haha, you guys, I’m not that good actually...” Hong Dali was praised until his face turned red. Thus, he decisively tipped. “Everyone, 5000 each!”
While everyone was boarding their cars with huge smiles on their faces, Hong Dali asked his driver, “Uncle Wang, how’s the investigation?”

“We have already done an investigation on the Cabinet Society,” said Wang Mingyu. “Da Tou is merely a small fry in the gang. It’s obvious that someone secretly instructed him to do it. Young Master, do you intend to...”
Since they couldn’t find the real culprits, Hong Dali fiercely said, “Then, we can only let them be the unlucky ones.”
Tang Muxin thought for a moment and asked, “Dali, are you going to get rid of the whole gang?”

Hong Dali folded his arms and said, “Yes, since they dared to harm my people, then they should not blame me when their retribution comes!” After saying so, he whipped out his phone. “I’m going to call someone to help now.”
Tianjing West Fourth Loop, Fengyuan Lake.
The originally calm Fengyuan Lake was very busy today. On the lake, a super cruise ship was parked.
Golden Yangtze River No. 6.

This was the new generation of the Yangtze River’s top luxury cruise ship line and had a qualitative leap in visual design and level of comfort. Even in standard rooms, the single bed size was the widest among all the different cruise ships. With entertainment, shopping, Chinese and Western food, and many other facilities on board, it would certainly let one’s time be fulfilling up on the ship. With more than 70 classic elements blended in the design of the ship, it made it look very distinctive. It seemed to be like a mobile water palace and was also a perfect place to enjoy the landscape, had the chance to be close to nature or engage in business and leisure activities. It was a place where one could have the greatest experience!

At this time, on this giant luxury cruise ship, there were all kinds of people everywhere filling the place. Pretty and well-dressed dancers swayed between men and women, hyping the atmosphere. Their gorgeous appearances made the rich merchants lose their souls and dance to their hearts’ content with them.

This feat was prepared by Hong Weiguo, president of the Sangle Group, for his only son, Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony. Just the Golden Yangtze River No. 6 alone cost more than 30 million yuan, not to mention the cost of transporting such a huge cruise ship to Fengyuan Lake and the additional decorations and entertainment options added on board. Just the transportation cost itself was already a million. As for the costs of the wine and the construction of the environment on board, those were simply not worth mentioning.

Everyone was shocked by Hong Weiguo’s generosity in spending so much, but more of them realized the love Hong Weiguo had for his only son. Hong Weiguo’s love for his only son, Hong Dali, had reached an alarming level. No one would doubt that if anyone dared to even touch Hong Dali’s hair, they would end up with serious consequences.

At this time, it was close to 8:00 PM and the main character of the coming of age ceremony still did not appear. The seniors in the politics and business world all started to become somewhat impatient. After all, the coming of age ceremony was similar to a wedding. If the bride or groom were to be missing when the time for the ceremony had reached, anyone would be suspicious of what had happened.

While everyone was wondering, the most beautiful goddess in the entertainment circle, Li Nianwei, appeared in the cabin. Her charming figure and long, curly hair made her look very beautiful. Her princess-like white dress also revealed her unique noble temperament. With a faint smile, she looked around with her beautiful eyes. She was a goddess, someone who one could only dream to be with but not dare to be close to in reality. Her glamorous but cold appearance shocked many.
The timing which Li Nianwei appeared could be considered as perfect.

As a savvy person, Hong Weiguo naturally understood what to do at this time. He immediately picked up the microphone, smiled and said, “Ladies and gentlemen, my son has just called and said that he has some private matters that need to be solved. I believe that it will be very soon before he arrives. I’m very sorry for delaying everyone’s time. Fortunately, Miss Li Nianwei has come to join us. I believe everyone will not be too bored.”

Goddess Li Nianwei had attracted everyone’s attention since her entrance. Although everyone understood the relationship between her and Hong Dali, after all, there were not many who were smart enough. Many CEOs of big companies approached Li Nianwei to ask if she was interested in the products of their companies.

Of course, there were also many curious as to what happened to Hong Dali. Many of them asked, “Director Hong, did Young Master Dali face any trouble? If you need our help, do tell us and we will guarantee that everything will be solved easily!”
It was a must to know that it was a big matter to leave the guests unattended to during an event, especially when the main character of the coming of age ceremony had yet to arrive.
As Hong Weiguo was just about to explain, his phone suddenly rang. He picked it up and asked, “Dali, how are things going over there?”

After hearing that it was Hong Dali that had called, everyone quieted down immediately. Everyone erected their ears and listened. They were curious about what trouble Young Master Dali was facing, causing him to delay his coming of age ceremony.

“I’m nearly done over here.” Hong Dali said over the phone. “Xiaoyi’s brother was tricked and sabotaged. I have already cleared the debt with those who have touched him, but I still have some loose ends to tie.”

Hong Weiguo cellphone speaker volume was not loud, but it was just enough for the few people nearby to hear. As the saying goes, three people spreading reports of a tiger made you believe there was one around. In a blink of an eye, the reason as to why Hong Dali would be arriving late was spread around to everyone.
Soon, the entire ship quickly quieted down to a pin-drop silence.
Hong Weiguo asked, “Loose ends? Do you need help?”

“En, the one that acted was an organization called Cabinet Society.” Hong Dali asked, “Dad, are there any gang leaders there? I’m thinking of wiping out this Cabinet Society once and for all, to avoid any more troubles in the future.”
As expected of my son! To be able to think of such a move, to beat the dog before the lion.
Hong Weiguo did not hesitate to promise. “Yes, there is. Sanquan Gang’s Boss Jin is here. Let me call him.” After this, Hong Weiguo directly shouted, “Is Boss Jin here?”

Since ancient times, there had been a saying that all successful businessmen were shrewd. Most businessmen generally had some relationship with gangs. The Boss Jin that Hong Weiguo called for was a very powerful gangster head in Tianjing City. He had more than 300 members under him, and his sphere of influence was very large.

“Director Hong, did you call for me?” Soon, a fat man with a thick cigar in his mouth pushed his way out from the crowd. He was dressed in a revealing suit, with only a few buttons on the shirt, revealing a furry chest. Coupled with his bald head, he looked like a meat mountain. Followed by several lackeys behind him, he was the Boss Jin Hong Weiguo wanted to find.
“Haha, Boss Jin. My son has met with a little bit of trouble, and I hope Boss Jin can help me out a bit.” Hong Weiguo said while smiling. “Is Boss Jin free to help?”
“If your family’s Dali has encountered some trouble, even if I’m busy, I will still make time for him.” Boss Jin laughed and asked, “What happened to him?”

Hong Weiguo handed the mobile phone over. “In fact, it’s not a big deal. It’s just that my family’s Dali has a subordinate called Ling Xiaoyi. Her younger brother has been tricked and sabotaged, causing Dali to be very angry about it. I’m also not too sure about what he wants. You should ask him about it.”
Boss Jin took over the phone and said while smiling, “Is this Dali? I’m your Uncle Jin.”
“Nice to meet you, Uncle Jin.” Hong Dali continued, “Are you free right now, Uncle Jin? I have a small matter to trouble you with.”
“En, talk about it.” Boss Jin then walked to a quiet place before asking, “Is it done by someone from a gang? Which gang is it?”
“Da Tou of the Cabinet Society.” Hong Dali said. “I think we should just wipe this Cabinet Society out.”

“Young Master really treats us so...
Ai, I will not say anything more.
Otherwise, I’m going to cry!””I agree.

Which Young Master would help his lackey when the lackey is in trouble?” “I think that for us to have become Young Master Dali’s lackeys, it was due to blessings that have been passed down for several generations.
Not anyone is qualified to be Young Master’s lackey!”
“Haha, you guys, I’m not that good actually...” Hong Dali was praised until his face turned red.
Thus, he decisively tipped.
“Everyone, 5000 each!”
While everyone was boarding their cars with huge smiles on their faces, Hong Dali asked his driver, “Uncle Wang, how’s the investigation?”
“We have already done an investigation on the Cabinet Society,” said Wang Mingyu.
“Da Tou is merely a small fry in the gang.
It’s obvious that someone secretly instructed him to do it.
Young Master, do you intend to...”
Since they couldn’t find the real culprits, Hong Dali fiercely said, “Then, we can only let them be the unlucky ones.”
Tang Muxin thought for a moment and asked, “Dali, are you going to get rid of the whole gang?”
Hong Dali folded his arms and said, “Yes, since they dared to harm my people, then they should not blame me when their retribution comes!” After saying so, he whipped out his phone.
“I’m going to call someone to help now.”
Tianjing West Fourth Loop, Fengyuan Lake.
The originally calm Fengyuan Lake was very busy today.
On the lake, a super cruise ship was parked.
Golden Yangtze River No.
This was the new generation of the Yangtze River’s top luxury cruise ship line and had a qualitative leap in visual design and level of comfort.
Even in standard rooms, the single bed size was the widest among all the different cruise ships.
With entertainment, shopping, Chinese and Western food, and many other facilities on board, it would certainly let one’s time be fulfilling up on the ship.
With more than 70 classic elements blended in the design of the ship, it made it look very distinctive.
It seemed to be like a mobile water palace and was also a perfect place to enjoy the landscape, had the chance to be close to nature or engage in business and leisure activities.
It was a place where one could have the greatest experience!
At this time, on this giant luxury cruise ship, there were all kinds of people everywhere filling the place.
Pretty and well-dressed dancers swayed between men and women, hyping the atmosphere.
Their gorgeous appearances made the rich merchants lose their souls and dance to their hearts’ content with them.
This feat was prepared by Hong Weiguo, president of the Sangle Group, for his only son, Hong Dali’s coming of age ceremony.
Just the Golden Yangtze River No.
6 alone cost more than 30 million yuan, not to mention the cost of transporting such a huge cruise ship to Fengyuan Lake and the additional decorations and entertainment options added on board.
Just the transportation cost itself was already a million.
As for the costs of the wine and the construction of the environment on board, those were simply not worth mentioning.
Everyone was shocked by Hong Weiguo’s generosity in spending so much, but more of them realized the love Hong Weiguo had for his only son.
Hong Weiguo’s love for his only son, Hong Dali, had reached an alarming level.
No one would doubt that if anyone dared to even touch Hong Dali’s hair, they would end up with serious consequences.
At this time, it was close to 8:00 PM and the main character of the coming of age ceremony still did not appear.
The seniors in the politics and business world all started to become somewhat impatient.
After all, the coming of age ceremony was similar to a wedding.
If the bride or groom were to be missing when the time for the ceremony had reached, anyone would be suspicious of what had happened.
While everyone was wondering, the most beautiful goddess in the entertainment circle, Li Nianwei, appeared in the cabin.
Her charming figure and long, curly hair made her look very beautiful.
Her princess-like white dress also revealed her unique noble temperament.
With a faint smile, she looked around with her beautiful eyes.
She was a goddess, someone who one could only dream to be with but not dare to be close to in reality.
Her glamorous but cold appearance shocked many.
The timing which Li Nianwei appeared could be considered as perfect.
As a savvy person, Hong Weiguo naturally understood what to do at this time.
He immediately picked up the microphone, smiled and said, “Ladies and gentlemen, my son has just called and said that he has some private matters that need to be solved.
I believe that it will be very soon before he arrives.
I’m very sorry for delaying everyone’s time.
Fortunately, Miss Li Nianwei has come to join us.
I believe everyone will not be too bored.”
Goddess Li Nianwei had attracted everyone’s attention since her entrance.
Although everyone understood the relationship between her and Hong Dali, after all, there were not many who were smart enough.
Many CEOs of big companies approached Li Nianwei to ask if she was interested in the products of their companies.
Of course, there were also many curious as to what happened to Hong Dali.
Many of them asked, “Director Hong, did Young Master Dali face any trouble?
If you need our help, do tell us and we will guarantee that everything will be solved easily!”
It was a must to know that it was a big matter to leave the guests unattended to during an event, especially when the main character of the coming of age ceremony had yet to arrive.
As Hong Weiguo was just about to explain, his phone suddenly rang.
He picked it up and asked, “Dali, how are things going over there?”
After hearing that it was Hong Dali that had called, everyone quieted down immediately.
Everyone erected their ears and listened.
They were curious about what trouble Young Master Dali was facing, causing him to delay his coming of age ceremony.
“I’m nearly done over here.” Hong Dali said over the phone.
“Xiaoyi’s brother was tricked and sabotaged.
I have already cleared the debt with those who have touched him, but I still have some loose ends to tie.”
Hong Weiguo cellphone speaker volume was not loud, but it was just enough for the few people nearby to hear.
As the saying goes, three people spreading reports of a tiger made you believe there was one around.
In a blink of an eye, the reason as to why Hong Dali would be arriving late was spread around to everyone.
Soon, the entire ship quickly quieted down to a pin-drop silence.
Hong Weiguo asked, “Loose ends?
Do you need help?”
“En, the one that acted was an organization called Cabinet Society.” Hong Dali asked, “Dad, are there any gang leaders there?
I’m thinking of wiping out this Cabinet Society once and for all, to avoid any more troubles in the future.”
As expected of my son!
To be able to think of such a move, to beat the dog before the lion.
Hong Weiguo did not hesitate to promise.
“Yes, there is.
Sanquan Gang’s Boss Jin is here.
Let me call him.” After this, Hong Weiguo directly shouted, “Is Boss Jin here?”
Since ancient times, there had been a saying that all successful businessmen were shrewd.
Most businessmen generally had some relationship with gangs.
The Boss Jin that Hong Weiguo called for was a very powerful gangster head in Tianjing City.
He had more than 300 members under him, and his sphere of influence was very large.
“Director Hong, did you call for me?” Soon, a fat man with a thick cigar in his mouth pushed his way out from the crowd.
He was dressed in a revealing suit, with only a few buttons on the shirt, revealing a furry chest.
Coupled with his bald head, he looked like a meat mountain.
Followed by several lackeys behind him, he was the Boss Jin Hong Weiguo wanted to find.
“Haha, Boss Jin.
My son has met with a little bit of trouble, and I hope Boss Jin can help me out a bit.” Hong Weiguo said while smiling.
“Is Boss Jin free to help?”
“If your family’s Dali has encountered some trouble, even if I’m busy, I will still make time for him.” Boss Jin laughed and asked, “What happened to him?”
Hong Weiguo handed the mobile phone over.
“In fact, it’s not a big deal.
It’s just that my family’s Dali has a subordinate called Ling Xiaoyi.
Her younger brother has been tricked and sabotaged, causing Dali to be very angry about it.
I’m also not too sure about what he wants.
You should ask him about it.”
Boss Jin took over the phone and said while smiling, “Is this Dali?
I’m your Uncle Jin.”
“Nice to meet you, Uncle Jin.” Hong Dali continued, “Are you free right now, Uncle Jin?
I have a small matter to trouble you with.”
“En, talk about it.” Boss Jin then walked to a quiet place before asking, “Is it done by someone from a gang?
Which gang is it?”
“Da Tou of the Cabinet Society.” Hong Dali said.
“I think we should just wipe this Cabinet Society out.”

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - Axe Gang
paragraphs: Boss Jin thought for a while and felt that the situation was a bit difficult. “Dali, if you had wanted one or two persons to be gone, that would not be an issue. But to wipe the whole gang out... Don’t you have a target already? There is no need to wipe the whole gang out, right?”
“Da Tou has already hidden.” Hong Dali continued, “I have to force him out. Of course, I will not let Uncle Jin do it for nothing. Five million, how about it?”

“Dali, you are really... Isn’t he just a family member of your subordinate? Is there a need to do so much?” Hearing that Hong Dali was willing to pay five million, Boos Jin couldn’t help but become shocked. He was actually willing to spend so much for a family member of his subordinate?
“Of course, if I can’t even protect my subordinates, I would lose face too, right?” Hong Dali said with a grin. “Uncle Jin, how about it? Are you willing to help?”
“Haha, just based on your sense of brotherhood, I will certainly help no matter what. Where are you guys now?” Boss Jin asked while smiling.
“The entrance of Ye Lai Xiang along the West Fourth Loop.” Hong Dali smiled and said, “What does Uncle Jin have in mind?”
“Just wait there. I will call my men to meet up with you there.” After thinking for a while, Boss Jin said, “Someone will contact you in at most 10 minutes.”
“Alright.”
Hanging up the phone, Boss Jin returned to Hong Weiguo’s side and sighed. “Five million, a tiger father will not beget a dog son. He is certainly as daring and resolute as you!”
Just by listening to him, Hong Weiguo could already roughly guess what had happened. A smile bloomed on his face as he said, “That’s natural, haha.”

“Such an act to earn people’s loyalty is certainly beautiful! With such sense of brotherhood, there will be no subordinate that would not follow him till death. He is indeed very charming and resolute. Even I myself am unable to do this.” Boss Jin praised once again before whipping out his phone to call someone.
West Fourth Loop, at the entrance of Ye Lai Xiang, inside the Soaring Angel.
Hong Dali asked, “Uncle Wang, where is the Cabinet Society’s sphere of influence?”

Wang Mingyu replied, “The Cabinet Society has two nightclubs and three bars along the North Third Loop Road. Their boss is called Yao Tianhao. At this time, they will generally go to these places to enjoy themselves. It should not be difficult to find them.”
“That’s good.” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “We shall go have a talk with them first, hehe.”
Wang Mingyu said, “This Yao Tianhao is known to be unscrupulous. If they dare to go overboard, we must let them taste some hardships! Young Master, what do you intend to do?”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said without hesitation, “What else is there to do? We will fight first, then talk!”

In fact, Hong Dali was actually a man with no ambition. He just wanted to be a happy prodigal. Teasing his dog, bringing his tiger out for a walk, or reading his novels while having small fights with Tang Muxin. These were basically what he wanted his life to be, just be happy. Up till the present, he enjoyed his life.

Hong Dali had never thought of building a sturdy background for himself. To be honest, he was able to handle small things but definitely did not have the ability to manage big matters. Hong Dali did not want to become someone that was high up above everyone. He was even scared of falling from so high up too.
But those people should never have touched Ling Xiaoyi’s brother.

Hong Dali only had a single creed—no one should touch those under him! If Hong Dali were to ignore what had happened today, how would his lackeys think of him in the future? How would others see him? To tell the truth, Hong Dali would not really care if he were to be bullied or mistreated. But to have sabotaged Ling Xiaoyi’s brother, that was equivalent to a death sentence. Ling Xiaoyi had the greatest role among his nine lackeys and also treated everyone well usually. Ling Xiaoyi was just like their big sister.
One must know that it was completely different when one’s precious and loving sister, who had taken care of them for so long, had gotten bullied. Anyone with a sister would understand.
Tang Muxin asked, “Dali, are we waiting for them to arrive first?”
Hong Dali nodded. “En, we will set out when they have arrived.” He said, “Old Xiao, you and Geezer Wang are both at Ye Lai Xiang, right? Come out and help me beat people up! I’m at the door.”
On the other side of the phone, Mu Zixiao excitedly said, “Alright, we will go out in just a while!”

At this time, Wang Mingyu took out a map. “Young Master, let’s make a plan first. If we want to do it, we should do it cleanly once and for all, so that they will not dare to offend us in the future again. Otherwise, it will be bothersome if people keep plotting against those around Young Master.”
Tang Muxin, who was holding the tiger cub Quentin at the side, asked, “Where is their boss Yao Tianhao?”
Hong Dali answered, “I’m not sure, we will find them one by one.”
Tang Muxin then asked, “By doing so, won’t we alert them before we even find them? If they were to find out they can’t fight us, wouldn’t they just run away?”

Hong Dali smiled and said, “What are you afraid of? After getting rid of one or two places, they will definitely gather at a certain place to fight with us, so even if we take them out one by one, he can only forcefully stand against us. Ai, it seems that Uncle Jin’s men have arrived.”

Sure enough, at this time, there was a person outside the car. In his forties, he looked to be the leader of the group. He knocked on the window of the car and asked in a very soft voice, “Is this Young Master Dali? Boss Jin told me to find you.”
After seeing him, Hong Dali instantly brightened up and opened the door. “Get on the car. How do I address you?”

“My name is Hai Qingtian. Young Master can just call me Old Hai.” Hai Qingtian boarded the car immediately and glanced at the interior of the car left and right. “The environment in the car is really good. This car is definitely not an average good car, hehe.”

As they were talking, Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang walked out from Ye Lai Xiang. As Hong Dali’s car was spacious enough, the two men got on the car without much trouble and asked, “Dali, what’s happening? Are we going to fight? I have just learned a few tricks!”
Geezer Wang, on the other hand, asked, “Young Master, did someone offend you?”
As everyone was finally present, Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “Someone plotted against Xiaoyi’s younger brother. Such an action can’t be tolerated. Old Hai, are your people ready?”

Hai Qingtian smiled and said, “After hearing that Young Master Dali has a use for us brothers, Boss Jin has already arranged for people to go directly to the North Third Loop Road. However, Young Master, how are you going to deal with this matter?”
“How to deal with it?” Hong Dali said, “You mean...”

“Do you intend to get rid of the entire Cabinet Society to let it serve as a warning for others,” Hai Qingtian continued, “or do you intend to take in the gang as yours and play with it? Cabinet Society is considered neither too big or too small.”
“Oh?” Hearing what he said, Hong Dali eyes brightened. “There’s no point in getting rid of the whole gang. Talk more about how we could take them in!”

“En.” Hai Qingtian said. “The taking-in process is quite simple. I personally know about the head of the Cabinet Society, Yao Tianhao. He is savvy at doing the small things but muddled when it comes to big matters. Otherwise, he would not have offended Young Master. His foresight is not that good, but he is able to fight well. He is the kind of person who is happy with small achievements. If the Young Master wants to take them in, as long as you beat them with absolute power before giving them enough benefits, it will definitely not be difficult.”
“En, thinking about it, this idea is not bad.” Hong Dali touched his chin. “But first, I still have to confirm who ordered Da Tou to plot against Ling Mufeng.”
Speaking up to here, Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Let’s go!”
The group immediately set off. At this time, a soft voice came from behind. “About that, Dali, can you let me fight more today? I have been denied for a few days already.”
After Hong Dali turned his head around, he saw Mu Zixiao with a pitiful face.
He had learned a lot of moves from Geezer Wang but had never had the chance to practice them. He couldn’t control himself when he heard that there was going to be a gang fight today.
Since the other party was not his man, Hong Dali was naturally not polite. “Sure, just make sure you don’t kill anyone.”
At this time, Hai Qingtian turned to look at Mu Zixiao, and then at Geezer Wang. Upon seeing Geezer Wang, he became stunned. “Master! He’s definitely a great master!”
Mu Zixiao became interested. “How did you know?”

Hai Qingtian: “I can see a grand and imposing air around him!” These words made Mu Zixiao smile. Then, Hai Qingtian turned his gaze to Hong Dali and said, “Young Master Dali, what do you intend to do when the time comes? I’m afraid they might hurt you...”
Hong Dali had a deep understanding of his abilities—he definitely couldn’t help much and would even drag everyone behind if he were to participate in the fight.
So, he replied quite simply, “Have you ever seen a prodigal engage in a fight? Such a job is obviously meant for the lackeys!”
Hai Qingtian smiled and said, “I can put my heart to ease, then!”

Thus, they managed to divide the roles between everyone. Hong Dali the prodigal, acted as the leader of the group. Hai Qingtian acted as the military advisor for the lackeys. Tang Muxin brought along the five female lackeys to act as cheerleaders. Driver Wang Mingyu, Mu Zixiao, and Geezer Wang were the three main fighters. The three male lackeys had also been practicing for the past few days and could barely be responsible for finishing and clearing up the scene.
And with such arrangements, a small gang was thus formed.

However, Hong Dali still felt a bit uncomfortable—one must admit that he was the type of person who pursued perfection. Thus, he ordered three male lackeys to buy fifty axes and threw them in the car. He then gave a name for his team—the Axe Gang.
Unfortunately, there was no Stephen Chow in this world, or they could have helped film a scene for “Kung Fu”...

Soon after arriving at the North Third Loop Road, Wang Mingyu took out a map and said, “Let’s settle them from the west to the east so that they have enough time to prepare.” With a glance, Hong Dali saw that there was a bar at the westernmost area. As the five strongholds of Yao Tianhao were not close, a blanket style attack was a good idea.
At this time, Hai Qingtian received a call and said, “Boss Jin’s men have all arrived too. They are currently waiting near the bar’s entrance. Young Master Dali, should we...”
“Everyone, take an ax each.” Hong Dali stroked Quentin’s head in his arms and said, “We shall be called the Axe Gang for this operation! Let’s move out!”
And thus, three male lackeys took the newly bought 50 axes and gave everyone from Boss Jin’s gang one each.

At this time, Hai Qingtian received a call and said, “Boss Jin’s men have all arrived too.
They are currently waiting near the bar’s entrance.
Young Master Dali, should we...”
“Everyone, take an ax each.” Hong Dali stroked Quentin’s head in his arms and said, “We shall be called the Axe Gang for this operation!
Let’s move out!”
And thus, three male lackeys took the newly bought 50 axes and gave everyone from Boss Jin’s gang one each.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - Heavenly State’s Four Talents
paragraphs: When they arrived at the entrance, Hai Qingtian, the military advisor for the lackeys, said, “Let’s further split the work first. When we enter, Young Master Dali will bring Lady Muxin and the cheerleading squad to shout our slogan. The three kung fu masters will be responsible for the fight, while the three male lackeys will be responsible for making sure no one escapes. Yao Tianhao might just be inside, so make sure not to let him escape. The others will be responsible for flanking the enemies and making sure no one escapes. We would rather get 1000 killed than miss one.
This strategy is really vicious, but I like it!

Hong Dali nodded in agreement and did not forget to add, “Oh right, Xinxin, arrange a female lackey to stand by at the door to look out for the police. It will not be pleasant if we end up in the police station.”
Tang Muxin smiled and nodded in agreement. “Alright, no problem.”
After entering, Mu Zixiao looked at the dimly lit room and frowned. “Let’s clear the place first. Otherwise, it will be hard if there are so many people present.”
Hong Dali climbed onto the stage and slashed the tuner with his ax. “Axe Gang is here to make trouble! Those that do not want to get involved, leave now!”
Tang Muxin brought the four female lackeys (one left outside the door) in, grabbed the mike, and shouted, “Axe Gang! Axe Gang!” Fulfilling their role as the cheerleaders.

After seeing such beautiful ladies shouting slogans for the gang, the people below were confused as to what was going on. Some of them cheered along while others thought that this was a show organized by the bar and started to clap their hands—standing aside to prevent getting injured, of course.

Gang fights were a normal occurrence in bars. The clever ones would be the first to rush and lean directly on the walls. By doing so, they would usually be injury-free. What was left was just to enjoy the show.

At this time, the people responsible for taking care of the bar had already rushed up to kill. The waiters threw all their dishes in Hong Dali’s direction—waiters in gang-run shops were all naturally well-trained.

Mu Zixiao had gained a lot of inspiration while practicing with Geezer Wang in the past two days, and he was also originally a vicious person. Thus, he made use of his advantageous height on the stage to punch the thugs who were trying to climb onto the stage. While fighting, Mu Zixiao randomly screamed and shouted. Seeing that, Hong Dali thought that since there was no Bruce Lee in this world, it might be a good idea to ask Old Xiao act in movies such as “Fist Of Fury.”

Geezer Wang lived up to his nickname of Flying Eagle with his fluid light movement technique. He seemed to be running around freely in the sea of people, punching chins and kicking the cheekbones of the thugs. Even after the fight, not even a hair of Geezer Wang had been touched by anyone. In just a blink of an eye, all that could be seen were people lying on the ground around him.
Wang Mingyu, being a retired special forces soldier, was vicious when he struck, but he aimed for non-fatal places.
When these three striked out, all those around them fell over. Thus, at least half of the thugs in the bar all rushed towards them.

Of course, there were some fishes that slipped past the net and managed to rush towards Hong Dali. As the three male lackeys near Hong Dali raised their axes to protect him, they were stopped by Hong Dali. Hong Dali, however, felt that such a situation was, in fact, easy to solve and there was no need to fight. He took a stack of hundred dollar bills from his lackey’s pocket and gave it to the thug rushing towards him. “This 10,000 yuan is yours if you become one of my men.”

Hong Dali was too lazy to fight, and even if he had to, he couldn’t win against the thugs. However, he didn’t mind using the power of yuan to attract people. As the saying goes, it was not that people did not want to betray, it was because the stakes were not attractive enough for them to betray. No matter the case, 10,000 yuan was definitely not a small sum. After looking at Hong Dali suspiciously for a while, the thug turned towards the one beside him decisively and smashed a beer bottle on his head—the one that got hit in the head then looked at Hong Dali wronged while falling down. His mouth even twitched a bit, seemingly asking why Hong Dali didn’t want to give money to him, causing Hong Dali to feel guilty. Hong Dali then decisively added, “It’s okay. I will tip you 5000 too.”
The one that fell then had a smile on his face.
The fight started out of a sudden and ended abruptly too.

Hong Dali looked around and found out that the people that were originally drinking had all ran out. More than half the thugs in charge of the area were already lying on the ground, with the rest not daring to come any nearer. Other than them were the lackeys sent by Boss Jin.

The situation was completely under control. After another three minutes, the battle was finally over. Hong Dali leisurely walked down the stage and held up a thug who was drenched in blood. He asked, “Where is your boss Yao Tianhao?”
The thug responded in fear, “He... He never comes by here.”
Hong Dali then asked, “Right, let me ask you. Do you know of Bighead in your Cabinet Society?”
“Bighead? I have indeed heard of him before,” the thug responded with a face full of horror. “Bro, you destroyed this place just to find him?”
“You can say so.” Hong Dali nodded his head. “Provide some details about him, then. You will then all have it easier.”

“Big Bro, I really don’t know how he irritated you,” said the thug who felt really wronged. “I have heard of Da Tou, but he only has a very small role in our Society. He rarely talks to the boss. If you are looking for him, you can simply make a call! There is no need to do so much!”

It appeared that destroying this place was wronging the Cabinet Society, but Hong Dali believed that they could only be considered unfortunate. As the saying goes, a fire in the city gates was also a calamity for the fish in the moat. Thus, Hong Dali smiled and patted the thug’s shoulder. “Brother, I would like to discuss something with you. How about it?”

After seeing Hong Dali’s expression turn mischievous, the thug almost peed in his pants. Normally, for gangsters, the happier the person was meant that his following actions were going to be even crueler. He was scared till his face was filled with sweat, stuttering, “Big... Big Brother, please... please do say!”

“Follow me from now on. How about that? I don’t know if you have heard of me. I’m Hong Dali.” Hong Dali then pulled out a cigarette prepared earlier by Hai Qingtian and put it into his mouth. The male lacks behind then pulled out a hundred-dollar bill and lit it up. “Young Master, please.”
To light up a cigarette with a hundred dollar bill. This scene shocked all the thugs present, causing them to almost kneel on the ground. “Let me kneel for Young Master!”
It seemed that such an imposing manner had an immediate effect. Hong Dali was quite satisfied with this result. “Tip them, 2000 per person.”
The male lackey who held the bills immediately stepped forward and counted the bills with aPa Pa Pasound, distributing 2000 per person.

The members of the original Cabinet Society all defected without hesitation. “Young Master Dali, you are our Boss from now on! If you call us to head east, we dare not go west. If you make us catch a dog, we dare not lick the chicken!”

It could be said that this group of thugs were not fools. It was well-known that this was the super prodigal son of the Hong Family, and thus, the betrayal happened without a second thought. Hong Dali, the superprodigal, had a reputation all over the world. Following him would definitely not go wrong!
Hong Dali was satisfied with this bunch of smart thugs and continued to say, “Then, from now on, you will all be part of our Axe Gang.”
The bunch of people shouted: “We will follow whatever Young Master says!”
After taking in the low-level thugs, he then continued to ask, “Where is Yao Tianhao?”

“Boss Yao... Oh no, Yao Tianhao usually plays mahjong in the basement of the two nightclubs.” Since they had already betrayed him, the thugs decided to go all the way and unhesitantly sold out their original master.
Wang Mingyu took out the map. “Let’s see where we should go next—en, Marriott nightclub, just right!”
Tang Muxin said, “If it’s like this, then we don’t have to go to those bars, right?”
Mu Zixiao’s face was full of sadness. “I haven’t fought enough...” Geezer Wang then kicked him. “Do you intend to get addicted to fighting?”

At this time, the rebellious thugs looked at Hong Dali with stunned looks. Hong Dali then stared at them and said, “What are you looking at. Call Yao Tianhao and ask him to wash his neck and wait for us. We will go to him.”

As the thugs moved to do his order, Hai Qingtian suddenly said slowly, “After thinking about it just now, Yao Tianhao should be waiting for us at Marriott Nightclub, but if you want him to surrender and be under you, it would be best if you could wait for him to gather all his people first.”
“Then, shall we go there now?” Hong Dali asked.
“En...” Looking at the map, Hai Qingtian replied, “Let’s wait another ten minutes. That should be sufficient for him to gather everyone.”

“Alright.” Hong Dali looked at the time. “It’s just nice at 8:00 PM now. Ai, my coming of age ceremony is starting, but I’m still fighting here. A pity, a pity.” Even though he said so, he was not in the slightest bit of a hurry. “Then, we will go to the Marriott nightclub at 8:10!” Compared with the boring coming of age ceremony, this was obviously more enjoyable!
Fengyuan Lake, on the Golden Yangtze River Cruise.

The cool and handsome Liu Mingxin was smiling and sitting on the sofa, surrounded by a bunch of women smitten with him, secretly sneaking at him from time to time. Of course, Liu Mingxin did not respond to any of them.

As the young master of the Liu family, although he was not friendly with Hong Family’s Hong Dali because of their family history, they had not reached a stage where they tore apart all their relationships. Although Liu Yihui didn’t want to give Hong Weiguo face, he can’t do it too much. Thus, Liu Mingxin, the young master, was naturally the best person to be sent to the ceremony.
At this time, his eyes stared curiously at a young man in the field, secretly thinking, Why did this guy come?

The “he” in Liu Mingxin was thinking about was about twenty years old. The length of his hair was short, his body thin, his skin color was bronze, and his facial features were distinct and deep. He looked like a Greek sculpture, looking wild and unconstrained but sexy at the same time. His distinct features were beautiful, and a sloppy smile could be seen on his sinister face.
His temperament was quite complicated, seemingly a mixture of different temperaments—gentle and handsome, yet having his own unique and ethereal feel!
This person who was recognized by Liu Mingxin was one of the outstanding talents in Heavenly State together with Liu Mingxin, Mu Zixiao, and Hong Dali—Liang Yifeng!
East’s Mingxin, West’s Zixiao, South’s Yifeng, North’s Dali. Finally, all four of the outstanding talents of the younger generation were gathered together!

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - Beautiful Woman Are Just so Self-Confident
paragraphs: Li Nianwei looked out of the window at the night-view, feeling anxious in her heart.
This coming of age ceremony cost almost 50 million yuan in total, yet the main character was actually late for it.

It was indeed not a polite thing to be late for such an occasion. Quite a few of the less patient and hot-tempered guests were already secretly expressing their unhappiness about this. Although it wasn’t to the extent where they would directly leave, the smiles of some weren’t as sincere anymore.

Being one of Hong Dali’s closest friends, Li Nianwei acted as the older sister of a playful brother and helped to ease the atmosphere. Although unwilling, she even talked with the guests to prevent them from becoming too impatient.
Sigh, I hope that Young Master can come as soon as possible. After all, such an occasion isn’t the same as usual times...Letting out a soft sigh, Li Nianwei helplessly thought to herself.

At this moment, a figure suddenly approached her. He was a young man of about 20 plus years old, short hair, skinny, tan skin, dark and deep cold eyes, demonic and sexy. The temperament he gave off was quite complex; as if it were a mix of different temperaments. Within his gentleness and handsomeness, there was also his own unique sense of elegance and otherworldliness.
Out of all those present, who could have such a temperament other than Liang Yifeng?

“This person...” After only just glancing at him, Li Nianwei’s heart instantly missed a beat. Then, she shook her head. “I wonder which family’s young master is this, he must be at least the same level as Liu Mingxin. I wonder if he is friend or foe, sigh...”

As she was thinking this, Liang Yifeng had already walked to her side. Suddenly, eyes looking up as if he were Fei Yuqing1, he started singing. “Beautiful woman is like the heavy rain, beautiful woman is just so self-confident, beautiful woman is not afraid of thunder, wind, and rain. Beautiful woman, who do you love, who do you want me to be, I shall let this beautiful woman have no regrets... A beautiful woman is like the heavy rain, beautiful woman is just so self-confident, beautiful woman call 110 if you need help, I will come and protect you. Your sorrow matter, only I shall hear them, I still love, I will never regret...”
“Pfft!” Hearing his interesting song, Li Nianwei couldn’t help but laugh even though she was still worried about Hong Dali.

“Beautiful woman, how are you. My name is Liang Yifeng.” Liang Yifeng had a slight smile on his face and playfully raised his eyebrows up and down. His whole body leaned on the railing, giving off a sense of leisure and handsomeness. “Your looks, figure, and skin complexion—you are totally akin to being the embodiment of the Goddess, the embodiment of perfection, perfect and flawless like a diamond. You must be the recently very hot and popular goddess, Miss Li Nianwei. Is my guess correct?”
“Yes.” Li Nianwei smiled slightly and nodded. “Hello.”

“Then, Miss Nianwei, I wonder if you are free now?” Liang Yifeng laughed and said, “I’m quite into music too and have been studying it. I have some questions that I would like to discuss with Miss Nianwei, I wonder if I may have this opportunity?”
“I’m really sorry.” Li Nianwei smiled and shook her head. “I’m afraid that I will have to disappoint you.”
Saying so, Li Nianwei instantly turned around and leisurely walked away.

“Ah, don’t go!” Looking at Li Nianwei’s back-view, Liang Yifeng felt hurt and started singing again. “Happiness, it’s buried in the deep winter cold, my heart is only left with bitterness and pain, it’s already frozen and sealed. Dreams, they flew away like the kite, I want to stretch out my hand to stop and save it, but I have already lost my freedom...”
While he sang and caused the surrounding ladies around him to screech, Li Nianwei only shook her head.
Compared to Hong Dali, he still lacked that kind of sincerity and pureness that would make people want to be close to him.
“That’s enough, stop singing.” Liu Mingxin’s voice sounded from behind Liang Yifeng. “Why did you suddenly return from overseas? Why, the women out there can’t attract you anymore?”

“Oh, it’s Mingxin.” As Liang Yifeng turned around, not a hint of sadness could be seen on his face anymore. He laughed and said, “I just wanted to express the feelings and emotions in my heart. Speaking of which, how are you doing recently? All these years, you still didn’t find a girlfriend? Even if you don’t want to find a girlfriend, you should have found a friend with benefit or something to release your excess energy, right?” Speaking up to this point, he purposely raised his eyebrows up and down.

“I’m not as free as you.” Liu Mingxin leisurely stroked back his graceful long hair, causing the surrounding ladies to scream and screech again. “I’m too busy just dealing with my family’s business, where would I have the time to think about such stuff.”

“I don’t think that is the case.” Liang Yifeng looked at Li Nianwei’s back-view, which was already far away in the distance. “This goddess isn’t bad at all, I don’t believe that your heart really never moved for her, hehe.”

“Nianwei?” Liu Mingxin helplessly shook his head. “Her relationship with Hong Dali is too strong. I did indeed make a move before, but I failed. However, to be honest, she is a good lady. Although the Hong Family and my family’s relationship isn’t too good, I’m not as low as to use despicable tricks on a woman.”
The two of them leaned on the window railing and looked out of the window at the city’s night-view together.
Liang Yifeng said, “You will just be labeled as a good man2like this. Against women, you just have to shamelessly keep trying. As long as you put in the effort, you will eventually succeed.”

“Hahaha, your words are still as lewd as ever.” Liu Mingxin laughed loudly and said, “Don’t talk about this anymore, at least for the time being, it isn’t time for me to live leisurely yet. Of course, if one day I have achieved all my ambitions or totally failed in doing so, I might consider your advice.”

“Sure, I’m always prepared.” Liang Yifeng laughed as well. “I will introduce you to whichever lady you set your eyes on.” Speaking up to this point, Liang Yifeng suddenly changed the topic. “Speaking of which, this Hong Dali from the Hong Family seems quite the talent. Wasn’t he rumored to be a superprodigal?”

“He is indeed a superprodigal, you are not mistaken.” Speaking of Hong Dali, even the always confident Liu Mingxin felt helpless about him. “The question is, when a superprodigal and super luckiness are combined together, no one can imagine the terrifying result that comes from that. At least for now, towards this Young Master Dali, I don’t have any confidence in winning against him.”

“Are you for real? He is so terrifying!?” Liang Yifeng’s eyes almost popped out. “You, Liu Mingxin, actually said that you are not confident against someone? Last time, against the Bai Family’s enormous online gaming enterprise, when Young Master Bai Yuhong hooted at you, you caused their company to collapse within two years. Now you are telling me that you don’t have any confidence at all against a prodigal?”
Speaking up to this point, Liang Yifeng angrily said, “You didn’t come here to make sport of me, right?”

“I don’t have that kind of leisure mood.” Liu Mingxin helplessly said, “No matter what I say now, you won’t understand. Just wait until Hong Dali is here, then you will see. Oh right, I advise you not to try those small tricks of yours. Otherwise, I fear that you will be at the losing end. Once you lose out, it definitely will not be just a small loss.”

The more you say it, the more that I want to try. Hahaha, this is interesting! I will be at a disadvantage!?”
Liu Mingxin helplessly shrugged. “Fine, that’s all that I have to say. If you don’t believe me, you will see for yourself later.”
At the same time, in another corner.
The gathering point of Hong Dali’s classmates.
Ling Yi jogged over and reported on the latest news he acquired. “The latest news, the latest news! Brother Dali went to deal with something, he said that he will be late.”

Du Xinzhen was listless, like a withered eggplant. “I made a prediction and knew that he had something on his hand right now... Sigh, I can’t even fend for myself, I shouldn’t make any more predictions...”
Ji Zhiruo asked, “Du Xinzhen, you still haven’t managed to court Su Luoyu yet?”
Du Xinzhen helplessly said, “Don’t mention that girl, you are not saving me any face.”

As he said this, Ling Yi suddenly saw a figure amongst the crowd. His face full of surprise, he said, “That’s... That’s... Blood Consort!? She actually came? This can’t be, she has never attended such an occasion before!”
Du Xinzhen was immediately invigorated. “Where, where is she? It really is her, oh god, what is she doing here?”
Ling Yi: “I have no idea. Oh my, look. She seems to be going out now.”
Lin Chuyin sat quietly at a corner of the hall. She suddenly looked at her watch and murmured, “Oh, it’s already 8:00 PM sharp. Hong Dali actually hasn’t arrived yet...”
She thought for a while and took out a small delicate signal receiver device. The screen quickly displayed a map. “North Third Loop, Wan Hao nightclub. Destination confirmed, moving out.”
She got up and walked out just like that.

sentences.text: Li Nianwei looked out of the window at the night-view, feeling anxious in her heart.
This coming of age ceremony cost almost 50 million yuan in total, yet the main character was actually late for it.
It was indeed not a polite thing to be late for such an occasion.
Quite a few of the less patient and hot-tempered guests were already secretly expressing their unhappiness about this.
Although it wasn’t to the extent where they would directly leave, the smiles of some weren’t as sincere anymore.
Being one of Hong Dali’s closest friends, Li Nianwei acted as the older sister of a playful brother and helped to ease the atmosphere.
Although unwilling, she even talked with the guests to prevent them from becoming too impatient.
Sigh, I hope that Young Master can come as soon as possible.
After all, such an occasion isn’t the same as usual times...Letting out a soft sigh, Li Nianwei helplessly thought to herself.
At this moment, a figure suddenly approached her.
He was a young man of about 20 plus years old, short hair, skinny, tan skin, dark and deep cold eyes, demonic and sexy.
The temperament he gave off was quite complex; as if it were a mix of different temperaments.
Within his gentleness and handsomeness, there was also his own unique sense of elegance and otherworldliness.
Out of all those present, who could have such a temperament other than Liang Yifeng?
“This person...” After only just glancing at him, Li Nianwei’s heart instantly missed a beat.
Then, she shook her head.
“I wonder which family’s young master is this, he must be at least the same level as Liu Mingxin.
I wonder if he is friend or foe, sigh...”
As she was thinking this, Liang Yifeng had already walked to her side.
Suddenly, eyes looking up as if he were Fei Yuqing1, he started singing.
“Beautiful woman is like the heavy rain, beautiful woman is just so self-confident, beautiful woman is not afraid of thunder, wind, and rain.
Beautiful woman, who do you love, who do you want me to be, I shall let this beautiful woman have no regrets...
A beautiful woman is like the heavy rain, beautiful woman is just so self-confident, beautiful woman call 110 if you need help, I will come and protect you.
Your sorrow matter, only I shall hear them, I still love, I will never regret...”
“Pfft!” Hearing his interesting song, Li Nianwei couldn’t help but laugh even though she was still worried about Hong Dali.
“Beautiful woman, how are you.
My name is Liang Yifeng.” Liang Yifeng had a slight smile on his face and playfully raised his eyebrows up and down.
His whole body leaned on the railing, giving off a sense of leisure and handsomeness.
“Your looks, figure, and skin complexion—you are totally akin to being the embodiment of the Goddess, the embodiment of perfection, perfect and flawless like a diamond.
You must be the recently very hot and popular goddess, Miss Li Nianwei.
Is my guess correct?”
“Yes.” Li Nianwei smiled slightly and nodded.
“Hello.”
“Then, Miss Nianwei, I wonder if you are free now?” Liang Yifeng laughed and said, “I’m quite into music too and have been studying it.
I have some questions that I would like to discuss with Miss Nianwei, I wonder if I may have this opportunity?”
“I’m really sorry.” Li Nianwei smiled and shook her head.
“I’m afraid that I will have to disappoint you.”
Saying so, Li Nianwei instantly turned around and leisurely walked away.
“Ah, don’t go!” Looking at Li Nianwei’s back-view, Liang Yifeng felt hurt and started singing again.
“Happiness, it’s buried in the deep winter cold, my heart is only left with bitterness and pain, it’s already frozen and sealed.
Dreams, they flew away like the kite, I want to stretch out my hand to stop and save it, but I have already lost my freedom...”
While he sang and caused the surrounding ladies around him to screech, Li Nianwei only shook her head.
Compared to Hong Dali, he still lacked that kind of sincerity and pureness that would make people want to be close to him.
“That’s enough, stop singing.” Liu Mingxin’s voice sounded from behind Liang Yifeng.
“Why did you suddenly return from overseas?
Why, the women out there can’t attract you anymore?”
“Oh, it’s Mingxin.” As Liang Yifeng turned around, not a hint of sadness could be seen on his face anymore.
He laughed and said, “I just wanted to express the feelings and emotions in my heart.
Speaking of which, how are you doing recently?
All these years, you still didn’t find a girlfriend?

Even if you don’t want to find a girlfriend, you should have found a friend with benefit or something to release your excess energy, right?” Speaking up to this point, he purposely raised his eyebrows up and down.
“I’m not as free as you.” Liu Mingxin leisurely stroked back his graceful long hair, causing the surrounding ladies to scream and screech again.
“I’m too busy just dealing with my family’s business, where would I have the time to think about such stuff.”
“I don’t think that is the case.” Liang Yifeng looked at Li Nianwei’s back-view, which was already far away in the distance.
“This goddess isn’t bad at all, I don’t believe that your heart really never moved for her, hehe.”
“Nianwei?” Liu Mingxin helplessly shook his head.
“Her relationship with Hong Dali is too strong.
I did indeed make a move before, but I failed.
However, to be honest, she is a good lady.
Although the Hong Family and my family’s relationship isn’t too good, I’m not as low as to use despicable tricks on a woman.”
The two of them leaned on the window railing and looked out of the window at the city’s night-view together.
Liang Yifeng said, “You will just be labeled as a good man2like this.
Against women, you just have to shamelessly keep trying.
As long as you put in the effort, you will eventually succeed.”
