chapters.title: Chapter 172 - Chui Chui, I Love You!
paragraphs: In the other side of the hall.

“Weiguo, it’s already past 8, why isn’t Dali here yet?” Hong Jianye’s face was full of nervousness. “This is his coming of age ceremony, being late will leave a bad impression on him. Quite a number of guests are already impatient.”
It was a very rude thing towards the guests for the male character not to appear on his coming of age ceremony.

Hong Weiguo insipidly looked at his fourth brother, Hong Jianye, smiled and said, “Relax, he will settle things over at his side very quickly. I believe in him.” Saying so, he looked at one of the people in the crowd. “Don’t you agree, Chief Dong?”

“That’s indeed the case.” Vice-Chief Zhang from the sub-department had already informed him about the matter regarding Ling Xiaoyi, so he was aware of the situation. “I heard that this matter was because of Ling Xiaoyi’s brother. He was lured into consuming drugs. This matter must be taken care of, if not his subordinates will lose faith in him. Also...” Chief Dong took a look at Hong Jianye, gave him a mysterious smile, and said, “Also, I feel that this matter isn’t so simple. If we investigate further, we might be able to discover the main culprit behind this.”

At his side, Boss Jin smiled and said, “Oh my, speaking of which, Chief Dong, I asked a few underlings of mine to protect Young Master Dali. You have to help me inform your side to let them off. You know that it’s a hard time for us to make a living nowadays.”
“No problem.” Chief Dong patted Boss Jin’s shoulder. “Your Golden Light enterprise is doing quite well lately, and also helped me settle quite a lot of problems.”

When he just entered the triads, it could be said that there was a lot of bloodsheds. However, Boss Jin had been trying hard to wash away his triads bad image and had been secretly settling some things for the Police that couldn’t be shown in public. Therefore, his relationship with Bureau Chief Dong Huarong was quite good.

People like him who was in a triad normally had connections with both the Underworld and the Police. If not, they couldn’t have lasted long if the Police kept checking on them and their business every two to three days.

“Haha, you’re flattering me. I’m just helping to share some of your burdens, it’s my duty to do so!” Boss Jin laughed loudly. “But Chief Dong, it isn’t easy trying to find that two bastards who lured him into taking drugs. I’m afraid that someone may be hiding them.”
“Of course, I’m aware of this.” Chief Dong shot a meaningful look at Hong Jianye and then smiled and said, “However, nothing is impenetrable in this world. Can that person hide them forever?”
“That’s true!” Boss Jin cooperated.

Hong Jianye watched these two people act in from of him and gave a cold laugh in his heart. On the surface, he nodded and said, “Since this is the case, I shall wait for your good news. Speaking of which, this action of luring people into taking drugs must be taken care of.”
“That’s for sure.”

Seeing that they had nothing more to say to him, Hong Jianye instantly walked away. When he walked to a corner, his son Hong Anbao came up and asked softly, “Dad, they couldn’t have found out about us, right?”

“Of course not.” Hong Jianye smiled and said, “I’m careful when doing things. Hehe, because of Hong Dali, Hong Weiguo probably spent a lot of money for today. This is a good excuse to use during the family meeting. We shall just stand aside and see how it plays out from now on. We don’t have to do anything else.”
“OK.” Hong Anbao smiled and said, “It’s fine as long as our goal is achieved.”

As they secretly conversed in the corner, Hong Weiguo was also discussing this matter at his side too. Dong Huarong asked, “Weiguo, regarding the matter about Ling Xiaoyi, who do you think is the mastermind?”

“There are a lot of suspects.” Hong Weiguo shook his head and said, “Dali has been involved in a lot of industries, any of his rivals might be the one behind this. Of course, my main suspect is... Unfortunately, I don’t have any proof, so there’s nothing I can do.”

Boss Jin was from the triads, he was naturally familiar with such stuff. “I encountered such a situation before too. Someone wanted to lay his hand on my son. I didn’t waste any words but just broke the legs of all those related. And now, my son is living perfectly fine. Hehe, you can’t be soft-handed when dealing with such matters. If not, those bastards will think that you are easy to bully. A kind person will be bullied, a kind horse will be mounted on, this is how things are.”

“Yup, this is my intention as well.” Hong Weiguo gradually said, “Although I’m not sure who is the culprit this time, I can put stress on the people who executed the plan. I need to let everyone know that even if I can’t find the mastermind, I will take it out on those who executed the plan!”

“Yes, this is the right thing to do.” Boss Jin agreed. “After this incident, they won’t dare to lay their hands on Dali again. Back to the main topic, I wonder how Dali is doing now. There couldn’t be any problems at his side, right?”
“There’s no problem.” Hong Weiguo nodded affirmatively. “Although Dali is a prodigal, he isn’t silly. Don’t worry.”
When Hong Dali and his group arrived at Wan Hao nightclub and saw the situation there, they knew that things wouldn’t be easy!

This was practically a base for hooligans and gangsters. From the entrance of the nightclub, all the way to the entrance of the street, all kinds of motorbikes were parked along the road. There were hooligans with ear holes, nose holes, and tattoos littered everywhere along the road.

It was May 28th today, they all wore shirts with short sleeves which exposed the tattoos of all kinds of animals on their skin. There were snakes, cats, goat heads, and even one that was tattooed “Chui Chui, I love You.” This caused Hong Dali to be quite depressed. He was wondering if he should hit that hooligan later, or should he hit him, or should he just hit him...
Regardless, it looked like Yao Tianhao was really daring in his moves after hearing the news of their coming. It was no wonder that he could become the leader of so many people.

Speaking of which, he gathered all of the hooligans who were within five kilometers in less than ten minutes. Just from this scene along, it was quite similar to the final battle scene in “Young and Dangerous.” There were almost 300 plus people present—although half of them looked like it didn’t concern them and they were just here out of curiosity. However, if it weren’t because of his wealth and stature, even if he was very famous amongst the triads, Yao Tianhao also couldn’t have managed to gather so many people.
At this moment, the difference in the ideas of the people around Hong Dali could be obviously seen.

Tang Muxin pulled his hand. “Dali, be careful, they have too many people. Why not wait for Boss Jin’s people to come first.” This little lass wasn’t afraid that these hooligans would dare to hurt them, she was afraid that Hong Dali would be accidentally injured in the chaos.

Mu Zixiao excitedly licked his lips. “Damn it, I can finally enjoy myself today!” This fellow seemed to think that he was the protagonist of those novels where the main character could defeat anyone and everyone who stood in his way.

As for Geezer Wang, he said, “Looks like I have to be hard on them. Otherwise, they won’t be easily settled.” This old fellow’s movements were slippery like a loach. Unless those hooligans used mud to cover all openings on their body, they would be helpless against Geezer Wang.

The three male lackeys valiantly stood beside Hong Dali, each carrying an ax—it was more practical to follow Young Master than buying insurance. Even if they sacrificed themselves, the Hong Family would repay their families.
As for those from Sanquan Gang—these people each had an ax with them and smiled coldly at those hooligans.

Speaking of which, professional gangsters and those small hooligans who were just for show were totally different in terms of their mental quality. These people totally paid those small hooligans no regard at all. After all, in a group fight, the most important factor was to see who was fiercer than the other—they had an ax each, who did they need to fear!

Since they had already seen each other, Hong Dali and his group alighted from the cars. By this time, the hooligans had already surrounded them. Their expressions were quite frightening and malevolent, but Hong Dali totally ignored them. He just stood there and smiled coldly towards the entrance to Wan Hao nightclub. The hooligans were slightly dazed—they had probably never seen before people coming for a fight and bringing along women and old people with them. What was even more surprising for them was that the leading Young Master seemed to be quite familiar...

At this time, two extra people appeared in front of the entrance to the nightclub. The entrance was a revolving door, but these two people were standing outside guarding the door instead of standing inside. It was obvious that they were bouncers. They were still quite polite and asked from afar, “Are you guys here to cause trouble?”
This was probably the first time that the words “cause trouble” were said so politely ever since they were was created.
Hong Dali: “Something like that. You can also say that I’m here to find someone.”

“Then, please hold on a moment.” These two bouncers had probably heard that Hong Dali had real fighting experts on his side, so they were obedient like cats instead of their usual behavior. “We will ask our boss to come out now.”
Then, they went in.
Hong Dali touched his nose and looked at Tang Muxin who was beside him. “Xinxin, do you think they will bring out a table, then we will sit down, drink tea and talk?”
Tang Muxin violently nodded. “I think this is possible!”

Actually, it wasn’t because they were scared by Hong Dali’s behavior and appearance. The main reason was—just seeing the three Prayer Angels and the Soaring Angel alone was enough to scare them. Even if Yao Tianhao had ten guts, he would also not dare to immediately start a fight with them.
As Hong Dali and the rest were waiting for them to ask Yao Tianhao to come out, a hooligan suddenly shouted, “You are Chui Chui! You are my favorite Chui Chui!”

Then, the hooligan who had “Chui Chui, I Love You” tattooed on his elbow pounced on Hong Dali and hugged his leg, disregarding the fact that he might be beaten up. “Chui Chui, you are Chui Chui! My favorite Chui Chui!” Then, he started crying. “Chui Chui, it’s me! I’m your fan who refreshes the website every day! From day to night, I keep refreshing So Cool’s website. When willUnexpectedly! release the second episode! Can you give me some insider info, please!?”
“...” Hong Dali softly said, “Get up, quickly get up! This is embarrassing!”
“No! I shan’t!” The small hooligan actually started acting coquettishly. “If you don’t tell me when the second episode will be released, I will not get up today!”

Speaking of which, professional gangsters and those small hooligans who were just for show were totally different in terms of their mental quality.
These people totally paid those small hooligans no regard at all.
After all, in a group fight, the most important factor was to see who was fiercer than the other—they had an ax each, who did they need to fear!
Since they had already seen each other, Hong Dali and his group alighted from the cars.
By this time, the hooligans had already surrounded them.
Their expressions were quite frightening and malevolent, but Hong Dali totally ignored them.
He just stood there and smiled coldly towards the entrance to Wan Hao nightclub.
The hooligans were slightly dazed—they had probably never seen before people coming for a fight and bringing along women and old people with them.
What was even more surprising for them was that the leading Young Master seemed to be quite familiar...
At this time, two extra people appeared in front of the entrance to the nightclub.
The entrance was a revolving door, but these two people were standing outside guarding the door instead of standing inside.
It was obvious that they were bouncers.
They were still quite polite and asked from afar, “Are you guys here to cause trouble?”
This was probably the first time that the words “cause trouble” were said so politely ever since they were was created.
Hong Dali: “Something like that.
You can also say that I’m here to find someone.”
“Then, please hold on a moment.” These two bouncers had probably heard that Hong Dali had real fighting experts on his side, so they were obedient like cats instead of their usual behavior.
“We will ask our boss to come out now.”
Then, they went in.
Hong Dali touched his nose and looked at Tang Muxin who was beside him.
“Xinxin, do you think they will bring out a table, then we will sit down, drink tea and talk?”
Tang Muxin violently nodded.
“I think this is possible!”
Actually, it wasn’t because they were scared by Hong Dali’s behavior and appearance.
The main reason was—just seeing the three Prayer Angels and the Soaring Angel alone was enough to scare them.
Even if Yao Tianhao had ten guts, he would also not dare to immediately start a fight with them.
As Hong Dali and the rest were waiting for them to ask Yao Tianhao to come out, a hooligan suddenly shouted, “You are Chui Chui!
You are my favorite Chui Chui!”
Then, the hooligan who had “Chui Chui, I Love You” tattooed on his elbow pounced on Hong Dali and hugged his leg, disregarding the fact that he might be beaten up.
“Chui Chui, you are Chui Chui!
My favorite Chui Chui!” Then, he started crying.
“Chui Chui, it’s me!
I’m your fan who refreshes the website every day!
From day to night, I keep refreshing So Cool’s website.
When willUnexpectedly! release the second episode!
Can you give me some insider info, please!?”
“...” Hong Dali softly said, “Get up, quickly get up!
This is embarrassing!”
“No!
I shan’t!” The small hooligan actually started acting coquettishly.
“If you don’t tell me when the second episode will be released, I will not get up today!”

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - I Enjoy Bullying Others in Numbers
paragraphs: There was an old saying that went like this: No one can stop a gangster who knows martial arts.
However, this hooligan’s ability to act cute was obviously mightier than knowing martial arts.

Hong Dali felt like hitting him but yet found it embarrassing to do so because he was, after all, his own die-hard fan. But if he didn’t hit him, letting him hug his leg in public under the view of hundreds was extremely inappropriate. Hong Dali was thus very torn. He was usually quick-witted, but he was stumped this time. He thought about it for a long while before finally clenching his teeth and saying, “Get up and I’ll sign you an autograph!”
“Autograph!” The hooligan perked up upon hearing that word. He rushed into the crowd shouting, “Brothers, come quickly! Chuichui said that he will sign his autograph for us if we serve him!”

“That’s not what I said...” Hong Dali was about going to deny it, but Tang Muxin pulled him vigorously. Hong Dali suddenly understood. He said, “That’s right. Follow me, and I’ll sign my autograph for you. You might even have a chance to be on screen in the future!”
To think Hong Dali shamelessly admitted it!

At that instance, about one-third of the hooligans surged up towards him noisily. What a rapid change in loyalty. Even the inept advisor Hai Qingtian who had been in the triads for more than a decade was speechless. Oh my, you’re going against the heavens!
This was when the situation got interesting.

The big group of hooligans was called over to buff up the numbers. Their loyalty was already questionable. They might still be able to handle it if they were needed to fight in a sure-win battle or to just wave the flags and shout. But against the super-rich Hong Dali, they were sure to suffer absolute defeat.
That was how this eye-popping scene unfolded.

Hong Dali had someone move a writing desk and had a notebook handed to him. It was just a regular handwriting practice book. He then plonked himself at the desk in the middle of the streets and started signing.
Hong Dali! Once the three words were signed, Hong Dali tore the page out with a swish and handed it to the hooligan in front of him. “Don’t rush, don’t rush. Wait for me to do it one by one.”

The male lackey behind him was in charge of maintaining order. “Young Master has orders, everyone is to queue up properly. Anyone who is willing to help us later will have a share! No cutting queue, don’t cause any trouble, or you will be cast out and left to die!”
The whole group of hooligans then formed themselves into lines straighter than those of an army dress parade during national day celebrations. They had probably never been so obedient.
The problem was, Hong Dali was good at many things, but his physical endurance was not that good. He started getting tired after signing for a while.

Yao Tianhao was really unlucky. Just as Hong Dali was getting tired of autographing, he led a whole group of people out from Wanhao Nightclub. Hong Dali took a casual glance and saw that they were all middle-aged men. Although it was not apparent from their dressing, from their tough demeanor, it was obvious that these were the real big shots inside the Cabinet Society.
One of the men was stout and stocky, looking just like the famous actor Big Silly. This must be the head of the Cabinet Society, Yao Tianhao.
Hong Dali smiled quietly. “Ah, sorry everyone, the main character is here. We will have to continue our autograph session later.”

It should have been time for the actual negotiations to begin and both sides should be getting their fight on and starting off with some opening banter. The problem was that seventy or eighty hooligans had yet to get their autograph. This was where things got troublesome.

This group of little hooligans couldn’t show Hong Dali their displeasure, so they turned their heads and directed their death glares at Yao Tianhao instead. Their expressions were fierce. It was as though he had killed their fathers.

When Yao Tianhao saw Hong Dali, he had originally intended to put on a show of might. He had to look imposing before they started negotiations. But seeing how big Hong Dali’s group was, and how menacing they seemed, looking at him as if he were their mortal enemy, his imposing manner was immediately taken down a notch. He took a few deep breaths before finally saying, “Friends, let’s take a seat and discuss the matter slowly. May I know what we have done to offend you? I’m not boasting but, although I may not be one of the most influential people in Tianjing City, neither am I some inconsequential person.”

He spoke cordially enough, but the problem was, Hong Dali saw through his ploy to first be polite and then bring out the troops. He immediately called out, “Cut the crap. Where is Bighead?” In actual fact, Hong Dali was feeling kind of despondent. After half a day, the other side did not even know what was happening. It was as if they got attacked for nothing. He definitely was going to win hands-down...

Although he was initially shocked, Yao Tianhao was not a man who got to where he was today without some abilities. He knew he had lost the battle but had to save some dignity. He called out, “Who is Bighead? How do I know where to find him?”
“Old Hai, tell him who was the small fry who offended me.” Hong Dali tossed his head back rakishly. “I should not need to waste my breath on such small matters.”

Hai Qingtian was playing the role of Hong Dali’s advisor today. Naturally, he had to step out to say something. “The younger brother of one of my Young Master’s henchmen was tricked by Bighead from your Society and took...”
Hong Dali whispered, “Blue Fantasy.”
Hai Qingtian said loudly, “Right, Blue Fantasy. He’s still in jail now trying to quit! You settle this matter.”
Yao Tianhao shouted wildly, “What Bighead! What Blue Fantasy?! I don’t know this person!”
Hai Qingtian said, “Bighead. His real name is Kong Guanghui, nicknamed Baldy Kong.”

Yao Tianhao was obviously stumped. “Eh...” To begin with, if they talked about Bighead, he had no idea who that was. But if they called him Baldy Kong, he knew who that was. The useless fool must have picked the wrong guy to trifle with this time. Unfortunately, he was getting dragged down as well. What a pain in the ass.
Yao Tianhao’s only mistake was not having enough accurate information.

Hong Dali was well-informed about the Cabinet Society that Yao Tianhao was in charge of. He knew how much territory they had and what their core activities were. Hong Dali even knew what kind of character Yao Tianhao was.

As for Yao Tianhao? Other than knowing that someone was here to create trouble and that the person was rich, he knew nothing else. He did not even know why they were here. Worse still, Bighead, aka Baldy Kong, had taken the job without his knowledge, and Yao Tianhao had no idea his man had offended such a big shot.

But that was just one man. As a triad boss, he had to help his men when they got into trouble, or he would lose his influence in the triads. It was lucky he was well prepared for the confrontation this time and so had little patience. Yao Tianhao pointed his finger at Hong Dali’s nose from afar and shouted, “I think we should sit down and discuss this. I don’t want to take advantage of you since I have more people...”
Just as Yao Tianhao said that, Hong Dali, who was sitting on the stool cross-legged, snapped his fingers and said, “Everyone who helps me fight will get 1,000 yuan each.”

The lackeys coordinated perfectly. They brought out a chest from the Prayer Angel’s trunk. When they opened the chest, it was filled with more than 500,000 yuan worth of red hundred-yuan bills. The two female lackeys took their positions with their cash counting machines.
The hooligans who came to buff up the numbers suddenly froze.
It was quiet all of a sudden.

A total of 300 hooligans stood in lines beside Hong Dali. The 50 Sanquan Gang members that Hai Qingtian brought had somehow increased to over a hundred. They all held coldly glinting axes in their hands...
Hong Dali laughed evilly at Yao Tianhao. “I enjoying bullying others in numbers...”

After being in the triads for so many years, it was the first time he had met someone cockier than him. Yao Tianhao trembled with rage, and it was then that he completely crumbled. His expression changed, and he said, fawning, “Young Sir, shall we not come to arms? No need to make this into such a big matter...” Actually, Yao Tianhao was quite the character. He understood when to back off when things were not to his advantage. He was actually much smarter than expected.

Hong Dali would do him no favors. His underling had tricked Xiaoyi’s younger brother. He could only blame it on his bad luck. Just as Hong Dali was about to order his men to go forth and oppress the opponent with their superior numbers, the low hum of a motor was heard. A pitch black super streamlined made a sudden turn and came to a screeching halt. The car pointed directly at Yao Tianhao and his men.
The only person who could make such a dramatic entrance was no other than the Blood Consort Lin Chuyin!

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - Full Missile Launch
paragraphs: Tang Muxin face-palmed. “Sigh, these people are goners.”

She then realized that the body of the super sports car, claimed to be 20 years in the world’s leading technology, emitted a mechanic squeaky sound. At the same time, Lin Chuyin’s indifferent voice echoed—this lass was announcing the name of her impending move. “Target confirmed. All-out Attack, begin... Full missile launch!”
When Lin Chuyin finished speaking, Hong Dali finally saw clearly what the interior of the car was equipped with...
The front of the car had four Gatling guns, there were three missile muzzles near the rear wheels of the car, the boot cover was opened, and in the boot were two warship artillery shells.

Hong Dali stared at it with his mouth agape. “This... this isn’t going to kill someone, is it?!” Everyone else around was also completely stunned. They thought they must still be dreaming. Wasn’t this a science fiction film set?

Yao Tianhao stared at the extremely high-tech sports car in front of him, bewildered. They were on the verge of an epic battle, and then this high tech sports car came in out of nowhere. Though the young lady driving the car was quite attractive...
He regretted.

The four Gatling guns mounted on the front of Lin Chuyin’s super sports car started to turn, making some kind of sizzling noise. Four rows of BB gun pellets fired like streams of water toward Yao Tianhao who was still looking at the car curiously.

Once the four Gatling guns started firing, cries of pain were heard. It was mentioned earlier that the BB pellets were capable of penetrating three-centimeter thick cardboard from a distance of twenty meters. It was gratifying to hit the triad members with them. The whole group was finished off amidst cries of pain.
Unfortunately for them, the attack had just begun.

It was not called “All-out Attack” for nothing. The other contraptions could not be left idling. The two cannons on the body of the car started firing cannons. One, two, three, four, five, six... Six white plastic cannonballs were fired in the time it took to take a breath. The cannonballs exploded mildly once they hit the ground within the crowd, and a cloud of unidentified red smoke was emitted. The explosion was mild, but the strange red powder inside was not so harmless...
The triad brothers started coughing violently. As they coughed, they frantically wiped tears from their eyes.
Hong Dali’s hairs stood on end as he asked in a small voice, “That... That... Xinxin, what is that red stuff?”

Tang Muxin was somewhat familiar with such occurrences and replied slowly, “It’s a mix of red pepper powder and mustard powder. Getting hit by the stuff... the feeling is... erm... not bad...” By the end of her explanation, that was all she could come up with.

Even if Tang Muxin didn’t say anything, Hong Dali could see from the tormented expressions on their faces that a mix of red pepper and mustard powder was not something he wanted to be near. Just thinking about it was enough to make him turn and run.

Just then, the last cannon started firing. The back of the super sports car had a row of cannons mounted on it, and they started firing cannonballs skyward. The cannonballs zinged through the air and arched gracefully across the sky, finally exploding in front of Wanhao Nightclub.
They were filled with itching powder...
That was how a group of triad members cried in pain and sneezed with burning, tearing eyes and randomly laughed out loud.
The battle started quickly and ended even more quickly.
Within two minutes, 70 or 80 powerful triad brothers all laid flat on the ground. None of them could get up.

The scene was chaotic. The surrounding hooligans and ruffians who used to be full of bravado were now shaking violently in fear. Many of the less brave was still trembling thinking about what happened. The ones who were swayed by Hong Dali’s bribes were the most affected. If they had not switched sides so decisively, it would be them paving the streets.
There were numerous little hooligans whose teeth chattered nonstop, making atat tat tatsound. Their legs tried to remain straight, but it was impossible.

It was only now that Hong Dali understood how Lin Chuyin got her moniker of Blood Consort. If she had wanted to, she could have changed the gear in her car with something more damaging. The scene would have then been Asura hell.
Luckily Lin Chuyin was still on good terms with him at the moment. They were still good buddies in cahoots with each other.

Lin Chuyin finally opened the door, got out of the car, and walked slowly towards Hong Dali. As she moved quietly forward, the three, four hundred little hooligans subconsciously backed away from her. By the time she reached Hong Dali, there was an empty space of fifty square meters around her. There were only Hong Dali with Tang Muxin and the Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin within that circle.

With regards to the Blood Consort, Tang Muxin had never thought of her as a normal human being. It was more like a playful child meeting the robot Doraemon. “Big Sister Blood Consort!” Tang Muxin ran happily to Lin Chuyin and hung on to her wrist.
Lin Chuyin did not reject Tang Muxin’s gesture of affection. She had no reaction whatsoever. She just looked at Hong Dali stonily and asked, “Hey, why are you not at your coming of age ceremony?”
Her voice was ice cold but held a tinge of concern.

The tinge of emotion was not obvious, but Tang Muxin was relatively familiar with her and could sense that the usually emotionless geek seemed to treat Hong Dali somewhat differently from other people.

Hong Dali chuckled and ruffled his hair. “Oh, this group of people bullied my underling, so I came for revenge.” He quickly explained the situation and said, “Regardless, I’m their Young Master. If my underlings get bullied, I have to stand up for them!”
Lin Chuyin did not display any objections to the matter, but she did not encourage him either. “Uh, now that the matter is resolved, go back?”

Hong Dali glanced at Yao Tianhao who was obviously completely wiped out. He thought for a while and said, “Erm, I think I need a little more time. There are some matters I need to settle. After all, I cannot leave things here the way they are.”
Lin Chuyin nodded and said, “Uh, ok. I’ll wait.”

Hong Dali happily waved over his three top lackeys, Mu Zixiao, and Geezer Wang. To Hong Dali, who resolved to be a happy prodigal son, the most important thing when he was out was his safety. He had to be on his guard against the opponent who could jump up at any moment and attack him.
As a prodigal son with ambitions, morals, and logic, it was a given that he should not go headlong into danger by himself.
And so, Yao Tianhao, who was lying beaten on the streets, sighed. He had lost his last chance.
After Hong Dali left, Lin Chuyin mumbled to herself, “If I were the one who got into trouble, would he help me too?”
Tang Muxin was resolutely on Hong Dali’s side this time. “Definitely. Although Dali may not seem very down to earth, he treats his friends quite well.”
Lin Chuyin tilted her head to one side. “Uh... This is being in cahoots with someone? It feels... not bad.”

Hong Dali, with his top three lackeys, as well as the two top fighters, Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang, strutted toward Yao Tianhao. Hong Dali squatted to take a look at the unlucky triad boss and shrugged. “I’m sorry about your current predicament, I did not expect her to show up either.”
Yao Tianhao asked fearfully, “Who... Who is that little lass?!”
It was no wonder he was despondent. The existence of Lin Chuyin was unfathomable to normal people such as him.
Hong Dali frankly said, “She is just a technology geek. The kind who could build a satellite herself.”

Yao Tianhao was unsure what kind of living thing a technology geek was, but hearing that she was able to build her own satellite, Yao Tianhao knew that he was really down on his luck today. “O... Ok. I’m resigned to my fate.” There was no hope in getting even. Someone who could build her own satellite was a genius who was highly sought after. The government was sure to have covert protection for them. It definitely was not someone who he, who could barely be called influential, could touch.
And so, Yao Tianhao decisively said, “What are your terms? Tell me.”

It was Hong Dali’s turn to be slightly shocked. “You’re pretty straight-forward. You’re admitting defeat just like that? No words like ‘As long as the mountains stand and the rivers run, we will meet again’?”
Mu Zixiao muttered under her breath, “That’s what the mountain bandits say, no one in today’s triads says things like that anymore...”

Yao Tianhao turned over with much difficulty. “What’s the point of saying that?” He was all dirty and disheveled after Lin Chuyin’s super “All-out Attack,” and there were still tears in his eyes. “I have been completely crushed today. I might as well get it over and done with quickly, at least then I can still retain some of my pride.”
He felt a sudden surge of despair. “You brought out all the big guns for just one underling, is it worth it?”

He was not exaggerating. No matter what, he was at least a triad boss with a hundred over underlings under him. This Young Master attacked him without a second thought. It was the first time he had met someone even more unreasonable then himself. He had been crushed just like that. It was bad enough that he lost pathetically. Worse, he didn’t even know what happened.
“It’s worth it.” Hong Dali asked curiously, “If I can’t protect my people, then how would I keep my standing in the world?”

Yao Tianhao felt a sudden wave of envy for Hong Dali’s lackeys. “Your underling is quite the lucky one. They have such a dependable boss. Sigh. Forget it. Tell me, what do you want from me? Lay it out.”
Hong Dali thought about it and felt kind of despondent. “Actually, I have not decided what to do.”

Yao Tianhao shrieked. “You came without knowing what you wanted?! What about me? I got beaten up without knowing why. There isn’t even a chance that I could take revenge, and in the end, there isn’t even any closure for me?”
He suddenly felt like crying. Was today the day his unlucky stars were all aligned? This was not how things should be!
Mu Zixiao teased laughingly. “You’re the perfect example of one who got fired upon despite being innocent. To be honest, I feel quite sorry for you.”
Yao Tianhao’s tears were already at the corner of his eyes. “Even so, It should not be this way. Who would be able to take it?”

Hong Dali shrugged. “Okay. I was a little too impulsive today.” He rubbed his chin and thought about it. Suddenly, his eyes lit up and he said, “Why don’t we do this. You can follow me in the future. I don’t mind more underlings.”

sentences.text: Tang Muxin face-palmed.
“Sigh, these people are goners.”
She then realized that the body of the super sports car, claimed to be 20 years in the world’s leading technology, emitted a mechanic squeaky sound.
At the same time, Lin Chuyin’s indifferent voice echoed—this lass was announcing the name of her impending move.
“Target confirmed.
All-out Attack, begin...
Full missile launch!”
When Lin Chuyin finished speaking, Hong Dali finally saw clearly what the interior of the car was equipped with...
The front of the car had four Gatling guns, there were three missile muzzles near the rear wheels of the car, the boot cover was opened, and in the boot were two warship artillery shells.
Hong Dali stared at it with his mouth agape.
“This... this isn’t going to kill someone, is it?!” Everyone else around was also completely stunned.
They thought they must still be dreaming.
Wasn’t this a science fiction film set?
Yao Tianhao stared at the extremely high-tech sports car in front of him, bewildered.
They were on the verge of an epic battle, and then this high tech sports car came in out of nowhere.
Though the young lady driving the car was quite attractive...
He regretted.
The four Gatling guns mounted on the front of Lin Chuyin’s super sports car started to turn, making some kind of sizzling noise.
Four rows of BB gun pellets fired like streams of water toward Yao Tianhao who was still looking at the car curiously.
Once the four Gatling guns started firing, cries of pain were heard.
It was mentioned earlier that the BB pellets were capable of penetrating three-centimeter thick cardboard from a distance of twenty meters.
It was gratifying to hit the triad members with them.
The whole group was finished off amidst cries of pain.
Unfortunately for them, the attack had just begun.
It was not called “All-out Attack” for nothing.
The other contraptions could not be left idling.
The two cannons on the body of the car started firing cannons.
One, two, three, four, five, six...
Six white plastic cannonballs were fired in the time it took to take a breath.
The cannonballs exploded mildly once they hit the ground within the crowd, and a cloud of unidentified red smoke was emitted.
The explosion was mild, but the strange red powder inside was not so harmless...
The triad brothers started coughing violently.
As they coughed, they frantically wiped tears from their eyes.
Hong Dali’s hairs stood on end as he asked in a small voice, “That...
That...
Xinxin, what is that red stuff?”
Tang Muxin was somewhat familiar with such occurrences and replied slowly, “It’s a mix of red pepper powder and mustard powder.
Getting hit by the stuff... the feeling is... erm... not bad...” By the end of her explanation, that was all she could come up with.
Even if Tang Muxin didn’t say anything, Hong Dali could see from the tormented expressions on their faces that a mix of red pepper and mustard powder was not something he wanted to be near.
Just thinking about it was enough to make him turn and run.
Just then, the last cannon started firing.
The back of the super sports car had a row of cannons mounted on it, and they started firing cannonballs skyward.
The cannonballs zinged through the air and arched gracefully across the sky, finally exploding in front of Wanhao Nightclub.
They were filled with itching powder...
That was how a group of triad members cried in pain and sneezed with burning, tearing eyes and randomly laughed out loud.
The battle started quickly and ended even more quickly.
Within two minutes, 70 or 80 powerful triad brothers all laid flat on the ground.
None of them could get up.
The scene was chaotic.
The surrounding hooligans and ruffians who used to be full of bravado were now shaking violently in fear.
Many of the less brave was still trembling thinking about what happened.
The ones who were swayed by Hong Dali’s bribes were the most affected.
If they had not switched sides so decisively, it would be them paving the streets.
There were numerous little hooligans whose teeth chattered nonstop, making atat tat tatsound.
Their legs tried to remain straight, but it was impossible.
It was only now that Hong Dali understood how Lin Chuyin got her moniker of Blood Consort.
If she had wanted to, she could have changed the gear in her car with something more damaging.
The scene would have then been Asura hell.
Luckily Lin Chuyin was still on good terms with him at the moment.
They were still good buddies in cahoots with each other.
Lin Chuyin finally opened the door, got out of the car, and walked slowly towards Hong Dali.
As she moved quietly forward, the three, four hundred little hooligans subconsciously backed away from her.
By the time she reached Hong Dali, there was an empty space of fifty square meters around her.
There were only Hong Dali with Tang Muxin and the Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin within that circle.
With regards to the Blood Consort, Tang Muxin had never thought of her as a normal human being.
It was more like a playful child meeting the robot Doraemon.
“Big Sister Blood Consort!” Tang Muxin ran happily to Lin Chuyin and hung on to her wrist.
Lin Chuyin did not reject Tang Muxin’s gesture of affection.
She had no reaction whatsoever.
She just looked at Hong Dali stonily and asked, “Hey, why are you not at your coming of age ceremony?”
Her voice was ice cold but held a tinge of concern.

The tinge of emotion was not obvious, but Tang Muxin was relatively familiar with her and could sense that the usually emotionless geek seemed to treat Hong Dali somewhat differently from other people.
Hong Dali chuckled and ruffled his hair.
“Oh, this group of people bullied my underling, so I came for revenge.” He quickly explained the situation and said, “Regardless, I’m their Young Master.
If my underlings get bullied, I have to stand up for them!”
Lin Chuyin did not display any objections to the matter, but she did not encourage him either.
“Uh, now that the matter is resolved, go back?”
Hong Dali glanced at Yao Tianhao who was obviously completely wiped out.
He thought for a while and said, “Erm, I think I need a little more time.
There are some matters I need to settle.
After all, I cannot leave things here the way they are.”
Lin Chuyin nodded and said, “Uh, ok.
I’ll wait.”
Hong Dali happily waved over his three top lackeys, Mu Zixiao, and Geezer Wang.
To Hong Dali, who resolved to be a happy prodigal son, the most important thing when he was out was his safety.
He had to be on his guard against the opponent who could jump up at any moment and attack him.
As a prodigal son with ambitions, morals, and logic, it was a given that he should not go headlong into danger by himself.
And so, Yao Tianhao, who was lying beaten on the streets, sighed.
He had lost his last chance.
After Hong Dali left, Lin Chuyin mumbled to herself, “If I were the one who got into trouble, would he help me too?”
Tang Muxin was resolutely on Hong Dali’s side this time.
“Definitely.
Although Dali may not seem very down to earth, he treats his friends quite well.”
Lin Chuyin tilted her head to one side.
This is being in cahoots with someone?
It feels... not bad.”
Hong Dali, with his top three lackeys, as well as the two top fighters, Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang, strutted toward Yao Tianhao.
Hong Dali squatted to take a look at the unlucky triad boss and shrugged.
“I’m sorry about your current predicament, I did not expect her to show up either.”
Yao Tianhao asked fearfully, “Who...
Who is that little lass?!”
It was no wonder he was despondent.
The existence of Lin Chuyin was unfathomable to normal people such as him.
Hong Dali frankly said, “She is just a technology geek.
The kind who could build a satellite herself.”
Yao Tianhao was unsure what kind of living thing a technology geek was, but hearing that she was able to build her own satellite, Yao Tianhao knew that he was really down on his luck today.
Ok.
I’m resigned to my fate.” There was no hope in getting even.
Someone who could build her own satellite was a genius who was highly sought after.
The government was sure to have covert protection for them.
It definitely was not someone who he, who could barely be called influential, could touch.
And so, Yao Tianhao decisively said, “What are your terms?
Tell me.”
It was Hong Dali’s turn to be slightly shocked.
“You’re pretty straight-forward.
You’re admitting defeat just like that?
No words like ‘As long as the mountains stand and the rivers run, we will meet again’?”
Mu Zixiao muttered under her breath, “That’s what the mountain bandits say, no one in today’s triads says things like that anymore...”
Yao Tianhao turned over with much difficulty.
“What’s the point of saying that?” He was all dirty and disheveled after Lin Chuyin’s super “All-out Attack,” and there were still tears in his eyes.
“I have been completely crushed today.
I might as well get it over and done with quickly, at least then I can still retain some of my pride.”
He felt a sudden surge of despair.
“You brought out all the big guns for just one underling, is it worth it?”
He was not exaggerating.
No matter what, he was at least a triad boss with a hundred over underlings under him.
This Young Master attacked him without a second thought.
It was the first time he had met someone even more unreasonable then himself.
He had been crushed just like that.
It was bad enough that he lost pathetically.
Worse, he didn’t even know what happened.
“It’s worth it.” Hong Dali asked curiously, “If I can’t protect my people, then how would I keep my standing in the world?”
Yao Tianhao felt a sudden wave of envy for Hong Dali’s lackeys.
“Your underling is quite the lucky one.
They have such a dependable boss.
Sigh.
Forget it.
Tell me, what do you want from me?
Lay it out.”
Hong Dali thought about it and felt kind of despondent.
“Actually, I have not decided what to do.”

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - Found a Coal Mine? Iron Mine? Hot Spring?
paragraphs: Yao Tianhao scanned Hong Dali from head to toe. “Follow you?! I’m the leader of the Cabinet Society. Why would I follow you?!”

It was no wonder he was depressed. He was a triad leader who was capable of summoning wind and calling for the rain, after all. But now, not only was he being taken advantage of and received a beating, he was further humiliated having to follow someone else. He couldn’t take revenge on the young lady, and there was nothing he could do about this young master as well...

Hong Dali looked up at the sky and said, “Actually, it’s not bad following me. You see, I will let you have a car of your own, and you get about ten thousand monthly. There is no restriction on your freedom. And if anything happens to you, I will settle it for you. Aye, now it seems like I’m on the losing end...”
Yao Tianhao was not stupid. Before Hong Dali could take back his words, Yao Tianhao promptly agreed. “Don’t say anything more, I’ll do it!”
Mu Zixiao was dumbfounded. “Damn it! Aren’t you agreeing too easily?!”

Yao Tianhao said, “I’d be a fool to take my time to decide! Dedicated car, ten thousand yuan a month, unrestricted freedom, Young Master’s protection... Where else could I find such a good deal! Do you think I’m stupid!”
Mu Zixiao curiously asked, “You don’t look like you’re strapped for cash. Don’t you own a few companies?”
It was Yao Tianhao’s turn to wonder. “That’s right. But I didn’t say I was going to forfeit them!”
“...” Mu Zixiao felt like he was punched by his own logic.
It was not long ago they were trying to kill each other. Just a blink of an eye and they became allies?!

Since Hong Dali had already said it, there was no way he could take back his words. “Eh... Alright. You will follow me with your bunch of brothers, then. When we get back, I will assign a car to you, the kind with good specs, just like that one.” Hong Dali pointed to the Prayer Angel parked a distance away. “Since you are now under me, you have to look good. Xiaoyi...” Hong Dali had called Xiaoyi out of habit. But Xiaoyi was not there, and he felt slightly despondent. “Forget it. Wait for two more days. My number one lackey is not here. It’s too troublesome to arrange it myself.”

It was not for no reason that Hong Dali was so angry. Xiaoyi was his left and right-hand man. Hong Dali was a lazy bum, it was easy for him to give instructions. But it was a headache to get involved in arranging and settling matters. Hong Dali was all bummed-out when he thought of it. “Anyway, I will assign your first task. Locate that big head, Baldy Kong, or something. I want to him see, dead or alive!”
Yao Tianhao decisively responded, “Yes... Yes, I understand! I will update you once I have any news. Oh, how do I address you in the future? Young Sir?”
“You can call him Young Master.” The male lackeys around Hong Dali knew his preference. “That salutation is good.”
Yao Tianhao promptly corrected himself. “In that case, Young Master, I will follow you in the future!”

Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Hmm, not bad. Tip, 10,000. Come along. Follow me to attend my coming of age ceremony. I have not thought of anything else for you to do. Maybe my father will have some ideas. Let’s go!”
Fengyuan Lake, Yangtze River Golden Cruise.

It was half past eight. The guests who arrived at the venue were starting to get impatient. But they had just gotten the news that Hong Dali was already on the way. It helped that everyone heard that he had gone to help his people; hence, they were less irritable. There weren’t many young people who would take such good care of people under them these days.
With the guests less impatient, as a host, Hong Weiguo also felt more at ease.

“Old Tang, how is your medical research getting along?” Hong Weiguo was then sitting on a sofa in the hall of the cruise with Tang Ruisi. He smiled as he said, “It seems that Tang Muxin is having a lot of fun with Dali recently. These two kids are also considered childhood sweethearts, haha.”

“The company is still the same, progress is slow. As for the kids, as long as they’re having fun, it’s good.” Tang Ruisi and Hong Weiguo’s families had had a deep relationship since way back. Tang Ruisi was glad to hear what Hong Weiguo said. Although they had prepared to reject the marriage arrangement after the crisis, that was due to Hong Dali’s worthlessness. After all, no one would wish for their own daughter to marry an incompetent prodigal son.

Fortunately, the things that Hong Dali had fiddled with recently weren’t too bad. Profitable or not, at least the money didn’t go to nothing. What Tang Ruisi wanted was very simple. Hong Weiguo had a big family and ran a big business. As long as Hong Dali wasn’t an idiot, it was okay to squander a little. He was more concerned about Hong Dali’s health. He quickly took the chance and whispered, “Weiguo, I heard that your Dali’s health has improved recently?”

This matter was confidential. But Tang Ruisi was not an outsider, and he trusted his character. Hence, Hong Weiguo did not hide the truth. “Old Tang, to be honest, I know what you’re thinking of. But I understand too, she is your flesh and blood. Since you asked, let me tell you something...”

Hong Weiguo moved closer to Tang Ruisi’s ear and whispered, “My Dali has gotten a lot better recently. Although he might not be running and jumping everywhere, if you’re thinking about gaining a granddaughter or grandson, that should be no issue!” As he finished his words, he winked at Tang Ruisi. Even a blind person could tell the meaning behind it.

Tang Ruisi was surprised. “Are you serious! Weiguo, don’t you lie to me! Our kids get along relatively well. To be honest, I was most worried about Dali’s health. No one would wish for their daughter to become a widow or be childless, right? It’s not a joking matter.”
Hong Weiguo smiled as he said, “Why would I lie about this? I don’t think I have ever lied to you about anything, right?”

Tang Ruisi was elated to hear that. “Haha, that’s great. Very good! My Xinxin is my precious baby. I don’t even bear to lay a finger on her or scold her. Good thing she’s a sensible girl. Your Dali seems to be doing well these days. Much stronger than before. Let’s leave them be, what do you think?”

Tang Ruisi might have planned to reject the arranged marriage initially, but that was because Hong Dali was weak and squandered too much. Now, even though Hong Dali spent a lot, but his luck was good. Nothing he fiddled with had lost money. His health was good, nothing major. There was no reason to reject the marriage, then. That would be the perfect ending for both families. Happiness was the most important thing.

Hong Weiguo was clearly in a good mood. “Haha, sure! I know you love Xinxin. Any parent would understand. My Dali is thriving. Though what he’s fiddling with might not be very profitable, at least there is no loss. I can’t promise much, but judging from the inheritance that I’m going to leave for Dali, from the way he is squandering, it would take him more than two lifetimes to finish it. So don’t worry too much.”
Tang Ruisi took a deep breath. “Yes, we’re all parents. There was nowhere else I couldn’t turn to previously, which is why I made that decision.”

“Hehe, don’t stand on ceremony. Our fathers knew each other so well, and we grew up together. Don’t say things like that.” Both families bared their hearts, and there were no hard feelings between them. That would make a big difference if they were to become in-laws in the future. Hong Weiguo said, “Old Tang, let me know if you need help with your company. I have an organization in charge of medicine development. Previously, it was used to develop medicine to improve Dali’s health. Dali probably doesn’t need it now. I could gift it to you.”

Tang Ruisi shook his head. “That’s a good idea, and I really would like to have it. But think about it. Dali can do what he wants outside now without you being worried—that’s partially because outsiders are aware that his health is bad and don’t treat him as a target, right?

“But once you gift the organization to me, others will start to suspect. And if anyone tries to harm Dali and it distracts you from your work, it would not be a good thing. Your family business is big, and it might not fall easily. But if it falls, it would be hard for you to do anything. And others won’t give you a chance too. We have to be more careful handling this matter.”

Hearing what Tang Ruisi said, Hong Weiguo nodded and said, “Yes. I was too happy and did not think of that. We will leave things as such, then. Just let me know if you need any help. Based on the relationship of our families, as long as you say the word, I will help you.”
“Deal. I won’t hold on ceremony, then. Hehe.”
As their conversation came to an end, someone suddenly ran in and looked all around the hall. When he saw Hong Weiguo, he ran over in an instant and whispered into his ear.
When he was gone, Hong Weiguo exclaimed, “Is that true?”
The man spoke with a low voice, “Yes, guaranteed the truth.”
“Okay. I understand. You may leave first.” Hong Weiguo waved his hand, and the man left.
“What could have made Weiguo worked up?” Tang Ruisi was curious as he saw Hong Weiguo’s expression.
“This is interesting.” Hong Weiguo did not bother to hide any as there wasn’t anyone around. “You know about the outer circle of Tianjing Mountain? The land that I bought for Dali.”
“Yes, what about it?” Tang Ruisi was puzzled. “Don’t tell me a gold mine was found?”
“Hehe, no such luck. Moreover, if they had found a gold mine, that piece of land would have to be handed over.” Hong Weiguo laughed as he said, “Come to think of it, this is thanks to Dali.”
Tang Ruisi truly felt that Hong Dali was an amazing person. It seemed everything was related to him. “What about Dali? Found a coal mine? An iron mine? Hot spring?”

“None of those.” Hong Weiguo smiled as he said, “Dali liked that place, so I bought it. But I’m not sure what happened after. Perhaps he thought it was too dirty, so he paid someone to clean up the place.
“It’s nothing. Just spending some money in exchange for his pleasure. So I let him be. But guess what happened?”
Tang Ruisi asked, “Found ancient ruins? Antiques?”

“Haha, none of those either. I should say I’m not sure.” Hong Weiguo said, “Someone found a cave opening near the peak of the mountain. The opening was small initially, hence the workers did not pay much attention to it. But they had cleared up the rubbish and did not have much to do, so they decided to enter the cave to explore. Who knew they would find something!”

“Hehe, don’t stand on ceremony.
Our fathers knew each other so well, and we grew up together.
Don’t say things like that.” Both families bared their hearts, and there were no hard feelings between them.
That would make a big difference if they were to become in-laws in the future.
Hong Weiguo said, “Old Tang, let me know if you need help with your company.
I have an organization in charge of medicine development.
Previously, it was used to develop medicine to improve Dali’s health.
Dali probably doesn’t need it now.
I could gift it to you.”
Tang Ruisi shook his head.
“That’s a good idea, and I really would like to have it.
But think about it.
Dali can do what he wants outside now without you being worried—that’s partially because outsiders are aware that his health is bad and don’t treat him as a target, right?
“But once you gift the organization to me, others will start to suspect.
And if anyone tries to harm Dali and it distracts you from your work, it would not be a good thing.
Your family business is big, and it might not fall easily.
But if it falls, it would be hard for you to do anything.
And others won’t give you a chance too.
We have to be more careful handling this matter.”
Hearing what Tang Ruisi said, Hong Weiguo nodded and said, “Yes.
I was too happy and did not think of that.
We will leave things as such, then.
Just let me know if you need any help.
Based on the relationship of our families, as long as you say the word, I will help you.”
“Deal.
I won’t hold on ceremony, then.
Hehe.”
As their conversation came to an end, someone suddenly ran in and looked all around the hall.
When he saw Hong Weiguo, he ran over in an instant and whispered into his ear.
When he was gone, Hong Weiguo exclaimed, “Is that true?”
The man spoke with a low voice, “Yes, guaranteed the truth.”
“Okay.
I understand.
You may leave first.” Hong Weiguo waved his hand, and the man left.
“What could have made Weiguo worked up?” Tang Ruisi was curious as he saw Hong Weiguo’s expression.
“This is interesting.” Hong Weiguo did not bother to hide any as there wasn’t anyone around.
“You know about the outer circle of Tianjing Mountain?
The land that I bought for Dali.”
“Yes, what about it?” Tang Ruisi was puzzled.
“Don’t tell me a gold mine was found?”
“Hehe, no such luck.
Moreover, if they had found a gold mine, that piece of land would have to be handed over.” Hong Weiguo laughed as he said, “Come to think of it, this is thanks to Dali.”
Tang Ruisi truly felt that Hong Dali was an amazing person.
It seemed everything was related to him.
“What about Dali?
Found a coal mine?
An iron mine?
Hot spring?”
“None of those.” Hong Weiguo smiled as he said, “Dali liked that place, so I bought it.
But I’m not sure what happened after.
Perhaps he thought it was too dirty, so he paid someone to clean up the place.
“It’s nothing.
Just spending some money in exchange for his pleasure.
So I let him be.
But guess what happened?”
Tang Ruisi asked, “Found ancient ruins?
Antiques?”
“Haha, none of those either.
I should say I’m not sure.” Hong Weiguo said, “Someone found a cave opening near the peak of the mountain.
The opening was small initially, hence the workers did not pay much attention to it.
But they had cleared up the rubbish and did not have much to do, so they decided to enter the cave to explore.
Who knew they would find something!”

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - Let us all eat and drink well!
paragraphs: “No way! Just like that?” After hearing what Hong Weiguo said, Tang Ruisi was shocked. “Dali just picked a piece of land randomly and found something good? Underground?”
Having said that, Tang Ruisi had a sudden surge of emotion. He suddenly felt like he had overlooked something.

Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Yes, right. Speaking of which, there aren’t any ancient ruins or mines of any sort there. However, the commercial value of that piece of land is undeniable.” Hong Weiguo took a sip of his tea and laughed. “Below that mountain is a huge karst cave. Do you remember there was a stream there? The cave where the stream originates from is an enormous karst cave. We’re not sure of the condition, but workers who entered were sure of one thing—the cave is very, very big.”
Tang Ruisi choked on his saliva. “My god!” He was really shocked this time. “Karst cave? You just need to explore it slightly and it could become a tourist attraction. How much would that be worth?!”
It was no wonder he was so shocked.

All they had to do was fix up the huge underground karst cave a little, and it could be a super money-making tourist attraction. Just the entrance fees for one year would earn at least tens of millions.
After the brief shock, Tang Ruisi wondered. “How was it that no one discovered the place before? By rights, if there were such a good place, it should have been found by the land surveyors long ago?”

Hong Weiguo said laughingly, “Why else would we say our Dali has good luck? It was raining in the first two days, and that caused a small landslide. It was fated. The entrance to the caves was smashed open by the falling rocks from the landslide.”
Hearing that, Tang Ruisi was stunned. That much luck... wasn’t it like cheating!?

Having said that much, the two heard a sudden chorus of congratulations from the entrance of the hall. Hong Weiguo turned his head to look and saw a group of people rowdily walk in. The happily smiling leader of the group was his son, Hong Dali.
Hong Dali quickly made his way toward Hong Weiguo. “Dad, I’m back. I’m late, I’m late. Hehe. Hello Uncle Tang!”
Tang Muxin, who was with Hong Dali, quickly greeted as well. “Hello, Uncle Hong.”

“Hello, Xinxin. Haha. You little brat, you’ve got some leadership skills. You know how to protect your followers.” Hong Weiguo’s eyes twinkled in happiness whenever he looked at Hong Dali. Even as he looked around at Hong Dali’s lackeys, his gaze was approving. Hong Dali may have spent quite a big sum on today’s matter, but the rewards were significant. His lackeys were looking at him like pious believers looking upon their God. It was pure idolatry. In today’s slang, it was loyalty to the max.

Hong Weiguo then stood up and pulled Hong Dali and Tang Muxin into the crowd. Hong Weiguo made introductions. “Dali, let me introduce you to someone. This is the Head of Police, Police Chief Dong. Say hello to Uncle Dong.”
Hong Dali greeted him. “Hello, Uncle Dong. Uncle Dong, you’ll have to take care of me if I need help in the future. Hehe.”

Dong Huarong knew Hong Dali’s importance in Hong Weiguo’s heart and quickly replied. “Haha. Sure. No problem. It’s unexpected that you would take such good care of your followers, Dali. That’s good. Haha.”

Hong Weiguo pointed at Boss Jin next. “This is Boss Jin. He is very influential in the triads. Uncle Jin and Uncle Dong were the ones who helped you when you said you wanted to get rid of the Cabinet’s Society.”
Hong Dali didn’t dare to disrespect him. “Hello, Uncle Jin! Uncle Jin, please take care of me in the future.”

Boss Jin had been around for many years and was good at judging people. “Well said. With a great father like you, your son is sure to be great himself. Dali is indeed not bad. You are decisive and brutal enough, willing to go all out. That bunch of fools said you are a prodigal son. The way I see it, you are not just an ordinary prodigal son! Haha! Aiya, to be honest, I don’t dare accept money for such a small favor, but I’m aware CEO Hong doesn’t like to be indebted to people, so I accepted a token sum. Don’t mind me.”
Everyone laughed.
Li Nianwei saw Dali coming in but hesitated. She wanted to go over but didn’t dare to. It was Hong Weiguo who finally waved her over. “Nianwei, come over. We’re one family, after all.”
Having gotten Hong Weiguo’s permission, Li Nianwei finally put her mind at ease and went over to Hong Dali. She asked gently, “Young Master, is everything all right over there?”
Hong Dali smiled and held Li Nianwei’s hand. “It’s ok. It’s just a small matter. Sister Nianwei, you look beautiful tonight.”
Li Nianwei sighed. “Too bad I couldn’t be of any help to Young Master. But I feel better now that Young Master has arrived.”
Hong Dali already saw an attendant pushing in a three-meter high gigantic birthday cake. He said, “All right, all right. Let’s not talk about that anymore. The ceremony is starting, right?”
Hong Weiguo said, smiling, “Of course. Since our little wastrel is here. Quick go get changed, you’re not appropriately dressed. Everything has been prepared for you. Quick go.”
A butler had already approached and led the way for Hong Dali.
They arrived at the place quickly. Two female servants approached. Obviously very professional in undressing people, Hong Dali was down to his underpants in less than twenty seconds...

Looking at his naked body in the mirror, Hong Dali felt slightly uneasy. “Er... Erm, Butler, it doesn’t have to be too formal, right?” He had never actually seen or attended anything like a coming of age ceremony.
Butler Hao clapped his hands and said, “Don’t worry, Young Master. Everything has been prepared for you. We will be done soon. Let’s begin.”

Soon, a few servants approached holding plates. The two female servants who were skilled at removing clothes started dressing Hong Dali quickly. It seems the skill of undressing and dressing someone came as a set. They were fast and efficient.
While Hong Dali was getting dressed, the old butler gave a running introduction.

“Old Master has specially prepared this Golden Edition Mariusz Calibrea 66 for you. It costs 5.12 million Swiss Francs and has twenty-five amazing and complicated functions. One of them is a built-in ten thousand year calendar which enables it to work for 28 centuries without needing any adjustments. As one of the watches with the most complicated functions in the world, it has a limited edition. Only four were produced—Gold, white gold, rose gold, and platinum.”
Hong Dali: “...”

“This pair of Tonys men’s leather shoes cost thirty-eight thousand USD. It uses top quality crocodile leather from around the world and was carefully handmade using traditional Norwegian shoe-making techniques. The thread used to sew the shoes is specially made linen thread. The lining is made of the softest sheepskin. The buckles are diamond encrusted gold. The top of the shoe is perfectly formed and attaches to the sole accurately. The shoe-making technique consists of more than two hundred steps, making the shoe light yet comfortable. It maintains a standard of comfort regardless of hot, cold, or wet weather.”
Hong Dali: “...”

“The champagne that we will be having at the coming of age ceremony is Lafitte. It’s one hundred and sixty thousand USD per bottle. Old Master spent a lot of time and effort obtaining it. There are only six bottles in the world. Soon, there will only be five left.”
Hong Dali: “...”

Five minutes later, dressed in blinding top grade luxury products from head to toe, Hong Dali stood in front of the microphone. He felt like he was in a dream, which resulted in him only blurting out one sentence after clutching on the microphone for a long time.
“Everyone, please eat and drink to your heart’s content!”
Everyone laughed as Hong Dali said this.
“Poosh!” “Hahaha!” “That’s funny!” “Young Master Dali is great!” The voices cried out in unison.

Lan Ruoxi, who was mingling with the other guests, walked over slowly and tapped lightly on Hong Dali and chided. “You little rascal.” Although she had called him “little rascal,” her eyes were full of adoration with no trace of anger. She said laughingly, “How is it that you did not prepare a few more words to say at such an important event? Quick, say a few more words.”
Hong Dali blushed and scratched his head. “Erm...” After trying for a long time, he blurted out, “Well then, everyone, eat and drink to your heart’s content!”
Everyone burst out laughing this time. Hong Weiguo’s face reddened and chided Dali laughingly. “That’s enough, little brat. Go along and play with your classmates. This is really...”
It was no wonder he was blushing. It was really something for a coming of age ceremony to be this grand...

Hearing that, Hong Dali let out a long sigh. It was finally over. In the past, he was most afraid of speaking publicly at occasions like this. He could chit-chat, but having to speak publicly was like asking him to die.
It was good that everyone knew Hong Dali was much doted on. All the guests just smiled kindly and did not say much.
It was still a huge mess.
After Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi made a long and magnificent speech, the coming of age ceremony was almost at an end.
Hong Weiguo heaved a quiet sigh of relief. It was really tough managing situations like this. “Hur, this little brat. I told him to prepare himself well before coming.”

Just as he was going to take a break, a man who was dressed like a country bumpkin walked tentatively toward him. He asked quietly, “Are, are you CEO Hong?” The man was dusty and muddy all over, and his face was as dirty as a beggar’s, streaked with dirt. He was quite stocky and looked fierce. The two differing traits mixed together had a strange effect that was hard to describe.
The only person who could still appear here even though he was in such a state of disarray was the boss of the Cabinet Society that Hong Dali had just taken over, Yao Tianhao.
Speaking of which, Yao Tianhao had been to hell today and then dragged to heaven.

He had been completely humiliated by Lin Chuyin previously and thought he was at the bottom of the pit, but things had worked out and he became Hong Dali’s henchman. The benefits were unexpectedly good—he had a dedicated vehicle to use and had an allowance of ten thousand dollars a month. The best part was that he had unlimited freedom to do as he wished. This was the most amazing thing ever.

He became the boss of the newly formed “Axe gang.” The three to four hundred little hooligans that Hong Dali had previously bought over were all brought into the ranks, and his might was greater than before.

Although his influence had grown exponentially, he was still shell shocked when he realized that the young master before him was the great prodigal son, Young Master Hong Dali, who had helped Li Nianwei rise to fame. Yao Tianhao hugged Hong Dali’s leg and refused to let go. He cried out loudly, “It’s you, it’s you! You’re my idol!” He was then violently kicked away by Hong Dali...
Today turned out to be a blessing in disguise for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - Brother, I Can Only Help You This Much...
paragraphs: Hong Weiguo had trouble organizing his thoughts as he looked at the country bumpkin in front of him. “You are...” By rights, only the truly influential people of Tianjing City could be here today. Even if they had some eccentricities, it was unthinkable that they would dress like a beggar. The important thing was, Hong Weiguo had absolutely no impression of this man in front of him.

Yao Tianhao spoke with some difficulty. “I’m Yao Tianhao.” The tightly restrained manner of the man before him was putting him under great pressure. “That, that is, I was the pre... the previous head of the Cabinet Society...”

Although they were not on friendly terms previously, there must be a reason for him to appear here. “Well, welcome.” Hong Weiguo was able to maintain a cordial manner and said, “Come, this way please.”
Yao Tianhao was slightly stunned. “O... Okay.”

The middle-aged man before him was obviously upper class from top to toe. It seemed as if he were facing a high mountain, but when the man spoke to him in a friendly manner, it felt like he was very gentle. Although Yao Tianhao used to be a triad boss, in front of Hong Weiguo, he still felt like he was unable to extend his full potential.
They arrived at a quiet corner.
Hong Weiguo held his pipe in his hand and wore a smile on his face. “Please, have a seat. May I know the reason you are here?”

Yao Tianhao sat down uneasily and quickly explained the situation from beginning to end. “Ah, it’s like this. I have a good-for-nothing henchman who plotted against Young Master Dali’s people behind my back. Young Master Dali then brought a significant number of people and came looking for me. The outcome, as CEO Hong can see, is that I got beaten up rather badly.”
His words matched with his current appearance, causing Hong Weiguo not to know whether to laugh or to cry. It appeared that Yao Tianhao was quite comical...

No matter what, Yao Tianhao was a triad boss. This was not something to be proud of. He said awkwardly, “I got beaten up, but I had no idea why until everything was over. Then I realized what happened and that I deserved the beating. It’s my bad luck. There’s nothing to be done about it, though. For those in our world, whoever has the biggest fist has the upper hand. I accepted my fate. However, Young Master Dali asked me to follow him in the future and be his henchman...”
It was Hong Weiguo’s turn to become stunned. “Eh...” He never thought his son would bring a triad boss into his employ. What mischief was he planning...
Hong Weiguo asked, “Erm, Mr. Yao, you mean...”

Before Hong Weiguo could finish his sentence, Yao Tianhao quickly waved his hand. “CEO Hong, please do not call me that. I’m unworthy of that. Sir, please call me Tianhao or Big Yao. Better if you just call me Biggie. That’s what I was called since young.”
Hong Weiguo asked, “Okay, Tianhao, you mean to say you will be our Dali’s henchman in the future? Like the other people around him?”

Yao Tianhao simpered as he scratched his head. “Erm, I don’t think so. Young Master asked me to look for you when I get here to ask if there was anything you need me to do. Young Master does n’t intend to get involved in the triads. He took me in just for fun, so I’m actually quite troubled too. I don’t know what I can do here, and the benefits Young Master offered me were quite significant.”

Hong Weiguo had no objections to any of Hong Dali’s endeavors. “So that was what happened.” He thought about it and said, “There’s nothing I need you to do. I think you can just do whatever you want to at the moment while waiting for his further instructions.”

Yao Tianhao was taken aback. “Ah? In that case, o... okay. I will go ask Young Master if he has anything planned.” He walked away with a troubled expression on his face. Sometimes, it was not a good thing when the benefits were too good and there was nothing that needed to be done. He didn’t feel comfortable about it.
On the other side of the hall, where Hong Dali’s classmates were gathered.
Hong Dali walked over with Tang Muxin. “Wahahaha! I can finally take a break!” Hong Dali said, laughing, “Everyone waited till they are impatient? What are you all playing here? It looks fun!”
Ling Yi said, “Brother Dali, you’re here? Du Xinzhen is hitting on a girl. It’s the most crucial timing now!”

This was exciting news. Hong Dali looked towards the two people surrounded by his classmates. “Du Xinzhen is looking for a girlfriend?!” There was nothing to be said about Du Xinzhen, but the girl who was sitting next to him looked delicate and pretty. Hong Dali stared at them with his eyes wide opened. He said, “Du Xinzhen’s target this time looks pretty good. She looks delicious—she’s even holding a stalk of rose in her hand. Has she accepted his confession of love?”
Ling Yi said, “No, the lady says she wants to use the rose to see if she should agree.”
Hong Dali decided to stay and watch. “Wow, wow. That’s super!”
Soon, the girl started to pluck off the petals—
“No, yes, no, yes, no, yes... No. ” The girl plucked out the last rose petal and spoke to Du Xinzhen sadly, “It’s heaven’s will. We’re not compatible.”
Hong Dali watched with his mouth agape. “That’s so sad. There should at least be a fifty percent chance!”
Du Xinzhen was at a loss. “Xiao Lan, it doesn’t count this time. Let’s try again!”
The girl, whose name was Xiao Lan, thought about it and nodded. “In that case... okay.”
Du Xinzhen saw Hong Dali making his way toward them and rushed over to ask for help. “Big Bro Dali, please help me think of something. Your brother’s lifelong happiness depends on you!”
Hong Dali mumbled, “Oh... Okay...” He plucked a four-leaf clover from somewhere and handed it to the girl. “No need for a rose this time. Let’s use this!”
The girl was touched as she accepted the four-leaf clover. “Okay! Yes, No...”
Hong Dali hugged Du Xinzhen. “Brother, Big Bro can only help you this much...”
Du Xinzhen hugged Hong Dali too and cried bitterly as he said, “I yield to my fate...”
All the onlookers broke into side-splitting laughter.

The two of them stood together forlornly for a while. Just then, Yao Tianhao came over. As soon as he saw Hong Dali, he bowed and asked, “Young Master, don’t you think I should be doing something? I will feel bad otherwise...” Yao Tianhao might have been a triad boss in the past, but he was still of a totally different level when compared to the Hong Family. Now that he had connections to the affluent Hong Dali, it was inevitable that he wanted to please his master.
Hong Dali was only thinking about his heartbroken friend at that moment and was in a bad mood. He answered flippantly, “If you have nothing to do, bring some men and go play a game or something!”

Yao Tianhao was a triad boss, it would be more normal if he were to bring his men out to fight over territories. But to bring his men out to play games, that would be ridiculous. “Eh...” However, since Young Master had given the order, he had to agree to it. He asked carefully, “Then, Young Master, what game should we play?”
Hong Dali huffed impatiently. “How would I know what game to play?” Suddenly, he had an idea. “Go play Draconic Continent with your men. This game is quite popular lately, and I heard it’s not bad.”

Yao Tianhao couldn’t do anything about it, but playing games was not a hard task. So, he agreed. “This... O... Okay... In that case, I will go back and gather some manpower, and fight for glory in the game!”
Hong Dali waved his hand. “Fine, whatever. Just go.”

Yao Tianhao walked away, perplexed. He was a triad boss, but the first thing he was supposed to do after following Young Master was to play internet games. Sigh, it was like going from fighting in real life to fighting in the virtual world. It was just as well, let the little brats see what the Axe Gang was capable of!
As they watched Yao Tianhao leave somewhat dejectedly, the classmates asked, “Big Bro Dali, what does that man do?”
Ling Yi said, “Maybe he’s the head of the Beggar Sect!”
Du Xinzhen said, “Just by looking, I can guess that this man knows martial arts. Eh, Big Bro Dali. Tell us, what does he do?”

Hong Dali sniffled and laughed. “He was actually a triad boss who had a run-in with me. He was unlucky and happened upon Chuyin visiting me. After that, all of you should be able to imagine what happened.”
Ling Yi said, “My god, he’s really pitiful... He’s lucky to be still able to walk after meeting the Blood Consort.”
Du Xinzhen said, “Yes, yes. If it were anyone else, they probably would have been completely screwed over.”

Hong Dali said smiling, “Actually, he was. I saw that he was down on his luck and so took him in as a henchman. You have no idea. When I was in the car, he showed me his body. It was covered in bruises. Chuyin’s Gatling Gun is too powerful, hehe!”

Ling Yi said, “That goes without saying! If the Blood Consort wants to kill someone, she has a thousand ways to do it. Although she has no feelings, she understands she cannot overdo it. Du Xinzhen: “Attending a gathering with friends.”
The girl: “Are there many people? Is there good food?”
Du Xinzhen: “Of course. There are many people and a lot of good food.”
The girl: Can I go too?”

It was just the wistful request of a little girl. Du Xinzhen, however, decided to shut her down and delete her from his life. He even scolded, “You want to freeload at such a high-class event? No way!”
Hong Dali kicked him to the ground angrily. “Serves you right if you’re single your whole life!”
Du Xinzhen finally came round. He pounded his chest, crestfallen. “Damn, how is it I didn’t think of that? She practically threw herself at me! Ahhhhhh!”
Everyone was dumbfounded.
While everyone was laughing away, Ling Yi suddenly cried out, “Everyone, watch out. Here comes the Blood Consort!”
As soon everyone heard that, they shushed and turned their heads to look. Blood Consort Lin Chuyin was slowly walking toward them!
The crowd turned silent in an instant.
Lin Chuyin stopped in front of Hong Dali and asked, “Are you free tomorrow?”
Hong Dali was temporarily shocked but quickly nodded. “Eh? Free. I will make sure I’m free!”
Lin Chuyin continued, “Mm, okay. In that case, come to the laboratory tomorrow. I have a newly installed setup.”
