chapters.title: Chapter 178 - I Have Special Recitation Skills
paragraphs: How could Hong Dali miss something like that? His eyes lit up like a light bulb. “New setup! Okay! I will be there tomorrow!”
“Oh, I will go back first...” As she spoke, Lin Chuyin turned around and left without looking at anyone else.
The classmates shouted, “Big Bro Dali is mighty and powerful! That’s the Blood Consort! Blood Consort! She actually invited Big Bro Dali on her own accord!”
Tang Muxin put her finger on her lips and asked curiously, “Sister Chuyin is a little weird today. She has never taken the initiative to invite anyone to her laboratory. Dali, you... Dali?”
It was no wonder Tang Muxin was shocked. One could see the stars of happiness in Hong Dali’s eyes. He was drooling. “Haha... new setup... Hahahaha... It must be pretty amazing... Hahaha...”
Tang Muxin pinched Hong Dali’s ears. “Hong Dali! Do you have to be so happy!”
Hong Dali shook his head hard. “Happy! Of course, I’m happy! Why would I not be happy? I have to be happy. Who else would be happy if not me?!”
“Who cares about you!” Tang Muxin turned her head away angrily but suddenly exclaimed. “Dali, Liu Mingxin is walking over. And there’s someone with him whom we have never seen before.”

Hong Dali looked over. “Eh? Old Liu is here too?” He chuckled as he welcomed them. “Old Liu, you are actually here? Haha. Who is this big brother? He must be someone to be able to walk alongside you!”

Liu Mingxin was graceful as usual and smiled kindly as he spoke, “Hehe, happy coming of age ceremony. Congratulations on becoming eighteen. Speaking of which, your speech was really...” Liu Mingxin didn’t know how to continue to praise Hong Dali. He held his breath for two seconds, then and finally said, “It was really special.”

Hong Dali was embarrassed. “Haha, that, that is...” He then looked toward Liang Yifeng, who was standing beside. “This big brother... you look so handsome and chic. Why don’t you introduce yourself, hehe.”

To call him “handsome and chic” on their first meeting, Liang Yifeng was slightly self-satisfied. He quickly introduced himself, “Hello, hello. I’m Liang Yifeng. I came uninvited today. Haha. I like reciting poetry and am okay with singing too. Of course, it would be better with beautiful ladies. Haha, hahaha.”
Okay at singing and with beautiful ladies, but reciting poetry was the main point?

Hong Dali was surprised as he asked, “You... you like to recite poetry? That’s pretty rare. What kind of poetry do you like to recite?” This Liang Yifeng looked like he came from southern Guangdong. There was a slight Cantonese slang when he spoke.

It seemed like Liang Yifeng really enjoyed reciting poetry. “Shall I recite a section for you? Yes yes, the poetry that I’m reciting is ‘Overnight at Master’s Mountain Lodge When Ding Failed to Arrive.’ Listen carefully!”
Hong Dali understood there and then what it meant by as easy as crushing weeds and smashing rotten wood, simply unstoppable.

Liang Yifeng’s recitation was cadenced and rich in feelings, and his voice had its ups and downs. Sometimes, he cast flirtatious looks; sometimes, he stretched his neck and looked around. Sometimes, he even set his eyes far away as though he was admiring the scenery.
That sorrowful expression, superb acting, expression, and actions complemented each other. Raising his head and pursing his lips at times, the surrounding audience had only praises for him!
In actual fact, his recital was just his hobby. But he had forgotten one thing—he was surrounded by the nouveau riche. With their phones and internet speed...

Just as he finished the recital, those unreliable nouveau riche classmates around Hong Dali had shared it on the internet. His distressed expression, and the different tones of his voice, it was simply amazing. It would be effortless for him to join All-Stars. Hong Dali was already rolling on the floor laughing and managed just one sentence. “Your recital is so stupendous. Does your family know?”

Liang Yifeng looked contented when he finished reciting. “That’s a must. I have practiced this for years!” The feeling he got from people looking at him was as though he had just rolled on the bed with a girl he liked1. “I have special recitation skills. For example, in the early part of the poem, I pretended to look around the scenery, with the corresponding action. In the last sentence of the poem ‘Playing lute under a wayside vine,’ because this poem depicts the author waiting for a friend, so I needed to continue to look around. Aye, it’s a pity that in this time and era, people are too impetuous and exaggerated. Everyone is defeated by money, attracted by women. Fewer and fewer people are in contact with poetry, which has deep meaning and connotation. It’s the great misfortune of the people of the Heavenly State. The great misfortune!!”

Hong Dali agreed fully and nodded as he said, “In the world of literature, you are indeed very expressive and creative, Old Liang. I think that with your skill, a show with you in it is sure to be popular!”
Liang Yifeng was shocked. “A show? A TV show? To think I will be suitable for TV shows?”

Hong Dali smacked his thigh and said, “Of course! I even thought of the name of the show! It will be ‘Old Liang Recites Poetry’! We’ll get a table, place a cup of tea on it, you can hold a fan and recite poetry for the TV viewers. Then you can explain the meaning behind the poetry, and the goodness of it. All others aside, Old Liang, just with your looks and appearance, your sorrowful expression, you living in poetry... I’m sure that will attract more people to enjoy the charm of ancient poetry recitation. You will definitely be popular!”

Hong Dali continued with his glib tongue, “Think about it, the young people are not in much contact with ancient poetry. They cannot understand the feelings and meaning of it. You can encourage them to come in contact with it. This is a good deed that will benefit them for generations to come. Not anyone could do that!”
Tang Muxin was almost rolling on the ground laughing when Hong Dali finished speaking. This Hong Dali was really mischievous.

Liu Mingxin burst out in laughter as well. “Haha, I think that works! Old Liang, you’ve traveled the world and have come in contact with everything. Not just ‘Old Liang Recites Poetry,’ I think you can produce a show called ‘Old Liang and the World.’ Just with your knowledge and exposure, you are sure to be popular!”

Hong Dali decisively concluded for Liang Yifeng. “Yes, yes, yes! Old Liang, allow me to say something. Think about it, students these days sit in their classrooms all day. What can they learn? Nothing, right? If you go on TV, parents are sure to allow their kids to watch you. At that time, the viewership ratings will definitely go up. Old Liang, you will be popular! I can pull some strings with Tianjing Satellite TV and introduce you to some people. How is that?”

While Hong Dali and Liu Mingxin chimed each other’s thoughts, Liang Yifeng was a little light-headed. He had enjoyed poetry from a young age and had depended on it to chase after girls. If he were to go on a TV show and became popular, wouldn’t he have the chance to meet some stars? With his family background, it would be a piece of cake to be surrounded with the ladies!
He instantly smacked his thigh. “Deal. I’ll do it!”

With his mind made up, Liang Yifeng turned around to leave. “I have to go back and do some preparations. Poetry is our country’s treasure. I can’t mess it up. Aye, as a new-age man with ideals and aspirations, I have to do my best...”

After he walked a few meters away, he smacked his head. “Damn, I was distracted. I was intending to challenge him properly. Who knew I got distracted before I even initiated anything? This can’t do, I need to go back. All things aside, I want to see who has better luck with women!”
There was a priority in everything. He must not forget his purpose for coming.
As he was turning around, Liu Mingxin stopped him and pointed toward Hong Dali. “Don’t bother competing. Take a look first.”
Liang Yifeng turned his head to look. “Look at what— What?!”

It was such a coincidence. Just as Hong Dali was done settling everything on hand, Li Nianwei came to see him. She smiled as she waved to him from far. “Young Master, I finally have some free time. Your speech was really funny.”
Seeing Li Nianwei approaching him, Hong Dali need not to worry about his pillow. “Sister Nianwei! I’m tired! Quick, come here!”

In an amazing stroke of luck, he tripped over one of the waiters in his hurry. Liang Yifeng stood afar dumbfounded as he saw Hong Dali stagger. Li Nianwei got anxious and stepped forward to hold Hong Dali.Puu.As Hong Dali’s landed on Li Nianwei’s pushed up bosom...

Watching the scene in front of him, Liang Yifeng’s eyes almost popped out. His jaw dropped, forming an ‘O’ shape. “Oh man, how is that possible?!” He felt cold air rush from the soles of his feet to the tip of his head.
That was blatant cheating!

Liu Mingxin shrugged his shoulders helplessly. “See it now? You’re courting death if you’re trying to compete with Dali. I’ve known him for quite a while now. I try to avoid any direct confrontation with him and will be glad if he doesn’t look for me.”
Liang Yifeng had not come to his senses. He mumbled, “I... I saw it... Okay... I’ll heed your advice this time...”
As they spoke, a young man’s voice came from behind. “Hey, isn’t this Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng? You two actually came?”

Liu Mingxin turned his head to see a man dressed in clothes which brands he could not identify. But they must cost a lot. He was smiling and had a red birthmark in the middle of his forehead. Looking like Erlang Shen with his third seeing eye, he smiled as he said, “I was wondering who it was. It turns out to be brother Mu Zixiao. Hehe. I heard you came to the capital city. Why didn’t you look for me?”

Mu Zixiao laughed. “Haha, that can be easily arranged. East’s Mingxin, West’s Zixiao, South’s Yifeng, North’s Dali, it seems everyone is here today. That’s really rare. Old Liang, why are you here? I thought you would be in bed with some female star.”

Liang Yifeng laughed and said, “I came to take a look as I was curious. I didn’t think it would be a rewarding day, haha. Oh yes, Zixiao, shouldn’t you be training in Modo? What made you come all the way here? Don’t tell me, is it because of Hong Dali?”

Who else would be happy if not me?!”
“Who cares about you!” Tang Muxin turned her head away angrily but suddenly exclaimed.
“Dali, Liu Mingxin is walking over.
And there’s someone with him whom we have never seen before.”
Hong Dali looked over.
“Eh?
Old Liu is here too?” He chuckled as he welcomed them.
“Old Liu, you are actually here?
Haha.
Who is this big brother?
He must be someone to be able to walk alongside you!”
Liu Mingxin was graceful as usual and smiled kindly as he spoke, “Hehe, happy coming of age ceremony.
Congratulations on becoming eighteen.
Speaking of which, your speech was really...” Liu Mingxin didn’t know how to continue to praise Hong Dali.
He held his breath for two seconds, then and finally said, “It was really special.”
Hong Dali was embarrassed.
“Haha, that, that is...” He then looked toward Liang Yifeng, who was standing beside.
“This big brother... you look so handsome and chic.
Why don’t you introduce yourself, hehe.”
To call him “handsome and chic” on their first meeting, Liang Yifeng was slightly self-satisfied.
He quickly introduced himself, “Hello, hello.
I’m Liang Yifeng.
I came uninvited today.
Haha.
I like reciting poetry and am okay with singing too.
Of course, it would be better with beautiful ladies.
Haha, hahaha.”
Okay at singing and with beautiful ladies, but reciting poetry was the main point?
Hong Dali was surprised as he asked, “You... you like to recite poetry?
That’s pretty rare.
What kind of poetry do you like to recite?” This Liang Yifeng looked like he came from southern Guangdong.
There was a slight Cantonese slang when he spoke.
It seemed like Liang Yifeng really enjoyed reciting poetry.
“Shall I recite a section for you?
Yes yes, the poetry that I’m reciting is ‘Overnight at Master’s Mountain Lodge When Ding Failed to Arrive.’ Listen carefully!”
Hong Dali understood there and then what it meant by as easy as crushing weeds and smashing rotten wood, simply unstoppable.
Liang Yifeng’s recitation was cadenced and rich in feelings, and his voice had its ups and downs.
Sometimes, he cast flirtatious looks; sometimes, he stretched his neck and looked around.
Sometimes, he even set his eyes far away as though he was admiring the scenery.
That sorrowful expression, superb acting, expression, and actions complemented each other.
Raising his head and pursing his lips at times, the surrounding audience had only praises for him!
In actual fact, his recital was just his hobby.
But he had forgotten one thing—he was surrounded by the nouveau riche.
With their phones and internet speed...
Just as he finished the recital, those unreliable nouveau riche classmates around Hong Dali had shared it on the internet.
His distressed expression, and the different tones of his voice, it was simply amazing.
It would be effortless for him to join All-Stars.
Hong Dali was already rolling on the floor laughing and managed just one sentence.
“Your recital is so stupendous.
Does your family know?”
Liang Yifeng looked contented when he finished reciting.
“That’s a must.
I have practiced this for years!” The feeling he got from people looking at him was as though he had just rolled on the bed with a girl he liked1.
“I have special recitation skills.
For example, in the early part of the poem, I pretended to look around the scenery, with the corresponding action.
In the last sentence of the poem ‘Playing lute under a wayside vine,’ because this poem depicts the author waiting for a friend, so I needed to continue to look around.
Aye, it’s a pity that in this time and era, people are too impetuous and exaggerated.
Everyone is defeated by money, attracted by women.
Fewer and fewer people are in contact with poetry, which has deep meaning and connotation.
It’s the great misfortune of the people of the Heavenly State.
The great misfortune!!”
Hong Dali agreed fully and nodded as he said, “In the world of literature, you are indeed very expressive and creative, Old Liang.
I think that with your skill, a show with you in it is sure to be popular!”
Liang Yifeng was shocked.
“A show?
A TV show?
To think I will be suitable for TV shows?”
Hong Dali smacked his thigh and said, “Of course!
I even thought of the name of the show!
It will be ‘Old Liang Recites Poetry’!
We’ll get a table, place a cup of tea on it, you can hold a fan and recite poetry for the TV viewers.
Then you can explain the meaning behind the poetry, and the goodness of it.
All others aside, Old Liang, just with your looks and appearance, your sorrowful expression, you living in poetry...
I’m sure that will attract more people to enjoy the charm of ancient poetry recitation.
You will definitely be popular!”
Hong Dali continued with his glib tongue, “Think about it, the young people are not in much contact with ancient poetry.
They cannot understand the feelings and meaning of it.
You can encourage them to come in contact with it.
This is a good deed that will benefit them for generations to come.
Not anyone could do that!”
Tang Muxin was almost rolling on the ground laughing when Hong Dali finished speaking.
This Hong Dali was really mischievous.
Liu Mingxin burst out in laughter as well.
“Haha, I think that works!
Old Liang, you’ve traveled the world and have come in contact with everything.
Not just ‘Old Liang Recites Poetry,’ I think you can produce a show called ‘Old Liang and the World.’ Just with your knowledge and exposure, you are sure to be popular!”
Hong Dali decisively concluded for Liang Yifeng.
“Yes, yes, yes!
Old Liang, allow me to say something.
Think about it, students these days sit in their classrooms all day.
What can they learn?
Nothing, right?
If you go on TV, parents are sure to allow their kids to watch you.
At that time, the viewership ratings will definitely go up.
Old Liang, you will be popular!
I can pull some strings with Tianjing Satellite TV and introduce you to some people.
How is that?”
While Hong Dali and Liu Mingxin chimed each other’s thoughts, Liang Yifeng was a little light-headed.
He had enjoyed poetry from a young age and had depended on it to chase after girls.
If he were to go on a TV show and became popular, wouldn’t he have the chance to meet some stars?
With his family background, it would be a piece of cake to be surrounded with the ladies!
He instantly smacked his thigh.
“Deal.
I’ll do it!”
With his mind made up, Liang Yifeng turned around to leave.
“I have to go back and do some preparations.
Poetry is our country’s treasure.
I can’t mess it up.
Aye, as a new-age man with ideals and aspirations, I have to do my best...”
After he walked a few meters away, he smacked his head.
“Damn, I was distracted.
I was intending to challenge him properly.
Who knew I got distracted before I even initiated anything?
This can’t do, I need to go back.
All things aside, I want to see who has better luck with women!”
There was a priority in everything.
He must not forget his purpose for coming.
As he was turning around, Liu Mingxin stopped him and pointed toward Hong Dali.
“Don’t bother competing.
Take a look first.”
Liang Yifeng turned his head to look.
“Look at what— What?!”
It was such a coincidence.
Just as Hong Dali was done settling everything on hand, Li Nianwei came to see him.
She smiled as she waved to him from far.
“Young Master, I finally have some free time.
Your speech was really funny.”
Seeing Li Nianwei approaching him, Hong Dali need not to worry about his pillow.
“Sister Nianwei!
I’m tired!
Quick, come here!”
In an amazing stroke of luck, he tripped over one of the waiters in his hurry.
Liang Yifeng stood afar dumbfounded as he saw Hong Dali stagger.
Li Nianwei got anxious and stepped forward to hold Hong Dali.Puu.As Hong Dali’s landed on Li Nianwei’s pushed up bosom...
Watching the scene in front of him, Liang Yifeng’s eyes almost popped out.
His jaw dropped, forming an ‘O’ shape.
“Oh man, how is that possible?!” He felt cold air rush from the soles of his feet to the tip of his head.
That was blatant cheating!
Liu Mingxin shrugged his shoulders helplessly.
“See it now?
You’re courting death if you’re trying to compete with Dali.
I’ve known him for quite a while now.
I try to avoid any direct confrontation with him and will be glad if he doesn’t look for me.”
Liang Yifeng had not come to his senses.
He mumbled, “I...
I saw it...
Okay...
I’ll heed your advice this time...”
As they spoke, a young man’s voice came from behind.
“Hey, isn’t this Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng?
You two actually came?”
Liu Mingxin turned his head to see a man dressed in clothes which brands he could not identify.
But they must cost a lot.
He was smiling and had a red birthmark in the middle of his forehead.
Looking like Erlang Shen with his third seeing eye, he smiled as he said, “I was wondering who it was.
It turns out to be brother Mu Zixiao.
Hehe.
I heard you came to the capital city.
Why didn’t you look for me?”
Mu Zixiao laughed.
“Haha, that can be easily arranged.
East’s Mingxin, West’s Zixiao, South’s Yifeng, North’s Dali, it seems everyone is here today.
That’s really rare.
Old Liang, why are you here?
I thought you would be in bed with some female star.”
Liang Yifeng laughed and said, “I came to take a look as I was curious.
I didn’t think it would be a rewarding day, haha.
Oh yes, Zixiao, shouldn’t you be training in Modo?
What made you come all the way here?
Don’t tell me, is it because of Hong Dali?”

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - What a Cute Lolita...
paragraphs: “Haha, don’t mention that anymore. You could say that I gained a blessing out of misfortune.” Every time he mentioned this, Mu Zixiao’s face was full of happiness. “In the past, my dad owned someone a favor. That someone is the boss of Miss Nianwei’s old company. He wanted to sleep with her but failed, so he stopped her activities. You guys know about this, right?”

“I have heard of it. Everyone knows of this matter now.” Liu Mingxin smiled and said, “That’s why I was curious at first. With her capability on the stage, unless it was because her boss purposely prevented her from showing her face on stage, how come she was so unheard of in the past. Zixiao, so you came to Tianjing because of this reason?”

“Haha, that’s right.” Mu Zixiao smiled and said, “Then, because of the small favor my dad owned him, I had to show him some respect when he requested me to help him. Therefore, I planned to teach Dali a lesson. Naturally, I had to check on his background and everything before I made a move, so I asked around. Then, I found out that his luck was extraordinary, the kind that can trip over a gold bar when he goes out. His luck is so good that... hm, how should I describe it...”

“I have seen it for myself already.” Liang Yifeng was slightly depressed. “I’m really incomparable with him in this regard. Oh right, Zixiao, why don’t you give us an example. That will be clearer. I can also see to what extent his luck is at.”

“An example...” Mu Zixiao instantly felt that there were just too many examples available. Just then, a shadow flashed by from the corner of his eyes. He saw Geezer Wang excitedly running in the crowd, secretly up-skirting ladies’ dresses. His eyes immediately lit up. “Do you guys see that old fellow over there? The one up-skirting ladies?”

“What the heck, since when was there such a perverted old man here!?” Liang Yifeng’s eyes almost popped out. “This can’t do, how can he do such a despicable thing to those beauties, I have to go and stop him! Why did the security guards let this kind of people in!?”

“Don’t go!” Mu Zixiao pulled him back. “That old man is my Master now. He’s fine in other aspects, just that he is slightly perverted. When we just arrived at the filming crew, he took advantage of all the females there. When this old guy got caught, he acted grievously.” Saying so, Mu Zixiao talked in Old Wang’s manner. “‘My small penis can’t even stand erect, can’t I just take a look?’ Think about it, he already acted so pitifully, who would still be able to blame him. Then, this old guy continued going about up-skirting women. This was not the most frustrating thing about him, what was more frustrating was that no one was able to land a hit on him...”
“Haha, this old guy seems quite interesting.” Liu Mingxin laughed and said, “Speaking of which, Zixiao, which aspect is he your master? Acting? Is his acting skills very good?”
“Do I still need to learn to act from others?” Mu Zixiao proudly said, “He is my martial arts Master.”

Hearing Mu Zixiao says so, Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng were instantly stunned. Liang Yifeng said, “Are you for real? Zixiao, with your fighting skills, you still need to learn from him? He is at least 60 plus years old, right?”
Liang Yifeng had seen Mu Zixiao’s fighting skills before. His three bodyguards were defeated by him in just two breaths of time. This old guy was actually the Master of such a formidable person?

“He’s 77 years old this year.” Mu Zixiao grinned and said, “Don’t see that he is old. When he fights seriously, I can’t even last three moves. He is definitely a formidable person. If not, why would I willingly beg him to be my Master?”
“Sheesh!” Hearing Mu Zixiao says so, Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng instantly sucked in cold air.
They were well aware of Mu Zixiao’s capabilities, yet he couldn’t even last three moves under this old guy’s hands?

“Are you speaking the truth?” This time, even Liu Mingxin couldn’t keep his composure. “With your skills, you couldn’t even last three moves!? And from your tone, this old guy is Hong Dali’s subordinate?”

Liang Yifeng fiercely nodded. “If you said that you lost to him after fighting for 300 rounds, I would believe you. But you are telling me that you couldn’t even last three moves, three moves! You have even fought in underground illegal fighting clubs before, is that old man really that strong!?”
“I’m really not lying. In fact, I lost in just one move.” Mu Zixiao shrugged.

“Fine...” Liu Mingxin felt that he wouldn’t be surprised anymore now by anything that was related to Hong Dali. “So, where did Hong Dali find this old man? I know that his luck has always been very good.”
Who knew that Mu Zixiao actually shook his head. “Speaking of which, my Master wasn’t found by Hong Dali.”
“Oh?” Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng showed surprise. Liang Yifeng said, “Such a formidable person, and he wasn’t found by Hong Dali. It couldn’t be that he just fell from the skies, could it?”
“Alright, I didn’t want to give you a setback at first.” Mu Zixiao grinned and said, “Actually, he did fall from the skies—this old guy was actually a barber in a small barbershop for old people.”
Liu Mingxin: “...”
Liang Yifeng: “...”

Mu Zixiao continued, “This old guy has a habit of speeding, speeding on his electric scooter. As a result, he knocked onto Dali’s Soaring Angel’s rear mirror twice. The first time, Dali wasn’t concerned over it and just let him off. But one can do a mistake once but not twice. The second time, Dali didn’t just let him go directly. I was in the car at that time. The old guy was extremely nervous, but when they chatted, we found out that his fighting skills were very good. Then, Dali hired him for 5,000 yuan a month.”
Liu Mingxin: “...”
Liang Yifeng: “...”
After going silent for a long while.

Liang Yifeng shouted, “A 77 years old man that can defeat you in one move, and Hong Dali hired him for just 5,000 a month!? You must be kidding me! Others would definitely be willing to spend 50,000 a month to hire such a person!”

“It is 50,000 yuan a month.” Mu Zixiao said. “Dali realized that his martial arts were real, so he raised his salary. Speaking of which, I wanted to hire the old man for 100,000 yuan a month, but my Master rejected. Yup. Oh right, you guys don’t know, my Master has a special move called the Dragon Taming Palm! He can make a small tree as thick as one’s neck collapse with just one palm. If this palm landed on a human body...”

As he was speaking, an eerie voice suddenly sounded from beside him. “You rascal, what are you talking about, hurry up and go practice your martial arts!” When he finished his sentence, Mu Zixiao’s body lightly floated to two meters away. In his place, an old guy was standing there. “Are you two friends of Young Master Dali too? Oh my, you guys are really young and handsome. If only I was 50 years younger...”
Then, the old guy lightly floated away like a leaf.
Continuing to go about up-skirting the beauties in the crowd.
Liu Mingxin: “...”
Liang Yifeng: “...”
Still stunned, they suddenly heard a clear, crisp voice. “Oh, isn’t this Brother Liu, you are here too?”

Liu Mingxin and Liang Yifeng turned around and saw a beautiful young lady walking over, carrying a pure, gentle smile on her face. Her long hair hung on her shoulders, wearing a whole dress of white. The gentle lamplight reflected on her, casting glamor over her. Liang Yifeng was astonished upon seeing this fairy-like young girl. When she got closer, he saw that she was only about 14 to 15 years old. Her skin was white as snow, delicate like the flower. She was so beautiful that he couldn’t even look at her directly.

Liang Yifeng roamed all over the world normally, and he was always proud of the fact that he had met a lot of the top-notch female celebrities and beauties in the world. He could even resist the charm of the currently highly popular goddess Li Nianwei. However, he didn’t expect to see such lolita here. Ripples seemed to flow in her eyes, and her delicate cheeks were rosy. Although she was still young, she was a beauty that he had never seen before. Those women that he normally played with were nothing compared to her. Now, hearing her soft, gentle words, he felt his heart going numb and his bones going soft. The lolicon aspect of him in the subconscious part of his brain immediately exploded, and he was so mesmerized that he couldn’t even speak a word now.

Liu Mingxin had seen Lin Zixuan before. Thus, he smiled and said, “Oh, it’s Sister Zixuan. I was still wondering why wasn’t you present just now. Now, thinking of it, you must have been playing online games somewhere, right?”

“Hehe, your guess is really accurate, Brother Liu.” Lin Zixuan grinned and said, “Brother Dali wasn’t around just now, and I also don’t know anyone here, so I might as well go play some games. I owned those people for 100 plus rounds, then I felt that Brother Dali should be back when I looked at the time, so here I am. Oh right, where’s Brother Dali?”

“He’s over there.” Liu Mingxin pointed at Hong Dali who was lying on Li Nianwei’s thighs. “This fellow seems to have a special liking for Miss Nianwei’s thighs. I have heard quite a lot about how he prevented her from taking on advertisement projects because of this reason.”

“He’s just like that, living carefreely every day. Then, Brother Liu, you two continue with your chat, I’m going over to Brother Dali and play with him.” Lin Zixuan was going to leave as she said so, but she quickly turned back. “Oh right, Brother Liu, if you have the chance, give me some gold to spend. You’re the GM of the game, it will be a waste if I don’t use this resource, hehe.” After saying so, she bounced away.
“This little lass, hehe. She is really adorable.” Liu Mingxin murmured.
But very quickly, he realized that there wasn’t any movement from beside him. He turned around and was immediately shocked. “Old Liang, what’s wrong with you?”

Liang Yifeng was staring intently at the direction where Lin Zixuan had left. His saliva almost drooled out as he smiled like a fool, saying, “A lolita... what a cute lolita... hehehehe... hehehehe...”

“Hey, stop being a love-struck idiot. She is Hong Dali’s.” Liu Mingxin helplessly smiled and said, “You will end up in a very terrible state if you try to fight with Hong Dali for a woman, although he hasn’t really treated her as one yet.”

“Lolicon... lolicon is indeed the right way to go... hehehehe...” Liang Yifeng continued smiling foolishly for a while, then suddenly grabbed Liu Mingxin’s shirt. “Old Liu, where did this lolita pop out from! Tell me, now!”

This old guy was leisurely roaming around the world previously, and the number of female celebrities that he slept with was at least two to three hundred. His family was rich anyway, those female celebrities who were really pure were only a minority. Coupled with his handsome look and his skill in reciting poetries, those women were like a dry wood meeting a strong fire—they were instantly ignited by him.
However, he didn’t expect his charm to fail multiple times today!

There wasn’t a need to mention Li Nianwei, she was definitely the first-placed goddess in the country currently. In fact, he never thought about seducing her. After all, he was very clear about how she rose to fame. If he succeeded in seducing her, the Hong Family didn’t have a need to show their face anymore.
But who knew that he would meet such an extreme beauty like Lin Zixuan!?

The lolicon aspect of him in the subconscious part of his brain immediately exploded, and he was so mesmerized that he couldn’t even speak a word now.
Liu Mingxin had seen Lin Zixuan before.
Thus, he smiled and said, “Oh, it’s Sister Zixuan.
I was still wondering why wasn’t you present just now.
Now, thinking of it, you must have been playing online games somewhere, right?”
“Hehe, your guess is really accurate, Brother Liu.” Lin Zixuan grinned and said, “Brother Dali wasn’t around just now, and I also don’t know anyone here, so I might as well go play some games.
I owned those people for 100 plus rounds, then I felt that Brother Dali should be back when I looked at the time, so here I am.
Oh right, where’s Brother Dali?”
“He’s over there.” Liu Mingxin pointed at Hong Dali who was lying on Li Nianwei’s thighs.
“This fellow seems to have a special liking for Miss Nianwei’s thighs.
I have heard quite a lot about how he prevented her from taking on advertisement projects because of this reason.”
“He’s just like that, living carefreely every day.
Then, Brother Liu, you two continue with your chat, I’m going over to Brother Dali and play with him.” Lin Zixuan was going to leave as she said so, but she quickly turned back.
“Oh right, Brother Liu, if you have the chance, give me some gold to spend.
You’re the GM of the game, it will be a waste if I don’t use this resource, hehe.” After saying so, she bounced away.
“This little lass, hehe.
She is really adorable.” Liu Mingxin murmured.
But very quickly, he realized that there wasn’t any movement from beside him.
He turned around and was immediately shocked.
“Old Liang, what’s wrong with you?”
Liang Yifeng was staring intently at the direction where Lin Zixuan had left.
His saliva almost drooled out as he smiled like a fool, saying, “A lolita... what a cute lolita... hehehehe... hehehehe...”
“Hey, stop being a love-struck idiot.

She is Hong Dali’s.” Liu Mingxin helplessly smiled and said, “You will end up in a very terrible state if you try to fight with Hong Dali for a woman, although he hasn’t really treated her as one yet.”
“Lolicon... lolicon is indeed the right way to go... hehehehe...” Liang Yifeng continued smiling foolishly for a while, then suddenly grabbed Liu Mingxin’s shirt.
“Old Liu, where did this lolita pop out from!
Tell me, now!”
This old guy was leisurely roaming around the world previously, and the number of female celebrities that he slept with was at least two to three hundred.
His family was rich anyway, those female celebrities who were really pure were only a minority.
Coupled with his handsome look and his skill in reciting poetries, those women were like a dry wood meeting a strong fire—they were instantly ignited by him.
However, he didn’t expect his charm to fail multiple times today!
There wasn’t a need to mention Li Nianwei, she was definitely the first-placed goddess in the country currently.
In fact, he never thought about seducing her.
After all, he was very clear about how she rose to fame.
If he succeeded in seducing her, the Hong Family didn’t have a need to show their face anymore.
But who knew that he would meet such an extreme beauty like Lin Zixuan!?

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - [Grand League]
paragraphs: Currently speaking, all those women around Hong Dali were top-notch beauties with their own uniqueness. The gentle goddess Li Nianwei, the next door sister Tang Muxin, and he vaguely heard that the super technological geek Lin Chuyin’s relationship with him was not bad too. Now, another super lolita Lin Zixuan popped out. This caused Liang Yifeng to be filled with envy and jealousy. His only impression now was that all these years he was leaving in vain!
“Lin Zixuan?” Liu Mingxin smiled bitterly and shook his head. “This little lass was picked up by Hong Dali from the roadside when he was walking his tiger.”
“He picked her up!” Liang Yifeng felt his sense of logic being shattered all over the floor. “He manages to pick up such top-notch lolita just by casually walking on the streets!?”

“That’s why I say not to compare your luck with his.” Liu Mingxin helplessly said, “You wouldn’t end up well if you compete with him in this. All those that did ended up like you. OK, let’s not talk about this anymore. They are starting to cut the cake already. The coming of age ceremony should be ending soon.”
“OK.” Liang Yifeng was very demoralized. “Once the ceremony ends, I’m going to the streets to pick up a lolita as well...”
Therefore, the coming of age ceremony that should have been being grand and majestic casually ended.
The second day.

“Sigh, days without Xiaoyi around are really so frustrating.” Hong Dali boringly lay on his school table reading novels from his phone. “I have no idea of the progress of all the other stuff. Forget it, I shall just continue reading my novel.”

After a while of reading and giving some rewards to the author, Hong Dali took another nap. As he tossed around, in his mind he was contemplating on how to seek out that person. “Damn that Bighead, he really dares to take up any kind of job! He actually lured Ling Mufeng to eat that drug, this would put him in jail for at least a few years, wouldn’t it? When I find him, I’m going to teach him a proper lesson! I wonder how Old Yao is doing, is he working or not.”

Speaking of which, the nine lackeys all had their own use and job scope. Ling Xiaoyi had the most use—she was in charge of overseeing and arranging all those projects and orders that Hong Dali passed down. As for the three male lackeys, Li Yang ran the most errands while the other two were sturdy in build. The other five female lackeys were all quick-witted. Although they couldn’t help Hong Dali ease his workload like Ling Xiaoyi, they were efficient at dealing with all those minor labors and helped Hong Dali spare a lot of mental effort.
Now that Ling Xiaoyi was looking after her brother, Hong Dali was lacking a capable assistant at his side. Therefore, Hong Dali was having quite a headache.
Ring

After sleeping for a while, it was finally the end of school for the afternoon. In a daze, Hong Dali went out for a stroll. After just a few steps, he saw someone waving at him in the corridor. At first, he couldn’t see properly because his eyes were still a bit blurry. After Hong Dali rubbed his eyes and looked again, he was immediately amused. “Isn’t this that die-hard fan of mine?”
The one waving at him was the hooligan that hugged his leg yesterday and had “Chui Chui, I Love You” tattooed onto his elbow!
This fellow came looking for me, could it be that he has news? Hong Dali was curious and directly walked over. “Do you have any new updates from your side?”

“Young Master.” The hooligan followed his boss and called him “Young Master too,” his attitude quite polite. “Our boss came back yesterday... Yup, I’m explaining myself clearly. It was like this. Yesterday, didn’t Young Master ask us to follow Big Boss, and Big Boss also agreed. Therefore, after Big Boss came back yesterday, he told us to play games if we have nothing to do, and said that it was Young Master’s order...”

This fellow talked a lot, but he didn’t talk about the main topic. Although Hong Dali was vexed, he was helpless too. Very obviously, Yao Tianhao sent this guy to clear Hong Dali of any suspicion that he might have. After all, Hong Dali was familiar with this guy. If it were someone unfamiliar, it might be difficult for them to communicate.
“Yup, can you get to the main point?” Hong Dali kindly reminded him.

“Ah, OK. I’m a bit long-winded.” The hooligan hurriedly continued. “Simply speaking, the game was quite fun. Currently, everyone is gathered in one server, about 400 plus of us. All of us uses a family name—a sight to behold!”
“So awesome!” Hong Dali was instantly curious. “So, what family name did you guys use?”

“Our Big Boss thought very long for the prefix. Then, it seemed that he used to hang out in an online chat group in the past.” The hooligan smiled and said, “It was called something like grand league, so our family name is called [Grand League-], in this format.”
Hearing him say so, Hong Dali instantly imagined the scene.
Four hundred plus level one avatars standing together, the top of their heads showing [Grand League-XX]—this scene, it was definitely awesome!

“Awesome! Hahaha!” Hong Dali felt his heart itching. He thought for a while. Since there weren’t any plans for later, he might as well go and play too. “I shall go and play for a while too, haha. Wait for me to call some people over!” Saying so, he took out his phone and started calling. “Is this Zhiruo? Help me inform Ling Yi and the rest, we shall be going to the Internet cafe in the afternoon!”
Ji Zhiruo: “OK, Young Master Dali.”

Very soon, Tang Muxin, Ling Yi, and his other classmates arrived. Therefore, in the afternoon, this bunch of wealthy kids drove all sorts of luxury cars and went to the Internet cafe. When they stopped outside the cafe, the people inside were scared to the point of peeing in their pants. Who had ever seen people driving 30 plus luxury cars that cost at least 500,000 each to go to an Internet cafe? Many were frightened, thinking that some wealthy kids were offended by something or someone in-game and came over to beat them up. Hong Dali even saw some people crawling under the table, probably because they were afraid that blood might be spilled on them.

The boss of the Internet cafe was scared too. He wasn’t sure where Hong Dali and his group were from, so he begged for forgiveness before saying anything else. “Please, show mercy. I’m just doing a small business here...”
“Your Internet cafe doesn’t seem to be small.” Hong Dali looked at the signboard on top and then looked inside. “There should be at least 300 plus machines in here...”
The boss cried, “But if you really smash them all, I would really just be making a meager profit...”

Actually, those who were able to open Internet cafes normally had some sorts of underworld background. The problem was that Hong Dali’s entrance was too astonishing—one Soaring Angel, three Prayer Angels, and the rest all super-sports cars. It was akin to driving Rolls-Royce, Bentley, and Lamborghini to an Internet cafe in his previous life—one could imagine that scene.

Therefore, although the boss knew people from the pugilistic world, he still couldn’t handle this kind of scenario. As a matter of fact, even if Hong Dali and the rest smashed his Internet cafe, he would still not dare to say anything. They were on a totally different level, he could only blame on his own luck for the misfortune.
“Hehe, it isn’t that serious.” Hong Dali grinned and said, “We’re just here to play games.”
The boss was scared to the point of peeing again, thinking that Hong Dali’s “play games” referred to the game of smashing computers. “This Young Master, I beg of you, please be gentle later...”
“We’re really here to play games...” Hong Dali felt helpless. “Stop talking rubbish and open up 40 machines for us.”

“O... OK!” Upon hearing Hong Dali asking him to open up machines for him, the boss instantly got invigorated, and his waist didn’t ache and his legs didn’t hurt anymore. “My shop’s second-floor lounge has the best machines available, please use them as much as you wish. All expenses are free today!”
“Not bad, not bad. Reward, 1,000!” Hong Dali was delighted. “This service attitude is very good!”
Then, the male lackey started counting the money.
The Internet cafe boss: “...”

Everyone happily went up, turned on the machines, and very quickly, the [Grand League] family had 30 plus new members. Hong Dali’s nickname was [Grand League-Young Master], Tang Muxin’s nickname was simply [Grand League-Muxin], and the others all picked nicknames they liked too. As a result, once they left the beginner’s village, they were instantly amused—all around them were people from the [Grand League] family, at least 500 to 600 of them...
Oh my, this is exactly the feeling that I wanted.Hong Dali was quite pleased.

Speaking of which, in his previous life, when Hong Dali read novels about online gaming, there were common plots such as a new game where a lot of people were playing, how the equipment was very valuable and limited, how those families were awesome and how they had a lot of members and such.
He wasn’t concerned with the things mentioned in front, but this [Grand League] really did seem to have that kind of style now!
When they just stood still, a few people instantly secretively ran over. One of them private messaged Hong Dali:
[Grand League-Liaison Officer]: “I’m the Liaison Officer of Grand League. Brother, which division are you from?”
[Grand League-Young Master]: “Look at my nickname.”
[Grand League-Liaison Officer]: “You are the Young Master? Are you for real?”
[Grand League-Young Master]: “I’m the legit Young Master.”

By this time, this liaison officer most likely had checked with the hooligan who tattooed “Chui Chui, I Love You” on his elbow. He decisively shouted, “The Young Lord is here. Brothers, come and welcome him!”

Once he shouted this, the people around immediately erupted. Numerous people stopped whatever they were doing and rushed over. At first, it was only those from the beginner’s village. Then, the warp gate started to flash continuously as people warped over. Two minutes later, there were about 700 to 800 people around them. Five minutes later, the whole beginner’s village was flooded with people. Everywhere was filled with heads when one looked around.

When everyone arrived, a balded and sturdy looking male avatar who had the highest level came forth. His nickname was [Grand League-Tianhao]. He loudly shouted, “Greetings, Young Master! Brothers, start with the horns!”
There was actually a server horn service in this game. Therefore, the whole server was filled with:
[Grand League-Member One]: “Warmest welcome to Young Master for showing his presence on this server. May the Young Master reign for 10,000 years and conquer the game!”
[Grand League-Member Two]: “Welcome, Young Master. Young Master is skilled in both literacy and martial arts, and will bless all of us!”
[Grand League-Member Three]: “Warmest welcome to [Grand League]’s Big Boss, Young Master. May you defeat all that stand in your way!”

Speaking of the online games in this world, there were definitely other family organizations such as this. But the problem was that this was definitely the first one that had such discipline and order. Other things aside, just this grand entrance was already astonishing enough. With Hong Dali’s style of spending money, just this short while, they already spent 3,000 plus yuan on horns that cost one yuan per horn.
Of course, this was nothing to Brother Dali. It wasn’t worth mentioning, wasn’t worth mentioning at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - Service Must Be Proper, Attitude Must Be Sincere
paragraphs: But this “wasn’t worth mentioning” was only relatively speaking. Once they bombarded the server with these messages, other unknowing players were instantly astonished.
“What the heck, what’s going on!?”
“Exactly, who is this Young Master, he is so powerful?”
“Is there a need to ask, he is definitely the Big Boss of this new [Grand League] family. He is really something!”
“Just this short while, there must already be 3,000 plus horn messages, right? Each message cost one yuan!”

Hong Dali wasn’t concerned with the discussion of those other players—he couldn’t be concerned even if he wanted to. One specific message would only appear on the screen for less than 0.01 second and would then be covered by other messages...
At this time, another white light flashed at the warp gate. A small lolita avatar bounced to Hong Dali’s side. “Brother Dali, you are here. Hehe, is my avatar good looking?”
Hong Dali looked over at her. This small lolita’s nickname was [Grand League-Zixuan]. Without question, she was naturally the gaming genius Lin Zixuan.
Hong Dali: “Yes, very good looking. Haha, very adorable.”
Lin Zixuan: “Hehe, that’s for sure!”

Now that the Big Boss of Grand League and their number one player were here, needless to mention about Yao Tianhao, this big commander. With the underlings also present, it was as if they were going to conquer the server.

At this moment, there were quite a number of players who came to view this spectacular scene and took pictures to post on the forum. Just a short while later, their post was highly viewed and supported. Hours later, the number of viewers multiplied by a few times!

After all, they had seen family organizations before, but one with such order and discipline—how could they not have discipline? Those without discipline would be chased a few streets by Yao Tianhao with a knife in his hand, and that wouldn’t be in the game...

As for those, Hong Dali had never considered about them at all. Now, he had only just brought his people and joined the [Grand League] clan. With aDing, “[Grand League-Tianhao] has transferred the position of clan leader to [Grand League-Young Master].” Thus, Hong Dali officially became the leader of [Grand League]. Of course, Yao Tianhao was still in charge of the main responsibilities and duties!
After transferring the leadership to Hong Dali, Yao Tianhao started to report on the family’s current condition:

“Currently, since Young Master is here, you shall naturally be the leader of the family. I shall recommend myself to be the temporary vice-leader. There are 120 elites, 440 core members, and 750 other players who joined us and are normal members.”
“Of all these people, there are 11 senior core members.”
“[Grand League-Huang Xing] is the number one core member. He is in charge of comprehensive planning.”
“[Grand League-Big X] is in charge of human resource management, including recruiting new members and allocation of manpower.”
“[Grand League-Chen Pi] is in charge of finance and how better manage them.”
“[Grand League-Mo Long] is in charge of publicity and design. He used to write novels, so he is more adept in this aspect.”
“[Grand League-Bai Jia] is in charge of planning and execution of plans.”
“[Grand League-Droco] is in charge of packaging our exterior looks so that our family will look more majestic.”
“[Grand League-Gui Taiji] is in charge of rewards, mainly giving out rewards to those members who contributed to the family.”
“[Grand League-Yang Yangxi] is in charge of leading and orientating new members. If someone with special talents appears, she will pass them to Big X for membership upgrading.”
“[Grand League-Yao Baoyang] is in charge of recruiting new players into the family.”
“[Grand League-Ge Baiwan] is in charge of thinking of ideas to spend money on, including on how the team should work so that our family will expand like a snowball.”
“[Grand League-Xiao Qingxin] is in charge of the family’s interior harmony. This lady has a gentle character, and her words are also more easily accepted.”
After he was done, Hong Dali’s eyes almost popped out. He never realized that this Yao Tianhao actually had some talent in him. Look at how he runs the family, it was quite effective!

“You management is not bad at all. Reward!” Hong Dali was happy and naturally had to play out his part as the God of Fortune. “Everyone, 1,000 yuan. Later, you go and look for Xiaoyi...” As he spoke to this point, Hong Dali went frantic again. “Damn it, Xiaoyi isn’t back yet! Have you guys looked for that person recently? I’m going to kill him, I’m going to flick his penis until he dies!”

Sitting in front of his computer, Yao Tianhao was drenched in cold sweat. Looks like as long as he didn’t find Bighead, Young Master definitely wouldn’t give him any good face. He hurriedly replied, “Rest assured, Young Master. I will definitely complete the mission! We have already laid out the net! We will find his whereabouts in just a few days!”

“Damn that guy,” Hong Dali mumbled. Then, he said, “OK, enough of this useless talk. Hurry up and bring me and my classmates to level up. Service must be proper, attitude must be sincere. These kids are all nouveau riches!”
Now that Hong Dali had given his order, it was naturally effectively implemented.

Therefore, such a scene appeared: A few hundred players split up into numerous small groups, the high level at the front killing the creeps while the low level picked up the loot at the back—it was quite efficient. Hong Dali controlled his avatar [Grand League-Young Master] to leisurely walk behind his group, basically doing nothing and just ensuring that he didn’t walk away from the others. Then, the high-level characters in front just bulldozed their way through the creeps.

As a result, those creeps along the way suffered. They were burned clean, killed clean, and looted clean—there weren’t any living things that stood in their path. If one must use a more appropriate description—you can imagine this, in his previous life’s World of Warcraft, 100 plus mages sending their spells flying as they walked, clearing the creeps along the way...
It was no wonder people always said that one would level up very fast if someone carried them. It was only about half an hour, and Hong Dali was already past level 10...

Giving out a long yawn, Hong Dali stretched his waist. “Ah, today’s game was really satisfying.” He looked at the time and said, “Brothers, it’s time to go back to class. Let’s go!” Then, this group of nouveau riches gave their account and password to Yao Tianhao’s people and asked them to train their account for them, logged out, and went back to school.
When they were leaving, the boss of the Internet cafe gratefully said, “Young Masters, thank you for coming. Please come again when you are free!”
“Reward!” Due to his good and passionate service, Hong Dali decisively rewarded him. “1,000 yuan.”

CEO HongCEO Hong, if they say that it belongs to the country, then that large piece of land that we bought will be...”

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - An Awesome Invention
paragraphs: Sucking in a deep mouthful of smoke, Hong Weiguo thought for a while and gradually said, “We can’t avoid it, whatever the result is. This matter can be big or minor depending on how we look at it. If they want it, there’s nothing we can do to reject them. An individual can never go against the country. Therefore, there’s one thing that you need to do immediately.”
The secretary asked, “What is it? Please tell me.”

“We have to ensure that we will obtain the most benefit.” Hong Weiguo sat back down on his chair. He laid out the map and pointed at a location. “Look, this is the outer area of Tianjing Mountain. We have already bought seven mountains there, including the plain field. Currently, we are already building a school and a laboratory there. Then, according to previous reports, the other places can be used to develop and build a filming base. Therefore!”

Speaking up to this point, Hong Weiguo violently slapped the map. “Speed up the process, but not too fast. Basically, the initial work must be mostly completed! This way, even if they want to reclaim the land, they will have to pay more for it! Much more than what we invested!”

“I understand.” The secretary nodded and said, “CEO Hong’s meaning is that we should speed up the initial development so that we’ll be able to better negotiate with them. For example, if we invested 10 million, plus the 60 million used to buy the land, our total cost will be 70 million. But if the government wants to reclaim the land, they will have to pay much more than that.”

“Yes, that’s what I mean.” Hong Weiguo laughed and said, “After all, we are the ones who found that place. If they want to reclaim it without any cost, that’s impossible.” Saying so, Hong Weiguo looked at the secretary. “But there’s something I need to remind you. Remember, don’t do everything for the sake of money. Many a time, the country might not have that much money, but they might use something else as an exchange.”

“Huh?” The secretary was a bit dazed. Although his intelligence quotient was very high, his experience in this aspect was still incomparable to Hong Weiguo. “What CEO Hong means is that we can negotiate for other terms and conditions with them?”

Hong Weiguo nodded. “Correct, something like that. We must ask for other terms. For example, the country may be unwilling to use money to buy back the land, but they may be willing to use other things as an exchange or give us better treatment in other aspects. Overall, we must not be at the losing end. Do you understand?”
“I understand!” The secretary smiled and said, “If they don’t use money, they will have to use more valuable terms as an exchange. Is that right, CEO Hong.”

“Yes.” Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Hehe, you may go now. Do a good job. When I’m older, you will need to become Dali’s right-hand man, so you mustn’t work sloppily. Don’t worry, the Hong Family will definitely not mistreat you.”

The secretary had very strong faith in Hong Weiguo. He smiled and said, “CEO Hong, actually, many a time, the treatment isn’t everything. I just feel that I’m very happy following you. Very, very happy.
“In fact...”

The secretary paused and said, “There are quite a lot of companies that privately approached me, but I have rejected them all. Because money isn’t the most important thing to me. Being with you will allow me to learn a lot of stuff.”

“Hahaha.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly. He walked up and patted the secretary’s shoulder. “You are a very outstanding young man. I have always had faith in my judgment. Do a good job. You may need to work harder and earn less now, but in the future, when you can take the lead, you will naturally have everything. OK, you may go now. Do a good job and don’t disappoint me.”
“I know.” The secretary instantly turned around and walked out. “Then, CEO Hong, I shall be leaving.”
“Go.”

After the secretary left, a cold light flashed in Hong Weiguo’s eyes. “Humph, how could I not know that Liu Yihui secretly sent his people to interact with my people. He just wants to put a spy by my side. Hehe, but he really underestimates my sense of judgment. Those who I set my eyes on, how could they be so easily bribed? However, this reminded me, I should be careful of spies around me. I wonder how that old guy Liu Yihui will go about doing it. Hehe, this is quite interesting.”
Tianjing College.
RingFinally, the dismissal bell rang.

“Brouhaha! It’s finally time to go home!” After waiting for it for a long time, it was finally dismissal time. Hong Dali excitedly carried his already tidied schoolbag and the little tiger Quentin and ran out of school. He hadn’t forgotten that today was the day where he was going to view Lin Chuyin’s new invention.
“Hahaha. Everyone, hurry up!” Those who were close with Hong Dali all ran along with him.

It was no wonder why people said that those who followed Hong Dali would have benefits too. Lin Chuyin’s laboratory wasn’t a place that just anyone could go. It was extremely dangerous for outsiders, and they might die a terrible death if they are not careful. But for Hong Dali, that was practically his own technological base. All kinds of strange and funny inventions might appear there. Therefore, Hong Dali was very excited.

Just as he ran out of his classroom, he saw Tang Muxin jogging over. This little lass was a beauty in the first place, and now that she was so close to Hong Dali, the surrounding schoolmates all took a few more looks at her. Their gazes were filled with such ambiguous meaning that her face went red from them—even her neck was red too...

“Dali, Sister Chuyin asked us to go to her laboratory, what new invention do you think she has created?” Upon seeing Hong Dali, Tang Muxin anxiously asked. This little lass was very curious about Lin Chuyin’s new invention. It was no wonder people always say that technological geeks were awesome. Just by looking at Lin Chuyin’s super awesome, super luxurious sports car, one could already expect how awesome her new invention would be.

“I have no idea.” Hong Dali said as he walked. “Anything is possible. It might be some new advancements regarding the Holographic Projection Technology, it might also be that there are new discoveries about that Virtual Reality Projection. Of course, it might also be that her exoskeleton armor can cover her whole body now. Who knows.” Speaking up to this point, Hong Dali grinned and said, “If her exoskeleton armor is really completed, I shall throw in money to film a sci-fi movie. Xinxin, you shall be the female lead! How does that sound?”
“Sure! Of course!” Tang Muxin seemed to have a special liking towards filming. She smiled and said, “Dali, what shall the movie be called?”
“We shall name it ‘Iron Man’!” Was there even a need to ask? Hong Dali, who came from his previous life, immediately said. “By that time, we can even save on the money for props, haha!”
“Yup, OK!” Tang Muxin excitedly stared at Hong Dali with her watery eyes. “I will definitely work hard!”
“That’s for sure!” Hong Dali laughed loudly.

After leaving school, driver Wang Mingyu had already brought the car squad and was waiting outside. Now, three Prayer Angel and one Soaring Angel, these four cars were Hong Dali’s signature formation. All those who frequently hang out around their school knew about him.
After boarding the car, the Soaring Angel gradually started. At this time, Ling Yi and the rest also drove their cars out of school and followed behind them towards Lin Chuyin’s laboratory.
However, when they alighted and entered Lin Chuyin’s house’s courtyard, Hong Dali became stunned.
Because, in front of him, a super small-sized device was floating in the air.

The device was the size of a can drink. It’s top was a small propeller, giving out a small humming sound as it spun and floated in the air. Hong Dali took a careful look at it—this small thing should be a small filming device. Being able to float in the air showed how agile it was, just that he hadn’t seen it yet. Without question, this small device must be Lin Chuyin’s new invention.

Speaking of which, this super invincible technological geek’s inventions were all weird and strange. Hong Dali originally thought that the new invention this time should be something to do with the Holographic Projection Technology or the Virtual Reality Projection.

“Wow!” At this moment, those around Hong Dali were all astonished. Ling Yi said, “Brother Dali, is this Blood Consort’s new invention? It’s really incredible, this device is really something out of some science fantasy!” Du Xinzhen said, “I make a prediction that the Blood Consort’s invention will definitely be something awesome. If this was used to peak at someone bathing...” Saying so, he pounced forward and hugged Hong Dali’s legs. “Brother Dali, help me ask for one of this!!!”
Hong Dali: “...”

Tang Muxin walked up and fiercely stamped on Du Xinzhen’s back. “Go and die. Is this wonderful invention of Sister Chuyin for you to use as a peaking device!? If she knew of this, you will die a terrible death!”
“That’s true.” Du Xinzhen mumbled and walked back. He continued to blabber at the back. “Sigh, with this device, I could see whoever’s panties that I wanted to see. If I throw this in the toilet...”
Then, everyone pushed him to the ground and gave him a good beating.
As they were playing around, Lin Chuyin’s voice suddenly sounded from the device. “The preventive measures are turned off now, come in.”
When the voice sounded, everyone was shocked!
Even Hong Dali’s tiger gave a sound of fright—it didn’t understand how did the device give off a human sound!

One must know that normally, for such a small item, there would special storage equipment inside. It couldn’t choose the things to record, but to just record everything that it shot. It wasn’t something that could be controlled.
But now, this thing could actually be used for communication. What did this signify?
This signified that this thing could receive wireless reception! If it could receive wireless reception, it could be remotely controlled!

That meant that this item was already a super advanced spying device! It could be remotely controlled to stop at any place and spy on the area there. The most awesome part was that it could even choose what it wanted to record. In other words, it could instantly transfer the images it captured to its owner’s computer!
If the former type of uncontrollable device could be given ten marks, this one now could be given a 100% marks!

No wonder this technological geek Lin Chuyin said that she had a new invention. Other things aside, if this small device was sent to the nation’s intelligence agency and be modified by a professional team, its worth would be unimaginable!
Of course, that was too distant. Now, Hong Dali grinned, sniffled and said, “Chuyin, can you hear me? Hello, is there any sound over there? Hello!”
“Yes, I can.” Lin Chuyin’s voice was as insipid as ever. “Come in.”

After saying so, the small device adjusted its direction. This time, because Hong Dali’s eyes were constantly looking at it, he saw very clearly. It was indeed as he had thought, this small device had small wings installed on it to adjust its direction and therefore could freely control its direction. It was indeed able to be remote controlled—his invention was definitely awesome!
