“I understand!” The secretary smiled and said, “If they don’t use money, they will have to use more valuable terms as an exchange.
Is that right, CEO Hong.”
“Yes.” Hong Weiguo smiled and said, “Hehe, you may go now.
Do a good job.
When I’m older, you will need to become Dali’s right-hand man, so you mustn’t work sloppily.
Don’t worry, the Hong Family will definitely not mistreat you.”
The secretary had very strong faith in Hong Weiguo.
He smiled and said, “CEO Hong, actually, many a time, the treatment isn’t everything.
I just feel that I’m very happy following you.
Very, very happy.
“In fact...”
The secretary paused and said, “There are quite a lot of companies that privately approached me, but I have rejected them all.
Because money isn’t the most important thing to me.
Being with you will allow me to learn a lot of stuff.”
“Hahaha.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly.
He walked up and patted the secretary’s shoulder.
“You are a very outstanding young man.
I have always had faith in my judgment.
Do a good job.
You may need to work harder and earn less now, but in the future, when you can take the lead, you will naturally have everything.
OK, you may go now.
Do a good job and don’t disappoint me.”
“I know.” The secretary instantly turned around and walked out.
“Then, CEO Hong, I shall be leaving.”
“Go.”
After the secretary left, a cold light flashed in Hong Weiguo’s eyes.
“Humph, how could I not know that Liu Yihui secretly sent his people to interact with my people.
He just wants to put a spy by my side.
Hehe, but he really underestimates my sense of judgment.
Those who I set my eyes on, how could they be so easily bribed?
However, this reminded me, I should be careful of spies around me.
I wonder how that old guy Liu Yihui will go about doing it.
Hehe, this is quite interesting.”
Tianjing College.
RingFinally, the dismissal bell rang.
“Brouhaha!
It’s finally time to go home!” After waiting for it for a long time, it was finally dismissal time.
Hong Dali excitedly carried his already tidied schoolbag and the little tiger Quentin and ran out of school.
He hadn’t forgotten that today was the day where he was going to view Lin Chuyin’s new invention.
“Hahaha.
Everyone, hurry up!” Those who were close with Hong Dali all ran along with him.
It was no wonder why people said that those who followed Hong Dali would have benefits too.
Lin Chuyin’s laboratory wasn’t a place that just anyone could go.
It was extremely dangerous for outsiders, and they might die a terrible death if they are not careful.
But for Hong Dali, that was practically his own technological base.
All kinds of strange and funny inventions might appear there.
Therefore, Hong Dali was very excited.
Just as he ran out of his classroom, he saw Tang Muxin jogging over.
This little lass was a beauty in the first place, and now that she was so close to Hong Dali, the surrounding schoolmates all took a few more looks at her.
Their gazes were filled with such ambiguous meaning that her face went red from them—even her neck was red too...
“Dali, Sister Chuyin asked us to go to her laboratory, what new invention do you think she has created?” Upon seeing Hong Dali, Tang Muxin anxiously asked.
This little lass was very curious about Lin Chuyin’s new invention.
It was no wonder people always say that technological geeks were awesome.
Just by looking at Lin Chuyin’s super awesome, super luxurious sports car, one could already expect how awesome her new invention would be.
“I have no idea.” Hong Dali said as he walked.
“Anything is possible.
It might be some new advancements regarding the Holographic Projection Technology, it might also be that there are new discoveries about that Virtual Reality Projection.
Of course, it might also be that her exoskeleton armor can cover her whole body now.
Who knows.” Speaking up to this point, Hong Dali grinned and said, “If her exoskeleton armor is really completed, I shall throw in money to film a sci-fi movie.
Xinxin, you shall be the female lead!
How does that sound?”
“Sure!
Of course!” Tang Muxin seemed to have a special liking towards filming.
She smiled and said, “Dali, what shall the movie be called?”
“We shall name it ‘Iron Man’!” Was there even a need to ask?
Hong Dali, who came from his previous life, immediately said.
“By that time, we can even save on the money for props, haha!”
“Yup, OK!” Tang Muxin excitedly stared at Hong Dali with her watery eyes.
“I will definitely work hard!”
“That’s for sure!” Hong Dali laughed loudly.
After leaving school, driver Wang Mingyu had already brought the car squad and was waiting outside.
Now, three Prayer Angel and one Soaring Angel, these four cars were Hong Dali’s signature formation.
All those who frequently hang out around their school knew about him.
After boarding the car, the Soaring Angel gradually started.
At this time, Ling Yi and the rest also drove their cars out of school and followed behind them towards Lin Chuyin’s laboratory.
However, when they alighted and entered Lin Chuyin’s house’s courtyard, Hong Dali became stunned.
Because, in front of him, a super small-sized device was floating in the air.
The device was the size of a can drink.
It’s top was a small propeller, giving out a small humming sound as it spun and floated in the air.
Hong Dali took a careful look at it—this small thing should be a small filming device.
Being able to float in the air showed how agile it was, just that he hadn’t seen it yet.
Without question, this small device must be Lin Chuyin’s new invention.
Speaking of which, this super invincible technological geek’s inventions were all weird and strange.
Hong Dali originally thought that the new invention this time should be something to do with the Holographic Projection Technology or the Virtual Reality Projection.
“Wow!” At this moment, those around Hong Dali were all astonished.
Ling Yi said, “Brother Dali, is this Blood Consort’s new invention?
It’s really incredible, this device is really something out of some science fantasy!” Du Xinzhen said, “I make a prediction that the Blood Consort’s invention will definitely be something awesome.
If this was used to peak at someone bathing...” Saying so, he pounced forward and hugged Hong Dali’s legs.
“Brother Dali, help me ask for one of this!!!”
Hong Dali: “...”
Tang Muxin walked up and fiercely stamped on Du Xinzhen’s back.
“Go and die.
Is this wonderful invention of Sister Chuyin for you to use as a peaking device!?
If she knew of this, you will die a terrible death!”
“That’s true.” Du Xinzhen mumbled and walked back.
He continued to blabber at the back.
“Sigh, with this device, I could see whoever’s panties that I wanted to see.
If I throw this in the toilet...”
Then, everyone pushed him to the ground and gave him a good beating.
As they were playing around, Lin Chuyin’s voice suddenly sounded from the device.
“The preventive measures are turned off now, come in.”
When the voice sounded, everyone was shocked!
Even Hong Dali’s tiger gave a sound of fright—it didn’t understand how did the device give off a human sound!
One must know that normally, for such a small item, there would special storage equipment inside.
It couldn’t choose the things to record, but to just record everything that it shot.
It wasn’t something that could be controlled.
But now, this thing could actually be used for communication.
What did this signify?
This signified that this thing could receive wireless reception!
If it could receive wireless reception, it could be remotely controlled!
That meant that this item was already a super advanced spying device!
It could be remotely controlled to stop at any place and spy on the area there.
The most awesome part was that it could even choose what it wanted to record.
In other words, it could instantly transfer the images it captured to its owner’s computer!
If the former type of uncontrollable device could be given ten marks, this one now could be given a 100% marks!
No wonder this technological geek Lin Chuyin said that she had a new invention.
Other things aside, if this small device was sent to the nation’s intelligence agency and be modified by a professional team, its worth would be unimaginable!
Of course, that was too distant.
Now, Hong Dali grinned, sniffled and said, “Chuyin, can you hear me?
Hello, is there any sound over there?
Hello!”
“Yes, I can.” Lin Chuyin’s voice was as insipid as ever.
“Come in.”
After saying so, the small device adjusted its direction.
This time, because Hong Dali’s eyes were constantly looking at it, he saw very clearly.
It was indeed as he had thought, this small device had small wings installed on it to adjust its direction and therefore could freely control its direction.
It was indeed able to be remote controlled—his invention was definitely awesome!

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - Can You Kiss Me Again? (Part One)
paragraphs: Everyone entered the single building and went down the stairs to the basement. Very quickly, they arrived at the door to Lin Chuyin’s laboratory.
Unsurprisingly, the door automatically opened by itself. Hong Dali again saw... a bunch of messy spare parts...

Speaking of which, although Lin Chuyin was a technological geek with an IQ of more than 180, she wasn’t good at cleaning up her own room. The stuff was messily stacked here and there, spare parts also lay around randomly on the floor—this troubled Hong Dali because there wasn’t any empty space for him to set his foot on...
Maybe, the only thing that was still worth mentioning here was that there wasn’t any odor that would normally be found in a man’s room. Therefore, this was still acceptable for Hong Dali.

Carefully finding places to land his foot on, Hong Dali and the rest were like playing a jumping game, there were places where they had to skip one-legged. Luckily, after five minutes of hard work, they finally ended up in front of Lin Chuyin.
Finally reaching the safety point, everyone wiped their cold sweat in unison.

At this moment, Lin Chuyin was sitting on a small bench. In front of her was a table which had a laptop on it. Around her was a stack of spanners, pincers and such. There was even an electrical welding torch and mask. This kind of environment coupled with Lin Chuyin’s beautiful face—they would definitely believe it if someone told them that Lin Chuyin was a cyborg.
“Oh, you guys are here.” Lin Chuyin didn’t look at them at all and just said, “Wait for a moment, the experiment is almost done.”
Her voice was always so insipid and tranquil as if there was nothing in the world that was worth distracting her attention for.
Maybe this wasn’t “as if,” but a fact.
Everyone held their breath, and the entire laboratory could only hear the humming sound from the propeller of that small device.
Luckily, shortly later, after Lin Chuyin adjusted a few parameters, she said, “Done.”
Then, she finally stood up.

At this time, Hong Dali finally had to chance to ask the question is his heart. “Chuyin, the new invention you mentioned, is it this small device? This device is really awesome!” Hong Dali excitedly said, “Can you let me play with it!?”
“You can.” Lin Chuyin nodded. “This device is basically completed. Its biggest flaw at the moment is that its source of energy isn’t very powerful. It can only be used for about... half an hour.”
Half an hour it is then, Hong Dali naturally wasn’t concerned with that. He anxiously nodded. “That’s fine. Hoho, how do I play with this?”

“Oh, use this.” Lin Chuyin picked up a joystick that was on top of her laptop. “Front, back, left right, and push down the joystick to land and pull it to rise. Be careful to not use too much movement, or you can cause problems in the controls.”
Brouhaha! This is good, this is good. This is practically playing an airplane. If there was some lightning overhead, this would be just like playing an air battle game.
Hong Dali excitedly took the joystick and started playing with it.
Left! The small device slowly flew towards the left side, and the screen on the laptop displayed the image captured by the device.
Right! The small device slowly flew toward the right.
Down, front, it was getting close... lift up!
All of the guys “Wowed” in unison. Du Xinzhen laughed loudly. “It’s pink in color!”
Ji Zhiruo, whose panties were being seen, screamed and pressed down her skirt... Hong Dali was really too evil!

“Hong Dali!” Tang Muxin walked up and fiercely stepped on his foot. “Can you not be so despicable!” He actually used this device to peek at the scenery under a girl’s skirt, he must be taught a lesson!
“AH, pain, pain!” Hong Dali grieved. “I just wanted to help everyone fulfill their dream, haha, haha...” Then, he hurriedly controlled the device and made it fly away.
“Hm, there are still three minutes before the battery runs up.” Lin Chuyin secretly estimated the time and reminded him. “Hurry up and land. If not, it will spoil if it’s dropped.”

“Ah, OK!” This was, after all, a high-tech device. Just from its appearance, the technology used to create it wasn’t simple. This type of high-tech stuff had a lot of spare parts on it. If it were dropped, it would easily shatter. If that happened, Hong Dali’s heart would break. He instantly slowly pressed down the joystick and landed the device. Shortly later, just before it landed, Lin Chuyin pressed a button on her laptop and they heard a squeaking sound coming from the device. Under the device, four support stands actually appeared. Then, under Hong Dali’s control, it landed safely with athud. It had landed successfully!

“Hahaha, this is fun!” Putting down the joystick, Hong Dali carefully picked up the device and looked it left and right. The more he looked, the more he liked it. He was very satisfied with this device. With this, he could peek at whoever he wanted to in the future!
After Hong Dali was satisfied and handed the joystick back to Lin Chuyin, she just casually placed it on the table.

Then, she didn’t take out some other awesome stuff. Instead, to everyone’s surprise, she walked up to Hong Dali and looked at him curiously. Then, she said something that stunned everyone. “Hm... that time when I went back to school to return you something, did I kiss with you? I think that’s what it’s called.”
Hong Dali: “...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
The rest: “...”
Could it be that she asked me over today to settle the score with me!? Please, God, no, I still want to live for another two more years AHHH!

Hong Dali’s tears flowed down his face, and his heart skipped furiously. Luckily, he had a small throat. If not, his heart might have jumped out of it! The others were also scared till their faces went white. Last time, Hong Dali accidentally kissed her in the classroom. At that time, she didn’t have any reaction. Why did she suddenly mention this today?

“Ah, that, that...” Hong Dali’s head was full of cold sweat, and his whole shirt was drenched too. “That was purely an accident! An accident! That was totally an accident!”That was really just an accident! I didn’t make any active move!

“Yup, I know... Actually, I’m just a little curious.” Lin Chuyin’s voice didn’t have any of the usual reactions one might expect to have upon mentioning such a thing. She had none of that shyness or heart jumping feeling, it was just like she was mentioning something irrelevant to her. Her tone was tranquil as always. “I unintentionally saw an advertisement from a roadside TV. After I did a check, the result was that kissing is the most romantic way of expressing one’s emotions. Therefore, I just wanted to ask you. That’s all.”
Oh... so this is the case.
Speaking of which, what kind of advertisement would have this kind of kissing scene! I’m going to smash those people! Smash them!
But returning to the topic, she doesn’t seem to be angry?

Hong Dali only just remembered that because her IQ was too high, as a result, her EQ was pulled down—in fact, she could be said to have none of the emotions that a normal human should have. Or rather, she had them, just not much. Of course, it was also accurate to say that they were not yet developed.
Then, what’s her meaning in mentioning their kissing the other time?

Could it be that Lin Chuyin, who has lost her emotions, in an effort to reclaim them or maybe she’s just suddenly interested, decided to find me, who kissed her before, to do some research on emotions?
The more he thought about it, the more Hong Dali was frightened.
God, are you planning on playing with me?
If there is no one else around, I’m happy to help her experience what kissing is like... but there are so many people here, especially my fiancée. How can I do it!?
Kissing other women in front of one’s fiancée, using a modern phrase to describe this would be:
“Could it be that I couldn’t think of a better way to suicide?”
One should know that when a woman gets jealous, they could destroy the world!

But the crucial question was not this, but that Lin Chuyin obviously didn’t feel anything wrong with being viewed by others. She just looked at Hong Dali naturally, then gradually opened her mouth and asked, “Then, can you kiss me again?”
God, you are playing with me!

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - Can You Kiss Me Again? (Part Two)
paragraphs: This scene caused Hong Dali to feel very depressed.

If he kissed her, the consequences would be severe. With Tang Muxin glaring at him intently from behind, Hong Dali could even feel waves of cold air! If he didn’t kiss her, the consequences seemed to be very severe as well! Lin Chuyin wasn’t someone that he could offend!
This was a tiger behind and a wolf in front, it would be a wrong move whatever he did!
As for Hong Dali’s evil classmates, although all of them turned their heads around and covered their eyes with their hands, the gap behind their fingers was large enough to expose their whole eyes!
This bunch of rascals!
Hong Dali really wanted to ask his lackeys to drag them out and beat them to death, but upon looking at them...
These fellows were actually doing exactly the same thing as his classmates! What the heck, no more rewards for them from now on!

As Hong Dali was wondering what he should do, Tang Muxin spoke up. This little lass gently placed her hand on Hong Dali’s waist and, in an understanding tone, said, “Dali, since Sister Chuyin has already said so, just go and kiss her. I won’t mind. Sigh, Sister Chuyin just wants to find her emotions, don’t worry.” Saying so, her two fingers lightly pinched a small portion of his skin...
This action of yours is showing that you don’t mind!? But I mind AHHH!
Hong Dali had goosebumps all over, but since Tang Muxin already said so, could he not kiss her? He definitely couldn’t!
Therefore, Hong Dali clenched his teeth and met Lin Chuyin’s gaze.
Speaking of which, she was really beautiful, totally aligned with his idea of a beautiful girl.

At this moment, Lin Chuyin was just opening her pair of big eyes normally, and her mouth wasn’t pouted—it was as if she were doing some research. Her face was extremely calm. Using unreliable words to describe, in her heart, kissing might be just akin to a piece of meat touching another piece of meat. There was a very appropriate scenario to describe this.
When one goes to the market to choose some pork meat, one will poke the meat with their finger to see if it’s fresh or not. This pretty much described the situation now.
Forget it, this can’t be avoided anymore. It’s all or nothing!
Therefore, Hong Dali made up his mind and kissed her!

“Oh my, oh my!” The surrounding classmates all softly exclaimed. “This scene is a restricted scene, we can’t watch this, we can’t!” Although they say that, their eyes were all wide open. Luckily, their gazes couldn’t kill. If not, Hong Dali would definitely be akin to being bombarded by a machine gun now.
It was just kissing the lips, not a french kiss. Therefore, their lips just touched lightly and ended without any other actions.
But Hong Dali was very depressed.
It was not that he regretted it, it was just that his back waist was green now due to being pinched by Tang Muxin. What was more depressing was that he couldn’t even show it.

“Oh...” After they kissed, Lin Chuyin felt for a moment and even took out a device to check. Then, she expressed her opinion. “The heartbeat didn’t increase, the temperature is normal, hormones have no reaction. Currently speaking, there isn’t any practical use.” In the end, she concluded: “Maybe it’s because the way of experiencing is wrong. Looks like I need to improve on the specific experiment model.”
It’s just as I expected AHHH!
Hong Dali was full of tears—this wasn’t worth getting my back waist green for!
But in actuality, Hong Dali was slightly proud that Lin Chuyin asked him to kiss her.

That was Lin Chuyin, the most powerful technological geek. Others couldn’t even get a within a meter of her, but now he actually kissed her—her first kiss! This must be... oh, her first kiss seemed to be that time back at school.
However, her little mouth was actually quite sweet. There was a light, sweet fragrance.

After she was done with the check, Lin Chuyin kept the equipment and turned around as if nothing happened and continued adjustments on her new invention. Hong Dali wanted to say something, but he didn’t know what to say. As for his classmates, they were secretly discussing.

Ling Yi: “Did you guys see that? Young Master Dali’s luck with the ladies has definitely exceeded the limits! That’s the Blood Consort! The Blood Consort! She was actually kissed again! And she asked for it!”
Du Xinzhen: “You’re right. I have made a prediction and know that Young Master Dali is domineering and formidable, without reason. I couldn’t even dream of something like this!”
Lang Hao: “The most impressive part is that Young Master Dali is still alive. I’m more and more impressed with him now!”
Ji Zhiruo: “Sister Blood Consort is really pitiful. Sigh, she didn’t feel anything even from this.”

Tang Muxin’s emotions were slightly more complicated compared to them. She wasn’t anxious to renege on their engagement anymore, but the question was that Hong Dali didn’t seem to be clear of this. Now that Hong Dali kissed another girl, although he wasn’t to be blamed, she still felt her heart going sore. Yet, she couldn’t say anything. This caused Tang Muxin to be really depressed.

Because she wasn’t sure what kind of attitude she should use to face this situation—the problem was that this couldn’t be considered as Hong Dali cheating on her, not even flirting with girls. Who could be able to flirt with Lin Chuyin? But they really kissed, and Lin Chuyin was the active one...
What’s more, it was in front of her, Hong Dali’s fiancée, yet she couldn’t say anything...
This time, it was Tang Muxin’s turn to be filled with tears...Forget it, I shan’t think about this anymore! I will just pretend I didn’t see it!
Tang Muxin fiercely shook her head. At this moment, she could only choose to change the topic. “Dali, do you know of the outer area of Tianjing Mountain that you bought?”

“Ya, why?” Hong Dali felt strange. He didn’t hear there were any problems with the outer area of Tianjing Mountain. Could it be regarding Chuyin’s laboratory? Hong Dali asked, “There’s a problem with Chuyin’s laboratory?”

“It’s not that. It’s something else.” Tang Muxin pulled Hong Dali over and softly said, “I heard that a worker who was cleaning the rubbish there found a natural underground cave, and it’s not small. However, there’s a part of it that humans seem to be very hard to pass through.”
“What you mean is...” Hong Dali instantly understood. He turned and looked at Lin Chuyin’s new invention. “Use that thing to see what’s in there!?”
“Yup, exactly. Aren’t you curious?” Tang Muxin’ eyes shone. “Use this small device to take a look, what if there is something precious inside!? For example, diamonds, gold mines and such!”

“What the heck! This is good, this is good!” Hong Dali’s heart itched upon hearing this. “Then let’s go take a look! Brouhaha! This news is awesome. Speaking of which, even I didn’t know about this secret cave yet. Oh right, Xinxin, how did you know about this?”
“My dad told me this afternoon when I called him.” Tang Muxin softly said, “I thought you knew of this at first, but looks like Uncle Hong hasn’t informed you yet.”

“I went to sleep once I returned home yesterday, he probably didn’t have time to tell me.” Hong Dali touched his chin. “Then, let’s go now? But this device can only fly for half an hour, and it has already run out of battery...”

As the two of them discussed up to this point, they suddenly saw Lin Chuyin eerily appearing beside them. “I made two of this device—the other one is fully charged. Where are you guys planning to go?”

“There’s one fully charged!?”What the heck, this is awesome. what’s there to wait for! Hong Dali instantly laughed loudly and gave Lin Chuyin a big hug, saying, “Chuyin, you are really fabulous! We were just in need of this!”

“Oh.” Lin Chuyin didn’t have any reaction towards Hong Dali’s hug. She just turned around and started preparing. “Then, let’s prepare to move now. Just nice, I have already finished adjusting the device.”

“OK, OK!” Hearing Lin Chuyin said that they could move out now, Hong Dali definitely wouldn’t reject. There was a saying that said that curiosity killed the cat. Now that there was such a fun place, how could they not go take a look! Hong Dali asked, “Then, Chuyin, is there anything that we should prepare?”

“Oh, there’s a lot of stuff that needs to be prepared.” Lin Chuyin started looking for stuff among all the things on the floor. They could find practically everything in this little lass’s laboratory. Of course, she was the only one who was capable of finding them. “Hm, since it’s an underground cave, then there will definitely be an underground river or even a lake. Therefore, diving equipment must be brought along.”

As she said so, she walked towards a pile of items at the southwest corner and kicked at it. After kicking away the items on the top, she took out three helmets. “Oh, I only made three at that time. Looks like there is a need to make more.” The helmet was made entirely from metal and looked like something from a science-fantasy movie.
Hong Dali: “...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
The rest: “...”

Then, she started looking for stuff again. “If we’re diving, we will need diving suits. Hm, I don’t seem to have that here, looks like there is a need to make a few of those. But if the water isn’t too deep, we can consider just go in without the suit. In that case, we will need a communication device—I have that here.” Saying so, Lin Chuyin walked to the southeast corner and dug for stuff there. Very quickly, she found a strange device with a lot of connectors on it. “Oh, this is the one. Using these connectors, I can effectively prevent the interference of the magnetic field. But it looks like I have to modify it first.”
Hong Dali: “...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
The rest: “...”

“An underground cave, we will also need lighting equipment.” This one was simple. She found it very quickly. “Hm, this should do.” That was a large-sized device that looked like a searchlight. Hong Dali asked, “Can this be used underwater?”
“Yes.” Lin Chuyin said, “This is specifically designed to be used underwater.”

Now, the diving helmet was available, the diving suit needed to be made, and the underwater communication device was available. Coupled with the lighting equipment, even if Hong Dali couldn’t search through the entire area in the underground cave, he could probably search through most of it.
Since their preparation was done, the only thing left was to move towards the destination to start their exploration.
In this world, technology was quite advanced—there weren’t many places left where humans hadn’t set foot on. It was really not a simple thing for Hong Dali to discover such a good place.
After everyone was ready, Hong Dali shouted, “Brothers, we are going to explore now, hahaha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - This Is My Home
paragraphs: The outer area of Tianjing Mountain.

“Director Lin, the plot now is much more complicated than the original plot, but the statue of the fairy sister that Young Master mentioned...” The stage manager stood in front of Director Lin who was eating snacks and carefully reported. “Now, everything is ready except the part about the small animal leading the character into the cave. It’s not a problem if we use dogs because they are easy to train, but we are unable to find one in these woods. If we change to other animals, we are unable to train them. Also, we really can’t find a large enough jade for the statue. Why not we just tell Young Master and use 3D for the statue, that will be cheap and time efficient.”

“Sigh, do you think I don’t want to?” Lin Hao was depressed. “If we use 3D, a simple colored model would do. After all, it just to show its face. As long as the camera shot isn’t too near and shows too much, it could be easily done. It would cost about only 10,000 yuan. But Young Master didn’t agree—he insisted on using a real one! Such a big piece of jade, even if we find one, it would cost at least a few hundred thousand yuan—and that’s not talking about sculpting it. And to find a master sculptor to sculpt it would cost another few hundred thousand yuan. What couldn’t he do with this money! How many snacks could that buy?”
But talk was just that, talk. Lin Hao could only whine about it.
Hong Dali had already said that he would be paying the expenses. Thus, Lin Hao had no reason to refuse him.

“Sigh.” After giving off another sigh, Lin Hao asked, “Oh right, have you found the cave for the fairy sister? According to the Young Master, it would be best to use a real cave. He will probably not agree to a set-up.”

The stage manager said, “The cave isn’t a problem.” Speaking up to this point, he acted like a thief and moved his mouth near Lin Hao’s ear. “I heard from those workers clearing the rubbish that some time back, because of the mudslide, a cave was discovered! A worker has already gone in and taken a look—it’s full of stalactites! As it hasn’t become a tourist attraction yet and this is Young Master’s territory, we should make use of this opportunity and ask Young Master to let us use that cave for shooting this scene. This cave was practically prepared for our movie!”
“There’s actually such a thing!?” Lin Hao was instantly alarmed. “Where is that cave? Let’s go take a look first so we can prepare beforehand!”
“It’s about one kilometer in front.” The stage manager said, “Why don’t we take a look now?”

“It’s about 6:00 PM now...” Lin Hao looked at the sky. “Forget about it, let’s just go now. Call another two fellows to come with us. Oh right, ask Sir Mu and Master Wang along too. They are skilled in kungfu. If there is any danger, they can handle it. There is no need to call the rest, the four of us will do. Prepare the lighting equipment too!”

“This is the place, right?” Hong Dali and the rest sat on their cars and directly went to the outer area of Tianjing Mountain. When they arrived at the location that Tang Muxin pointed out, they saw quite a lot of workers already gathered there holding a map and discussing something.

Hong Dali naturally didn’t know any of them. He was also lazy to bother about them. He and his group directly barged in and were stopped by a security guard just a few steps later. “Stop, where are you guys from?”

“Us? Where are we from?” Hong Dali strangely looked left and right, then pointed at his nose. “We are students, can’t you tell?” Saying so, he looked at his lackeys and said, “Oh, and a few lackeys too.”
“Please return.” The security guard was depressed. “This isn’t some place where children can come and play.”

“About that.” Hong Dali was instantly angered to the point of amusement. “I think you have gotten something wrong.” He pointed at the surrounding forest and the mountain. “This seems to be my territory...”

“This...” Although the security guard didn’t know Hong Dali, just from his behavior he knew that this was someone he couldn’t offend. He could only appease him and said, “Then, please wait for a while. I will go check with my superior.”

Saying so, he ran inside and shouted, “Captain Zhao, Captain Zhao, someone’s here. He said that this is his territory and wants to go in and take a look. I don’t dare to make a decision. Please advise me on what to do.”
“What is he talking about, this place belongs to the nation!” An arrogant voice sounded out. “Ask them to get lost!”

Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “I don’t think I remember wrongly. I’m sure I bought this place.” Saying so, as he looked at around, there wasn’t a single plastic bag to be seen. “There’s no mistake, this place was obviously cleared before. What situation is this?”
At this moment, the security guard carefully said, “Captain, I think it’s better if you go and take a look. I really dare not make the decision.”

“How are you doing your job? You don’t have any capabilities at all.” While saying so, a bald man walked out from the crowd. He seemed to be about 40 years old and was carrying a mug in his hand. With his beer-belly popping out from his shirt, once he saw Hong Dali and his group, he said, “Hurry up and go back to where you come from. I don’t care who you are. This place has been expropriated by the nation, unrelated persons are not allowed to enter.”
“This...” Hong Dali gradually said, “This place seems to be my home.”

“You are Hong Weiguo’s son, Hong Dali, right?” Captain Zhao looked him up and down. “I know this is your home, but this place has been expropriated by the nation. It might become a tourist attraction, so it doesn’t belong to your house anymore. Hurry up and return home. I’m giving your Dad some face, so I’m talking to you nicely now.”
This dude knew that Hong Dali was Hong Weiguo’s son and still dared to be so arrogant.
By right, those who could do such a thing only belonged to one of two categories.
The first that this guy was a retard.
The second was that this guy was a retard and was also the person of a rival of the Hong Family.
Yup, from the current circumstances, the second scenario was more probable.
Hong Dali touched his chin. “What if I refuse?”
“You can’t refuse.” Captain Zhao said darkly, “I know that your bodily condition isn’t good. I can’t touch you, but it might be difficult for your father, hehe.”
His standpoint was very clear once he said that.
He was obviously not on the same side as them and obviously had a backing that was his family’s rival.

Now, he was just displaying their strength to him. His meaning was simple—he had someone on top to back him up. Although the Hong family was a large business entity, Hong Dali still couldn’t do anything to him!

If it were some other nouveau riche, they would naturally get hot-headed, rush up, and prepare to slap his face. Then, this Captain Zhao would use various methods to defeat and embarrass them—this was what was written in the novels in his previous life. Normally, it was the nouveau riche who was the antagonist.
Naturally, Hong Dali wasn’t so silly.

Being a prodigal with ambition and aim, Hong Dali firstly had to consider if his opponent had any weakness. Therefore, he simply took out his phone and called his father. “Dad, the outer area of Tianjing Mountain has been occupied by other people, and they aren’t letting me in.”
Hong Weiguo obviously knew who they were. He lowered his voice and said, “Don’t go against them. Quickly return home first.”
“Ah, I wouldn’t go to that extent.” Hong Dali grinned and asked, “I just wanted to ask, have they bought this piece of land?”

“Oh? Not yet.” Hong Weiguo thought for a while. He wasn’t sure of Hong Dali’s meaning. “They are still doing an exploration of the underground cave. As for the price, we haven’t finished negotiations yet. What’s wrong?”

“Oh, since negotiations haven’t ended yet, then it’s simple.” Hong Dali sniffled. “I was thinking. Since negotiations haven’t ended yet, then this land is still ours, it’s still our family’s. So, aren’t they trespassing on private property without the owner’s permission?”
“Er... I guess so.” Hong Weiguo was dazed for a while before he understood Hong Dali’s meaning. “You mean... Dali, don’t be rash. It’s not worth fighting with them.”
“Naturally, I wouldn’t be so rash.” Hong Dali said that matter-of-factly. “However, I’m unsure if Chuyin will be rash or not. Hoho, then, Dad, I shall hang up first.”
“Chuyin?” Hong Weiguo put down the phone and murmured, “Chuyin is with Dali now?”

Thinking of this, Hong Weiguo fiercely slapped his thigh and laughed loudly. “He is indeed my son! Brilliant! Brilliant! Hahaha! Zhu Guangyuan, I indeed cannot do anything about you sending your men and occupying that place, but I never expected that Dali would bring Chuyin with him. Now, you have to swallow your anger whether or not you want to, hahaha!”

As Hong Weiguo was laughing loudly in his office, Captain Zhao was laughing loudly too. “Haha, kid, why, you want to strike at me? I’m warning you, you will be striking at a civil servant—you will be liable to be punished under the Nation’s law. By that time, even your father, Hong Weiguo, won’t be able to save you!”
“I never said that I would be doing anything to you.”

Hong Dali’s face was full of naivety, his eyes widely open. “Uncle Zhao, you have thought wrongly. How could a weak person like me use violence on you?” Saying so, he walked aside. “Chuyin, this person is preventing us from entering. What do you think we should do...”

“Oh, understood.” Lin Chuyin’s body instantly gave off the metallic sounds of machines moving, and her right arm was quickly covered by her exoskeleton armor. She insipidly said, “Target confirmed. Attack.”

As she spoke, the area under her feet exploded, and her whole person rushed forward. In the blink of an eye, her right arm was already pressed against that Captain Zhao’s chest. Then, an extremely cold voice sounded off. “30,000 volts!”

Then, they heard the sizzling sound of something being electrocuted. The sad Captain Zhao’s hair was standing on end, just like the character “Heihachi Mishima” from the video game “Tekken” from his previous life—bald in the center and the hair at the sides standing up... that appearance was fabulous!

Seeing Captain Zhao lying on the ground trembling continuously, Hong Dali gave a deep sigh, his face full of innocence. “Sigh, why must you block Chuyin’s path out of all people. This is really seeking one’s own death...”

“Stop, where are you guys from?”
“Us?
Where are we from?” Hong Dali strangely looked left and right, then pointed at his nose.
“We are students, can’t you tell?” Saying so, he looked at his lackeys and said, “Oh, and a few lackeys too.”
“Please return.” The security guard was depressed.
“This isn’t some place where children can come and play.”
“About that.” Hong Dali was instantly angered to the point of amusement.
“I think you have gotten something wrong.” He pointed at the surrounding forest and the mountain.
“This seems to be my territory...”
“This...” Although the security guard didn’t know Hong Dali, just from his behavior he knew that this was someone he couldn’t offend.
He could only appease him and said, “Then, please wait for a while.
I will go check with my superior.”
Saying so, he ran inside and shouted, “Captain Zhao, Captain Zhao, someone’s here.
He said that this is his territory and wants to go in and take a look.
I don’t dare to make a decision.
Please advise me on what to do.”
“What is he talking about, this place belongs to the nation!” An arrogant voice sounded out.
“Ask them to get lost!”
Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “I don’t think I remember wrongly.
I’m sure I bought this place.” Saying so, as he looked at around, there wasn’t a single plastic bag to be seen.
“There’s no mistake, this place was obviously cleared before.
What situation is this?”
At this moment, the security guard carefully said, “Captain, I think it’s better if you go and take a look.
I really dare not make the decision.”
“How are you doing your job?
You don’t have any capabilities at all.” While saying so, a bald man walked out from the crowd.
He seemed to be about 40 years old and was carrying a mug in his hand.
With his beer-belly popping out from his shirt, once he saw Hong Dali and his group, he said, “Hurry up and go back to where you come from.
I don’t care who you are.
This place has been expropriated by the nation, unrelated persons are not allowed to enter.”
“This...” Hong Dali gradually said, “This place seems to be my home.”
“You are Hong Weiguo’s son, Hong Dali, right?” Captain Zhao looked him up and down.
“I know this is your home, but this place has been expropriated by the nation.
It might become a tourist attraction, so it doesn’t belong to your house anymore.
Hurry up and return home.
I’m giving your Dad some face, so I’m talking to you nicely now.”
This dude knew that Hong Dali was Hong Weiguo’s son and still dared to be so arrogant.
By right, those who could do such a thing only belonged to one of two categories.
The first that this guy was a retard.
The second was that this guy was a retard and was also the person of a rival of the Hong Family.
Yup, from the current circumstances, the second scenario was more probable.
Hong Dali touched his chin.
“What if I refuse?”
“You can’t refuse.” Captain Zhao said darkly, “I know that your bodily condition isn’t good.
I can’t touch you, but it might be difficult for your father, hehe.”
His standpoint was very clear once he said that.
He was obviously not on the same side as them and obviously had a backing that was his family’s rival.
Now, he was just displaying their strength to him.
His meaning was simple—he had someone on top to back him up.
Although the Hong family was a large business entity, Hong Dali still couldn’t do anything to him!
If it were some other nouveau riche, they would naturally get hot-headed, rush up, and prepare to slap his face.
Then, this Captain Zhao would use various methods to defeat and embarrass them—this was what was written in the novels in his previous life.
Normally, it was the nouveau riche who was the antagonist.
Naturally, Hong Dali wasn’t so silly.
Being a prodigal with ambition and aim, Hong Dali firstly had to consider if his opponent had any weakness.
Therefore, he simply took out his phone and called his father.
“Dad, the outer area of Tianjing Mountain has been occupied by other people, and they aren’t letting me in.”
Hong Weiguo obviously knew who they were.
He lowered his voice and said, “Don’t go against them.
Quickly return home first.”
“Ah, I wouldn’t go to that extent.” Hong Dali grinned and asked, “I just wanted to ask, have they bought this piece of land?”
“Oh?
Not yet.” Hong Weiguo thought for a while.
He wasn’t sure of Hong Dali’s meaning.
“They are still doing an exploration of the underground cave.
As for the price, we haven’t finished negotiations yet.
What’s wrong?”
“Oh, since negotiations haven’t ended yet, then it’s simple.” Hong Dali sniffled.
“I was thinking.
Since negotiations haven’t ended yet, then this land is still ours, it’s still our family’s.
So, aren’t they trespassing on private property without the owner’s permission?”
I guess so.” Hong Weiguo was dazed for a while before he understood Hong Dali’s meaning.
“You mean...
Dali, don’t be rash.
It’s not worth fighting with them.”
“Naturally, I wouldn’t be so rash.” Hong Dali said that matter-of-factly.
“However, I’m unsure if Chuyin will be rash or not.
Hoho, then, Dad, I shall hang up first.”
“Chuyin?” Hong Weiguo put down the phone and murmured, “Chuyin is with Dali now?”
Thinking of this, Hong Weiguo fiercely slapped his thigh and laughed loudly.
“He is indeed my son!
Brilliant!
Brilliant!
Hahaha!
Zhu Guangyuan, I indeed cannot do anything about you sending your men and occupying that place, but I never expected that Dali would bring Chuyin with him.
Now, you have to swallow your anger whether or not you want to, hahaha!”
As Hong Weiguo was laughing loudly in his office, Captain Zhao was laughing loudly too.
“Haha, kid, why, you want to strike at me?
I’m warning you, you will be striking at a civil servant—you will be liable to be punished under the Nation’s law.
By that time, even your father, Hong Weiguo, won’t be able to save you!”
“I never said that I would be doing anything to you.”
Hong Dali’s face was full of naivety, his eyes widely open.
“Uncle Zhao, you have thought wrongly.
How could a weak person like me use violence on you?” Saying so, he walked aside.
“Chuyin, this person is preventing us from entering.
What do you think we should do...”
“Oh, understood.” Lin Chuyin’s body instantly gave off the metallic sounds of machines moving, and her right arm was quickly covered by her exoskeleton armor.
She insipidly said, “Target confirmed.
Attack.”
As she spoke, the area under her feet exploded, and her whole person rushed forward.
In the blink of an eye, her right arm was already pressed against that Captain Zhao’s chest.
Then, an extremely cold voice sounded off.
Then, they heard the sizzling sound of something being electrocuted.

The sad Captain Zhao’s hair was standing on end, just like the character “Heihachi Mishima” from the video game “Tekken” from his previous life—bald in the center and the hair at the sides standing up... that appearance was fabulous!
Seeing Captain Zhao lying on the ground trembling continuously, Hong Dali gave a deep sigh, his face full of innocence.
“Sigh, why must you block Chuyin’s path out of all people.
This is really seeking one’s own death...”

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - Underground Expedition
paragraphs: If not, why would Hong Dali laugh so loudly? He could only blame on his own luck for being struck at by Lin Chuyin.

Who was Lin Chuyin? She was a member of the Holy Grail organization, a technological geek with an IQ of more than 180, someone even the Nation had to carefully protect. One could tell this just from her inventions. Other things aside, as long as they kept her happy, and she gave them one or two of her inventions—such as the Holographic Projection Technology—the Nation just had to research and upgrade it, and it would be a precious treasure.
This Holographic Projection Technology would be very useful in both military and civilian use.
Also, Hong Dali had never forgotten that this lass could even build a rocket by herself.
Towards such a person, how would a small character that relied on the influence of others be able to afford to anger her?
Now that he was beaten to the ground by Lin Chuyin, he could only blame his own luck.

The commotion here had already alerted the surrounding security guards. Instantly, a large group of people rushed forward. Seeing that a fight was about to break out, two voices suddenly sounded out. “Dali, what are you doing here?” “Young Master Dali, do you need my help?”
Without question, the person who could ask this was naturally the formidable fighters—Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang.

Upon seeing them, Hong Dali was delighted and said, “You guys came at just the right time. This is my territory, but they are taking it over without any documents to show. What kind of action is this? This is robbery, thievery! They are breaking into my home and stealing from me! Beat them up! Beat them till they die!”
The others were still fine, but Mu Zixiao was definitely the type that when he heard there was a fight, his eyes would shine.

Normally, he would definitely not dare to fight with others when his master was around. But now, with Hong Dali’s approval, things were different. He immediately rushed in and started fighting the security guards. Geezer Wang obeyed Hong Dali’s orders and went in like a gust of wind as well.
Once the two of them started, the three male lackeys and driver Wang Mingyu naturally didn’t hold back. Also, there was the emotionless Lin Chuyin...

To be honest, those security guards were only normal, human standard. Facing Hong Dali’s fierce fighters, they could only be at the receiving end. Within two minutes, all of them were lying on the floor.
At this time, Hong Dali’s classmates all exclaimed:
Ling Yi: “What the heck, kungfu! This is real kungfu!”
Du Xinzhen: “I simply made a prediction and know that they can only lose when they go against Brother Dali!”
Lang Hao: “What the heck, aren’t they the ‘Old and Young Killers’ in the video posted online!? I’m actually seeing them in person now! Brother Dali, you are too awesome!”
Ji Zhiruo: “Sister Chuyin is really formidable!”
Hong Dali was delighted and was making sound effects for them. “Adadada! How dare you go against Brother Dali!”
Tang Muxin softly said, “Dali, is this fine? If they look for other people to help them later...”

Hong Dali scorned and said, “There’s nothing to be afraid of. Everything needs to have a reason. Do they have any document? They don’t, right? Have their superior given my family money to expropriated the land? No, right? They have no document and never spent money, so this is still my family’s territory. It isn’t against the law for me to go back to my own home! If they really push me, I will build a house and just stay here!”
When he said that he would build a house here, he wasn’t joking!
After all, the environment here was graceful. If he really built a villa that had an underground cave filled with stalactites, just thinking about it felt interesting already...
By this time, the path was mostly cleared. Those security guards were like rice straws being cut down by a scythe, falling in pieces here and there, posing no threat at all to the fighters.

Dumbfounded by looking at the entire process, Director Lin’s head was full of cold sweat. He carefully asked, “Young Master, is there a need to go to such an extent? Those are civil servants, after all. Hitting them...”
“There’s no such thing.” Hong Dali strangely said, “I never hit anyone! I swear on God, I’m a good person—did you see me hitting anyone!?”
If you were a good person, would there be any bad person left in this world?

However, after Lin Hao carefully thought about it, he had to admit that Hong Dali didn’t hit anyone. Just now, from far away, he only saw a girl with blue hair and two ponytails making the first move. As for the other security guards—they couldn’t only take the beating without any complaints...
Forget it, I shan’t care about this, there is more important stuff.

Lin Hao grabbed Hong Dali’s elbow and softly said, “Young Master, I heard that there is an underground cave with stalactites here. I think that this is very suitable to use for the cave-in you mentioned for the movie. Therefore, I wanted to ask if you...”
“Oh, hearing you say this, I just realized this too.” Hong Dali was dazed. “This is good, this is good. Let’s just use this cave for that scene!”
Lin Hao secretly thought to himself, See, I said that there was no need to find another location for that scene. Success!
They chatted as they walked and very quickly reached the entrance to the cave.

Hong Dali looked at the dark cave, smiled and said, “We’re finally here. This is the place, right? Inside is the natural stalactite cave? Let’s take a good relaxation today, we shall see what’s in this mysterious cave.” Saying so, he looked at Lin Chuyin. “Chuyin, is your searchlight ready? Let’s go in now and take a look?”

“Oh, it’s ready.” Lin Chuyin didn’t look at all like she just finished a fight. She took out the searchlight from a bag that one of the lackeys was carrying for her and went in first, leading the way.

At this time, it was already close to 7:00 PM. But it was already the 29th of May—daytime was slightly longer. Some faint light came in from the cave entrance. Those civil servants who quarantined this place still had some use to them, so there were already lighting devices placed in the cave. Their group slowly went in, following the steps of the person in front.
The cave was at mid-mountain about 20 meters above sea level. Once they entered the cave, they could obviously feel it going downwards.

No one knew where this mysterious cave led to, but they were certain that it went all the way deep beneath the earth. By that time, there wouldn’t be any lighting available other than what they prepared. It was just as Lin Chuyin predicted, the lighting equipment must be prepared beforehand. Otherwise, they would be blind down there.

Inside the cave, the ground was quite level, and there actually wasn’t any rotten smell. Also, the air was very dry. Tang Muxin softly said, “Looks like there must be a tunnel inside where air can flow through in here. If not, the air wouldn’t be this fresh.”
They continued moving forward for about 30 to 40 meters before Lin Chuyin suddenly said, “Oh, it’s getting steeper. About 15 degrees.”
Tang Muxin, who was following behind her, softly asked, “Sister Chuyin, you can even tell this?”

“Yes.” Lin Chuyin was emotionless. Naturally, she wasn’t afraid. As she walked, she said, “I just calculated, we have walked a total of 46 meters in. There were five turns. When our feet land, we will slightly incline forward.”
“Sister Chuyin is really incredible!” Tang Muxin enviously said, “I didn’t felt anything at all... ah!”
As she spoke, she suddenly gave a sound of surprise, shocking Hong Dali, who was behind her. He asked, “What’s wrong?”
“I was just scaring you, hee hee!”
Tang Muxin suddenly grinned and wittily said, “You were shocked by me just now, right?”
Hong Dali was speechless and said, “You can scare someone to death doing such a thing!”
Tang Muxin pouted. “It’s just that the atmosphere was getting a bit gloomy.”
Just as she said that, Lin Chuyin, who was walking in front, insipidly said, “That are two paths—one towards the left and quite wide, and the other downwards and quite narrow.”
“The downwards one.” Hong Dali instantly decided. “Let’s go and see what there is down there first. Then, when we return, we can go through the left path.”
Since he had spoken, no one objected. Therefore, everyone followed the path downwards.
Mu Zixiao excitedly said, “Dali, do you think that there will be something like a martial arts secret manual inside?”

“You are going crazy from thinking about martial arts all day, aren’t you?” Hong Dali said depressingly. “This is the real world, not a movie. You really think that there is a statue of a fairy that will let you obtain a ‘Nine Suns Divine Art’ if you kowtow a thousand times?”

Speaking of which, Hong Dali wasn’t in the slightest concerned with what was inside this mysterious cave. Mu Zixiao’s dream items, elixirs, and martial arts secret manuals—these were meaningless to Hong Dali.
His aim in coming here was really simple. It was purely for fun...

At this time, Lin Chuyin suddenly stopped. Using the searchlight to illuminate their surroundings, she insipidly said, “It’s obviously much steeper here, and it’s also much larger than expected.” She then illuminated the roof. “Oh, speaking of which, these stalactites seem really normal. They are much smaller than expected.”
However, Hong Dali said, “This place is really big, did everyone bring something to eat? Don’t end up so hungry that you can’t even walk back. That will be funny.”
Everyone looked around at one another and all shook their heads. Instead, Director Lin Hao smiled and said, “I brought quite a lot of snacks...”
This foodie!

They then continued downwards. After not sure how long, Hong Dali suddenly realized that the path was quite steep now. He took in a deep breath. The air was still fresh, there wasn’t any sense of that muffled feeling one would get when they were deep below the earth. He felt strange that the air was actually still very fresh deep down here. This should be impossible.
After another short distance, the sound of water flowing came from the front. Lin Chuyin fastened her pace and, shortly later, they saw a small stream cutting their path.

“Wow, there’s actually a small stream here! Dali, this water must be very tasty, right? It definitely isn’t contaminated!” Tang Muxin cheered and squatted down to drink some water. However, Hong Dali pulled her back. “Be careful, we don’t know where this stream comes from. You might drink something dirty down your stomach.” Saying so, Hong Dali scared her by saying, “For example, snake’s eggs, tadpoles...”
These kinds of slippery creatures were very frightening for females. As expected, Tang Muxin screamed and hid in Hong Dali’s arms.
Hong Dali touched his chin in satisfaction.Speaking of which, the fragrance coming from Xinxin’s body is really quite nice...

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - An Amazing Discovery
paragraphs: As they were fooling around, Lin Chuyin suddenly pointed her searchlight towards the other side of the stream and looked carefully. Then, she squatted down and felt the ground. After that, she insipidly said, “Oh, there’s a small cave opposite, but we are unable to enter.”
“Where, where is it?” Hong Dali moved near Lin Chuyin and his gaze followed the light. “Oh, it really is a small cave... isn’t this a bit too small? I reckon only a spider could crawl in, right?”

It was no wonder that Hong Dali was so surprised, the cave was only as big as a person’s head. By itself, it wasn’t actually significant. But a light breeze was coming from there, so it was obviously a place where the wind could pass through. As for what was actually in there, that was uncertain. As Hong Dali said that, he lightly inhaled from around him. He felt that the air here was even more fresh, like the air in a forest after a rain. It even caused one to feel invigorated. The environment didn’t seem to be too bad.
Lin Chuyin touched around her and suddenly said, “Snakes frequently pass here. Let’s see what’s in there.”
She took out her laptop and the recording device from her backpack as she said that. After she started it, a soft humming sound could be heard as she controlled the device to fly into the small cave.
As the device went in, the image recorded by the device could be seen on Lin Chuyin’s laptop.

Everything was black, and there wasn’t any source of light. The lighting device in the center of the recording device could only shine up to three meters in front of it. Nothing could be seen beyond that.
Everyone held their breath and quietly looked at the image displayed on the monitor.

At first, it was just a very tiny tunnel. The entrance was only a head’s size, but it got wider as the device flew deeper in. Just 10 meters in, space suddenly widened up. Space now was enough for a grown man to stand up and walk. Even further in, after going past a turn, everyone was astonished.
When the light shone in a small part of the space there, even though Hong Dali and the rest were already mentally prepared, they were still shocked by what they saw.

Under the slight shaky light from the recording device, Hong saw that the device was in a place of an enormous amount of space. His family’s Hongwu Villa was already quite large with a length of 200 meters and width of 100 meters, but compared to this enormous underground cave, just from what they could see from the dim light, space there seemed to be almost the same as the villa, and maybe even larger!

Lin Chuyin controlled the device to fly upwards and illuminated all of its surroundings. This cave was sliced into two parts, the left was that enormous piece of land while at the right was a pond which bottom couldn’t be seen. Further ahead where the light could hardly reach, although they couldn’t see clearly, it seemed to be an enormous cave hole.
After scanning around, Lin Chuyin controlled the device to point directly at the center of this enormous cave.

At first, they could faintly see a circular shape with a radius of three to four meters. The top half was large and the bottom half small, causing everyone to be puzzled. Currently, they couldn’t think of anything that fit this shape. Also, this didn’t seem to be something made by humans, but rather something that lay there naturally.
To be precise, this object was just like a gigantic bowl that was placed there.
The device slowly flew forward. When it got closer, everyone exclaimed in shock!
Tang Muxin said, “What a huge turtle!”
Ling Yi said, “What the heck!”
Du Xinzhen: “God, this thing must be from our great-grandfather’s generation, right?”
As for Hong Dali, he said, “What a huge tortoise!”
It was such a gigantic turtle that it was almost unbelievable.
A real gigantic turtle.

Its large shell was at least three meters long, same as that of a medium-sized limousine. The most strange thing was the turtle’s looks. Its head seemed to be that of a crocodile’s, and its hands and legs were unable to shrink into its shell. Its upper jaw was like an eagle’s, and there were three rows of protrusions from its shell. At the sides, there were dentations, just like a saw. Every piece of the shell had a protrusion on it. Its eyes grew at the side of its mouth. At the side of its head, forehead, and neck, there was stuff that protruded out, just like the swelling on a toad. It also looked a bit like scales. At the head, neck, and stomach area were numerous arm-long tentacles.

“Oh, so it’s this.” Lin Chuyin controlled the device to illuminate the turtle all over. Then, she gradually said, “This is an alligator snapping turtle. Hm, this one looks like it has lived for a long time.”
“Alligator snapping turtle?” Seeing that Lin Chuyin knew this creature, Hong Dali immediately asked, “Chuyin, this alligator snapping turtle, what kind of species is this?”

Lin Chuyin was indeed worthy of being a technological geek. It seemed that she had read about such stuff before and remembered them very clearly. “The alligator snapping turtle species is native to freshwater habitats. They don’t have a high requirement for their living environment. They will go into a deep hibernation when the water temperature is below 10-degree Celsius and a light hibernation below 15-degree Celsius. They start to eat normally when the water temperature is above 18-degree Celsius, but 20~33-degree Celsius is the optimal temperature level where they move and eat. They only move a little when the temperature is 34-degree Celsius and above and most stay at the bottom of the water or in the seabed to avoid the heat.

“Their body is quite large. A fully grown alligator snapping turtle’s body length can reach 75 CM and weight as much as 100 KG. Their shell is 60-80 CM long, enabling them to camouflage themselves in the water. Their tongue is like a worm. They will normally stay still in the water and just open their mouth and move their tongue to lure their prey.”
“However, this type of alligator snapping turtle should be normally found in the southeast part of the United States. How this one got here and grew so large is puzzling.”

Hong Dali was cleared of his doubt as to what it was and gave quite a reasonable explanation for its abnormal growth. “1,000-year-old tortoise and 10,000-year-old turtles1, this fellow looks like it must have lived for at least a thousand years. It isn’t strange that it has grown this large. What I feel strange is, how did it get itself into this situation?”
It was no wonder that Hong Dali felt strange.

This gigantic fellow that exceeded the limits of the human imagination on how large it could grow was actually lying on its back in the center of the cave. They also couldn’t tell if it was actually dead or alive. That was why they thought of a gigantic bowl upon seeing its shape at first, those who raised turtles at home could try it out...
Therefore, this super gigantic alligator snapping turtle was amazing in this aspect.

Just lying there, it was already two meters tall. And judging from its size, it must weight at least a few thousand kilograms. It was really a puzzle what kind of incident could actually cause such a large body to be overturned.
As they looked at it, as if sensing something humming and flying around it, the alligator snapping turtle suddenly opened its football-sized eyes, shocking everyone.

Although they were far enough away from it, Tang Muxin still screamed in fright and hid behind Hong Dali. As for the rest, those not as brave fell and sat down on the floor, their whole body shaking in fright.
ROARRR!!!

The camera on the device made contact with the eye of the alligator snapping turtle for a moment, then suddenly, its originally closed mouth opened and let out a huge roar, causing the entire cave to seemingly shake and their ears to go numb.
The roaring lasted quite a while, but there seemed to be a sense of unwillingness in it.

Hearing the roaring sound from the laptop, the originally terrified Tang Muxin furiously shook Hong Dali’s elbow and pitifully begged him. “Dali, this turtle has been here for don’t know how many years, it’s so pitiful. Let’s rescue it, please?”
Actually, even if she didn’t ask, Hong Dali also planned to rescue this super rare gigantic alligator snapping turtle.

After all, this was definitely the first time Hong Dali saw such a special beast from the wild. What was rarer was that its gigantic turtle head seemed to have scales growing on it. From the looks of it, there was almost intelligence in it. It was definitely a divine beast. If this was in ancient times, people would most likely think that it was one of the four sacred beasts, the Black Tortoise2.

However, even though Hong Dali, too, felt pity for the beast, he still shook his head after some thought. “We need time to rescue it. This fellow must weight at least a few thousand kilograms. Putting aside the fact of whether we can successfully rescue it or not, even if we really managed to do it, we have to prevent ourselves from being eaten by it. Or, end up causing it to be captured to some laboratory and cut into pieces for investigation. If that happens, we will really be sinners.”
He wasn’t exaggerating. Although it was unlikely that he would be eaten by this alligator snapping turtle, the other scenarios might happen.

If this gigantic turtle ended up in a laboratory or send to the zoo for an exhibition by the government because of them... That would definitely make them condemned by history—this turtle had lived for thousands of years, it was history by itself!
Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin could only nod.

After all, she was quite an intelligent lass, how could she not understand what Hong Dali was getting at? Just from its appearance, this alligator snapping turtle wasn’t something to be trifled with. What would happen if they turned it over but couldn’t control it? What if it bit anyone it saw?

At this moment, Tang Muxin was at a loss of what to do too, struggling between rescuing and not rescuing it in her heart. In the end, she could only look at the laptop’s screen and softly said, “Big turtle, if we rescue you, you will not cause trouble everywhere, right? You definitely will not eat us, right?”
As she said that, the device really broadcasted her words out.
Strange enough, when the gigantic turtle heard her words, it actually opened it’s mouth again and shouted in joy.
“Haha!” Tang Muxin was overjoyed and cheered. “Dali, it can understand what I am saying! I knew it. Such a cute gigantic fellow, it definitely isn’t some monster, hee hee.”

Looks like this thing really had intelligence in it after living for so many years! Although it might not have understood Tang Muxin’s words, it shouldn’t be a problem for it to understand her meaning!

This was probably the first time that someone said that it was cute in the thousand plus years that it lived, it actually got angry all of a sudden. It stretched its limbs and frantically waved them in the air. It looked like it wasn’t just a small fit that it got into.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - Brother Turn Back
paragraphs: The giant turtle’s action caused Hong Dali and the rest to be amused and laugh. Hong Dali helplessly shook his head, smiled and said, “Big Turtle, I didn’t think you would be this petty. However, I don’t have any ideas on how to save you yet, so you still have to tolerate for some more time—we are unable to get to your place yet!”
Hearing Hong Dali’s words, the turtle opened its mouth and roared again.

Now that they had decided to rescue the alligator snapping turtle, everyone was very happy. Tang Muxin smiled and said, “I knew that Dali had a kind heart. Then, hurry up and think, how can we rescue it? Even if it can’t come out, we have to at least help it flip over, right? Looking at it now, I reckon that it didn’t eat for a long time.”
She was right. If it weren’t a turtle, a miraculous creature, any other type of creature would have died from hunger ages ago.

They would definitely save it, but the size of this alligator snapping turtle... Very obviously, even if they managed to get inside, just the few of them wouldn’t be enough. As for large machines, they wouldn’t fit inside too. It was really a difficult situation.

As they were thinking hard for a solution, Hong Dali suddenly noticed Geezer Wang standing at the side and asked, “Geezer Wang, do you think using Taiji’s method of using a small force to move a large force will work?”

Geezer Wang shook his head and said, “Definitely not. That refers to borrowing strength from one and returning it to them. If done properly, we can use a small force to deflect a large force. However, no matter how miraculous kungfu can be, it needs to have a foundation. Using a 5 KG force to deflect a 10 KG force is still possible, but using a 50 KG force to deflect a 5000 KG force is definitely impossible.”
Looks like there indeed wasn’t any possible solution.
They thought for a long time, but the alligator snapping turtle’s size was really too huge, they couldn’t come up with anything.

Hong Dali thought for another short while before finally helplessly saying, “OK, let’s not think about this for now. Chuyin, give me a copy of the video you took just now. I will go back and think of something.”

“Oh, OK.” Lin Chuyin agreed and quickly took out a flash drive to save it. Hong Dali turned around and said, “OK, let’s go back now. We are not fully prepared today, we shall come back after we prepare the tools and stuff.”
Since he said so, the rest could only follow.

After Lin Chuyin kept her flying device, they instantly walked back. When walking past the crossroad, they went in to take a look too. There were only stalactites that were suitable for tourists to view, but nothing else.

After they came out of the cave hole into the underground cave, Lin Hao remembered that he had something to ask Hong Dali. He hurriedly pulled him back and asked, “Young Master, this cave is the perfect spot for that scene in our movie, do you think...”
“I approve.” How could Hong Dali not understand his meaning, so he directly said, “After I chased those annoying guys away, you can bring your crew over!”
With his trump card, Lin Chuyin, by his side, Hong Dali didn’t believe that Captain Zhao dared to resort to violence against him!
If Captain Zhao dared to touch a single hair on Lin Chuyin, the National Security Bureau would definitely invite him over for tea. As for how long, he wasn’t sure. Humph!
Having obtained Hong Dali’s approval, Lin Hao was finally relieved. Young Master’s words were like nails nailed to a steel plate, they definitely wouldn’t change.
He thought for a while and suddenly remembered that the name of the film had yet to be decided. He hurriedly asked, “Also, Young Master, what name do you think we should use for this film?”

“Name?” Hong Dali touched his chin. According to his view, names were better the longer they were. He fiercely slapped his thigh and said, “Let’s name it ‘Condor Shooting Heroes, Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre—Jianghu of Eight Legions’!”
“Pfft!” Hearing this name, everyone couldn’t help but collapse in laughter.
Cheh, laugh all you want, you guys have no idea what such a meaningful name means!

To be honest, Lin Hao wanted to laugh too, but he didn’t dare. He tried to hold it in, but in the end, he couldn’t help but helplessly say, “This... Young Master, isn’t this name a bit too long, why not we shorten it? Also, what should the main character’s name be?”
“Decide yourself.” Hong Dali said without much thought. “Decide on the main character’s name yourself. Just don’t name him Long Xiangtian!”

Actually, he intended to name him Xiao Feng. That’s King Xiao, Hong Dali’s favorite character! However, naming the main character of such a low movie Xiao Feng, that’s not very appropriate. Just wait till I reproduce Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils in this world myself! Brouhaha!
The group of them continued walking out. When they exited the underground cave, they were instantly dazed.

It was already past 8:00 PM now, there shouldn’t be anyone around here anymore. But now, there were 200 plus people blocking their way. Their leader was a bald man who was around 40 plus years old. He carried a mug with him, and his beer belly was popping out. He was the guy who was knocked down by Lin Chuyin’s “30,000 Voltage,” Captain Zhao.
Upon seeing Hong Dali and his group walking out, he violent pointed at them. “It’s them! Capture them! Be careful of that blue-haired stinky lass, she has an electric baton on her!”
Hearing him said that, Hong Dali helplessly shrugged.

It’s really annoying when one’s IQ is so low. Not only is he unfortunate, but he also affected other people’s mood. Being a lackey, his Master isn’t someone like me who constantly gives tips, what are you risking your life for?
However, they didn’t end up in a fight.

Seeing Captain Zhao’s people rushing towards Hong Dali and his group, a man in suits suddenly walked out from the side. He was around 30 plus years old and wore a sunglass even in this dark environment. He even had a cigarette in his mouth. He just sloppily stood in front of Hong Dali and his group, blocking the attack for them.
Anyone would be curious upon seeing such a person suddenly appearing and interfering with their business, right?
Captain Zhao was very curious too. He violently waved his hand, and the 200 plus security guards instantly stopped. He then asked, “Who are you, what are you here for?”

“Me?” That man waved his hand and four men rushed out from the surroundings and seized Captain Zhao. The man with the sunglass then took out a credential from his pocket, walked up to Captain Zhao, and waved it in front of him. “I’m from the National Security Bureau. Your name is Zhao Changfa, right? It’s nothing much, just that I want to invite you over for a cup of tea.”
Hearing his words, Hong Dali instantly touched his own nose.
Being invited by the National Security Bureau for tea, it would be easy to go in, but it was hard to say when he could come out...

As expected, Zhao Changfa was instantly frightened upon hearing that. He furiously shouted, “Why are you capturing me? Why? We belong to different systems, even if I’m to be taken in, it shouldn’t be your affair, right?”

“Originally, it wasn’t our affair.” The sunglass man said, “But the problem is, you are going to make a move against Lin Chuyin, so we can’t just stand aside.” Saying so, he chicly waved his hand. “Take him away. Let him have a cup of tea. Drink slowly, don’t rush, in case you get burned.”

Hong Dali watched on in delight. He knew that the National Security Bureau wouldn’t just leave this matter like this. Normally, they wouldn’t appear, but when someone wanted to lay their hand on Lin Chuyin, they definitely had to come out and help!
Just that he had no idea how much authority the sunglass man had. If he had a lot of power, they could ask for his help regarding the alligator snapping turtle’s problem.

As he was thinking about this, sunglass man waved his hand and dismissed the security guards that Zhao Changfa gathered. Then, he turned around and smiled at Hong Dali, saying, “Hello, you are Young Master Dali, right? My name is Mu Huishou. We are on all on the same side. I should be older than you by a few years, you can just call me Brother Mu. It will sound more close this way, hehe.”
Look at this, look at this. Isn’t he amiable and approachable?
Hong Dali decisively agreed and said, “Then from now on, I shall call you Brother Turn Back1!”
Everyone around them instantly collapsed in laughter.
The sunglass man from the National Security Bureau was very depressed, but Hong Dali wasn’t wrong in calling him that. After all, Huishou and turning back meant the same thing.
Mu Huishou smiled and said, “I wonder if you are free now? Can we find a place and have a chat?”

Hong Dali knew that since he was very close with Lin Chuyin, this situation would come sooner or later. Naturally, he wouldn’t reject. He smiled and said, “OK, I don’t have any matters anyway. Why don’t you find a place?”
“You car is parked just in front, right?” Mu Huishou said, “Let’s just go there.”
That was convenient. They instantly moved out towards the car.

They got into the Soaring Angel. Now that someone from the National Security Bureau wanted to talk to Hong Dali, their surroundings naturally had to be cleared of people. Even Wang Mingyu had to alight and move away to avoid suspicions. In the end, only Hong Dali, Tang Muxin, Lin Chuyin, and the sunglass man were left inside.

“Brother Turn Back, what is the matter, why is it so mysterious?” Hong Dali looked outside the window at the men from the National Security Bureau guarding the perimeter and asked, “It definitely isn’t a small matter for you to come to find me at night, right?” As he said so, he suddenly laughed and said, “Also, Brother Turn Back, aren’t you going to take off your sunglass when we are already here?”

“Haha, there is no need for that.” Mu Huishou smiled and said, “Speaking of which, this sunglass was invented by Miss Chuyin.” Mu Huishou touched his sunglass that was similar to the one wore by Cyclops from X-Men and said, “This sunglass has an electromagnetic sensor that can discover signal receivers nearby. It also has a heat sensor and can discover the living creatures in my blind spots.”
“Heat sensor?” Hong Dali liked these kinds of fun and small devices. “What kind of device is that?”

“It’s like a snake. A snake’s eye can’t see, it relies on sensing the heat source of its surroundings when hunting for food.” Mu Huishou casually explained, then changed the topic. “Let’s not talk about that. The reason I appeared today partly is that I worried about Captain Zhao’s IQ. Another reason is that I wanted to ask you all, what did you see in the cave that we can’t pass through?”
After saying that, he added, “We saw the flying device that Miss Chuyin invented. You know what I mean.”
