Even if it can’t come out, we have to at least help it flip over, right?
Looking at it now, I reckon that it didn’t eat for a long time.”
She was right.
If it weren’t a turtle, a miraculous creature, any other type of creature would have died from hunger ages ago.
They would definitely save it, but the size of this alligator snapping turtle...
Very obviously, even if they managed to get inside, just the few of them wouldn’t be enough.
As for large machines, they wouldn’t fit inside too.
It was really a difficult situation.

As they were thinking hard for a solution, Hong Dali suddenly noticed Geezer Wang standing at the side and asked, “Geezer Wang, do you think using Taiji’s method of using a small force to move a large force will work?”
Geezer Wang shook his head and said, “Definitely not.
That refers to borrowing strength from one and returning it to them.
If done properly, we can use a small force to deflect a large force.
However, no matter how miraculous kungfu can be, it needs to have a foundation.
Using a 5 KG force to deflect a 10 KG force is still possible, but using a 50 KG force to deflect a 5000 KG force is definitely impossible.”
Looks like there indeed wasn’t any possible solution.
They thought for a long time, but the alligator snapping turtle’s size was really too huge, they couldn’t come up with anything.
Hong Dali thought for another short while before finally helplessly saying, “OK, let’s not think about this for now.
Chuyin, give me a copy of the video you took just now.
I will go back and think of something.”
“Oh, OK.” Lin Chuyin agreed and quickly took out a flash drive to save it.
Hong Dali turned around and said, “OK, let’s go back now.
We are not fully prepared today, we shall come back after we prepare the tools and stuff.”
Since he said so, the rest could only follow.
After Lin Chuyin kept her flying device, they instantly walked back.
When walking past the crossroad, they went in to take a look too.
There were only stalactites that were suitable for tourists to view, but nothing else.
After they came out of the cave hole into the underground cave, Lin Hao remembered that he had something to ask Hong Dali.
He hurriedly pulled him back and asked, “Young Master, this cave is the perfect spot for that scene in our movie, do you think...”
“I approve.” How could Hong Dali not understand his meaning, so he directly said, “After I chased those annoying guys away, you can bring your crew over!”
With his trump card, Lin Chuyin, by his side, Hong Dali didn’t believe that Captain Zhao dared to resort to violence against him!
If Captain Zhao dared to touch a single hair on Lin Chuyin, the National Security Bureau would definitely invite him over for tea.
As for how long, he wasn’t sure.
Humph!
Having obtained Hong Dali’s approval, Lin Hao was finally relieved.
Young Master’s words were like nails nailed to a steel plate, they definitely wouldn’t change.
He thought for a while and suddenly remembered that the name of the film had yet to be decided.
He hurriedly asked, “Also, Young Master, what name do you think we should use for this film?”
“Name?” Hong Dali touched his chin.
According to his view, names were better the longer they were.
He fiercely slapped his thigh and said, “Let’s name it ‘Condor Shooting Heroes, Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre—Jianghu of Eight Legions’!”
“Pfft!” Hearing this name, everyone couldn’t help but collapse in laughter.
Cheh, laugh all you want, you guys have no idea what such a meaningful name means!
To be honest, Lin Hao wanted to laugh too, but he didn’t dare.
He tried to hold it in, but in the end, he couldn’t help but helplessly say, “This...
Young Master, isn’t this name a bit too long, why not we shorten it?
Also, what should the main character’s name be?”
“Decide yourself.” Hong Dali said without much thought.
“Decide on the main character’s name yourself.
Just don’t name him Long Xiangtian!”
Actually, he intended to name him Xiao Feng.
That’s King Xiao, Hong Dali’s favorite character!
However, naming the main character of such a low movie Xiao Feng, that’s not very appropriate.
Just wait till I reproduce Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils in this world myself!
Brouhaha!
The group of them continued walking out.
When they exited the underground cave, they were instantly dazed.
It was already past 8:00 PM now, there shouldn’t be anyone around here anymore.
But now, there were 200 plus people blocking their way.
Their leader was a bald man who was around 40 plus years old.
He carried a mug with him, and his beer belly was popping out.
He was the guy who was knocked down by Lin Chuyin’s “30,000 Voltage,” Captain Zhao.
Upon seeing Hong Dali and his group walking out, he violent pointed at them.
“It’s them!
Capture them!
Be careful of that blue-haired stinky lass, she has an electric baton on her!”
Hearing him said that, Hong Dali helplessly shrugged.
It’s really annoying when one’s IQ is so low.
Not only is he unfortunate, but he also affected other people’s mood.
Being a lackey, his Master isn’t someone like me who constantly gives tips, what are you risking your life for?
However, they didn’t end up in a fight.
Seeing Captain Zhao’s people rushing towards Hong Dali and his group, a man in suits suddenly walked out from the side.
He was around 30 plus years old and wore a sunglass even in this dark environment.
He even had a cigarette in his mouth.
He just sloppily stood in front of Hong Dali and his group, blocking the attack for them.
Anyone would be curious upon seeing such a person suddenly appearing and interfering with their business, right?
Captain Zhao was very curious too.
He violently waved his hand, and the 200 plus security guards instantly stopped.
He then asked, “Who are you, what are you here for?”
“Me?” That man waved his hand and four men rushed out from the surroundings and seized Captain Zhao.
The man with the sunglass then took out a credential from his pocket, walked up to Captain Zhao, and waved it in front of him.
“I’m from the National Security Bureau.
Your name is Zhao Changfa, right?
It’s nothing much, just that I want to invite you over for a cup of tea.”
Hearing his words, Hong Dali instantly touched his own nose.
Being invited by the National Security Bureau for tea, it would be easy to go in, but it was hard to say when he could come out...
As expected, Zhao Changfa was instantly frightened upon hearing that.
He furiously shouted, “Why are you capturing me?
Why?
We belong to different systems, even if I’m to be taken in, it shouldn’t be your affair, right?”
“Originally, it wasn’t our affair.” The sunglass man said, “But the problem is, you are going to make a move against Lin Chuyin, so we can’t just stand aside.” Saying so, he chicly waved his hand.
“Take him away.
Let him have a cup of tea.
Drink slowly, don’t rush, in case you get burned.”
Hong Dali watched on in delight.
He knew that the National Security Bureau wouldn’t just leave this matter like this.
Normally, they wouldn’t appear, but when someone wanted to lay their hand on Lin Chuyin, they definitely had to come out and help!
Just that he had no idea how much authority the sunglass man had.
If he had a lot of power, they could ask for his help regarding the alligator snapping turtle’s problem.
As he was thinking about this, sunglass man waved his hand and dismissed the security guards that Zhao Changfa gathered.
Then, he turned around and smiled at Hong Dali, saying, “Hello, you are Young Master Dali, right?
My name is Mu Huishou.
We are on all on the same side.
I should be older than you by a few years, you can just call me Brother Mu.
It will sound more close this way, hehe.”
Look at this, look at this.
Isn’t he amiable and approachable?
Hong Dali decisively agreed and said, “Then from now on, I shall call you Brother Turn Back1!”
Everyone around them instantly collapsed in laughter.
The sunglass man from the National Security Bureau was very depressed, but Hong Dali wasn’t wrong in calling him that.
After all, Huishou and turning back meant the same thing.
Mu Huishou smiled and said, “I wonder if you are free now?
Can we find a place and have a chat?”
Hong Dali knew that since he was very close with Lin Chuyin, this situation would come sooner or later.
Naturally, he wouldn’t reject.
He smiled and said, “OK, I don’t have any matters anyway.
Why don’t you find a place?”
“You car is parked just in front, right?” Mu Huishou said, “Let’s just go there.”
That was convenient.
They instantly moved out towards the car.
They got into the Soaring Angel.
Now that someone from the National Security Bureau wanted to talk to Hong Dali, their surroundings naturally had to be cleared of people.
Even Wang Mingyu had to alight and move away to avoid suspicions.
In the end, only Hong Dali, Tang Muxin, Lin Chuyin, and the sunglass man were left inside.

“Brother Turn Back, what is the matter, why is it so mysterious?” Hong Dali looked outside the window at the men from the National Security Bureau guarding the perimeter and asked, “It definitely isn’t a small matter for you to come to find me at night, right?” As he said so, he suddenly laughed and said, “Also, Brother Turn Back, aren’t you going to take off your sunglass when we are already here?”

“Haha, there is no need for that.” Mu Huishou smiled and said, “Speaking of which, this sunglass was invented by Miss Chuyin.” Mu Huishou touched his sunglass that was similar to the one wore by Cyclops from X-Men and said, “This sunglass has an electromagnetic sensor that can discover signal receivers nearby.
It also has a heat sensor and can discover the living creatures in my blind spots.”
“Heat sensor?” Hong Dali liked these kinds of fun and small devices.
“What kind of device is that?”
“It’s like a snake.
A snake’s eye can’t see, it relies on sensing the heat source of its surroundings when hunting for food.” Mu Huishou casually explained, then changed the topic.
“Let’s not talk about that.
The reason I appeared today partly is that I worried about Captain Zhao’s IQ.
Another reason is that I wanted to ask you all, what did you see in the cave that we can’t pass through?”
After saying that, he added, “We saw the flying device that Miss Chuyin invented.
You know what I mean.”

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - The Mascot of Tianjing City
paragraphs: Damn, looks like this dude isn’t easy to dupe, his information on everything is very thorough.
Hong Dali touched his chin, carefully calculating the possible results.

It shouldn’t be a simple thing for this Mu Huishou to appear. Settling Captain Zhao should be only one aspect of it. The other aspect... could it be that they have discovered the alligator snapping turtle in that cave? Or they anticipated that there’s some sort of treasure there?

Seeing Hong Dali’s reaction, Mu Huishou knew what he was worried about. He smiled and said, “Young Master Dali, don’t worry. I just want to know the situation. I guarantee with my integrity that I just want to understand what is in there, that’s all.”
“Oh, your integrity?” Hong Dali looked at him and suddenly asked Lin Chuyin, “Chuyin, is his integrity reliable?”
Mu Huishou: “...”
Luckily, although Lin Chuyin didn’t have any emotions, her answer was still quite reliable. “His reliability is 89/100.”
Mu Huishou felt very depressed.
Hong Dali was relieved. If Chuyin said so, then that must be the case. Then, Hong Dali grinned and said, “Brother Turn Back, you really want to know? But I have a condition for telling you!”

Mu Huishou had already expected that Hong Dali would definitely have conditions. Therefore, he didn’t object and just laughed. “Why don’t you let me take a look at the video, then we can discuss the conditions, how about that? I think, as long as your conditions are not too overboard, I still can make the decision myself.” Since he already said it this way, looks like his rank in the National Security Bureau wasn’t a low one.

“Since you are able to represent the National Security Bureau to discuss the terms and conditions with me, it would be embarrassing if you didn’t have the power to be able to decide on things yourself.” Hong Dali’s face put on a harmless smile and said, “Then, Brother Turn Back, let’s look at the video we took first?”
“Then, let’s do that now?” Mu Huishou smiled and said.

Very quickly, Lin Chuyin prepared her laptop and showed him the video. After just seeing two minutes of it, Mu Huishou was already astonished. “This can’t be? There really exist such a creature!? One of the four sacred beasts, the Black Tortoise!?” On the monitor of the laptop was the extremely huge alligator snapping turtle.

“It’s really scary for one to be uneducated!” Hong Dali decisively showed off the knowledge he only just learned from Lin Chuyin, not forgetting to look down on Mu Huishou at the same time. “This is an alligator snapping turtle! The alligator snapping turtle species is native to freshwater habitats. They don’t have a high requirement for their living environment. Their body is quite large. A fully grown alligator snapping turtle’s body length can reach 75 CM and weight as much as 100 KG. Of course, this one is even more incredible, it must weight at least a few tons.”

“Yup.” Mu Huishou touched his chin. “Looks like this alligator snapping turtle developed quite healthily. There might be some sort of variation in its genes too. Actually, this often happens to some animals because of various strange reasons. This isn’t a new thing anymore. I have even seen before an 800 KG tuna. It’s still considered normal for this alligator snapping turtle to grow to such an extent.”
“An 800 KG tuna!” Hong Dali’s eyes lit up. “Is it tasty!?”

“How would I know that?” Mu Huishou felt quite depressed towards Hong Dali’s answer. But now, since he had finished seeing the video, it was time to talk about the conditions. “Since there is such a large alligator snapping turtle in there, this matter can be either a big one or a small one. Young Master Dali, tell me your conditions first.”

“My condition is very simple, really.” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “First, the Nation is not allowed to expropriate this place. Second, since this alligator snapping turtle was discovered in my territory, naturally, it belongs to me. No one is allowed to capture it for research!”
I have the title of Animal’s Best Friend, this alligator snapping turtle naturally will not hurt me.
“Hm...” Mu Huishou thought for a while and gradually said, “This two matters, both of them are not easy...”

“Brother Turn Back.” Hong Dali wasn’t silly, he naturally knew that it was time to negotiate. “Since you are able to show yourself here, naturally, you have the power to make decisions. If not, you wouldn’t have directly asked to talk with me, right?”

“Haha, it’s indeed convenient to talk with a smart person.” Mu Huishou laughed loudly. “Then, I shan’t go roundabouts with you. Let me put it this way, my people have also gathered quite a bit of information regarding this underground cave. It will only become an average tourist attraction, not too good, not too bad either. If I inform my superiors about this place and ask them not to take back this place, that will not be a problem.

“The real problem is this alligator snapping turtle.” Mu Huishou point at the alligator snapping turtle’s figure on the monitor. “This thing, if we think about it simply, it’s just a big turtle. But if we think about it more complexly, then, it will be a severe matter.”

Speaking up to this point, Mu Huishou said in a deep voice, “According to the news we obtained previously, it was said that there are occasional sounds of roaring coming from inside. However, the cave entrance is too small, so we couldn’t enter. Today, we heard that you guys came over here. We knew that you guys would be able to find out what’s inside, so we followed here. Put it this way, this alligator snapping turtle, if we exaggerate a bit, it’s the Black Tortoise, one of the four sacred beasts!”

The Black Tortoise, also called Xuan Ming, a combination of snake and turtle. It was a water god that lived in the north sea. Turtles were a symbol of longevity, and Xuan Ming became a symbol of immortality. Because the Underworld1was also in the north, so it was also called the God of the North. The Green Dragon and White Tiger controlled the four directions, the Vermilion Bird and the Black Tortoise maintained the balance of Yin and Yang. The Black Tortoise was also capable of entering the Underworld. Therefore, different from the other three sacred beasts, it was also named “Heavenly Emperor Zhen Wu.”
Hearing Mu Huishou saying that, Hong Dali very quickly understood his meaning. “Brother Turn Back, you mean to say that this alligator snapping turtle might become a totem and... Advertise it?”

“That’s right.” Mu Huishou said, “The most crucial thing about it is that it’s a huge turtle and it’s alive. Have you thought of its enormous influence on the citizens of the Nation once it goes on TV? One of the four sacred beasts, the Black Tortoise, coming alive, how much moral would that boost for our people?”
To put it bluntly, this alligator snapping turtle wasn’t just a large-sized turtle anymore.
It could become a symbol, a symbol of Heaven’s blessing.

“Yup, that’s indeed the case...” Hong Dali touched his chin and nodded. “Thinking about it this way, this is really interesting. One of the four sacred beasts, the Black Tortoise, appearing in front of everyone. If the Nation advertises and say that this is a symbol of the rise of our Nation, then everyone’s enthusiasm for work will definitely shoot up—but what has this got to do with me?”

“How has this got nothing to do with you!?” Mu Huishou frantically said, “It was discovered in your territory, at least before the Nation officially announce that it belongs to the Nation, it belongs to you...”

However, once he said that, Mu Huishou knew that he had fallen for Hong Dali’s trick. As expected, Hong Dali laughed loudly, his eyes shining golden lights. “That’s the way to go. Brother Turn Back, you have said for yourself that this big fellow belongs to me. To put it this way, I intended to raise it as a pet. Oh my, with it around, next time when I bring it out for a walk, just imagine this, me sitting on its back and carrying Quentin in my arms. If I have an eagle standing on my shoulder too, I will practically become the animal king of the city, right! That will be extremely cool!”
“I suddenly realized that you are really sinister.” The corner of Mu Huishou’s lips twitched. “You aren’t serious about sitting on it and walking it out on the streets, right?”

“Why not?” Hong Dali’s eyes were full of stars. “I’m sure that this thing is more attention-grabbing than my Soaring Angel by a hundred times! A hundred times! Also, I dare to guarantee.” Hong Dali humphed and said, “Other than me, no one else is capable of taming it!”
“That’s true.” Mu Huishou felt helpless. “You seem to naturally attract the welcome of animals. This might be related to the fact that you have a lack of attacking power as a human.”
Hong Dali had a weak constitution, practically anyone with a bit of power knew this.
Being a member of the National Security Bureau and being able to become its representative, he was naturally very well-informed. He also knew that Hong Dali liked to raise animals.

Now, hearing Hong Dali said that, Mu Huishou suddenly felt that this seemed to be the only possible solution—at least, this Hong Dali should be able to calm the emotions of this gigantic alligator snapping turtle so that it would not have a tendency to attack people.

Thinking about it like this, before his superiors gave him specific orders on what to do with the alligator snapping turtle, getting Hong Dali to interact with it first might be a good idea. This seemed more probable and also would not offend him—amongst the higher-ups in the National Security Bureau, the lucky prodigal Hong Dali had a well-known nickname that even Hong Dali himself didn’t know.
They called Hong Dali “The Mascot of Tianjing City.”
Of course, no one knew what Hong Dali would think of such a cute nickname if he knew about it.

Currently, Hong Dali was thinking about how he should ride the turtle once it belonged to him. Although a turtle moved very slowly, this one shouldn’t be too slow due to its huge size. Even if its speed couldn’t be compared to cars, it should be at least on par with the speed of bicycles...

“Young Master Dali.” Mu Huishou thought for a while and said, “I really can’t make the decision regarding this matter. However, I’m confident of one thing.” Saying so, he smiled and said, “At least before the official documents arrive, this alligator snapping turtle is still your private property. As long as you don’t take it out of our Nation, then, I can assure you that we will not make any move against you.”

“Hahaha, that’s enough for me!” Hong Dali was quite satisfied with his words. “Yup, looks like I should consider building a super enormous villa to ensure that it has enough space to move about. Or, should I just let it play in Fengyuan Lake? Oh my, it’s really smart of me to buy that place last time. Fengyuan Lake is so large, it’s the perfect place to be its home!”
Hearing Hong Dali said so, Tang Muxin softly said, “This time, Fengyuan Lake is also being used...”

“Since this is the case, then let’s hope that we will have a happy collaboration.” Mu Huishou stretched out his hand. “I wish that Young Master Dali will ensure your own safety. After all, you are very popular in my department.”
The mascot of Tianjing City, how could his popularity not be high?

This seemed more probable and also would not offend him—amongst the higher-ups in the National Security Bureau, the lucky prodigal Hong Dali had a well-known nickname that even Hong Dali himself didn’t know.
They called Hong Dali “The Mascot of Tianjing City.”
Of course, no one knew what Hong Dali would think of such a cute nickname if he knew about it.
Currently, Hong Dali was thinking about how he should ride the turtle once it belonged to him.
Although a turtle moved very slowly, this one shouldn’t be too slow due to its huge size.
Even if its speed couldn’t be compared to cars, it should be at least on par with the speed of bicycles...
“Young Master Dali.” Mu Huishou thought for a while and said, “I really can’t make the decision regarding this matter.
However, I’m confident of one thing.” Saying so, he smiled and said, “At least before the official documents arrive, this alligator snapping turtle is still your private property.
As long as you don’t take it out of our Nation, then, I can assure you that we will not make any move against you.”
“Hahaha, that’s enough for me!” Hong Dali was quite satisfied with his words.
“Yup, looks like I should consider building a super enormous villa to ensure that it has enough space to move about.
Or, should I just let it play in Fengyuan Lake?
Oh my, it’s really smart of me to buy that place last time.
Fengyuan Lake is so large, it’s the perfect place to be its home!”
Hearing Hong Dali said so, Tang Muxin softly said, “This time, Fengyuan Lake is also being used...”
“Since this is the case, then let’s hope that we will have a happy collaboration.” Mu Huishou stretched out his hand.
“I wish that Young Master Dali will ensure your own safety.
After all, you are very popular in my department.”
The mascot of Tianjing City, how could his popularity not be high?

chapters.title: Chapter 190
paragraphs: “Of course, of course.” Hong Dali didn’t have any awareness of being a mascot. He stretched out his hand and lightly held Mu Huishou’s hand. “Then, from now on, you will have to help me help, hehe.”
This is really cool, isn’t it? The National Security Bureau! Even someone from the National Security Bureau is shaking hands with me and chatting with me!
“Hehe, these are all small matters.” Mu Huishou didn’t forget to do Hong Dali a favor. “I heard that you are looking for a small hooligan called Bighead? I will help you look for him.”
Look at that, he is really good at building connections, isn’t he? Hong Dali decisively waved his hand. “Reward everyone 5,000!”
Instantly, a male lackey ran up and started counting money.
Mu Huishou didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. “Young Master Dali, this... there is no need for this, right?”
“Just take it.” Hong Dali opened the door. “This isn’t considered a bribe. All those who are around my age and that I feel comfortable with, I will tip them. Haha, OK, I’m going home to sleep now.”
The matters here had come to an end. Thus, Hong Dali instantly got on the car and left.
“Boss, what do you feel about this mascot? He seems quite easy to bluff!” After Hong Dali left, a young man from the National Security Bureau looked at the direction Hong Dali left and asked.
“Easy to bluff? This kid isn’t simple.” Mu Huishou put on a thoughtful expression and took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket, throwing one to the young man.

“This can’t be, I have followed you around in our department for five to six years and have seen all kinds of situations before. This small kid, what’s not simple about him?” White Wolf1caught the cigarette, put it below his nose and violently sniffed it, looking at his boss incredulously.
“Old Bai2, remember, in this field, your eyes must be sharp. On the appearance, this kid seems to always laugh about and never seems serious. However, in reality, he isn’t easy to bluff at all.”

Mu Huishou took a puff, his eyes squinted, radiating lights of wisdom. “Don’t you feel that he is like a sly fox? He looks very harmless, but in fact, he is quite cunning. Especially his attitude of not showing much concern for anything. Towards such a person, the only thing we can do is to maintain a good relationship with him!”
If Hong Dali heard this, he would definitely bite him to death! Since when was he cunning? That’s called cute! Cute!
“But he is already 18 this year, he just completed his coming of age ceremony!” White Wolf still felt unconvinced. Being their boss, Mu Huishou rarely ever commented on someone so seriously.

“White Wolf, didn’t you always ask me what happened about that incident in the past?” Mu Huishou threw down his cigarette and violently stepped on it. Then, he found a rock and sat down on it, lighting up another cigarette and taking in a deep puff.

White Wolf admired this boss from the bottom of his heart. Since the first day he entered the National Security Bureau, he knew that this person was the hero who wiped out the international drug trafficking organization, Cobra.
However, Mu Huishou had never told him what exactly happened on that incident before. Hearing he mentioning about it himself today, White Wolf instantly felt curious.
“Do you know how Cobra was wiped out that year?” Mu Huishou’s expression was quite marvelous.
It contained a bit of longing and even some envy.

White Wolf couldn’t believe his eyes. The boss who was never concerned about his own death and was ranked third in fighting skills in the whole army actually showed envy. This strange scene caused White Wolf’s heart to feel a sense of coldness. He knew that what his boss said next would definitely be shocking.
“Wasn’t it said that they were wiped out by 200 special forces from the counternarcotics trafficking department?” White Wolf asked.

“Two hundred special forces?” Mu Huishou put on a ridiculing bitter smile, and in a hoarse voice that could cause people’s heart to ache, said, “There were indeed 200 special forces, and I was one of the leaders then. However, there was only one person who went and killed Cobra’s leader, a real martial arts master!”

Mu Huishou’s expression was slightly obsessed now. It was apparent how deeply that incident had affected him. As someone who had gone through blood and chaos before, his body actually started to tremble. “One person infiltrated their main base and killed their leader with only one move!”
White Wolf’s mouth was already wide open, he didn’t even felt the cigarette burning his fingers.

“You must be curious who that person is, right?” Mu Huishou took in a deep breath and didn’t hold back this time. “Even until now, I still don’t know his name. However, he has a nickname—Iron Bear. And his master is called Long-Armed Ape.
“You might be unfamiliar with this name, but you will know who I’m talking about once I mention another person.
“That Geezer Wang who was with Hong Dali, Soaring Eagle Wang Daoming, is Long-Armed Ape’s senior fellow apprentice.”
White Wolf was shocked to the point of falling down on his butt.
He couldn’t accept this fact, definitely not! Although it was an actual fact, a fact that was like a fantasy story!

Being a member of the National Security Bureau, White Wolf naturally knew who Geezer Wang was. However, he never thought that this Geezer Wang was actually so strong! The senior fellow apprentice of Long-Armed Ape! Long-Armed Ape’s apprentice alone was able to single-handedly kill the leader of Cobra when they were all armed with modern weapons!

“He is a tiger under the disguise of a pig!” Mu Huishou sighed and said, “This kid is followed by all kinds of strong and powerful people, yet he doesn’t know it himself. Saying that he is a tiger under the disguise of a pig is already a compliment to him.

“He isn’t pretending to be a pig, he really is a pig! But the problem is, this pig is a bit large, a bit demonic. I think that using Zhu Bajie3to describe him is quite apt. On the surface, he seems easy going and a bit cute, but whoever becomes his enemy, that nine-toothed rake will definitely smash their head.
“Our Tianjing City’s mascot isn’t as simple as he looks, hehe.”

“Xinxin, you’re home now. Hurry up and go sleep, I shall see you tomorrow.” After sending Tang Muxin to her house district’s gate, Hong Dali got down the car and stretched his waist. The bright moonlight hung on his shoulder, giving him a starlight-glittering appearance.

“Goodbye then.” Seeing the current Hong Dali, Tang Muxin slightly lowered her head. She didn’t know why, but her heart was jumping furiously.Pump! Pump! Her face was very hot, like having a fever, and she didn’t dare to look at Hong Dali’s eyes.

If it were day time now, Tang Muxin’s shy expression would definitely attract the sight of numerous people. The rate of people looking back would be at least 90%. If there were objects like lamp-posts and such, it would definitely cause some casualties.

Hong Dali looked at her snow-white neck that was smooth like silk, seeing her dillydallying lowering her head and just standing there, not talking and not going home either. His eyes filled with curiosity, he asked, “Xinxin, what are you thinking about? Why are you not going home now?”
In the car, Wang Mingyu palm-faced.
What a wonderful opportunity, yet this prodigal missed it just like that...
Looks like he doesn’t only squander on money, he also squanders on opportunities too, AHHH!
At times like this, shouldn’t he romantically hug her, kiss her on the mouth and such, then say “I love you” or something like that!? But Young Master Dali, what is he doing AHHH!

“Then, I shall be going home now.” Tang Muxin was a bit shy and also obviously a bit disappointed too. After lifting up her head and saying that, she hurriedly added, “Then, you should also hurry up and go home and sleep. Sleeping early and waking up early is good for the body.” Speaking of which, this was the first time she actively showed concern for Hong Dali.

“Me? I shall see about that.” Hong Dali touched his chin and looked at the starry sky. “After I go back, I still have to go online a while, then bath. Oh right, then I will go into the game and see how Yao Tianhao is doing with our Grand League...” His words were really asking for a beating, weren’t they!
Indeed, as he said so, Tang Muxin’s eyebrows slowly went up.

After Hong Dali was done with his words, Tang Muxin walked up and violently stomped on his foot, causing him to jump in pain. She loudly said, “You big moron, I hate you! Tomorrow after school, you are not allowed to come and find me, you hear me!”

After saying that, she turned around and ran. As she ran, she gloomily said, “This moron, prodigal, he is really going to anger me to death!” Her lithe footsteps caused her to seemingly become a fairy. A slightly angered fairy.

But Hong Dali was left in pain and sorrow. He hugged one leg and hopped about in circles, his face full of weird expressions. “What the heck, I was just speaking the truth, why is she so fierce towards me!? It’s really painful to step on someone like this, OK!”

Driver Wang Mingyu palm-faced again and muttered, “My god, Young Master Dali’s nerves... Forget it, I shan’t report about this matter. Otherwise, Master and Madam will surely go and jump off the building.”

“This lass, why did she become so violent in the middle of the night!?” Hong Dali mumbled as he got on the car and depressingly said, “Uncle Wang, don’t you think that Xinxin’s temper should change a bit? She bullies me for no reason, and I can’t even win her in a fight!”
Wang Mingyu: “...”
Hong Dali: “Uncle Wang, why aren’t you saying anything?”
Wang Mingyu’s back was full of sweat and helplessly said, “Yup, someone should really do something about her temper.”

But when he heard Wang Mingyu said that, Hong Dali instead felt a bit unable to bear it. “Never mind, forget it. Speaking of which, I have been at the losing end all this time, it doesn’t matter for it to happen one more time. How does that saying goes, losing something is a fortune! I’m at the losing end all the time, so my fortune will also be very full, haha!”

Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Wang Mingyu quite approved of it too. Hong Dali could understand the logic of losing was a fortune at such a young age, this was very good indeed. There was a very good saying, “if one loses a lot over small matters, they would be able to enjoy large fortunes and large advantages!”
Speaking of which, if it weren’t because Hong Dali suffered a lot of small disadvantages last time, how would he be able to gain advantages over everything he did now?

Wang Mingyu laughed and said, “Only after being able to stand disadvantages will you then be able to enjoy advantages. Loss and gain, you can only gain something after you lose something. Young Master Dali is very clear about this!”
“Oh my, that’s why people say that those people who are highly experienced can say brilliant words.” Hong Dali was overjoyed. “Hearing Uncle Wang say this, I feel much more comfortable now, haha!”
“Haha.” Wang Mingyu smiled and said, “Young Master Dali is a straightforward person. Then, let’s go now?”
“Let’s go.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Let’s go back home now!”

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - Alarming Luck
paragraphs: When Tang Muxin came home, Tang Ruisi was smoking on the sofa. Tang Muxin dived toward her father, put her hands around his neck, and effeminately said, “Daddy, Dali bullied me!”

Hearing that his beloved daughter got bullied, Tang Ruisi paused for a while before he smiled and said, “Oh? To think there would come a day when our Xinxin would get bullied? Tell Daddy, what did he do to bully you?”

“I was...” Before Tang Muxin could continue, her face flushed red. As a matter of fact, what happened was that she wanted to get bullied but it didn’t happen. That was a weird feeling. She quickly changed the topic. “Let’s not talk about it. It’s too embarrassing to be bullied by that prodigal son!”
Tang Ruisi laughed. “Haha. Okay, we won’t talk about it!”
This young lady had her emotions all displayed on her face. If her daddy couldn’t tell what was going on, he would have lived in vain.
Tang Muxin massaged Tang Ruisi’s shoulders with her delicate hands and asked, “Daddy, how is your company? How far has the development progressed?”

Tang Rusi gave a mighty laugh. “En, our Xinxin is indeed the most thoughtful. There’s no problem with the company currently. I’ve arranged for Qiu Qiu to be in the company as per Dali and your idea. This lad is full of energy. Everything seems good so far, thanks to you and Dali.”

Hearing her father mention Qiu Qiu, who graduated from medical school, made Tang Muxin laugh. “Qiu Qiu? Hehe. Daddy, you were not aware, but Dali was fooling around. Qiu Qiu’s girlfriend had broken up with him that day, and we happened to hear it. Dali suddenly asked his lackey to buy a stuffed pancake, a golden chain, a house key, and a car key. Nobody knew what he was up to.”
Tang Ruisi got curious. What link did their breaking up have to do with these items? “Oh? Whatever for? What were those used for?”

Tang Muxin giggled as she continued to massage her daddy’s shoulders. “Hear me out. That materialistic girl said, ‘do you think stuffed pancakes fall from thesky1? It’s easy for you to talk about raising your salary.’ The lackey then threw the stuffed pancake from the upper levels, and it fell beside the girl with a splat!”

Hearing Tang Muxin talk about Hong Dali’s glorious achievements, Tang Ruisi couldn’t help but laugh out loud. “Hahahahaha! Interesting! Haha! Let me guess, did the girl continue by saying that gold would drop from the sky, and Dali’s lackey then threw the golden chain down?”
Tang Muxin said, “Hehe. That’s right. He even threw the house key and car key. Daddy, you didn’t see, but the girl’s expression was too fascinating. Haha.”

“That’s for sure. Haha. Dali is really an interesting lad.” Tang Muxin continued to massage him and Tang Ruisi patted her hand and said, “All right. You go rest early. Hehe. I need to go through some more documents.”

“En, okay. I’ll go to bed first, then.” As Tang Muxin skipped to her bedroom, closed the door and lied on the bed, her heart started to race. “Dali is an idiot! Serves him right if he can’t find a girlfriend his whole life! Humph!”
She thought for a little more and then fell asleep.
To be truthful, if Hong Dali were the kind who was good at making girls happy, Tang Muxin would be even more worried.
On the other hand.

When Liang Yifeng’s car arrived at Rich Days, the magnificent five-star hotel, a handsome doorman quickly opened his door. Liang Yifeng casually threw his car key to him and asked calmly, “Is Miss Tai Yajing here?”
The doorman promptly replied, “Yes. She’s waiting for you at the Golden Years room on level three.”

“Okay.” Liang Yifeng entered the main door of the Rich Days Hotel and attracted much attention. He might not be a famous person, but everyone enjoyed looking at good looking men and beautiful ladies. When a man was good looking to a certain extent, they brought about the same effects as a beautiful lady.
Especially when the super good looking bachelor turned up in a public place alone, several young ladies’ hearts fluttered. At many a time, the difference between men and women were not that vast.
The way up was smooth, and he soon arrived at the door of the Golden Years room on level three. As Liang Yifeng entered, the big starlette Tai Yajing smiled sweetly as she stood up to welcome him.
Liang Yifeng picked a seat near the window. Tai Yajing waited for him to sit down before she started to order some dishes. Meanwhile, Liang Yifeng stared outside the window in a daze.
Tai Yajing gazed at the familiar face quietly, suddenly feeling unfamiliar.
Liang Yifeng’s messy hair made him look a little listless and casually decadent. As someone who had been proficient in poetry and literature from an early age, he looked ever refined.
Liang Yifeng spoke warmly all of a sudden. “Yajing, I heard you were rather close to Hong Anbao from the Hong Family?”
Tai Yajing slowly shook her head. “En, I was. But it’s a pity. His self-esteem is too high, and he is overconfident. He doesn’t listen to anyone, so it’s hard for him to become a great person.”

Liang Yifeng smiled and said, “We have known each other for two years now? Let’s not mention the past. But as a friend, heed my advice, don’t stand on the wrong side. Otherwise, it won’t be a pretty sight.”
Tai Yajing was shocked. “Do you mean Hong Dali? That superprodigal?”

Liang Yifeng smiled faintly and gently caressed Tai Yajing’s soft and supple cheeks. He laughingly said, “Speaking of which, after our night together, you left quite an impression on me. What I said earlier was a gentle reminder. Listen if you wish. But it’s also okay if you don’t.”
He suddenly smiled and said, “Aye, you should be the spokesperson for skincare products. The lotus that emerges from clear water, a beauty with the flesh of ice and bones of jade was such.”
They were both engrossed in the ambiguous exchange of eyes and the affectionate teasing.
Tai Yajing tilted her head slightly and closed her eyes, enjoying his touch like a lazy kitten.
Being in the entertainment business, once impure, one could only continue to sink.

Tai Yajing: “...”

sentences.text: When Tang Muxin came home, Tang Ruisi was smoking on the sofa.

“I was...” Before Tang Muxin could continue, her face flushed red.

She quickly changed the topic.

Tang Ruisi laughed.

I’ve arranged for Qiu Qiu to be in the company as per Dali and your idea.
This lad is full of energy.
Everything seems good so far, thanks to you and Dali.”
Hearing her father mention Qiu Qiu, who graduated from medical school, made Tang Muxin laugh.

Qiu Qiu’s girlfriend had broken up with him that day, and we happened to hear it.
Dali suddenly asked his lackey to buy a stuffed pancake, a golden chain, a house key, and a car key.
Nobody knew what he was up to.”
Tang Ruisi got curious.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - The Superb Mu Zixiao
paragraphs: Baizhi Private Club.
This was a famous private club in Tianjing City South Second Ring Road.
Minimal but not simple. From the chandelier hanging from the wall to the carpet on the floor, everything could be described as low profile extravagant.

Mu Zixiao was calm and composed as he sat on the sofa. He crossed his legs and put popcorn in his mouth from time to time, smiling as he looked at Huawei Entertainment’s CEO, Zhao Manting, who was sitting uneasily in front of him.

Zhao Manting was trembling. He knew from the rumors floating around that the favor that he had asked from Mu Zixiao was a no go. And it was obvious that Mu Zixiao was already standing on Hong Dali’s side. “Master Mu, this problem...”

Mu Zixiao ate another popcorn and looked at the thugs standing behind Zhao Manting disdainfully. “You should count your blessings. I’m in a good mood recently. Otherwise, you will be lying flat now. I assure that you will not be able to get off from bed for months.”

Seeing that his plan had completely failed, Zhao Manting clenched his teeth and spoke in a hoarse voice, “Young Master Mu, for the sake that I have helped your father in the past, couldn’t you spare me a thought? Forget it if you are not willing to help in this small matter, but do you have to stand on the same side as him?”
As Zhao Manting spoke, the thugs stepped forward, indistinctly threatening Mu Zixiao.

Mu Zixiao stood up and responded arrogantly, “What’s the matter? Smashing the pot just because it’s cracked1? Either the fish dies or the net splits2? If you’re not happy, you can use whichever way you think works to solve the issue.” Nobody saw what happened, but the three unlucky thugs were beaten off.
Mu Zixiao sat down again and continued eating popcorn. “Including violence. You know I will never reject a duel.”
Hearing that, about twenty people stood up immediately, staring fiercely at the nonchalant Mu Zixiao.
Zhao Manting was sweating. “You forced me to it!”
The truth was, if he had not taken all the wrong steps along the way, he wouldn’t have ended up in this situation.

Mu Zixiao laughed and said, “I forced you to it? Don’t blame others for your stupidity. You were the one who harbored malicious intentions and wanted to meddle with Li Nianwei. Not only did you fail, but you also lost more than you gained. Now that Li Nianwei has shot to fame, as a former boss, you must have been completely judged by public opinions. Such a remarkable talent like Li Nianwei was hidden by you—must have heard a fair deal of such sarcastic remarks. You can only blame it on your own luck. The TV drama on Tianjing Satellite TV that you produced was in the same time slot as I Am a Singer.”
“And then you came looking for me, expecting me to do something for you. It’s a pity.” Mu Zixiao laughed and said. “There’s a saying which is very appropriate for this situation.
“Trouble comes with women, especially beautiful ones.”

Mu Zixiao stood up with his hands behind his back, completely ignoring thugs, and walked slowly around Zhao Manting. He said as he walked, “Li Nianwei is a very beautiful woman. I have seen a lot of beautiful women, but I have never met someone like her. She is perfect, like the goddess in fairy tales.
“Fortunately, I’m different from you. Because I always remember that the more beautiful a woman is, the more you can’t provoke them. Especially if you don’t understand her background.

“Thankfully, I’m different from you. I didn’t harbor any malicious intent. Before I came, I investigated and found out about Hong Dali and Li Nianwei. Do you think I’d be so stupid as to get excited over a beautiful lady and disregard the consequences?

“Li Nianwei has shot to fame and is known all over the country. Do you think that the Hong Family will not pay attention to her? Do you think she can be hooked up so casually? If so, the Hong family wouldn’t be where it is now.
“Hehe, do you think that no one can tell if you tried to destroy something that you can’t get?

“If I had done anything to Li Nianwei, do you think Hong Dali would just sit back and do nothing? Do you think I wouldn’t consider the fact that that would cause a war between the Mu and Hong families?”

Mu Zixiao couldn’t help but shake his head. “Aye, one is not afraid of a god-like enemy, only a pig friend3. You seem to have gotten dizzy with success these years, and became overconfident. Do you know what is your mistake now? It’s a pity, it’s too late.

“Do you know who is Hong Dali to me now? He is my Master’s Young Master. Do you think I would offend him over a good-for-nothing? Haha, you overestimated yourself. Many times, people who consider themselves important end in tragedy. Just like you.” Mu Zixiao’s expression was unsympathetic, and a dark aura lingered around him.
When he was done, Mu Zixiao stretched his neck and started to warm up.

Although there were about ten thugs in front of him, Mu Zixiao only thought of whether to make it more bloody or be more gentle with them. It seemed inappropriate to break their arms and legs in a public place like this. And he would probably get into trouble with his Master when he got back.
Of course, from the invisible aura around Mu Zixiao, anyone with a bit of insight could tell that this young man who looked somewhat handsome and refined was not to be trifled with.
Zhao Manting was gloomy, and his body had stopped trembling. “I understand everything you said.”

At that moment, he looked like someone determined to give his all. “I’m prepared for this to happen. Since you understand everything, there’s nothing more I can say. If I’m forced to die, someone will have to go down with me!”
Mu Zixiao got excited as he clenched his fists. “You want to fight? My fists are itching.”
The thugs around had pulled out the iron rods they had hidden before. But their speed was comparable to snails eating. They were no match for the Mu Zixiao who was taught kungfu by Geezer Wang.
The battle started quickly but ended even faster.

Ten thugs lied on the floor moaning. Mu Zixiao didn’t bother being polite toward thugs like them. All their limbs were broken, and their mouths were bruised. All they could do was moan. That was just a slap in the hands of Mu Zixiao.
Zhao Manting started to shiver with fear.

After the fight, Mu Zixiao was pleased. “To tell you the truth, your luck is not bad. I’ve been learning kungfu from my Master, and my temperament has converged a lot. If it were in the past, you wouldn’t be able to stand there and shiver.
“Seeing that you have treated my father well, I won’t do anything to you this time. Get lost. This is all I can give you in exchange for the help you gave my father. Haha.”
Zhao Manting sweated all over, drenching his clothes wet. He hurriedly crawled out the door.
Watching the pathetic sight in front of him, Mu Zixiao sighed softly. He muttered, “Thankfully, I wasn’t too rash and didn’t do anything to Dali. Otherwise, I’d be in his situation now.”
Speaking of Hong Dali, Mu Zixiao shook a little.
Even if his kungfu was good, facing Hong Dali’s bizarre luck... he could only surrender.
Hong Dali could even find someone who was sacredly good in kungfu, what else would Mu Zhixiao dare to think of doing?
“Ah, it was fun today!”
Hong Dali had arrived home and ate supper. When he closed the door to his room, the System suddenlyDinged. The cold, mechanic voice came up again.

[Side Mission 2: Nature’s Little Prodigal. Mission Status: Completed. Current Progress: 1000/1000. Mission Reward: The title “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to freely float in water. Title Level: Beginner.]
This announcement was similar to Side Mission 1, which came with an additional explanation—
[Degree of Mission Completion: Perfect.

Additional Explanation 1: The host had already improved the natural surroundings before the Mission was announced. Host is indeed a nature-lover and did not do the mission for the sake of completing it. Additional Reward: Title Effect is enhanced, and the Title Level has the possibility of being increased.

Additional Explanation 2: This title is a secret title. The host does not need to wear it, it will come into effect once the mission is completed. Title Effect: Current attribute [Water]. Detailed explanation: Host can move freely on water. Host will be able to control the surrounding water element. Example: Float, sink, move forward, left and right control, backward, etc.
This mission has follow-up tasks which will be announced when system upgrading is done. Upon completion, the Title Level can be upgraded.
Upgraded Effect: Control of the five elements. Next element: Unknown.]
Seeing the additional explanation, Hong Dali couldn’t stop laughing.
Such an awesome additional reward!
In the future, the rivers, lakes, and seas will be my playground! After I get into the water, I will be able to float as I wish, sink as I wish, move left or right as I wish?!
There was a reason why Hong Dali was so happy.
Before the transmigration, he couldn’t swim. He didn’t dare to go to the deeper side of the pool without the swimming float.
This was not the most important thing. The most important thing was, once he had completed this Mission, Hong Dali could squander freely while waiting for the System to upgrade!

Hong Dali smiled and looked at little tiger Quentin and Samoyed Xiao Xiao who were fighting. “Hahaha, Xiao Xiao, Quentin, I can finally squander again!” These two little guys seemed to have sensed that Hong Dali was happy and run around joyfully.

There was a saying, if the tiger went down to the dog’s level, he would be bullied by the dog4. Little tiger Steel Bullet had never won against Samoyed Xiao Xiao. But instead, he was under Xiao Xiao and was being licked furiously...
After watching them for a while, Hong Dali pulled out the Great Prodigal System. The Mission Squandered Value was only short of about two million.
Thankfully, Hong Dali had already managed the surroundings of Tianjing Mountain outer circle previously. Otherwise, he would have no way of completing Side Mission 2.
It seems like he would be able to reach his goal very soon. It was not far till the day of the System upgrading.

All their limbs were broken, and their mouths were bruised.
All they could do was moan.
That was just a slap in the hands of Mu Zixiao.
Zhao Manting started to shiver with fear.
After the fight, Mu Zixiao was pleased.
“To tell you the truth, your luck is not bad.
I’ve been learning kungfu from my Master, and my temperament has converged a lot.
If it were in the past, you wouldn’t be able to stand there and shiver.
“Seeing that you have treated my father well, I won’t do anything to you this time.
Get lost.
This is all I can give you in exchange for the help you gave my father.
Haha.”
Zhao Manting sweated all over, drenching his clothes wet.
He hurriedly crawled out the door.
Watching the pathetic sight in front of him, Mu Zixiao sighed softly.
He muttered, “Thankfully, I wasn’t too rash and didn’t do anything to Dali.
Otherwise, I’d be in his situation now.”
Speaking of Hong Dali, Mu Zixiao shook a little.
Even if his kungfu was good, facing Hong Dali’s bizarre luck... he could only surrender.
Hong Dali could even find someone who was sacredly good in kungfu, what else would Mu Zhixiao dare to think of doing?
“Ah, it was fun today!”
Hong Dali had arrived home and ate supper.
When he closed the door to his room, the System suddenlyDinged.
The cold, mechanic voice came up again.
[Side Mission 2: Nature’s Little Prodigal.
Mission Status: Completed.
Current Progress: 1000/1000.
Mission Reward: The title “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to freely float in water.
Title Level: Beginner.]
This announcement was similar to Side Mission 1, which came with an additional explanation—
[Degree of Mission Completion: Perfect.
Additional Explanation 1: The host had already improved the natural surroundings before the Mission was announced.
Host is indeed a nature-lover and did not do the mission for the sake of completing it.
Additional Reward: Title Effect is enhanced, and the Title Level has the possibility of being increased.
Additional Explanation 2: This title is a secret title.
The host does not need to wear it, it will come into effect once the mission is completed.
Title Effect: Current attribute [Water].
Detailed explanation: Host can move freely on water.
Host will be able to control the surrounding water element.
Example: Float, sink, move forward, left and right control, backward, etc.
This mission has follow-up tasks which will be announced when system upgrading is done.
Upon completion, the Title Level can be upgraded.
Upgraded Effect: Control of the five elements.
Next element: Unknown.]
Seeing the additional explanation, Hong Dali couldn’t stop laughing.
Such an awesome additional reward!
In the future, the rivers, lakes, and seas will be my playground!
After I get into the water, I will be able to float as I wish, sink as I wish, move left or right as I wish?!
There was a reason why Hong Dali was so happy.
Before the transmigration, he couldn’t swim.
He didn’t dare to go to the deeper side of the pool without the swimming float.
This was not the most important thing.
The most important thing was, once he had completed this Mission, Hong Dali could squander freely while waiting for the System to upgrade!
Hong Dali smiled and looked at little tiger Quentin and Samoyed Xiao Xiao who were fighting.
“Hahaha, Xiao Xiao, Quentin, I can finally squander again!” These two little guys seemed to have sensed that Hong Dali was happy and run around joyfully.
There was a saying, if the tiger went down to the dog’s level, he would be bullied by the dog4.
Little tiger Steel Bullet had never won against Samoyed Xiao Xiao.
But instead, he was under Xiao Xiao and was being licked furiously...
After watching them for a while, Hong Dali pulled out the Great Prodigal System.
The Mission Squandered Value was only short of about two million.
Thankfully, Hong Dali had already managed the surroundings of Tianjing Mountain outer circle previously.
Otherwise, he would have no way of completing Side Mission 2.
It seems like he would be able to reach his goal very soon.
It was not far till the day of the System upgrading.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - It Should Work
paragraphs: The next few days passed relatively peacefully, and soon, it was time for episode three of I Am a Singer.
As usual, it was an explosive experience. As with episodes one and two, the audience screamed their lungs out.
The web download numbers were crazy this time as well.
The only difference was, this time, the audience’s discussion was almost entirely focused on the overwhelming suspense in I Am a Singer.
The biggest social media platform in China—Sina Weipo.
“I used to think that Jiang Ruoyu was enough to dominate the stage, but the appearance of Chang Gongyan changes everything.”
“Yes, Chang Gongyan’s ‘Reminiscing the Past’ is a classic. Jiang Ruoyu has met her match this time.”
“Are you blind? How can our Ruoyu lose? Just wait and see!”
“The one who really sang well this time is Chu Zhongqin. Okay, unfortunately, he only placed third. Sigh, that makes me so sad.”

“Be contented. The few contestants in I Am a Singer now are all people with real skill! Chang Gongyan deserved to win this time. Jiang Ruoyu and Chu Zhongqin who came in second and third, respectively, are both singers with real ability. All the other contestants are also very talented.”

“That’s right, the organizers seem to be have invested a lot this time. The singer lineup is impressive. The first few contestants were relatively unknown, and I thought it was going to be uninteresting. Now, I hope Tuesday comes quickly every week so that I can watch the singing legends compete!”
“Who would deny it? There is a serious battle going on now on stage. I’m really excited about the upcoming rounds!”

Originally, people had thought that the outcome of the contest was more or less certain. But ever since Hong Dali completely ignored all the popular singers who had come to apply, deciding instead to pick Chang Gongyan, who had always kept a low profile, the audience suddenly felt that I Am a Singer was once again full of suspense and unexpected turns.
Chang Gongyan’s stage presence was simply overwhelming.
It was so overwhelming that the previously popular Jiang Ruoyu could do nothing to diminish his magnificence.

The contest was once again the topic of people’s conversations. Almost all of the discussion was focused on two points: the first being who would be the ultimate champion, and the second when the fourth episode was over, who would be the newcomer on stage.
Hong Dali didn’t care about the discussions online at all.

At that moment, he was lying on Li Nianwei’s lap, listening to Zhang Cai’s report. “Young Master, the popularity of I Am a Singer is steadily increasing. The download counts on the web are also increasing. Downloads for Nianwei’s concert and, unexpectedly, episode one, have both reached record highs.”
Hong Dali waved his hand. “Mm, mediocre. Anything else?”
Zhang Cai smiled. “There’s more. We have received the broadcasting rights fees from Tianjing Satellite TV, So Cool Video, as well as hosting rights fees from the US. The amount is substantial.”
Hong Dali had a slight headache. “Mm, leave it as petty cash. It’s really hard without Xiaoyi around. I have no idea how my projects are coming along. So troubling.”
Zhang Cai and Li Nianwei were also troubled about Xiaoyi.
It was hard to help in such situations. They still did not manage to find out who the mastermind was.

The few of them were idly chatting when Chu Zhongqin rushed in. He hurled himself at Hong Dali and grabbed his leg. “Young Master, help! They are too fierce. The newcomer Chang Gongyan is too powerful, I can’t hold up!”
Hong Dali had known all along that he would not be able to hold up. He just didn’t expect that he would fall apart so soon. “Ahem... Slowly, slowly. What is the situation now? Can you slow down?”

Chu Zhongqin was still flustered but tried his best to calm down. “Okay, okay. Young Master, you must help me now, else I’m afraid I will not be able to go on and will get kicked out of the show! I didn’t go anywhere at all and have practiced hard the whole week for this episode. I only placed third! I’m afraid if I let up a bit, I will end up in the last place. That would be super embarrassing!”
It was not just unfounded fears on Chu Zhongqin’s part. He really couldn’t afford to lose.

Dignity was an important part of life. He had come here to increase his popularity. If the audience really didn’t support him anymore, even if he didn’t get kicked out, being in one of the last few places would already be very embarrassing.
Hong Dali was unperturbed. Coming to this world, he might as well kill himself if he couldn’t even handle such a small matter. “Oh, it’s okay. Don’t worry.”
So, Hong Dali straightened himself and smilingly said, “Here is a song for you. I wrote it while I was bored at school these two days.”

Zhang Cai was surprised but quickly caught herself as comprehension dawned. “Young Master can write songs? Oh right, you wrote Rolling up the Beaded Curtain for Nianwei last time. What song is it this time?”

Hong Dali said as he walked, “Follow me and you’ll find out. Erm, oh right, I only have the lyrics and can only vaguely hum the tune. You still need to arrange the music. I would still like to have it edited and arranged as per my request, but I think it should work.”

Although Chu Zhongqin knew that Rolling up the Beaded Curtain was gifted to Li Nianwei by Hong Dali, there was a saying that the difference between gifts for a woman versus a man was like heaven and earth. “This... Young Master, will it work?”
Hong Dali seemed relaxed. “Don’t worry. It should be okay.”
Chu Zhongqin suddenly felt weak. “Should...”
As a previously unknown new singer, Jiang Ruoyu was in a good mood recently.
As the popularity of I Am a Singer rose, her popularity also soared. Although she was nowhere near as popular as Li Nianwei, her standing in the domestic market was at least substantial.
Having signed a couple of advertisement contracts a few days ago, Jiang Ruoyu had been feeling increasingly more self-confident.

Her luck had not been good previously, and her popularity remained low and stagnant. That was probably the darkest time of her life. It was not so bad that she had to sell her body, but there were numerous commercial engagements which did not pay very well.

It was at such a time when she heard about the program”I Am a Singer”produced by Caiwei Entertainment and the fact that there was a monetary prize that Jiang Ruoyu agreed to take part without hesitation.
Judging from the current situation, that was the best decision she had made in her life. It would not be a stretch to call it the turning point in her life.
She had talent and looks, as well as Young Master Hong Dali’s overly generous financial support. Jiang Ruoyu was famous.
Very famous.
People even thought that the future stage of I Am a Singer would be dominated by Jiang Ruoyu.
A new star was rising.

And so it was inevitable that Jiang Ruoyu became complacent. It was not her fault. It was a necessary stage for many people who suddenly became famous. First, their attitude changed for the worse, then they started being full of themselves. Finally, they became unreasonable and thought themselves above others.
It was lucky then that Jiang Ruoyu had a somewhat hard life in the past. She understood that success did not come easy. She was happy about her success but did not become complacent.
When Chang Gongyan arrived on the scene, Jiang Ruoyu was not fazed. Instead, she felt excited.
That was because she knew that a contest with strong competition would have higher viewership rating. That would mean that her popularity would also increase.
She did not say anything. All she did was work hard at bettering herself, compose better songs, and train hard at singing.
She was a resilient woman and made it through the dark days in the past. How could she give up now that the light was just ahead?
She stood in front of the mirror in the washroom, silently encouraging herself. Jiang Ruoyu’s face was filled anew with confidence. “Jiang Ruoyu, fight on! You’re the best!”

At that moment, the sound of footsteps came from outside the door. Jiang Ruoyu didn’t bother with them at first, but she soon felt uneasy. She heard Chu Zhongqin’s voice saying, “Young Master, what is the name of the song?”
Hong Dali’s voice rose. “I will tell you about it later. First I need to see if you can sing. If you can’t sing it well, then too bad, you just don’t have the luck.”
As they spoke, the sound of their footsteps faded away.

Jiang Ruoyu was puzzled. “It’s Chu Zhongqin? Didn’t he come in third previously? Why is he coming to Young Master for help?” With Chu Zhongqin’s standing in the entertainment circle, there should be no need for him to get help from Hong Dali when it came to music.

Jiang Ruoyu shook her head gently. “Keke, I wonder what they are up to. I better go practice my singing. I heard Young Master hum before. His singing is completely out of tune. It’s not possible that Chu Zhongqin is asking him for advice...”
Not two steps later, Jiang Ruoyu came to an abrupt stop and cried out hoarsely, “No, that’s not right!”

At this moment, Jiang Ruoyu suddenly thought of something. “The song that Miss Nianwei sang previously, Rolling up the Beaded Curtain, was supposed to be a gift from Young Master! In that case, is Chu Zhongqin thinking of... No way, I have to listen to it!”
Having carefully followed Chu Zhongqin and Hong Dali to the singing room, Jiang Ruoyu secretly eavesdropped on them.
The door to the singing room was not closed tight, and Hong Dali’s obviously out of tune singing could be heard. “I have loved, and lost...”

Jiang Ruoyu casually continued listening to another two verses and wondered. “Just this standard? This is not right.” Although she was perplexed, she had to say it. Her difficult past had made Jiang Ruoyu an extremely careful person, and she knew Hong Dali was a superprodigal. However, she also knew something else about Hong Dali. She knew that Hong Dali was not only good at spending money, he could also make miracles happen.
So, even though the song was out of tune, she continued listening patiently.

The sound of Hong Dali’s out of tune voice drifted out from the room. “I have searched for the ends of the sea, but neglected the winding rivers...” Jiang Ruoyu listened for a while and wondered. “It’s not right. This is still not right. Have I made a mistake somewhere?” She thought about it some more and suddenly came to a realization. “That’s right, it’s because the lyrics are not in sync. Young Master is not singing in sync!”

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - Never Left
paragraphs: Jiang Ruoyu felt more at ease as she thought about it. “Let’s see how the song is when it’s completed. These lyrics were quite well written. The mood is very good, although the tune doesn’t have much rhythm. The singing is not very professional too. But it should be completely different from Young Master when Chu Zhongqin sings it.”
Soon, Hong Dali had sung the whole song in the practice hall.
His voice was hoarse and off tune, and he often got stuck at the lyrics. But at least the song was complete.
Chu Zhongqin didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. “Young Master, this song, will it work?”
Jiang Ruoyin wanted to ask the same.

Hong Dali said, “Rubbish, it’s not like you don’t know that I sing off tune. Come here, we’ll go through verse by verse. I will adjust it as I listen. Start with the first verse, follow my speed.” As he spoke, he called out, “Sister Cai, get a staff1member. I don’t know about this stuff. Ask Old Chu to record and adjust himself.”

Chu Zhongqin had no choice but to listen to Hong Dali. “O... Okay...” He had prepared himself to be at the bottom in the next episode. In any case, quickly get the next episode done with so he could find a way to escape. Otherwise, it would be tough for future episodes.
Chu Zhongqin decisively started singing and making notes. “I have loved, and also lost.”
Hong Dali corrected Zhong Chuyin’s speed and tone as he sang. “No, no. You need to speed up when you’re singing ‘also lost.’ The tone should be higher too. Aye, yes, that’s right.”

How should this be put across—a stupid person had his way of doing things. Hong Dali didn’t know how to write scores, but that didn’t mean he couldn’t listen. He could still tell if Chu Zhongqin sang it right or wrong.

As Jiang Ruoyu listened, a voice came from behind. “Sister Jiang, What are you doing?” She turned around and saw Tang Muxin. Jiang Ruoyu quickly shushed. “Shh, Young Master is coaching Mr. Chu’s singing. Let’s listen quietly.”

Tang Muxin was dumbfounded. “Dali? Coaching Chu Zhongqing?! Can he do it? Chu Zhongqin allowed Dali to coach him? Dali’s voice... But then again, Dali did give Sister Nianwei ‘Rolling up the Beaded Curtain.’”
After they listened for a while, Tang Muxin asked, “Will this really work?”
Jiang Ruoyu: “I... I don’t know either...”
Tang Muxin concluded. “If he appears before me now, I promise I won’t kill him!”
Tang Muxin and Jiang Ruoyu were discussing softly outside, but the two continued to experiment the tones inside.

Hong Dali’s voice resounded again. “Sing this word higher, higher, drag on, drag on, up! Up! Ah ah ah ah, yes, just like that. Hmm, let me see, how do we record this score. En, I think I’d better draw lines...”
Tang Muxin: “How does one read the score if there are no lines?”
Jiang Ruoyu: “I’m not sure, either. I suppose... one can...”
The people inside continued to practice, and the people outside continued to discuss. Two hours passed in a flash.

At this time, Hong Dali had more or less conveyed the singing method of the whole song and completed the basic composition of the tune. Hong Dali laughed as he said, “It’s done. We just need some last adjustments. Remember to try singing it once later, to see how it turns out.”
Chu Zhongqin moaned. “Young Master, this song is too difficult. Can I take a break? I’m afraid I will collapse from inadequate vocal capacity.”
Hong Dali chuckled. “Oh. Okay. Take a break, then. I’ll lie down for a while too. As your voice recovers, get something to soothe your throat and vocal cords.”
He added, “Actually, I have another powerful song, a song without lyrics. But I’m afraid you can’t sing it. That song is even more awesome.”
Chu Zhongqin helplessly said, “I better stick to this song. I would like to live for another two years...”

Tang Muxin, who was outside the door, whispered, “What is Hong Dali up to. I don’t find this song so special. Just a lot of howling. But the lyrics are pretty good. Dali is rather talented to be able to write lyrics, hehe.”

“I think the song will actually sound quite good when sang in full...” Although Jiang Ruoyu said that, she didn’t have much confidence. She was sure of one thing, though—Hong Dali was good at creating miracles. Hence, before the results were out, it was best not to underestimate him.
Naturally, Hong Dali couldn’t see how surprised Tang Muxin was or Jiang Ruoyu’s thoughts.
In actual fact, he had never worried that this song would not be able to make it.

On earth, the moment this song appeared on the stage of I Am a Singer, it impacted the entire music industry. In this world, Chu Zhongqin’s voice was not bad, he just needed a little more practice... heh heh...
Done with his preparations, Chu Zhongqin picked up the microphone and deeply glanced at the miraculous Hong Dali. At that moment, he could only give his all.
Young Master has never given anything bad to anyone!
The music started, the piano accompanied by the symphony orchestra. The tone was heavy and the music was melodious.
The familiar prelude played—this was one of Hong Dali’s favorite songs on earth. The tune started gentle, soft, low and charming, then the second chorus spectacularly unfolded.
The lyrics talked about the persistence in achieving one’s dream, the helplessness when facing reality, and the exclamation when finally finding everything. It all related to Hong Dali.
He was deeply attracted to the song from the moment he heard it.
If not for the fact that Hong Dali listened to the song every day when he was on earth, there was no way someone who sang off tune could remember it so clearly.
That’s right. That was the song. The song that had amazed everyone the moment it first came out—Never Left.
Majestic yet emotionally rich, that was the best interpretation of Never Left.

The creation process of this song could be described as innumerable twists and turns. It could also be compared to the brewing of wine, becoming better as it ages, tasting better each time one drinks it. The song’s cadence, turning and waving, soothing yet vehement. In a nutshell, the emotions for this song were overflowing.

The original singer of this song was the enchanted Terry Lin. His voice was full of emotions and sincere. The song and his voice matched beautifully and uniquely together, there was no way anyone else could surpass him.
It was a pity Hong Dali was in this world. He could only find other ways to listen to this song.
Chu Zhongqin, a veteran singer in the music industry—his singing skills were superb, especially his stamina. He didn’t pant or breathe too hard when singing. This was comparable to Terry Lin.
Else, there was no way Hong Dali would him ruin this classic.
Soon, Chu Zhongqin started singing. “I have loved, and also lost.”

The practice room was filled with his charismatic voice. In an instant, Tang Muxin and Jiang Ruoyu, who were outside the door, were completely absorbed into the song. It was as though they had returned to some part of their memories.
Tang Muxin was dumbfounded.
Jiang Ruoyu was stunned.
They were both in disbelief, and their mouths were slightly agape. This was the song that the tone-deaf Hong Dali wrote?

Jiang Ruoyu was not very popular, but she had grown up in others’ praises for her voice. She knew very early that her future was different from others. Her dream was to become a singer, a queen in the music industry.
She had indeed been working hard. But she realized today, that music, at many times, had no limit.
Hong Dali’s voice was hoarse and off tune. But who would have thought that the song he wrote could create such a deep impact!?
Jiang Ruoyu was stirred.
She had come out of curiosity and didn’t expect to have such a great takeaway.
Even songs composed by the famous composers in the current music scene were not able to create such a stir. Moreover, the person who wrote this song was a contestant who sang off tune.
As she was getting emotional, Chu Zhongqin achieved the best singing condition.
“Suddenly I looked back, I found you waiting for me. You were always there.”
Tang Muxin was completely astonished.
She had only listened to parts of the lyrics before and didn’t feel much about them. But at that moment, hearing Chu Zhongqin beautifully interpret the song, she was totally amazed.

She suddenly realized that the prodigal son that she had been hanging out with had changed. She actually felt envious of Hong Dali and his talent. It was hard to describe how she felt. A bit of jealousy, and a little bit of sweetness. It was as though something had nudged her heart, and the figure was becoming clear in her mind. The shadow was engraved in her mind was not easily wiped off.
She stood for a while longer in the strangely silent practice room.
A familiar voice resounded. “Aye, Ruoyu, Xinxin, what are you two doing here?”
As they came to their senses, Tang Muxin was welcomed with Hong Dali’s smiling face.
Only his eyes were bright like the stars.
Tang Muxin approached Hong Dali and held his hand, coyly saying, “Hehe, Dali, this song that you wrote is very nice. Can you tell me what it’s called?”
Hong Dali held her in response. “The name of the song? Never Left. How is it? Good?”
Tang Muxin didn’t hold back her praise. “Very good! This is the nicest song I’ve heard in my whole life!”
Wasn’t that obvious? The songs in this world were rather bad...

Chu Zhongqin and Jiang Ruoyu were in awe and had a new-found respect for Hong Dali. They were both humble, especially Chu Zhongqin. His gaze was soft and gentle, just like a bride looking at her newly wedded husband. Those who didn’t know better would have thought he was gay...

Soon, Hong Dali had sung the whole song in the practice hall.
His voice was hoarse and off tune, and he often got stuck at the lyrics.
But at least the song was complete.
Chu Zhongqin didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
“Young Master, this song, will it work?”
Jiang Ruoyin wanted to ask the same.

I will adjust it as I listen.

I don’t know about this stuff.
Ask Old Chu to record and adjust himself.”
Chu Zhongqin had no choice but to listen to Hong Dali.
Okay...” He had prepared himself to be at the bottom in the next episode.
In any case, quickly get the next episode done with so he could find a way to escape.
Otherwise, it would be tough for future episodes.
Chu Zhongqin decisively started singing and making notes.
“I have loved, and also lost.”
Hong Dali corrected Zhong Chuyin’s speed and tone as he sang.
“No, no.
You need to speed up when you’re singing ‘also lost.’ The tone should be higher too.
Aye, yes, that’s right.”
How should this be put across—a stupid person had his way of doing things.
Hong Dali didn’t know how to write scores, but that didn’t mean he couldn’t listen.
He could still tell if Chu Zhongqin sang it right or wrong.
As Jiang Ruoyu listened, a voice came from behind.
“Sister Jiang, What are you doing?” She turned around and saw Tang Muxin.
Jiang Ruoyu quickly shushed.
“Shh, Young Master is coaching Mr.
Chu’s singing.
Let’s listen quietly.”

Chu Zhongqin allowed Dali to coach him?
Dali’s voice...

I don’t know either...”
Tang Muxin concluded.

Hong Dali’s voice resounded again.

Up!
Ah ah ah ah, yes, just like that.
Hmm, let me see, how do we record this score.
En, I think I’d better draw lines...”
Tang Muxin: “How does one read the score if there are no lines?”

I suppose... one can...”

Remember to try singing it once later, to see how it turns out.”

Can I take a break?
I’m afraid I will collapse from inadequate vocal capacity.”
Hong Dali chuckled.

Okay.
Take a break, then.
I’ll lie down for a while too.
As your voice recovers, get something to soothe your throat and vocal cords.”

But I’m afraid you can’t sing it.
That song is even more awesome.”

I don’t find this song so special.
Just a lot of howling.

Dali is rather talented to be able to write lyrics, hehe.”
