chapters.title: Chapter 195 - The Woman Who Jumped into the River
paragraphs: Hong Dali stretched lazily and said, “Ah, today was fun. Let’s head home and get some sleep, get some sleep!”
He turned around, grabbed Li Nianwei’s hand, and smilingly said, “Sister Nianwei, in a few days, I’ll write a script. Let’s make a movie for fun. It has been kind of boring recently.”
Li Nianwei, who had never been in an advertisement or film before, answered without hesitation. “Okay.”
Tang Muxin got excited about the idea too. She said, “Okay, okay. Dali, I want to go too!”

Hong Dali laughed out loud. “You will definitely be included. Dali’s productions must be the best. I will have to make sure the cast line-up is spectacular. Don’t be impatient. I’ll start on the script in the next few days.

“We should have quite a lot of money on our hands. The broadcasting rights fees for I Am a Singer, the download fees fromUnexpectedly!, and there is more than forty thousand every day from Ye Lai Xiang. We might as well make good use of all this money!”
How one is a prodigal son without spending money?!
Right, since we don’t have much experience with anything else, let’s start with movies.
There are so many classic movies in existence on Earth. We don’t even have to remember the storyline and setting for all of them, just random snippets here and there is enough.
If we include Chuyin’s set-up, wahaha! It’ll be something spectacular!

Hong Dali had already given some thought to this matter. However, he had not come up with a concrete plan yet. Now, all he had to do was wait for Chu Zhongqin to gracefully leave the stage of I Am a Singer and he’d be free to move on to other things. All he had to do was wait for the payments to come in. With Zhang Cai handling things, he had nothing to worry about.

It was getting late and he should be going home. However, he got caught in a traffic jam. Pedestrians, bicycles, private cars and taxis, as well as buses, had completely clogged up the roads, which were actually quite wide. He thought of going backward, but the cars behind had completely blocked off any exit.
Right, seems like they would have to walk.
However, Hong Dali did not seem to be in any hurry. Instead, he laid down and declared. “I’ll take a nap first.”

Tang Muxin hugged Quentin and was unable to fall asleep. Her thoughts were filled with the song Hong Dali wrote. She could see that Dali was tired, but she was bored. She decided to find out what was happening outside. Rolling down the windows, she stuck her head out to ask a passerby who got here before they did. “Mister, what is happening ahead?”
The passerby was a man in his fifties. He pointed towards the front. Tang Muxin looked toward the direction his finger pointed.

She saw a woman standing on the bridge over Fengyuan Lake, looking down into the waters. Her face couldn’t be seen clearly. As the chilly night winds rose, the white dress the woman wore fluttered in the wind like a fairy’s dress, and her waist-length hair danced in the wind.
Tang Muxin exclaimed. “She is going to jump into the river!”
This was probably the most ethereal lake-jumping scene in the history of lake-jumping.

Hong Dali snapped awake upon hearing that someone was going to jump into the river. He asked the passerby, “Is it a man or a woman? What happened?” He had no idea that it was a woman who wanted to end her life.
The passerby said, “I heard that her career has not been going well, and she was unable to find a proper job, her childhood dreams dashed...”
Hong Dali and Tang Muxin said in unison, “Poor thing.”

The passerby continued, “The woman climbed up half an hour ago, saying she wanted to jump. There are already a couple of men around who have taken off their shirts waiting for her to jump. It would be a great opportunity for them to be the hero and save the damsel in distress—she has a great figure. Everyone is waiting, but the woman has not moved, all she did was cry.”
Hong Dali said, “That would be her fault, then. How could she be so inconsiderate? They didn’t take off their pants?”
The passerby said, “No, I did hear people saying that a few men got aroused, but as time passed, it went down again.”
Look at what the passerby was implying.
Hong Dali laughed. “The lady is going to kill herself just because she couldn’t find a job? How weak is her mind?”
The passerby said, “Rumors say that she has emotional problems too. Her boyfriend hooked up with a rich lady and dumped her.”

That was it. Other news might not affect her, but this hit a nerve with Tang Muxin. They were women, after all. Tang Muxin made a small sound of indignation and started shaking Hong Dali’s wrist. “Dali, think of a way to save her.”

Hong Dali replied, “Don’t worry. If she wanted to jump, she would have done so long ago. If you ask me, I don’t think she will jump at all today. Didn’t you hear, it’s likely she’s just emotional. There are so many men there with their shirts off waiting to be heroes, there are probably enough of them to start a fight. Why would we be needed to help her?”
The passerby said, “Who knows. Big Young Master, you look like a rich man yourself, what do you think the lady wants to do?”
Hong Dali rubbed his chin. “I wouldn’t know. Forget it, we’re stuck in the jam, anyway. Let’s go see what’s happening.”
Before Dali transmigrated, he was nicknamed Goody Dali. After all, he came here because he was trying to save two kids. Seeing the situation, he wanted to go save her.
They all alighted from the car.

With the nine lackeys leading the way and making space between the crowd for him, Hong Dali and his people reached the bridge in no time. As they got near the bridge, Hong Dali saw the lonely silhouette of the lady standing on the railings, her flowy white dress fluttering and the wind running through her long hair. Unfortunately, her face was obscured, and he couldn’t see her clearly.
He had just been talking about making a movie. Hong Dali felt a shiver run through him.
If this lady had come out from a movie, she would be Sadako. She didn’t even need further make-up or costumes!
Just at that moment, the lady sensed a change in the atmosphere around her and turned around. She discovered Hong Dali and his people behind her and cried out in agitation, “Don’t come any closer!”
Hong Dali shrugged. His expression remained friendly and smiling. “We’re just here to gawk, but my eyesight is not so good, so I wanted to come closer.”
The lady turned around. Hong Dali still couldn’t see her face clearly. He could only hear her say with self-deprecating laughter, “Here to see me for a joke?”
Isn’t it obvious? You decided to jump, are you afraid of people looking?

That was what Hong Dali thought, but he didn’t say it out loud. Instead, he asked curiously, “Speaking of which, sister, why do you want to kill yourself? You have a great figure, curves in all the right places, your waist is slim, and your legs are long. Your dress is pretty, and your hair long and flowy. You look like a goddess, so what are you troubled about?”
Although it was her freedom as an adult to want to commit suicide, Hong Dali was unable to suppress his natural urge to want to try and save her.
He didn’t expect her to simply answer sadly, “If you want to talk me out of it...”

Hong Dali was crushed. “You’re going to jump soon anyway. No harm chatting a little, right? We can talk about our hopes and aspirations, or about life in general. Whatever will do. That won’t be too bad, will it?”

Hong Dali knew something was very wrong when the lady didn’t find what he said funny, and only nodded slightly. The aura the lady gave off was peaceful. The chilly night air would have made anyone shiver, but she gave no signs of feeling cold.
What Hong Dali originally thought was wrong. This lady was bent on killing herself.
Her voice was serene. “What do you want to chat about?”
Hong Dali thought for a while but realized he didn’t know. Finally, he asked, “Hrm... Do you smoke?”
The lady replied, “I don’t smoke.”

Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “You’re going to jump anyway, there’s no harm trying. Even if you choke, take it as a new experience before you die.” As soon as he finished talking, a lackey came forward and respectfully passed him a cigarette.
The lady reached out, took the cigarette from him, and put it to her lips.”Well... Okay...”
She had long slim fingers which were very pale. He could see that not only was her clothing white, but her complexion was also white as well.

This made Hong Dali more curious than ever. What made such a naturally beautiful lady want to kill herself? Was it because she was jobless? He had never heard of anyone who wanted to commit suicide because they couldn’t find a job. Was it because she fell out of love? Which man would be so stupid as to give up a beautiful woman such as this?
Hong Dali commanded. “Light it!”
The lackey took out a few hundred dollar notes, set them on fire, and used them to light the lady’s cigarette.

“You’re very rich.” The lady took a deep draw of the cigarette. She had never smoked before and choked, which set off a coughing fit, her long, luscious hair blowing in the wind. She took another two puffs, after which she commented, “Cigarettes taste bitter, and hot, and acidic...”
Hong Dali stomped his foot impatiently. “You shouldn’t be complaining now. Why do you want to jump into the river? Tell me about it.”
The woman continued smoking. “I’ve never amounted to anything all my life. I loved drawing comics. I drew characters and their settings and submitted my drawings to the comic publisher. After...”
Hong Dali asked curiously, “That’s good. What happened after that?”

The lady gave a bitter laugh. “After that? The comic book publisher’s company caught fire. That fire turned four years worth of my drawings into nothing. Four years. How many four years do we have in life? They were all hand-drawn and irreplaceable. The comic book publisher went out of business as a result of the fire. I didn’t get a single cent...”
This was such a tragedy. If it had happened to Hong Dali, he definitely would have been badly affected. “That’s really sad.”
The lady said in a dry voice, “After that, I found a boyfriend, but he soon left me for a rich lady.”

Hong Dali asked forlornly, “You can draw the comics again even after they were gone. Speaking of which, you’re jumping into the river for him, and he is still not concerned? Is the rich lady very rich?”
The lady said slowly, “Richer than me at least.”
Hong Dali nodded and said, “Right, that’s his fault then. But as the saying goes, out with the old and in with the new.”

The lady said miserably, “It’s not that easy. I wanted to work hard and earn more money, but who knew my luck was so bad? No matter which company I joined, it folded. Finally, I went to work at a supermarket. Within two months, the supermarket closed down. Sigh, I have no other way out, how can I continue living?”
The lady really had quite an unfortunate life. Hong Dali asked, “Did you try to find out why?”
She laughed bitterly. “I tried to find out. I’m very ugly. I’m an ugly and unlucky woman. I have no place on this earth. Who would treat me as a human being?”
As she talked, her face started looking sadder and sadder. She shrugged her shoulders hopelessly. “Thank you for chatting with me.”
After saying that, she smiled and finally turned around to take one last glance at Hong Dali.

If you ask me, I don’t think she will jump at all today.
Didn’t you hear, it’s likely she’s just emotional.
There are so many men there with their shirts off waiting to be heroes, there are probably enough of them to start a fight.
Why would we be needed to help her?”
The passerby said, “Who knows.
Big Young Master, you look like a rich man yourself, what do you think the lady wants to do?”
Hong Dali rubbed his chin.
“I wouldn’t know.
Forget it, we’re stuck in the jam, anyway.
Let’s go see what’s happening.”
Before Dali transmigrated, he was nicknamed Goody Dali.
After all, he came here because he was trying to save two kids.
Seeing the situation, he wanted to go save her.
They all alighted from the car.
With the nine lackeys leading the way and making space between the crowd for him, Hong Dali and his people reached the bridge in no time.
As they got near the bridge, Hong Dali saw the lonely silhouette of the lady standing on the railings, her flowy white dress fluttering and the wind running through her long hair.
Unfortunately, her face was obscured, and he couldn’t see her clearly.
He had just been talking about making a movie.
Hong Dali felt a shiver run through him.
If this lady had come out from a movie, she would be Sadako.
She didn’t even need further make-up or costumes!
Just at that moment, the lady sensed a change in the atmosphere around her and turned around.
She discovered Hong Dali and his people behind her and cried out in agitation, “Don’t come any closer!”
Hong Dali shrugged.
His expression remained friendly and smiling.
“We’re just here to gawk, but my eyesight is not so good, so I wanted to come closer.”
The lady turned around.
Hong Dali still couldn’t see her face clearly.
He could only hear her say with self-deprecating laughter, “Here to see me for a joke?”
Isn’t it obvious?
You decided to jump, are you afraid of people looking?
That was what Hong Dali thought, but he didn’t say it out loud.
Instead, he asked curiously, “Speaking of which, sister, why do you want to kill yourself?
You have a great figure, curves in all the right places, your waist is slim, and your legs are long.
Your dress is pretty, and your hair long and flowy.
You look like a goddess, so what are you troubled about?”
Although it was her freedom as an adult to want to commit suicide, Hong Dali was unable to suppress his natural urge to want to try and save her.
He didn’t expect her to simply answer sadly, “If you want to talk me out of it...”
Hong Dali was crushed.
“You’re going to jump soon anyway.
No harm chatting a little, right?
We can talk about our hopes and aspirations, or about life in general.
Whatever will do.
That won’t be too bad, will it?”
Hong Dali knew something was very wrong when the lady didn’t find what he said funny, and only nodded slightly.
The aura the lady gave off was peaceful.
The chilly night air would have made anyone shiver, but she gave no signs of feeling cold.
What Hong Dali originally thought was wrong.
This lady was bent on killing herself.
Her voice was serene.
“What do you want to chat about?”
Hong Dali thought for a while but realized he didn’t know.
Finally, he asked, “Hrm...
Do you smoke?”
The lady replied, “I don’t smoke.”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers.
“You’re going to jump anyway, there’s no harm trying.
Even if you choke, take it as a new experience before you die.” As soon as he finished talking, a lackey came forward and respectfully passed him a cigarette.
The lady reached out, took the cigarette from him, and put it to her lips.”Well...
Okay...”
She had long slim fingers which were very pale.
He could see that not only was her clothing white, but her complexion was also white as well.
This made Hong Dali more curious than ever.
What made such a naturally beautiful lady want to kill herself?
Was it because she was jobless?
He had never heard of anyone who wanted to commit suicide because they couldn’t find a job.
Was it because she fell out of love?
Which man would be so stupid as to give up a beautiful woman such as this?
Hong Dali commanded.
“Light it!”
The lackey took out a few hundred dollar notes, set them on fire, and used them to light the lady’s cigarette.
“You’re very rich.” The lady took a deep draw of the cigarette.
She had never smoked before and choked, which set off a coughing fit, her long, luscious hair blowing in the wind.
She took another two puffs, after which she commented, “Cigarettes taste bitter, and hot, and acidic...”
Hong Dali stomped his foot impatiently.
“You shouldn’t be complaining now.
Why do you want to jump into the river?
Tell me about it.”
The woman continued smoking.
“I’ve never amounted to anything all my life.
I loved drawing comics.
I drew characters and their settings and submitted my drawings to the comic publisher.
After...”
Hong Dali asked curiously, “That’s good.
What happened after that?”
The lady gave a bitter laugh.
“After that?
The comic book publisher’s company caught fire.
That fire turned four years worth of my drawings into nothing.
Four years.
How many four years do we have in life?
They were all hand-drawn and irreplaceable.
The comic book publisher went out of business as a result of the fire.
I didn’t get a single cent...”
This was such a tragedy.
If it had happened to Hong Dali, he definitely would have been badly affected.
“That’s really sad.”
The lady said in a dry voice, “After that, I found a boyfriend, but he soon left me for a rich lady.”
Hong Dali asked forlornly, “You can draw the comics again even after they were gone.
Speaking of which, you’re jumping into the river for him, and he is still not concerned?
Is the rich lady very rich?”
The lady said slowly, “Richer than me at least.”
Hong Dali nodded and said, “Right, that’s his fault then.
But as the saying goes, out with the old and in with the new.”
The lady said miserably, “It’s not that easy.
I wanted to work hard and earn more money, but who knew my luck was so bad?
No matter which company I joined, it folded.
Finally, I went to work at a supermarket.
Within two months, the supermarket closed down.
Sigh, I have no other way out, how can I continue living?”
The lady really had quite an unfortunate life.
Hong Dali asked, “Did you try to find out why?”
She laughed bitterly.
“I tried to find out.
I’m very ugly.
I’m an ugly and unlucky woman.
I have no place on this earth.
Who would treat me as a human being?”
As she talked, her face started looking sadder and sadder.
She shrugged her shoulders hopelessly.
“Thank you for chatting with me.”
After saying that, she smiled and finally turned around to take one last glance at Hong Dali.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - Dreams Will Never End!
paragraphs: Hong Dali finally understood why she kept her face covered with her hair. She was only twenty-four or twenty-five years old, at the peak of her youth. Her eyes, nose, mouth, and silhouette was beautiful. Perhaps not comparable to Tang Muxin or Li Nianwei, but she was in the superior range. But on her face was a rather big black birthmark which made her look like an ink bowl was on her face. Simply put, the female version of Yang Zhi1.
She quirked up the corners of her mouth. “Do I look very ugly?”
Hong Dali simply said, “Actually, yes. It’s very ugly. Even if I said you look beautiful, you wouldn’t believe me, right?”

The lady was satisfied with Hong Dali’s reply. “Yes, you’re very honest. Thank you. I have to leave. It’s my honor to meet someone as honest as you before I die. I’m very happy. Hopefully, we will become friends in my next life.”
As she finished speaking, her body leaned to the front and fell into the water with a plop, in front of everyone’s cries.
Without thinking, Hong Dali jumped into the water after her. Everyone around exclaimed. “This young master is really outstanding, giving help where it’s needed!”
But what went through Hong Dali’s mind was: “Who the heck pushed me from behind?!”

Seeing Hong Dali jump down, his lackeys naturally couldn’t pretend they didn’t see anything. Some ten of them jumped in in an instant. Someone even shouted from the side, “Someone fell into the water, quick save them!”
Then they saw Hong Dali happily swimming in the water like a fish.
Freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, butterfly stroke. As Hong Dali got into the mood, he even swam dog paddle!
Everyone was shocked, but Hong Dali was having fun!

Hong Dali encountered a problem like this just as Side Mission 2, Nature’s Best Friend, was completed. There was no better time than now. He was invincible in water. He didn’t get a chance to experiment before, but now he swam to his heart’s content.

The water was warm and Hong Dali didn’t feel a bit cold. The buoyancy force was strong, and he could change the current as he wished—All he did was strike a few poses, the force moving him forward was done by the water current in Fengyuan Lake!
The lady was sinking. Hong Dali ferociously dived and quickly saw her.
Her white dress helped him to spot her easily...

Pulling the lady’s hand, Hong Dali dragged her up to the surface. The lackeys then took over and pulled both of them the rest of the way. After about five or six minutes, they were finally safely on land.
Hong Dali had forgotten that someone had pushed him down the water. “Damn, it felt really good swimming! Haha!” All he felt was happiness that he had saved someone today.
Tang Muxin anxiously approached Hong Dali, despite the fact that Hong Dali was all wet. She worriedly asked, “Dali, are you okay? Did you choke on water?”

Hong Dali grinned widely as he replied, “It’s okay, what could happen to me? I was like a fish in the water.” He looked over at the lady and said, “You really jumped in. You scared me so much my heart was in my mouth.”
The lady coughed and hoarsely said, “Why, I can’t die even if I want to?”

Hong Dali thought about it and fished out his mobile phone. He looked at it, not bad, it was indeed worth its price. It survived the swim. He hurriedly said, “Don’t be in such a hurry, let me show you something...”

As he spoke, he looked for a picture of a person who drowned to death and showed it to the lady, saying, “Look. At least your figure looks great now. If you had drowned to death, this is how you’d look...”
Love of beauty was human nature, regardless of whether they were beautiful or ugly.
This lady was already ugly, but she could at least be proud of her figure. Seeing photos of people drowned to death, the lady was finally calm. “If I drown, this is how I will look?”
Hong Dali nodded. “That’s right.”
She was finally scared. “I... I’m not jumping anymore... Thank... Thank you...”
It was a relief to hear that. Hong Dali waved at the bystanders and said, “Everyone can leave. It’s okay now. I’m her brother and I’ve convinced her not to do silly things anymore!”
The bystanders slowly dispersed. Those who had taken off their shirts and prepared to save her didn’t even get to perform CPR. They must have done something wrong.

Hong Dali rubbed his chin. “To be honest, that’s a small matter.” At that moment, one of his lackeys had brought out blankets from the car for them. Hong Dali brought the lady to the car and said, “Actually, you don’t look that bad. It’s just a mark on your face. All you need is surgery. Why take things so hard?”
The lady buried herself in her arms, embarrassed. “Actually, I know that. But I don’t have money...”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers with a pap. “Oh, that’s a small matter. I can sponsor the surgery first. You can follow me in the future. That can be your advance salary.”
She had just escaped from the jaws of death. She would not let go of this chance so easily. “Are... Are you serious? But... I don’t know what I can do...”

Hong Dali didn’t know what she could do either, but he had a feeling she might be useful. He thought long and hard while rubbing his chin before his eyes suddenly lit up. Laughing, he said, “Although I have not thought it through, do whatever you enjoy the most now. Don’t you enjoy drawing? Draw some cartoon characters, anything will do. Draw whatever you feel like drawing!”
The lady was unsure. “Will... that work?” It was no wonder she thought that way, she had lived her whole life in the shadow of bad luck. It was not easy for her to become confident.

Hong Dali laughingly said, “If I say you can do it, then you can do it. Don’t overthink matters. Let me send you to Ye Lai Xiang. You can spend a night there. Tomorrow, look for Zhang Cai at Chenhui Building. Tell her I sent you. En, there might be a medical team at home. Let me find out more. You can start on your drawings first.”

He had intended to bring the lady home, but he suddenly remembered being pushed into the lake earlier. Hence, he changed his mind suddenly. Before he found out everything about the lady, he should not invite her home.

At this moment, the lady finally realized who this man standing in front of her was. “Oh, thank you, Young Master. You must be Young Master Hong Dali? I didn’t dare to point you out earlier, but only recognized you from your car now.”
Hong Dali chuckled. “That’s right, hehe. What’s your name?”
The lady finally introduced herself. “My name is Zishan, Jin Zishan!” Tears flow down her cheeks. “Young Master Dali, I, I, can I really do it?
Hong Dali roared with laughter. “Of course, you can! There is no limit to one’s dreams. It’s for eternity, and will never end. Hahahaha!”
She covered her mouth gently, her voice muffled from crying. “Young Master Dali...”
Tang Muxin was also moved to tears. “Dali...”
Driver Wang Mingyu nodded discreetly. “Young Master Dali, you have grown. Haha.”
Old Master and Madam will be happy to hear what happened tonight.
Now that everything had come to an end, the jam was eased. Hong Dali sent Jin Zishan to Ye Lai Xiang to settle her down.
On the way home, Wang Mingyu gently said, “Young Master Dali, this Jin Zishan...”

Hong Dali laughed. “En, I know. Do a simple background check. She has a unique feature, it shouldn’t be too hard to find out. What concerns me more is the person that pushed me into the water. I need to know who that is.”
Wang Mingyu awkwardly said, “I understand. I’m sure someone was trying to be funny, but in that situation, it wouldn’t be easy to find the person that pushed Young Master.”

Hong Dali mumbled, “En, just try your best. I was too careless today. It seems many have found out about my improved health and are anxious to do something to me. I’m just wondering where this person could be from...”

Wang Mingyu said, “Both is possible. Old Master has been in the industry for years and is bound to have made some enemies. Young Master Dali is Old Master’s only weakness. It’s impossible for the enemies to be unaware of your existence. Pardon me, but if anything happened to Young Master Dali, I’m afraid Old Master would...”
Hong Dali stretched his body lazily. “I understand. I will be more careful in the future. Aiya, all I want to do is to be a happy prodigal son, spend some money, and walk the dogs as I please.”
With things as such, Wang Mingyu sighed. “The tree stands still but the wind doesn’t stop blowing. It’s inevitable.”

Hong Dali thought about it and decided not to tell his parents about this matter. “Alright, Uncle Wang, let’s not mention this. Don’t tell my parents about this when we get home. No point making them worry for nothing. It won’t be easy to find the culprit. If they know about this, they are bound to lose sleep over it. I will be careful.”
Wang Mingyu agreed with Hong Dali and nodded his heard. “Okay, I understand, Young Master Dali.”
Back in the Hong Manor, Hong Dali ran through the door and up the stairs. “Mother, I’m home. My clothes are wet, I’ll go change first.”

Lan Ruoxi was sitting on the sofa, drinking tea and reading newspapers. “Aiyo, what happened to you?” She got anxious when she heard Hong Dali and quickly asked Wang Mingyu, “Old Wang, what happened? Why are Dali’s clothes wet?”
Wang Mingyu explained the situation about Jin Zishan. “It’s like this, Young Master Dali met a lady by the lake who was trying to commit suicide and saved her.”
Lan Ruoxi was scared to death. “He saved her!? Can he swim? Did he choke?”
Wang Mingyu smiled as he said, “Young Master Dali is good at swimming. I’m not his match in the water.”

Hearing what happened from Wang Mingyu, Lan Ruoxi took a deep breath. “This little rascal is trying to scare me to death.” She thought about it again and instructed Wang Mingyu. “Someone harboring evil intentions might have seen him when he saved the lady. You have to follow him closely these few days in case anything happens.”
“I understand, Madam, please rest assured.”

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - Good Luck
paragraphs: Speaking up to this point, Hong Dali had changed his clothes and come down, exclaiming as he walked. “Mum, can our family medical team do plastic surgery?”

“Oh my, our little prodigal has become so capable, he even knows how to swim now. I heard that you’ve even done a pretty good job at doing so?” The moment she saw Hong Dali come down, a smile appeared in Lan Ruoxi’s eyes, as she walked forward to hold Hong Dali’s hand. “You’ve even learned to boldly do what is righteous, you’ve really grown, hehe.”

“Actually, it was just a coincidence that I encountered that situation, and I couldn’t possibly have turned a blind eye and not saved her, right?” Hong Dali rubbed his nose. “Mum, you haven’t answered. Can our family medical team do plastic surgery?”

“It can definitely do plastic surgery, no problem at all.” Hong Weiguo smiled as he came out of the study room. “Dali, next time you encounter this kind of situation, don’t do anything personally. It’s good enough that you have the heart to do so since there’s actually no difference between either you or your men saving her. I’m not saying this because we’re seeing ourselves as superior to others, but it’s because your body has just recovered and it still lacks energy, so saving her by yourself could be dangerous for you.”

“Okay, I understand, hehe.” Hong Dali smiled and said, “Sister Jin Zishan is actually quite pretty, it’s just that the birthmark in the middle of her face is a tad too large. I’m planning to remove that birthmark, then that will make her look better, and she won’t be so unlucky anymore.”

In Hong Dali’s view, the main reason why Jin Zishan was so unlucky was that the birthmark was in the wrong place. Should the birthmark be removed, that will definitely improve the situation from a bad to a good one—since her figure was definitely of the first rank.
“Jin Zishan? ‘Jinzi’(Gold) Shan(Mountain)?” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly. “The luck brought by the person found by our Dali is indeed not too bad!”

“Huh?” Oh right, now that he had mentioned that, it really seemed like it! Hong Dali was rather happy as well. “Dad, in that case, I won’t follow up on Sister Zishan’s issue, okay? I’m sleepy, so I’ll go to sleep now!”

“Okay, go ahead, I’ll get someone to contact her tomorrow.” Hong Weiguo nodded. Only after Dali had returned upstairs to sleep did Hong Weiguo smilingly say to Lan Ruoxi, “The person Dali has found seems to be rather useless to us. It’s just that I’m rather curious what this Jin Zishan can do.”
“Me too.” Lan Ruoxi nodded and said, “Let’s wait and see.”
During the next few days, the storm ofUnexpectedly! started to rage once again!
“Unexpectedly! has released episode two. Brothers, let’s quickly download it!”
“Really? I’ve waited two full weeks for that! The wait almost killed me! Quick, let’s go!”
“Episode two is so good as usual. Brothers, let’s go!”

“‘I believe that it won’t take much time before I get promoted to general manager with a pay raise, get appointed as CEO, marry a Bai Fumei, and advance towards the peak of my life. Just thinking of that makes me a little excited, hahaha!’ This statement is just too awesome!”

During the next few days, whether it was Xinhai Weibo, Sangle Forum, or a sharing between friends, the downloading counts of episode two ofUnexpectedly!, which was put on So Cool video-sharing website’s top advertisement, increased at a speed which was literally insane, right until it reached the top ten of the downloading charts.

After which, within only a day, it went up again to Number Six, with the top three placings going to Li Nianwei’s concert, episode one ofUnexpectedly!, as well as episodes one, two and three of I Am a Singer, respectively.
The entire entertainment business industry was stunned.

The record of the number of total downloads on So Cool video-sharing website was constantly being broken, and the cruel part of the game was that, though the top six videos were all Hong Dali’s works, under the column of “production company,” however, it stated Caiwei Entertainment.

The fame of Caiwei Entertainment swept the entire entertainment business, as numerous famous artistes wanted to sign a contract with Caiwei Entertainment, and numerous artistes that wanted to get famous came to beg for contracts with Cai Wei Entertainment, while numerous fans gathered daily at the lobby of Chenhui Building.
Sweep through all the charts!
This was the current momentum of the current Caiwei Entertainment.
Numerous entertainment companies were having meetings, and the goal of these meetings was entirely that of the programmes produced by Hong Dali.
Many people felt dejected after they compared themselves to the prodigal Hong Dali and suddenly realized that they didn’t know how to spend money at all.
On the other hand, there were numerous people celebrating with joy, as they could shoot to fame once their programmes had the slightest reference to Hong Dali’s.
The main page of Caiwei Entertainment, in the meantime, was flooded with comments in the comments section, increasing at a speed of tens of thousands of comments per day.
“It’s just too good to watch! I’ve watched many times, and I’m confident that Young Master’s production works are definitely of top quality!”
“These videos are all classics, whoever manages to produce this programme is definitely a genius!”
“Please accept my knee for the year!”
“This is the rhythm of huge fame!”
WhileUnexpectedly! was sweeping the charts, on Tuesday, June 15, the fourth stage of I Am a Singer also had its grand opening.
A shocking opening, cool lightings, an explosive live broadcast, absolutely everything was so astonishing.
Today, especially, since it was the second round of the finals, it attracted practically everyone’s attention.
The reason being that, in this episode, another singer would be eliminated.

The entire Fourth Loop Stadium was filled with a greatly anticipating atmosphere. The audiences screamed wildly to cheer their favorite singers on, and the seven singers also gave their best and tried hard to adjust their state of mind.
The first to perform was Chu Zhongqin.

He walked to the side of the stage and stopped there, raising his head and slightly glancing at Hong Dali who was far away in the VIP room, with a relaxed expression in his eyes and brimming with confidence.
This time, he wouldn’t have anything to worry about anymore. He only needed to perform the song to perfection, and that was enough. He believed that he was the shiniest star in the sky.
“Ruoyu, what placing do you think he will get this time?” The manager in Jiang Ruoyu’s room smilingly asked as he watched from the television screen.

“If it was in the past, I couldn’t tell for sure. But this time,” Jiang Ruoyu stared at the television screen, her eyes filled with the desire towards music. “he will be Number One, the absolute Number One.”
“It can’t be, right? Are you that sure?” The manager exclaimed in surprise.
“It’s because this song of his was what Young Master gave him to perform.” Jiang Ruoyu said, “Dali will definitely produce a miracle, I’m sure of this.”
Off the stage.
“The performance of this Chu Zhongqin for the first two episodes was only mediocre, this time it must be so stressful for him to be the first to perform.”
“Sigh, who says it won’t be? Though he definitely has the skills, the others in this show are all nothing but ferocious, it won’t be easy if he wants to break through.”
“Yes, this competition is too stressful and cruel... However, it’s not the first or second time they have been in this competition, so Chu Zhongqin shouldn’t mess it up this time, right?”
“We can’t say for sure, can’t say for sure.”
At this point in time, the audiences offstage were all engaged in discussions.

Chu Zhongqin’s ability was, of course, still very high, but it was just that everyone’s ability was equally as high. Without exaggerating, as long as the performance of the song faltered even by the slightest bit, that was the end of the competition for him.
As Chu Zhongqin stood at the center of the stage, looking down at the numerous heads offstage, he didn’t feel the slightest pressure.
He knew better than anyone else how nice “Never Left” given by Young Master sounded. Without exaggerating, once this song was truly completed, he had a certain type of feeling.
Every single time, he was touched by the melody of this song. He felt that it was a bliss to be able to encounter and sing this song in his lifetime, no matter how many times he sang it.
The entire site became silent instantly.
Chu Zhongqin, at this point in time, could see neither the worried stares of the audiences nor the gloating expressions of those audiences who did not like him.
With great fame comes great complications, Chu Zhongqin knew this long ago.

He had already closed his eyes, thus ignoring the discussions and noise offstage. Now, all he wanted to do was to fully enjoy his moment on stage, as well as the touching emotions this song had given to him. That was enough.
Music sounded.
The light from the projection appeared.
The surrounding lightings were all concentrated on him.
“I have loved, and lost, and tasted the sweet and tart parts of love, escaping from the irony of destiny, I know what I desire...”

His deep yet bright voice resounded throughout the entire Fourth Loop Stadium. Instantly, it became totally silent, with only his voice reaching the hearts of the audiences. The audiences offstage closed their eyes, slightly pressing their lips as if their emotions had already entered his voice.
“There is an indescribable state, made up of all the emotions blended together, why would I want to have needless thoughts, what in this world is there to be proud of...”
No applause, no cheering, absolutely nothing.
However, there were quite a number of people on site who were crying, with the muscles on their faces twitching, as they smacked their thighs with much force.
Chu Zhongqin’s singing had reached the audiences’ hearts directly, those feelings of gentleness, the baring of one’s troubles, shot to the sky along with his voice.
“Without you, I eye the peak from afar, but I miss the turning road, looking back, I then realize that you were waiting for me, and never left...
“I have searched for the ends of the sea, but neglected the meandering rivers, when I row my boat against the currents, you were by my side, pushing me on...”
Everyone was stunned.
The music producer of Ku Ge Music, Sheng Wenshi, couldn’t believe what he was hearing—this song, why hadn’t he heard it before?
Such a nice song, how could he not have heard it before?!

However, all these no longer mattered, there was a surge of tumultuous emotion within Sheng Wenshi. He originally came today just to experience the explosive live but did not think of receiving something so unexpected.
“All emotions that tie me down don’t mean anything anymore, baby, may you be the crux of my world, I’m happy when you’re happy, sad when you’re sad...”
If the voice at the beginning was only a gentle baring of the soul, then towards the end, it could only be described as tumultuous and grand!
Numerous audiences couldn’t even come to terms with themselves while hearing the music, never have they felt the great impact that could be brought about by singing.

All the music production companies at the site tried to find out from one another, but alas, realized that nobody had heard this song before. When Sheng Wenshi came to a sudden realization that this song was possibly written by Young Master, all the music production companies were stunned.
Who would have thought that Hong Dali, who claimed to be the Number One prodigal, could have this type of talent?
However, with the preceding Li Nianwei’s Rolling up the Beaded Curtain, the ability to write such a song, thus, was nothing too extraordinary.

“Right here right now, let’s lift up our heads together, and welcome the descent of love, the sunlight proves that this is not mere fantasy, right now, close your eyes to experience wholeheartedly, a voice that is speaking of love...
“Never left—”
The voice slowly trailed off and vanished.

Towards the end, right up until Chu Zhongqin bowed to the audiences and left the stage, did the audiences completely react, and the already emotional audiences wildly shook their fists and poured their entire energy into screaming...
“‘Never Left’!” Sheng Wenshi repeatedly smacked his thighs. “This song must be called ‘Never Left’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - System Upgrade
paragraphs: In the VIP room, Hong Dali’s classmates listened and stared in bewilderment, and it took them a full three to four minutes to regain their composure.
“Dali!” Ling Yi violently grabbed Dali’s arm and loudly exclaimed. “This song is called Never Left, right? He’s definitely going to get first place, right?!”
“Of course.” Hong Dali giggled. “Of course, it’s the first place.”
In this episode of I Am a Singer, after the final results were released, as expected, Chu Zhongqin clinched first place with a huge advantage over the others.
There was absolutely no suspense.

Even when Zhang Cai announced that Chu Zhongqin was going to Merika to host I Am a Singer when the episode was ending, numerous audiences present bawled their eyes out, hoping that Chu Zhongqin would stay.
Even if it was to solely this song every single time, they still were willing to listen to him.
Chu Zhongqin, who had previously felt so nervous and skeptical on this stage, finally had his due recognition.

“Ah, today felt so satisfying.” After the fourth stage of I Am a Singer had finished, Hong Dali stood up and stretched. While he was taking in deep breaths, all of a sudden, a ray of golden light emerged from throughout his body. Then, Hong Dali heard a mechanic voice—
“The total attribute points of the host has increased to the full 100 points. System will start the upgrade now.
“Upgrading in progress, please wait...”
“What? What the heck, the System has upgraded in the span of a few days when I wasn’t even paying attention to it? Seems that the money spent is enough already!
“My Strength has finally reached 100!”
Hong Dali closed his eyes to feel it properly, heh! His whole body was filled with energy! Awesome! Satisfying!
Soon, the mechanic voice sounded again—
“Great Prodigal System, upgrade successful, currently host has successfully upgraded from an rookie prodigal to an elementary-level prodigal.”
Wahahaha, my prodigal title can actually be upgraded? Cool!
Hong Dali was very happy. Seems like that thing behind the System was really awesome!
The System continued—

“Elementary-level prodigal, for every one million yuan squandered, host will be rewarded an attribute point. The previous amount of money squandered will be completely cleared out, and everything will be counted from zero.
“Main mission: Welfare for elementary-level prodigal. Mission details: Host gets to exchange a set of welfare side branch for every ten attribute points used.
“Welfare side branch is separated into three choices: ‘Technology’, ‘Skill’ and ‘Survival,’ respectively.
“Mission Requirement: Squander ten million yuan within two weeks. Worth five attribute points. Penalty for failure: Minus ten attribute points from sexual capability.
“After host is done with exchanging a type of welfare side branch, he can continue using the attribute points to exchange welfare information in detail.”

[Side Mission 1 (Upgraded): The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Unknown. Current Progress: 0/100. Reward: The upgraded title “Animal’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Host can easily control animals until fifty kilograms in weight. Title Level: Level Two. Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed. Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]

[Side Mission 2 (Upgraded): Nature’s Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Unknown. Current Progress: 0/100. Mission Reward: The upgraded title of “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to be immune from a certain type of natural disaster(Reward according to how the mission is completed). Title Level: Level Two. Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed. Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
What the...
Hong Dali’s eyes opened so wide that they seemed to almost pop out. There was only one attribute point rewarded after upgrading once and directly becoming one million yuan?
Upon reaching here, Hong Dali’s palms were soaked with sweat.

Not to mention others, but these three exchange subsidiaries alone already demanded thirty million! Which meant that the squanderer method of transmigration previously could only be counted as a starter?
Moreover, this was only opening the side branch, and it was hard to say how much the exchange afterward would be!
Moreover, this was only the elementary stage of being a prodigal, looks like in the future...

Moreover, there was also a Main Mission, squander ten million yuan in two weeks! Minus ten attribute points from sexual capability upon failure! What the heck, I definitely cannot fail this, who knows whether the sexual capability can increase after being deducted!

“Okay, then.” Hong Dali let out a long sigh. “Looks like I’ve gone too far this time, haha! I’ll fight with all my might! Right, when Xiaoyi comes back, I’ll ask her to consolidate how much money I have already.”
After which, while he was still thinking, there was a knock on the door all of a sudden. Hong Dali recovered from his thoughts and said, “Come in.”
The door of the VIP room slowly opened, and two people walked in.
Everyone was stunned upon seeing them.
After a slight daze, following it were shouts of joy all around. “It’s Sister Xiaoyi! Sister Xiaoyi has come back! Hahaha!”
Ling Xiaoyi, she was so capable of helping Hong Dali out with his problems, just like a big sister, and she was finally back!
Smilingly following her from the back with eyes filled with admiration and worship, naturally, was her brother, Ling Mufeng!

“Sister Xiaoyi, hahaha, you’re finally back!” Hong Dali went forward to welcome her and plunged his head into her arms, his head desperately fidgeting. “Hahaha! Sister Xiaoyi, you’re finally back. I almost died of desperation when you weren’t around, and I couldn’t do anything well!”
“Young Master...” Just as she opened her mouth to speak, Ling Xiaoyi was already sobbing. “Young Master, during these days when I wasn’t around, you, have you been well?”

“It was still alright, it had to be alright!” Hong Dali grinned as he pulled Ling Xiaoyi to sit down, and Tang Muxin even personally sliced an apple for Ling Xiaoyi. “Sister Xiaoyi, during this period of time you were not around, we all missed you so much.” As she spoke, she looked towards Ling Mufeng. “Brother Mufeng, are things alright now?”
Hong Dali’s friends naturally knew about the incident of Ling Mufeng being conned, and upon seeing him arrive together with Ling Xiaoyi, he should have recovered from that incident.
As expected, Ling Mufeng deeply bowed towards Hong Dali, before saying, “I’m fine now, there’s no issue now. Young Master Dali, thank you. I can’t repay you enough for your kindness.”
“Why are you so polite?” Hong Dali grinned and said. “We’re all family, quickly have a seat, it’s good enough that you’ve recovered.”

Ling Mufeng promptly found a seat and sat down, saying, “Young Master Dali, about me eating that thing, our whole school had come to know about that, I’m scared that my classmates will laugh at me after I return to school. Moreover, I’ve thought for a good while during this period of time, and it just happened that my elder sister said that you, Young Master Dali, have a school of your own, so I was thinking..”

“Call me Young Master, same as your elder sister.” Hong Dali thought for a while and asked, “You want to study at the school I’ve opened? Mm, that’s a pretty good idea too. And we need some men there as well, so you can study while helping out with some tasks. Not bad, not bad.”

Ling Xiaoyi at the side said, “Young Master, why not ask Mufeng to teach English or something, his English is not too bad. And in the future, when the school starts accepting students, it’ll need English teachers as well, so why not let him teach for some time first.”
Mm, that’s true, and he could ask him to keep a lookout as well to divert his attention... it would be best if he had people around him to report any emergency situation discovered.

“Okay! Let’s do that, then!” Hong Dali agreed on the spot. “Let’s set off now, then! Sister Xiaoyi has brought Mufeng back today, we should properly celebrate that! Let’s go to Hung Lung Hotel! Brothers, let’s go!”
Xiaoyi was back, of course, that was to be properly celebrated!
There was a loud response from everyone, and they giggled and grinned as they fetched their cars and called the others, and not long after, all of them gathered at the front door of Hung Lung Hotel.
Speaking of which, this was still his territory, but he hadn’t really come back to have a look for a long time.

Hong Dali, along with his lackeys in full force, proudly entered the hotel, and the welcoming staff, as well as other staff, immediately exclaimed in unison upon seeing Hong Dali. “Good evening, Young Master!” This was their God of Fortune, they had to please him with all their might no matter what!

Today, the fourth stage of I Am a Singer has achieved great success, the Great Prodigal System has been upgraded, Xiaoyi has come back, I’m so happy today! Thus, Hong Dali waved his hand and said, “Reward for all, everyone will get 1,000!”
The lackeys immediately came forward to count the money.
Ling Xiaoyi, who was following behind, smiled and said, “Young Master still hasn’t changed at all.”
After rewarding the tips, everyone was happy, and Hong Dali asked, “Is there any large private room available? I want the biggest one!”

“There is!” Service was, of course, up to standard after the tips were received, and five waiters came to the front to clear up and lead the way, with their mouths grinning almost up to their ears—they really only had to throw petals while walking already...
They reached the largest National Dinner room in no time. Hong Dali went in and glanced through, before nodding his head in satisfaction. “Not bad, this room is good!”
Could it not be good? This room could well occupy up to over a hundred people without it being too squeezy!

“Get me all the best dishes, and serve some good wine as well.” Hong Dali was really happy today, happier than the day of his adult ceremony. Thus, this lad decided to drink less wine and enjoy it to the fullest. “We’ve got to celebrate today well. Everyone, drink some wine, after which you can either sleep here or go to Ye Lai Xiang!”
These two places were both his anyway, thus everyone naturally agreed.

Just as they sat down, Li Nianwei, Zhang Cai, as well as both master and disciple—Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang—all arrived, and the entire room was filled with a passionate atmosphere. As the saying went, people were in high spirits when involved in happy events. Once the atmosphere became good, everyone naturally started to demand wine.
Hong Dali was so happy, drink!
Tang Muxin sat by his side and softly reminded him. “Dali, your body is not that well, stop drinking.”

“How can I!” Hong Dali beamed with delight as he poured a glass of beer for himself. “It’s a happy day today, I have to drink! No worries, I’ll just drink... three glasses! Just three glasses of beer, and I’ll go home to sleep! Okay?”
Three glasses, and that was beer, Tang Muxin thought for a while and mumbled. “That... should be alright...”
From what the small lass knew, drinking three glasses of beer should not be a big issue. After which she regretted it.
It was not a big issue to others, but it was an issue to Dali, for he got drunk after gulping down three glasses of beer...

The easiest type of situation was someone immediately falling asleep after getting drunk. For some people, they tend to talk too much after drinking too much, and that was fine as well. Then there was the type of people who enjoyed making a big ruckus after drinking too much—that was the most troublesome type.

But Hong Dali was none of those types of people—this lad had a special trademark; after he had too much to drink, and that was to be completely alert, with little to speak, not sleeping, not creating havoc, but just swaying from left to right!
When he sat, he would start to sway from left to right, and when he stood up to walk, it was an S shape...

Actually, that was not a big issue initially, but the problem was that not long after Hong Dali drank, two smartly dressed men came in from the main entrance of the room, and, upon seeing Hong Dali, politely said, “Young Master Dali, the family meeting will start tomorrow. The Big Elder has tasked us with fetching you there to rest, to avoid being late tomorrow. The helicopter is already on standby, please come with us now, Young Master Dali.”

sentences.text: In the VIP room, Hong Dali’s classmates listened and stared in bewilderment, and it took them a full three to four minutes to regain their composure.
“Dali!” Ling Yi violently grabbed Dali’s arm and loudly exclaimed.
“This song is called Never Left, right?
He’s definitely going to get first place, right?!”
“Of course.” Hong Dali giggled.
“Of course, it’s the first place.”
In this episode of I Am a Singer, after the final results were released, as expected, Chu Zhongqin clinched first place with a huge advantage over the others.
There was absolutely no suspense.

Even when Zhang Cai announced that Chu Zhongqin was going to Merika to host I Am a Singer when the episode was ending, numerous audiences present bawled their eyes out, hoping that Chu Zhongqin would stay.
Even if it was to solely this song every single time, they still were willing to listen to him.
Chu Zhongqin, who had previously felt so nervous and skeptical on this stage, finally had his due recognition.
“Ah, today felt so satisfying.” After the fourth stage of I Am a Singer had finished, Hong Dali stood up and stretched.
While he was taking in deep breaths, all of a sudden, a ray of golden light emerged from throughout his body.
Then, Hong Dali heard a mechanic voice—
“The total attribute points of the host has increased to the full 100 points.
System will start the upgrade now.
“Upgrading in progress, please wait...”
“What?
What the heck, the System has upgraded in the span of a few days when I wasn’t even paying attention to it?
Seems that the money spent is enough already!
“My Strength has finally reached 100!”
Hong Dali closed his eyes to feel it properly, heh!
His whole body was filled with energy!
Awesome!
Satisfying!
Soon, the mechanic voice sounded again—
“Great Prodigal System, upgrade successful, currently host has successfully upgraded from an rookie prodigal to an elementary-level prodigal.”
Wahahaha, my prodigal title can actually be upgraded?
Cool!
Hong Dali was very happy.
Seems like that thing behind the System was really awesome!
The System continued—
“Elementary-level prodigal, for every one million yuan squandered, host will be rewarded an attribute point.
The previous amount of money squandered will be completely cleared out, and everything will be counted from zero.
“Main mission: Welfare for elementary-level prodigal.
Mission details: Host gets to exchange a set of welfare side branch for every ten attribute points used.
“Welfare side branch is separated into three choices: ‘Technology’, ‘Skill’ and ‘Survival,’ respectively.
“Mission Requirement: Squander ten million yuan within two weeks.
Worth five attribute points.
Penalty for failure: Minus ten attribute points from sexual capability.
“After host is done with exchanging a type of welfare side branch, he can continue using the attribute points to exchange welfare information in detail.”
[Side Mission 1 (Upgraded): The Caring Little Prodigal.
Mission Requirement: Unknown.
Current Progress: 0/100.
Reward: The upgraded title “Animal’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Host can easily control animals until fifty kilograms in weight.
Title Level: Level Two.
Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed.
Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
[Side Mission 2 (Upgraded): Nature’s Little Prodigal.
Mission Requirement: Unknown.
Current Progress: 0/100.

Mission Reward: The upgraded title of “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to be immune from a certain type of natural disaster(Reward according to how the mission is completed).
Title Level: Level Two.
Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed.
Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
What the...
Hong Dali’s eyes opened so wide that they seemed to almost pop out.
There was only one attribute point rewarded after upgrading once and directly becoming one million yuan?
Upon reaching here, Hong Dali’s palms were soaked with sweat.
Not to mention others, but these three exchange subsidiaries alone already demanded thirty million!
Which meant that the squanderer method of transmigration previously could only be counted as a starter?
Moreover, this was only opening the side branch, and it was hard to say how much the exchange afterward would be!
Moreover, this was only the elementary stage of being a prodigal, looks like in the future...
Moreover, there was also a Main Mission, squander ten million yuan in two weeks!
Minus ten attribute points from sexual capability upon failure!
What the heck, I definitely cannot fail this, who knows whether the sexual capability can increase after being deducted!
“Okay, then.” Hong Dali let out a long sigh.
“Looks like I’ve gone too far this time, haha!
I’ll fight with all my might!
Right, when Xiaoyi comes back, I’ll ask her to consolidate how much money I have already.”
After which, while he was still thinking, there was a knock on the door all of a sudden.
Hong Dali recovered from his thoughts and said, “Come in.”
The door of the VIP room slowly opened, and two people walked in.
Everyone was stunned upon seeing them.
After a slight daze, following it were shouts of joy all around.
“It’s Sister Xiaoyi!
Sister Xiaoyi has come back!
Hahaha!”
Ling Xiaoyi, she was so capable of helping Hong Dali out with his problems, just like a big sister, and she was finally back!
Smilingly following her from the back with eyes filled with admiration and worship, naturally, was her brother, Ling Mufeng!
“Sister Xiaoyi, hahaha, you’re finally back!” Hong Dali went forward to welcome her and plunged his head into her arms, his head desperately fidgeting.
“Hahaha!
Sister Xiaoyi, you’re finally back.
I almost died of desperation when you weren’t around, and I couldn’t do anything well!”
“Young Master...” Just as she opened her mouth to speak, Ling Xiaoyi was already sobbing.
“Young Master, during these days when I wasn’t around, you, have you been well?”
“It was still alright, it had to be alright!” Hong Dali grinned as he pulled Ling Xiaoyi to sit down, and Tang Muxin even personally sliced an apple for Ling Xiaoyi.
“Sister Xiaoyi, during this period of time you were not around, we all missed you so much.” As she spoke, she looked towards Ling Mufeng.
“Brother Mufeng, are things alright now?”
Hong Dali’s friends naturally knew about the incident of Ling Mufeng being conned, and upon seeing him arrive together with Ling Xiaoyi, he should have recovered from that incident.
As expected, Ling Mufeng deeply bowed towards Hong Dali, before saying, “I’m fine now, there’s no issue now.
Young Master Dali, thank you.
I can’t repay you enough for your kindness.”
“Why are you so polite?” Hong Dali grinned and said.
“We’re all family, quickly have a seat, it’s good enough that you’ve recovered.”

Ling Mufeng promptly found a seat and sat down, saying, “Young Master Dali, about me eating that thing, our whole school had come to know about that, I’m scared that my classmates will laugh at me after I return to school.
Moreover, I’ve thought for a good while during this period of time, and it just happened that my elder sister said that you, Young Master Dali, have a school of your own, so I was thinking..”
“Call me Young Master, same as your elder sister.” Hong Dali thought for a while and asked, “You want to study at the school I’ve opened?
Mm, that’s a pretty good idea too.
And we need some men there as well, so you can study while helping out with some tasks.
Not bad, not bad.”
Ling Xiaoyi at the side said, “Young Master, why not ask Mufeng to teach English or something, his English is not too bad.
And in the future, when the school starts accepting students, it’ll need English teachers as well, so why not let him teach for some time first.”
Mm, that’s true, and he could ask him to keep a lookout as well to divert his attention... it would be best if he had people around him to report any emergency situation discovered.
“Okay!
Let’s do that, then!” Hong Dali agreed on the spot.
“Let’s set off now, then!
Sister Xiaoyi has brought Mufeng back today, we should properly celebrate that!
Let’s go to Hung Lung Hotel!
Brothers, let’s go!”
Xiaoyi was back, of course, that was to be properly celebrated!
There was a loud response from everyone, and they giggled and grinned as they fetched their cars and called the others, and not long after, all of them gathered at the front door of Hung Lung Hotel.
Speaking of which, this was still his territory, but he hadn’t really come back to have a look for a long time.
Hong Dali, along with his lackeys in full force, proudly entered the hotel, and the welcoming staff, as well as other staff, immediately exclaimed in unison upon seeing Hong Dali.
“Good evening, Young Master!” This was their God of Fortune, they had to please him with all their might no matter what!
Today, the fourth stage of I Am a Singer has achieved great success, the Great Prodigal System has been upgraded, Xiaoyi has come back, I’m so happy today!
Thus, Hong Dali waved his hand and said, “Reward for all, everyone will get 1,000!”
The lackeys immediately came forward to count the money.
Ling Xiaoyi, who was following behind, smiled and said, “Young Master still hasn’t changed at all.”
After rewarding the tips, everyone was happy, and Hong Dali asked, “Is there any large private room available?
I want the biggest one!”

“There is!” Service was, of course, up to standard after the tips were received, and five waiters came to the front to clear up and lead the way, with their mouths grinning almost up to their ears—they really only had to throw petals while walking already...
They reached the largest National Dinner room in no time.
Hong Dali went in and glanced through, before nodding his head in satisfaction.
“Not bad, this room is good!”
Could it not be good?
This room could well occupy up to over a hundred people without it being too squeezy!
“Get me all the best dishes, and serve some good wine as well.” Hong Dali was really happy today, happier than the day of his adult ceremony.
Thus, this lad decided to drink less wine and enjoy it to the fullest.
“We’ve got to celebrate today well.
Everyone, drink some wine, after which you can either sleep here or go to Ye Lai Xiang!”
These two places were both his anyway, thus everyone naturally agreed.
Just as they sat down, Li Nianwei, Zhang Cai, as well as both master and disciple—Mu Zixiao and Geezer Wang—all arrived, and the entire room was filled with a passionate atmosphere.
As the saying went, people were in high spirits when involved in happy events.
Once the atmosphere became good, everyone naturally started to demand wine.
Hong Dali was so happy, drink!
Tang Muxin sat by his side and softly reminded him.
“Dali, your body is not that well, stop drinking.”
“How can I!” Hong Dali beamed with delight as he poured a glass of beer for himself.
“It’s a happy day today, I have to drink!
No worries, I’ll just drink... three glasses!
Just three glasses of beer, and I’ll go home to sleep!
Okay?”
Three glasses, and that was beer, Tang Muxin thought for a while and mumbled.

After which she regretted it.
It was not a big issue to others, but it was an issue to Dali, for he got drunk after gulping down three glasses of beer...

Actually, that was not a big issue initially, but the problem was that not long after Hong Dali drank, two smartly dressed men came in from the main entrance of the room, and, upon seeing Hong Dali, politely said, “Young Master Dali, the family meeting will start tomorrow.
The Big Elder has tasked us with fetching you there to rest, to avoid being late tomorrow.
The helicopter is already on standby, please come with us now, Young Master Dali.”

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - Family Meeting (Part One)
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, Tang Muxin who had been supporting Hong Dali, knew that things had gone wrong.

She knew Hong Dali’s character very well. If it were the usual joking around, he, of course, couldn’t be concerned. But what kind of place was the family meeting? That was a tradition passed on since many years ago, and it was where the young descendants of the Hong Family were trained.
Tang Muxin’s grandfather had quite a long history with the current Big Elder Hong Tu, and she recalled the Hong Family meeting had been mentioned back then by her grandfather.

Moreover, it was said that the Hong Family did not feed idle people. If Hong Dali was to go just like that... not to mention about others, solely having those young descendants who were jealous of Hong Dali’s family background to mock and ridicule him was not entirely impossible.
Especially that Hong Anbao and that Hong Ancheng they had seen just once previously.
With even both of them behaving that way, there was no need to mention the other descendants of the family.

While Tang Muxin was having such a dilemma, Hong Dali, instead, was wobbling and looking at those two people, grinning as he said, “What family meeting, I’m not going. You go just go back and tell him that I’m not feeling well.”
He was an infamous prodigal anyway, so going to that kind of place would only make him unwelcomed by the others.
There would neither be any good dinner nor meeting there. Naturally, it was best not to go.

“This...” Those two people were put into an awkward situation. “We don’t call the shots, Young Master Dali. Why don’t you just make a trip back with us and just treat it as some time to relax. Once you’ve arrived there, you can just ask for permission from Big Elder and come back, what do you think?”
Hong Dali was greatly displeased. “Can’t I not attend it? This family meeting can still go on without me.”

It was actually understandable why he said that. Hong Weiguo had always wanted him to be happy just as he was, thus, he did not explain about the family meeting to Dali in detail. According to Hong Weiguo’s plan previously, Hong Dali only had to make an appearance for a while there, and anyway, there wouldn’t be any loss suffered by him doing so. There was no big issue with that, and thus, no need for him to explain any details to Dali.

Hong Dali was too lazy to move as well, for he desired neither fame nor fortune, and there was not much for him to speak with those fellow descendants who were green with envy. Instead, he would be unable to avoid all kinds of mockery and sarcasm against him. Thus, he would naturally not want to go.

However, those two people who came to fetch him had no right to decide whether he could miss the meeting, so they pleaded. “Young Master Dali, please don’t make things difficult for us. To be honest with you, the two of us are just the messengers. If you refuse to go, we’ll be fired for sure. Actually, it’s not so much whether we’d be fired, but the problem is that there will still be people coming to fetch you after us, and it will be worse if it’s an elder from the family.”
Oh right, if they were to return, suppose the family insisted on getting him to go for the meeting, they would still have to send someone else here instead.
Should that person sent here be an elder whom he did not like, that would spell trouble for certain.

Fine, he’d just go then. Fortunately, Hong Dali didn’t have too much to drink yet, so he swayed just a little while standing up. “I’ll make a trip there, then, it’s not a big issue anyway. Brothers, just continue drinking first, I’ll be back shortly!”

His words sounded as if he were Li Kui from “Water Margin” who was going out to kill someone—”Brothers! Feel free to drink some wine fist, I’ll be back shortly, after which I’ll drink heartily with you, my brothers!” After which Li Kui took two axes and went off to chop someone’s head off...

Hong Dali’s friends were naturally not worried about him, but Tang Muxin couldn’t bear to leave him alone and anxiously said, “Dali, look at how drunk you are. I’ll accompany you, I’m don’t feel safe letting you go alone!”
“Then, let’s go together, together!” Hong Dali laughed heartily. “Sister Nianwei and Sister Xiaoyi are going too, let’s go!”
Those two people who came to fetch him hastily said, “Young Master Dali, this is a family meeting, outsiders are not allowed to enter...”

“What does that have to do with me?” Hong Dali was angered upon hearing that. “We’re going together if I’m going. Otherwise, forget about it. I’ll leave it up to you to decide!” He wasn’t close to those descendants of the family anyway, and Hong Dali couldn’t be bothered to form any ties with them, but it was, instead, those around him whom he relied heavily upon. Naturally, they had to go altogether. Moreover, he had a tad too much to drink. So, he couldn’t tell what kind of chaos may ensue should he go alone.

Upon hearing what Hong Dali said, those two people glanced at each other. Fine, just bring them all back, Young Master Dali would be going anyway, so there should not be a big issue with bringing two more people along, they just had to warn them not to play around. They immediately agreed. “Since Young Master Dali has spoken, let’s go now, then.”
“That should be the way.” Hong Dali beamed with delight. “Then, let’s go now!”

A few people went out together at once. During the journey, Tang Muxin, who was worried that Dali didn’t understand the structure of the family meeting, took the time to softly instruct him. “Dali, within your family, Big Elder is called Hong Tu—he’s your grandfather who has some history with my grandfather—Second Elder is called Hong Wei, and Third Elder is called Hong Ying, don’t forget that no matter what. Should you not want to participate in the meeting, just find Big Elder to take your leave.”
“Understood, understood.” Though he was walking in an “S” shaped manner, Hong Dali’s mind was still very alert. “Rest assured, I know what to do.”
They quickly got onto the helicopter, flew towards the north direction throughout, and reached the large-scaled Hong family estate “Forest Capital” in the blink of an eye.
After the helicopter had landed onto the helicopter runway, Hong Dali giddily got off the helicopter... he had gotten a little airsick.

Those two people who came to fetch Hong Dali led him inside. While Hong Dali glanced around while walking, Li Nianwei and Ling Xiaoyi were dumbstruck by what they saw. They only knew that the Hong Family was one of the rare large-scale families in the country, but upon seeing it now, it was still much larger than they had imagined it to be.

There were tens of buildings in sight alone, a swimming pool, table tennis court, movie theater, musical theater, underground wine cellar, and so on, came into their sight. Just this huge construction area alone had to measure up to at least two to three hundred thousand square meters, it was truly absolutely scary.
“Right, do you know where’s my Big Grandfather?” Hong Dali asked as he walked. Since he was here to take leave, of course, he wouldn’t be satisfied with aimlessly walking around the whole area.
“He should be in the big meeting room at this time. Even if he’s not, you should be able to wait for him.” One of the two people replied.
“Then, I’ll go to the big meeting room.” Hong Dali didn’t waste any time. “Let’s go!”
The estate was now filled with quite a number of young people. Once they saw Hong Dali from afar, they made animated gestures, and a voice sounded from afar—
“Quickly look, Hong Dali has come.”
“Hehe, this prodigal, he actually knows how to bring women back, sigh, seriously...”
“That’s Li Nianwei, right? Speaking of which, it’s very possible for Dali to be given a new lease of life this time, those things that he has started up seems rather lucrative.”
“What new lease of life, I heard that Big Uncle had given him over 20 million, how much has he earned back?”
“That’s true, seems like the family meeting this time will be a fun one to watch.”
“Can’t say for sure, I’ll just wait and see, there’ll definitely be a big event coming up tomorrow!”
“Don’t mention tomorrow, I reckon that there’s going to be some fun even in short while later. Look at him walking in that “S” shaped way, he probably had too much to drink, haha!”

The faint sounds of conversations in the surroundings spread to the ears of Hong Dali and the rest. Tang Muxin, while supporting Hong Dali by the arm, made it a point to give a fierce glare at those around. Li Nianwei, on the other hand, along with Ling Xiaoyi, stood behind the two. She knew her own position very well. Over here, she had to tone down on everything and make it her priority to not cause any trouble for Hong Dali.
Everyone walked forward, and in no time, reached the front door of the big meeting room where the family meeting was to be held.
Hong Dali lifted his leg to enter the room but was stopped by the entrance guard, who said, “Young Master Dali can enter, those outsiders are not allowed to enter.”
“Damn!” Hong Dali was greatly angered as he exclaimed. “What kind of rule is this, you’re the outsider, your whole family are outsiders!”
Those two entrance guards were, however, not angered, and they just stood there guarding the door.
At this point of time, Tang Muxin softly spoke. “Dali, it’s fine, we’ll just not enter, you just go in to take leave and come out afterward.”
“Okay then, seriously,” Hong Dali mumbled. “They’re rules all around, it makes people so uncomfortable.”
How would he not enjoy coming, if not for all these? Once he stepped into this place, there were rules everywhere, how was it possible to for him to have fun like that?!
However, just then, an enigmatic voice sounded. “Oh, isn’t it Dali who has come. Why isn’t he going in?”
Hong Dali turned his head to look. The person who had come was evidently gloating, who would it be other than that rotten Hong Anbao?
“Humph, I can’t be bothered with you.” Hong Dali gave off a humph, ignoring Hong Anbao as he entered the room alone.

“Why are you so anxious?” Hong Anbao grinned and went after him, filled with an exceedingly annoying expression. “I haven’t congratulated you properly during your coming of age ceremony that time. It’s such a rare chance to do so today.”

“This is counted as a congratulation. Where’s my Big Grandfather?” Hong Dali didn’t bother to look at him, as he single-mindedly searched for his target, which was Big Elder Hong Tu. He felt completely uncomfortable under this kind of atmosphere, and he only wanted to take leave as soon as possible.

The outside of the conference room where the family meeting was to be held didn’t look that outstanding, and it was after entering the room that he discovered its size was so astoundingly huge. Within the entire meeting hall, the huge wooden table was very round, placed on top of which were various types of fruits, apples, oranges, kiwis, and so on, and quite a number of drinks as well, which made Hong Dali a little hungry just by seeing them.

There were quite a number of descendants coming to help out, but Hong Dali recognized none of them. He reckoned that they were probably not closely related to him as well, seeing their expressions as they busied themselves around. They were probably trying to grab more chances to show off and curry favor from the three elders of the family, which would naturally bring them many benefits.

“Big Elder? I’m not sure?” Hong Anbao followed Hong Dali into the room and sneered. “But to be honest with you, it won’t help even if you want to find Big Elder to make yourself look better. Nevertheless, I admire you very much for your boldness.”

As mentioned in the previous chapter, Hong Dali was perfectly normal after having too much to drink, it was only that he was randomly swaying as he walked. All along, he never liked Hong Anbao, and especially after hearing Hong Anbao’s words, he felt rather offended and thus increased his walking speed. In the end, Hong Anbao caught up closely with him after noticing, and the two of them somehow bumped into each other just like that.

Initially, Hong Dali did not use much force. However, it could be due to Hong Dali’s full attribute strength points or on purpose by Hong Anbao. Anyway, after colliding with each other, Hong Anbao was thrown two meters away accompanied by a scream—landing on the meeting table with athudsound. There wasn’t much harm done to the meeting table since it was made of hardwood. However, the fruit platters on the table were implicated as they fell one by one on the floor.
